title: EAP Clinical Case Specialist
description:
At Uprise Health our Mission is transforming the delivery and accessibility of mental and behavioral healthcare and to bring whole person care to every individual worldwide

Our Values:

Compassion: We demonstrate empathy and understanding towards individuals experiencing mental and behavioral health challenges and foster a culture of care and support within our partnered organizations.

Integrity: We operate with honesty, transparency, and ethical principles in all aspects of service delivery and organizational conduct.

Collaboration: We foster teamwork, communication, and synergy to achieve common goals and maximize collective potential.

Velocity: We are committed to delivering timely and responsive support, ensuring individuals receive the care and resources they need with efficiency and empathy.

Advocacy: We advocate for mental and behavioral health awareness and access to quality care by promoting mental wellness and reducing barriers to treatment.

EAP Clinical Case Specialist will play a key role in the success and continued growth of Claremont/Uprise Health by providing top notch clinical skills and customer service. Our Clinical Case Specialists are empowered to conduct a comprehensive clinical assessment and provide solution-focused guidance, advocacy and support on every call.

This position is required to work Pacific Time Zone Hours from 8 am to 5 pm.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • EAP clinical services experience, including clinical call center operations, case management, crisis response, and employer-based programs.
  • Assess clinical information provided and apply medical necessity criteria.
  • Coordinate behavioral health physician advisor activities as well as consult on cases with medical complications.
  • Coordinate discharge planning needs with facility, health services providers, members and family.
  • Provide care coordination with and facilitate referrals to physical health providers, social services and disability services as needed.
  • Record and resolve member and provider inquiries and complaints in accordance with company policies and procedures for first levels of appeals.
  • Triage calls from members in crisis and assist to ensure safety and access to appropriate care.
  • Handle and triage Employee Assistance Program service calls as needed.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation in system.
  • Perform administrative tasks and other duties as assigned

Essential Education & Experience

  • Master’s degree in behavioral health field required
  • Clinical licensure required (LCSW, LPC, LMSW, or LMFT)
  • Ability to work pacific hours (8am -5pm PST)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • 3-5 years of experience in a Clinical setting preferred
  • EAP and call center experience required
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience using MS Office, SharePoint, and other collaboration tools.
  • Ability to work well in a fast-paced, team environment
  • SAP certification required
  • Bi-Lingual Spanish/English is a plus

Working Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee regularly works in a home remote office near office equipment (telephone, computer). Verbal and written communication, telephone usage, filing, sitting, typing, reading, and carrying are required to perform the essential functions of this job.

The compensation range is based on the candidates experience and/or level of education or certifications.
Uprise Budgeted Pay Range
$100,000—$100,000 USD

Uprise Health is an equal opportunity employer. In accordance with anti-discrimination law, Uprise Health prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Uprise Health conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
What You'll Do

As a Senior Technical Program Manager on the Customer Onboarding Operations and Technical Programs team reporting to the Sr. Manager of Business Operations & Strategic Programs, you will lead the modernization, systems integration, and AI-driven automation of customer onboarding workflows across five key business lines. In this role, you will eliminate bottlenecks and shorten onboarding times, unlocking capacity to help new customers get up and running faster without needing linear team headcount growth. Unlike traditional TPM roles, you will directly shape our AI-first operational transformation, partnering across operations, product, and engineering teams to replace manual handoffs with smart automations, real-time performance tracking, and scalable internal systems.

#LI-Remote


What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Lead Cross-Functional Onboarding Modernization: Own the program roadmap for internal workflow optimization and technical modernization across Property Tax, Hospitality, Avalara for Accountants, 1099, and Excise onboarding pipelines.
  • Architect AI-First Workflow Automation: Partner strategically with the Senior Program Manager of Automation & AI to identify, design, and implement intelligent automations (integrating LLMs, OCR, robotic process automation, and agentic workflows) that streamline repetitive data ingestion, document classification, tax profile validation, and account provisioning tasks.
  • Drive Process Engineering & Journey Mapping: Conduct comprehensive end-to-end value stream mapping of onboarding workflows across all five business lines to uncover friction points, technical debt, redundant handoffs, and cycle time delays.
  • Define Metrics & Operational Observability: Partner with our Data Analysts to define and build robust operational KPIs, dashboards, and reporting frameworks (e.g., onboarding cycle time, first-time-right rate, manual touch time, and throughput) to drive executive alignment and data-backed prioritization.
  • Bridge Operations, Product, and Engineering: Translate complex operational requirements into clear technical specifications, epics, and user stories. Partner with engineering squads to build systemic tooling, API integrations, and scalable internal platforms.
  • Establish Human-in-the-Loop Governance: Design robust validation, exception-handling, escalation protocols, and quality assurance checkpoints for automated and AI-enabled workflows to guarantee strict compliance and data integrity.
  • Drive Change Management & Operational Adoption: Serve as the core technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) providing workflow requirements, technical guidance, and source materials to the Senior Enablement Program Manager (who builds and delivers the training), while owning end-to-end accountability for ensuring actual operational adoption, process compliance, and sustained change across onboarding teams.


At Avalara, we hire only Bar Raisers—individuals who improve the average performance, talent density, and execution quality of the team by their presence. You are expected to:

  • Hold yourself and cross-functional partners to the highest standards of ownership, operational craftsmanship, and accountability.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment in balancing speed, scalability, customer risk, and technical rigor when designing solutions.
  • Simplify complex cross-functional challenges and drive decisive, data-backed execution.
  • Challenge assumptions respectfully and elevate the capabilities of everyone around you through mentorship, example, and operational discipline.
  • Leave every process, system, and workflow significantly stronger, faster, and more scalable than you found it.

What You'll Need to be Successful

  • Education: Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive professional experience in Technical Program Management (TPM), Business Systems Architecture, or Operational Process Engineering within a high-growth SaaS, fintech, or technology enterprise.
  • Process & Systems Architecture: Proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional workflow optimization programs, value stream mapping, and technical system integrations (CRM, ERP, ticketing, and custom operational platforms).
  • Applied AI & Automation Proficiency: Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing or deploying AI-enabled workflows, robotic process automation (RPA), agentic pipelines, or LLM-based tools to automate operational business processes.
  • Technical Program Execution: Deep expertise in agile methodologies, SDLC management, defining technical requirements, managing cross-functional dependencies, and mitigating risk across distributed technical and operational teams.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to influence senior business leaders, technical architects, and front-line operational teams.

Avalara is an AI-first Company

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

  • You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.

  • You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.

  • You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


How We'll Take Care of You

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.


What You Need To Know About Avalara

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Trade & Customs Specialist
description:
​WHAT YOU’LL DO​

As Trade & Customs Specialist, you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth and compliant international trade operations. You’ll manage documentation, support customs clearance, and help maintain regulatory compliance across all movements of goods. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Manage import and export operations, ensuring timely and compliant movement of commercial and non-commercial goods, including monitoring shipments and coordinating with logistics and warehouse teams.
  • Prepare, review, and submit customs documentation and declarations, including invoices, packing lists, bills of lading, and other documents required for customs clearance.
  • Manage import and export permits, licenses, and approvals, ensuring all required regulatory documentation is obtained, valid, and properly maintained.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements, monitor regulatory changes, identify potential risks, and support the implementation of new requirements.
  • Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, transport providers, and relevant authorities to resolve customs clearance issues, shipment delays, and documentation discrepancies.
  • Maintain and update local customs and trade SOPs and records, and support internal and external customs audits by preparing the required documentation and information.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve trade and customs processes, enhance compliance, reduce clearance delays, and support regional and global Trade & Customs initiatives.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders across the business to ensure seamless trade operations. Your main collaboration partners will be:

  • Regional Trade & Customs Operations Team

  • Transport Service Providers

  • Customs Brokers

  • DC Teams

  • Finance Team

  • IT/System Support Teams

WHO YOU ARE​

We are looking for people with…​

  • Awareness of international trade and customs laws (preferred but not mandatory)

  • Experience in operational customs and logistics

  • Proficiency in trade management systems and documentation tools

  • Strong organisational skills to manage shipment documentation effectively

  • A keen eye for detail to ensure compliance with trade and legal regulations

And people who are…​

  • Collaborative team players who work well with internal teams, customs authorities, and transport providers

  • Problem-solvers who can address operational challenges efficiently

  • Proactive and reliable, with a structured approach to daily tasks

  • Clear communicators who can support training and process updates across teams

WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

  • Employee discount card, usable for all H&M Group brands both in stores and online

  • Inclusion in the H&M Incentive Program (HIP)

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

This is a full-time role with a local contract. The Trade & Customs Associate is reporting to the Trade & Customs Team Leader. Sounds interesting? Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through the career page. ​

​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​

title: Product Manager AIAD
description:
As a Product Manager within our COS AI, Analytics and Data (AIAD) team, you will play a pivotal role in driving the development, implementation, and management of data & insights products for global COS. You will work together with a diverse team comprising Data Analysts, Business Analysts, Data Scientists, AI and Data Engineers, closely engaging with key stakeholders to deliver high-quality AI, data & insights products for Global COS.

You will lead our Customer Experience (CX) and marketing analytics suite, which includes overseeing and driving the vision, delivery, and lifecycle of data & insights products across three dedicated product teams: marketing, digital/web, and customer analytics. This role carries a dynamic dual focus: acting as an empowered product leader who defines strategic roadmaps and priorities, while remaining sufficiently hands-on and technically literate to guide complex analytical problem-solving in areas such as omnichannel customer behaviour, marketing attribution (MTA/MMM), and digital product (mobile app and website) optimization.
What you will do:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define the strategic vision, direction, and roadmap for data & insights product development, aligning it with business goals and customer needs.
  • Work closely with cross-functional areas to identify data & insights product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure timely delivery.
  • Define high-level KPIs/OKRs and align them with the respective stakeholders, supporting a data-driven environment.
  • Follow agile methodologies and best practices to facilitate efficient and iterative product development.
  • Work on a broad variety of business challenges with a wide range of business stakeholders (marketing, sales, merch, purchasing, logistics, controlling etc.).
  • Act as the subject matter expert on customer journey analytics, e-commerce web analytics, or digital marketing performance (attribution models such as MTA/MMM), paid media tracking, CRM analysis etc. business domain within the product team.
  • Stay up to date with the latest advancements in data management, advanced analytics and AI technologies, and evaluate their potential impact on our organization.
  • Proven several years of experience as either:
    • Data Analyst, Product/Business Analyst or Controller with formal/informal experience in leading data analytics product/projects.
    • Product/Project Manager with hands-on experience in data analysis, product/business analysis or controlling.
  • Functional knowledge of lean-agile development and methodologies as well as product vision creation and product roadmap development
  • Ability to build end-to-end product strategy, including definition of scope, roadmap, and KPIs, and understand product development from ideation to release.
  • Capable of gathering, analysing, and understanding customer and business needs and understanding impact against product backlog and impact on team
  • Able to clearly express the connections between larger business goals and small backlog items for team members.
  • Have strong business sense and business interest with the ability of making sound interpretations of data and other information.
  • Have excellent communication skills and are skilled in translating and explaining complex data analysis to non-technical and/or senior stakeholders.
  • Are prestige less and enjoy collaborating with others to solve problems.
  • Are fluent in English.

Behaviours based on our values

  • Delivery & Execution: Ability to produce high-quality, accurate work, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines. You should also be able to demonstrate resilience under pressure.
  • Problem Solving & Judgment: Ability to analyse issues logically, use data and evidence to guide decisions & anticipate and address issues before they arise.
  • Communication: Able to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, you should be able to explain technical or complex points simply and keep stakeholders informed and updated.
  • Collaboration: Abiloity to work constructively with other colleagues, share knowledge and support teammates. You should also be openminded and accept feedback professionally.
  • Adaptable & Curious: You should be able to adjust to changing priorities, learns new tools and processes quickly and show curiosity and self-development

This is a Full time permanent contract based at our Head Office in London.

If you feel this opportunity is exciting feel free to apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

We value collaboration and believe that great ideas thrive when we work closely together. Therefore, this role is primarily office-based, with Three days per week at the office to foster teamwork and engagement. Two day per week, you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with broad development opportunities. All our employees receive a staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to this UK- based colleagues also receive

  • Up to 20 days holiday
  • Annual health checks
  • Pension scheme
  • Discounts on various activities and financial/lifestyle products via our benefits hub
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Employee assistance via retail trust
  • Private health & dental care

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are. We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

We look forward to hearing from you

To ensure we provide an insightful experience to our candidates, and we support their understanding of the role scope and responsibilities for this role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment with our recruitment processes. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you will receive feedback with the score you obtained. title: Office Specialist
description:
GENERAL PURPOSE
Performs a variety of full performance, routine administrative clerical duties as needed to expedite public access to city
administrators and staff. Follows established processes and procedures.
SUPERVISION RECEIVED
Works under general supervision from the Mayor/City Administrator.
SUPERVISION EXERCISED
None.
ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
Administrative Support: Responsible for the effective and efficient performance of receptionist/secretarial functions. Answer and
screen incoming calls; take and deliver accurate messages. Schedule buildings, parks, and campground for use. Check and clean
Civic Center. Resolve citizens' requests and problems, or refer them appropriately. Provide customer service in accordance with
established City policies and procedures. Provide various types of customer service including taking payments, copying,
researching records, and assisting with inquiries.
Attends and prepares minutes for City Council, Planning Commission, and/or Board of Adjustment Meetings when needed;
Responsible for the accurate and efficient performance of miscellaneous accounting and filing functions. Enter payments daily.
Oversee the collection of delinquent parking citations and dog impounds, by writing letters and proceeding with small claims when
needed. Assist with shut offs. File accounts payable reports.
Keep office forms stocked. Monitors inventory of office supplies and orders as necessary. Researches supply pricing information.
Types and drafts various documents, as required for city personnel.
Assist with building permit procedures and processes.
Utility Billing Support: Assists in generating and processing of utility and solid waste billings to accomplish various Utility Billing
functions. Generate, reports, and work orders. Set up and maintain auto payments. Tack, identify, and resolve account errors and
discrepancies with customers. Process utility payments made through Xpress BillPay and Caselle.
Assists in the processing of utility payment agreements and non-payment shutoffs. Process shut-offs and payment agreements in
accordance with applicable City policies and standards.
Collections Support: Operates personal computer to enter and retrieve department data, generate reports, create spreadsheet
documents.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
1. Education and Experience:
A. Graduation from high school with general office practice and procedures; plus, one (1) year of specialized training
related to above duties;

AND

B. Two (2) years of responsible experience performing above or related duties;

OR
C. An equivalent combination of education and experience.

2. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Working knowledge of modern office practices and procedures; of grammar, spelling, and punctuation; of modern filing
systems related to alphabetical and numeric files; personal computer operations and various program applications;
telephone etiquette, various office machines, i.e. ten-key, copy machine, fax, etc. Some knowledge of administrative
procedures; of legal processes associated with the maintenance of public records and documents; interpersonal
communication skills, and basic accounting.
Skill in computer keyboard operations.
Ability to exercise initiative, independent judgment and to act resourcefully under varying conditions; communicate
effectively verbally and in writing; establish and maintain effective working relationships with fellow employees, other
agencies of the public; perform general bookkeeping; establish and maintain comprehensive records and files.
3. Work Environment:
Incumbent of the position performs in a typical office setting with appropriate climate controls. Tasks require variety of
physical activities, not generally involving muscular strain, related to walking, standing, stooping, sitting, reaching, lifting.
Essential functions generally require communications such as talking, hearing, and seeing. Rapid work speed required to
perform keyboard operations. Common eye, hand, finger, leg, and foot dexterity exist. Mental application utilizes
memory for details, verbal instructions, emotional stability, guided thinking, and problem solving.

title: Assistant Controller
description:
The Assistant Controller supports the Controller in delivering accurate, timely accounting, reporting, and financial analysis for Corvant's Service Division. This role owns key parts of the monthly close, WIP reconciliation, service billing, and variance reporting, and serves as a day-to-day finance partner to branch operations and Corporate Accounting.

Working closely with the Controller, Operations leaders, and branch administrative teams, the Assistant Controller turns financial and operational data into clear reporting and insight, supports budgeting and forecasting, and helps strengthen processes and controls as the service platform grows.

title: Narrative Designer
description:
About the game

Hopetown is a new narrative-first RPG inspired by Disco Elysium, being built by some of the team that worked on Disco Elysium, including Martin Luiga (founder of the ZA/UM Cultural Movement, writer of several characters on Disco Elysium, writer of the first short story in the Disco Elysium world), Lenval Brown (narrator of Disco Elysium) and Piotr Sobolewski (former CEO of Knights of U, which completed all the tech for Disco Elysium).

We are currently moving into early production, building out the foundational systems, characters, and mechanics that will define the experience. With your help, we can transform Hopetown from a great cRPG into an unforgettable one — a living, breathing universe of stories, surprises, and challenges.

About us

Longdue is a studio founded to create rich, emotional, story-first games that challenge players’ expectations. We’re a remote team of writers, artists, designers, and engineers, bringing together talent from across the industry to push the boundaries of narrative-driven RPGs.

We are still early in production, meaning new team members will have a real, tangible impact on the world we are building. We believe that extraordinary games can come from small, focused teams that value creativity, openness, and care over convention.

About the role

We’re looking for a Lead Narrative Designer with both creative and production instincts — someone who can shape Hopetown’s story while helping to build the systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
You’ll lead a small team of writers through the early stages of development, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations — ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Add to What You’ll Be Doing:

  • We’re looking for a Narrative Lead with both creative and production instincts, someone who can shepherd Hopetown’s story while helping us refine systems and structures that make great narrative work possible.
  • You’ll lead a small team of writers, balancing storytelling vision with clear planning, coordination, and delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with design, production, and tech to align narrative goals with development milestones and to ensure the narrative team’s output fits smoothly into the broader pipeline.
  • This role sits at the intersection of creativity and operations, ideal for someone who loves story but also thrives on clarity, structure, and collaboration.

Requirements

MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

  • 5+ years of experience leading and/or managing a narrative team on a narrative-first game, ideally in the RPG space.
  • Proven ability to plan, organise, and deliver narrative work within production milestones, experience coordinating pipelines, tracking progress, and aligning with design or production teams
  • Proven experience writing emotionally resonant, character-driven stories
  • Experience overseeing multiple writers’ work and overseeing edits to ensure cohesion in both tone and style
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills
  • Basic understanding of other disciplines and how their work integrates with narrative and design.
  • Familiarity with production and project management tools (e.g. Basecamp, YouTrack, or similar)

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience shipping or contributing to a narrative-driven RPG title, especially within a small or startup-style team
  • Strong familiarity with Disco Elysium-like, dialogue-heavy storytelling structures
  • A creative and adaptable mindset suited to an early-stage, highly collaborative studio environment
  • A love for narrative experimentation, psychology, and surreal or philosophical themes

Benefits

WHY JOIN US

Creative Freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.

Thought-Provoking Project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.

Flexible Working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.

title: Pega Test Engineer
description:
Als Pega Test Engineer zorg jij dat wat we bouwen ook écht goed werkt. Jij kijkt verder dan een geslaagde testcase. Je denkt mee over risico’s, kwaliteit en samenhang. Waar kan het misgaan? Wat missen we nog? En hoe maken we het beter voordat het in productie gaat?

Je werkt aan Pega-applicaties binnen complexe omgevingen. Samen met developers, analisten en architecten zorg je dat testing geen sluitpost is, maar vanaf het begin onderdeel van het ontwerp.

In deze rol houd je je vooral bezig met:

  • Het bepalen van een slimme testaanpak binnen Pega-projecten
  • Het ontwerpen en uitvoeren van testscenario’s op functioneel en technisch niveau
  • Het opzetten en verbeteren van testautomatisering waar dat waarde toevoegt

Je werkt hybride vanuit Nieuwegein, gecombineerd met klantlocaties en thuis. Binnen RulesMatter werk je in een multidisciplinair team waar kwaliteit geen bijzaak is, maar vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van hoe we werken.

Dit zijn jouw sterktes

Je hebt een scherp oog voor kwaliteit en neemt geen genoegen met “het zal wel goed zijn”. Je stelt vragen, denkt vooruit en durft ook tegen te spreken als iets niet klopt. Je begrijpt hoe processen werken en weet waar risico’s zich kunnen verstoppen.

Wat we bij jou terugzien:

  • Ervaring als tester in complexe applicatieomgevingen
  • Ervaring met testautomatisering, bijvoorbeeld met Tosca, Selenium of Cucumber
  • Je kunt schakelen tussen verschillende testniveaus en stakeholders
  • Je voelt je prettig in een Agile omgeving
  • Je spreekt Nederlands op minimaal B2-niveau

Ervaring met Pega is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Als jij de basis van testdenken goed beheerst en de motivatie hebt om je verder te verdiepen, helpen wij je daarbij.

Dit krijg je van ons

Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract en een salaris afhankelijk van jouw ervaring en inschaling
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van gezellige borrels tot sportieve of inhoudelijke uitjes;
  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden via trainingen, kennisdelingssessies en inspirerende (netwerk)events;
  • Hybride werken: thuis, op ons kantoor in Groningen of bij de klant, afhankelijk van wat jij nodig hebt;
  • Een mobiliteitsbudget, in de vorm van een leaseregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatief vervoersregeling. Net wat het beste bij jouw manier van reizen past;
  • Winstdeling van 8% on target;
  • 27 betaalde vakantiedagen;
  • Mogelijkheid om op fiscaal vriendelijke manier studieschuld af te lossen, een fiets, zonnepanelen of sportabonnementen aan te schaffen (Cafetaria-systeem) of andere personeelskortingen te verkrijgen;
  • Een internetvergoeding van €15 netto per maand, een aanvullende thuiswerkvergoeding van €21,50 netto per maand waarbij wij jou daarbij faciliteiten bieden voor de uitrusting van jouw eigen thuiskantoor;
  • Een flexibele pensioenregeling, waaraan jij op maat en passend bij jou, bijdragen kan toevoegen.

Je sluit je aan bij onze area RulesMatter. Een team met korte lijnen, veel inhoud en collega’s die elkaar scherp houden zonder gedoe.

Reageer gerust. We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Senior Office & Project Manager
description:
The future of aerospace and defense starts here.


Ursa Major was founded to revolutionize how America and its allies access and apply high-performance propulsion, from hypersonics to solid rocket motors, satellite maneuvering and launch. We design and deliver propulsion and defense systems that solve the most urgent and critical national security demands.

The Role

We are hiring a seasoned Senior Office & Project Manager to own the day-to-day operation of our DC office and to build the operational foundation for its growth. This is not a traditional administrative role, and it is not a static one: Ursa Major is scaling rapidly across in- space propulsion, hypersonics, solid rocket motor production and our DC footprint will grow with it. We are looking for someone who has run operations through a company's growth curve before and wants to do it again — someone who can run today's office flawlessly while designing the systems, vendor relationships, and processes that a much larger DC presence will need. The office hosts customer briefings, executive meetings, congressional and Pentagon visitors, and hosted events, and the person in this seat sets the first impression of Ursa Major for every guest who walks in. You will run the office like a small program: anticipating needs, managing vendors and budgets, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks in a fast-moving, high-visibility environment.

You will also serve as the DC point of contact for headquarters functions (IT, Security, Finance, People) and help coordinate the flow of visiting engineers and leadership from Berthoud.

Where This Role Can Go

We expect this hire to grow with the company. Candidates who have taken an office or region from a handful of people to a mature site — and who want ownership over what comes next — will find real runway here.

This is a technical company, and the best person for this seat will be energized by that. You do not need an engineering background, but you should be the kind of operator who learns how the products work, understands why an ITAR-controlled document or a cleared visitor requires different handling, and adopts new tools readily rather than waiting to be trained on them.

Responsibilities

Office operations

  • Own daily operations: keep the office clean, stocked, secure, and fully functional
  • Manage vendor and building relationships (janitorial, maintenance, catering, security, IT/AV, property management); negotiate and track service contracts
  • Oversee shipping/receiving, mail, equipment, and supply inventory
  • Track and manage the DC office budget and expenses; process invoices and corporate card reconciliation
  • Establish and maintain office procedures and SOPs; identify and drive continuous improvements

Visitor, meeting & event management

  • Prepare the office for customer visits, executive meetings, and hosted events; coordinate logistics end-to-end (scheduling, catering, AV, materials, follow-up)
  • Manage visitor pre-registration, check-in, badging, and escort procedures in coordination with Security; uphold controlled-access and ITAR-aware practices for guests
  • Support Strategy and Government Affairs teams with meeting materials, printing, and briefing packages
  • Coordinate travel and hospitality for visiting Ursa Major leadership and engineers traveling to and from the DC office

Cross-functional coordination

  • Act as the DC liaison to IT, Security/FSO, Facilities, Finance, and People teams at headquarters
  • Onboard new DC-based hires (workspace, access, equipment) and support local culture and team events
  • Build scalable operational infrastructure (vendor portfolio, budgeting cadence, SOPs, onboarding playbooks) that can be replicated at future sites
  • Mentor and, as the office grows, hire and manage junior operations and administrative staff
  • Support light project-management tasks for the DC team (tracking action items, event calendars, conference logistics) as needed

Project management

  • Own end-to-end delivery of DC office projects from scoping through close-out
  • Develop project plans with clear scope, schedules, milestones, budgets, and owners; track progress and report status to leadership
  • Run cross-functional working groups impacting the DC office with IT, Security/FSO, Facilities, Finance, and People to keep initiatives on schedule and unblock dependencies
  • Identify risks and issues early, drive mitigation plans, and escalate decisions with clear options and recommendations
  • Maintain the DC team's action-item tracker, event calendar, and conference logistics; run recurring operating reviews and follow-ups
  • Standardize project tools and templates (charters, timelines, budgets, lessons learned)

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years in office management, workplace operations, facilities coordination, executive support, or a related operations role
  • Experience managing vendors, service providers, and operational budgets, including negotiating and owning contracts
  • Demonstrated experience hosting executives, customers, or external guests in a professional, high-visibility setting
  • Strong organization and prioritization under frequent last-minute changes
  • Comfort operating in a technology-driven environment: proficiency with Microsoft 365, Teams and scheduling/expense tools, plus a demonstrated ability to quickly pick up new platforms (visitor-management systems, ticketing tools, AV/conferencing, ERP or procurement software)
  • Genuine curiosity about what Ursa Major builds and the ability to learn enough about rocket propulsion, hypersonics, and defense acquisition to speak credibly with engineers, customers, and government visitors
  • Ability to work on-site in Washington, DC five days per week
  • U.S. citizenship, permanent residency, refugee, or asylum status is required (role involves access to export-controlled information)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in aerospace, defense, government affairs, or another regulated/controlled-access environment and working with front-offices within the Pentagon
  • Familiarity with visitor-control and security protocols (badging, escorts, cleared facilities)
  • Experience planning events, briefings, or congressional/customer visits
  • Experience coordinating with multiple sites and leading office expansions and build-outs
  • Experience hiring, mentoring, or managing operations/administrative staff
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance
  • Notary public or willingness to become one
  • Experience introducing or administering workplace technology (access control, room booking, asset tracking, automation tools) to make operations more efficient
  • Prior exposure to engineering, hardware, or R&D teams and their working rhythms

Benefits Include: (Please note, Interns are not eligible for benefits)

  • Unlimited PTO - Vacation, Sick, Personal, and Bereavement

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance
  • Tax Advantage Accounts (HSA/FSA)

  • Additional Benefit Options Including Voluntary Life and Emergency Medical Transport
  • EAP Program
  • Retirement Savings Plan - 401k with Company Match
  • Equity Grants in the Company

  • Experience managing subcontractors, RFIs, submittals and change orders

  • Experience with budgets, schedules, procurement and project controls

title: Software Engineer - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract
description:
Deputy is a global SaaS workforce management company with hubs in Sydney, Melbourne, San Francisco and London, plus team members working remotely across the United States. Our platform serves over 1.5 million workers and 375,000 workplaces across 100+ countries. We are backed by top global investors and recently achieved Unicorn status.
At Deputy, we’re improving the world of work, one shift at a time, for 80% of the world’s workforce: hourly workers. These are the dedicated employees who keep our world running – from baristas to nurses, cleaners to delivery drivers, florists to factory workers. Despite their vital role in society, most workplace technology has focused on those workers who sit behind a desk, but at Deputy, we transform the frontline. When businesses use Deputy, their workplaces thrive – the business is more profitable, compliant, and productive, while the workers are more engaged and happier at work.
We're becoming an AI-native company, a commitment that means you'll be empowered (and expected) to use AI tools and thinking in your day-to-day work. You'll have the training, support, and freedom to use AI responsibly and creatively to spark ideas, solve problems faster, and unlock new ways of working.
If you’re passionate about creating solutions that put people first and helping businesses and their teams thrive, join us at Deputy and make an impact where it matters most!

The Role

As a Software Engineer, you will be working closely with your peers, product, design and leadership to build amazing products and features for the Deputy platform, delivering services and products to millions of users and businesses from small & medium to enterprise.

Responsibilities

  • Working independently to solve complex, highly ambiguous customer-facing problems.

  • Scope, specify, design, implement and deliver software solutions, applying modern industry best practices to deliver resilient, high-performance, high-quality, and scalable systems and applications.

  • Develop end-to-end solutions, writing clean and efficient code for front-end web applications and back-end services to deliver seamless user experiences.

  • Own the quality of your work by thoroughly testing your solutions, including writing automated tests.

  • Collaborate with the engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to determine requirements and deliver complex problems.

  • Write simple, efficient, self-documented, modular, high-quality code that follows best practices.

  • Investigate, debug and solve issues within a bounded context.

  • Provide coaching to junior team members across the entire SDLC.

  • Engage in technical discussions of solutions and process improvement through documentation, design reviews, pair programming, code review and technology discussions.

Skills & Experience

  • You are a skilful engineer with high standards and a passion for quality backed by 3+ years of related work experience.

  • You are customer-obsessed, always working to deliver solutions that give the best possible experience for customers.

  • You show a bias for action and have a demonstrated track record of delivering high-quality, scalable, and fault-tolerant software systems.

  • You have strong computer science fundamentals: algorithms and data structures.

  • You are programming language agnostic with proficiency in front-end (e.g. Javascript, modern frameworks like React/Vue) and back-end (e.g. PHP, Golang) development.

  • You have expertise in API design (REST & RPC) and its frameworks. Including using protobuf, gRPC, OpenAPI

  • Experience building service-oriented architecture, microservices, and modern techniques and tools. Including using Docker, ECS, Lambda, SQS, Kinesis, etc

  • Experience in a few persistence, storage and caching mechanisms. Including MySQL, Redis, DynamoDB, S3, etc

  • Experience implementing responsive designs into software by developing reusable components with JavaScript, HTML and CSS

  • You have experience embedding 3rd party software solutions into other platforms, providing a seamless experience for users.

  • You build systems that include appropriate monitoring and observability, employing modern best practices for fault tolerance, including but not limited to caching, eventual consistency, queues, load balancing, circuit breaking, etc.

Employee Perks

  • Take paid parental leave to support you and your family

title: Azure Platform Engineer
description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform – FMP – er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Azure Platform Engineer bliver du en del af hele platformens livscyklus. Du kommer både til at onboarde nye kunder, implementere løsninger og bidrage til den løbende udvikling og drift af platformen.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, konsulenter, arkitekter og resten af FMP-teamet. Du får gradvist mere indflydelse i takt med, at du lærer platformen, kunderne og vores arbejdsmetoder at kende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Onboarding af nye kunder og deres Azure-miljøer på FMP

  • Implementering og konfiguration af platformskomponenter

  • Automatisering af deployment, konfiguration og driftsopgaver

  • Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Infrastructure as Code

  • Fejlsøgning og håndtering af tekniske problemstillinger

  • Test, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring af løsninger

  • Deltagelse i dialogen med kunder om behov og mulige løsninger

  • Bidrag til videreudvikling af FMP’s funktionalitet, værktøjer og standarder

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Vi deler arbejdet op i mindre, værdiskabende leverancer og afstemmer tilgang og design, før vi går i gang med implementeringen.

Vi betragter ikke en opgave som færdig, blot fordi teknikken virker. Test, dokumentation, monitorering og validering hos kunden er en del af leverancen.

Du behøver ikke kende Golazo på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde struktureret, gøre dit arbejde synligt og give og modtage konstruktiv feedback.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får din daglige gang i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for blandt andet Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande oglægger stor vægt på samarbejde, fælles ejerskab og videndeling.

Du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og samtidig sætte dit eget præg på platformen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Om dine kompetencer

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund som cloud- eller infrastrukturkonsulent, DevOps engineer, platform engineer eller udvikler med interesse for Azure.

Vi forestiller os at du

Har en teknisk nysgerrighed og et solidt fundament inden for cloudteknologier. Du har praktisk erfaring med Azure eller lignende cloudplatforme og har arbejdet med automatisering, scripting eller Infrastructure as Code. Samtidig har du forståelse for centrale områder som sikkerhed, governance og stabil drift, og du trives med at analysere tekniske problemstillinger og arbejde struktureret frem mod holdbare løsninger.

Du er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og dele viden med dine kolleger, og du kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer. Derudover motiveres du af at kombinere produktudvikling med konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du kan omsætte teknologi til værdi. Du kommunikerer professionelt og ubesværet på både dansk og engelsk.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med:

  • Azure landing zones, governance og identitetsstyring med Azure Policy, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID

  • Infrastructure as Code med eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende teknologier

  • Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD samt automatisering med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller lignende værktøjer

  • Monitorering, logging og observability samt kendskab til Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework eller drift af cloudplatforme

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt teknisk fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med platformen og teamet.

Om dig

Du går op i kvalitet og tager ansvar for, at dine leverancer fungerer i praksis. Du er nysgerrig, opsøger ny viden og spørger om hjælp, når det skaber et bedre resultat.

Du trives med at arbejde i et team, hvor løsninger bliver kvalificeret gennem dialog og review. Du kan stå på egne ben, men holder ikke viden eller udfordringer for dig selv.

Samtidig har du blik for, at den bedste tekniske løsning ikke nødvendigvis er den mest avancerede. Den skal være forståelig, driftsvenlig og skabe reel værdi for kunden.

title: Senior Finance Change and Enablement Analyst
description:
Company Overview



Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).


What you'll do



What you’ll do

The Senior Finance Change and Enablement Analyst is a critical role focused on driving transformation across our most critical Finance initiatives. In this role, you will transform behaviors and mindsets to drive end user adoption and achieve desired business outcomes. To be successful, you will develop holistic change management strategies to overcome adoption hurdles, minimize resistance and ensure impacted audiences are ready and enabled. By acting as a trusted partner, you’ll advise senior leadership on strategies and approaches for getting the business from the “as is” state to the desired adoption state.

Successful candidates will be able to quickly build rapport and trust-based relationships and collaborate effectively across training, communications, project and business teams. You will execute with empathy and have a passion for connecting the dots for impacted users and their leadership. You will drive a consistent drum-beat to ensure people understand the “why,” feel prepared and excited for the change.

This position is an individual contributor reporting to the Sr. Director of Finance Strategy and Operations.

Responsibility

  • Identify impacted audiences by driving and completing stakeholder analysis and impact assessments, defining personas, areas of resistance, and motivators
  • Partner with business owners to define adoption and business success; Partner with SMEs to create user‑focused training and enablement materials that support readiness and adoption
  • Partner with Project Management teams to ensure alignment on progress, raise risks, and increase change management advocacy where appropriate
  • Craft holistic, right-sized change strategies and drive execution across the Finance organization; drive broader culture and communication strategies across Finance (e.g. newsletters, team spotlights)
  • Partner with other enablement and communications team members to develop plans consistent with Docusign’s broader change strategy, approach and branding
  • Develop and manage change plans, including change deliverable execution (communications and training)
  • Identify Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and other metrics of success to ensure we are meeting adoption goals or pivoting where needed
  • Build executive‑level presentations that distill complex information into concise, decision‑ready insights
  • Develop a flexible change strategy, methodology, and toolkit to drive holistic adoption across Finance and enable other Finance teams to drive change within their teams


Job Designation



Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.


What you bring



Basic

  • 5 years + of change management experience, leading large scale transformation across varied audiences, technologies and processes
  • Experience with Finance organizations, processes, and stakeholders
  • Natural problem-solver with proven experience managing multiple unique projects and stakeholder groups
  • Ability to influence and drive change and execution without direct authority
  • Consultative approach, including the ability to analyze current state processes to challenge the status quo, connect dots, and envision the “art of the possible”
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including presentation and white paper building

Preferred

  • Experience in the enterprise software industry (SaaS and B2B experience)
  • Experience in strategy, planning, and operations work
  • Research and analysis skills that can be applied to bring clarity to ambiguous problems or asks
  • Understands financial and business metrics

Wage Transparency



Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

California: $105,800.00 - $163,450.00 base salary

This role is also eligible for the following:

  • Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.

Global benefits provide options for the following:

  • Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
  • Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
  • Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
  • Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
  • Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements
  • Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life-changing events

Work Authorization Notice: Please note that we do not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time, permanent basis without the need for current or future sponsorship.


Life at Docusign



Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. title: Doradca / Doradczyni Sprzedaży (Galeria Bronowice)
description:
JAKIE BĘDĄ TWOJE OBOWIĄZKI

Jako Doradca/Doradczyni Sprzedaży będziesz odgrywać kluczową rolę w zapewnianiu klientom wyjątkowych doświadczeń podczas zakupów. Będziesz wspierać klientów podczas wizyty w sklepie i pomagać w znalezieniu odpowiednich produktów, prezentując naszą ofertę. Dzięki pracy zgodnej z naszymi wartościami przyczynisz się zarówno do własnego sukcesu, jak i sukcesu firmy.

Twoje zadania będą obejmować:

  • Dzielenie się wiedzą na temat mody i produktów oraz wspieranie klientów w podejmowaniu najlepszych decyzji.
  • Współpracę z zespołem w celu zapewniania wyjątkowej obsługi na każdym etapie wizyty klienta w sklepie.
  • Dbanie o odpowiedni stan produktów oraz porządek na sali sprzedaży.
  • Pomoc podczas otwierania i zamykania sklepu.
  • Budowanie pozytywnego wizerunku marki podczas interakcji z klientami.
  • Aktywne promowanie programu lojalnościowego – tak, by zakupy były dla klientów nie tylko przyjemnością, ale też korzyścią.

Z KIM BĘDZIESZ WSPÓŁPRACOWAĆ

Nasze sklepy stanowią fundament firmy — to właśnie w nich klienci bezpośrednio doświadczają naszej marki. Jako część dynamicznego zespołu sklepowego, każde stanowisko — od doradców/doradczyń sprzedaży, przez kierowników/kierowniczki działów i sklepów, po dekoratorów/dekoratorki i kontrolerów/-ki administracyjno-kasowych/-e — przyczynia się do tworzenia inspirującej i przyjaznej atmosfery. Współpracując z innymi sklepami oraz zespołem regionalnym, będziesz dzielić się spostrzeżeniami i osiągać wspólne sukcesy. Wraz z członkami swojego zespołu będziesz pełnić kluczową rolę, pomagając klientom czuć się pewnie i wyrażać swoją indywidualność dzięki najnowszym trendom i ponadczasowym fasonom. Budując relacje z klientami, sprawiamy, że moda staje się dostępna i zrównoważona dla każdego.

​KIM JEST DORADCA/DORADCZYNI SPRZEDAŻY

Szukamy osób, które...

  • Lubią pomagać innym, interesują się modą lub handlem detalicznym – wszystkiego innego Cię nauczymy!
  • Doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta np. w branży modowej, detalicznej lub pokrewnej, będzie mile widziane, ale nie jest konieczne.

Oraz osób, które…​

  • Chcą rozwijać się w dynamicznych i zróżnicowanych zespołach, gdzie podstawę stanowi współpraca.
  • Są komunikatywne, kreatywne, ciekawe pracy z nowymi technologiami w sklepach, zmotywowane do nauki i rozwoju.
  • Są elastyczne i nastawione na działanie.
  • Swobodnie komunikują się w języku polskim, także w kontaktach z klientami i zespołem.

KIM JESTEŚMY​

​Grupa H&M to globalna firma, która łączy silne marki modowe. Naszym celem jest pokazanie, że wyjątkowy design, przystępne ceny i zrównoważone rozwiązania mogą iść w parze. Chcemy, by moda była dostępna dla jak najszerszej grupy osób, dlatego nasi klienci stoją w centrum każdej decyzji, którą podejmujemy.

Wspieramy rozwój tysięcy współpracowników pełnych pasji i talentów, których łączy wspólna kultura i wartości. Razem chcemy wykorzystać naszą siłę, zasoby i wiedzę, aby kształtować bardziej inkluzywną i zrównoważoną przyszłość branży modowej.

DLACZEGO POKOCHASZ PRACĘ Z NAMI

W Grupie H&M jesteśmy dumni z tego, że tworzymy otwarte i pełne energii miejsce pracy. Oferujemy naszym pracownikom atrakcyjne świadczenia oraz szerokie możliwości rozwoju na całym świecie.

Zapewniamy:

  • Umowę o pracę oraz wynagrodzenie dla:

    3/4 etatu – 3606 PLN brutto (ok. 120 godzin miesięcznie)*
    1/2 etatu – 2404 PLN brutto (ok. 80 godzin miesięcznie)*
    1/4 etatu – 1202 PLN brutto (ok. 40 godzin miesięcznie)*
  • Kartę lunchową z comiesięcznym doładowaniem o wartości od 50 PLN do 150 PLN (proporcjonalnie do etatu).
  • 25% zniżki dla Ciebie i jednej bliskiej osoby na zakupy we wszystkich markach Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Program motywacyjny H&M HIP. Dowiedz się więcej o programie tutaj.
  • Bonusy za polecenie nowych pracowników (od 480 PLN do 1200 PLN brutto w zależności od stanowiska, na które polecasz).
  • Okazjonalne kupony i bonusy w ciągu roku.
  • Dopłatę do karnetów sportowych lub platformy wellbeingowej.
  • Dopłatę do prywatnej opieki medycznej.
  • Ubezpieczenie na życie w atrakcyjnej cenie.
  • Dostęp do platformy MyBenefit.
  • Dodatkowy dzień wolny (jubileuszowy).
  • Program szkoleń wstępnych i rozwojowych.

DOŁĄCZ DO NAS

​Nasza wyjątkowość wynika z połączenia wielu czynników — inkluzywnej kultury opartej na współpracy, silnych wartościach i możliwościach rozwoju. Jednak to przede wszystkim nasi pracownicy tworzą tożsamość Grupy H&M.

Oferujemy pracę w niepełnym wymiarze godzin. Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV tak szybko, jak to możliwe.

Zrób z nami kolejny krok w swojej karierze. Twoja podróż zaczyna się tutaj.

* Test Online

Aby skutecznie zarządzać dużą liczbą aplikacji na stanowisko doradcy/doradczyni sprzedaży, w procesie rekrutacyjnym korzystamy z testu online. Oznacza to, że zostaniesz poproszony/-a o jego wykonanie w ramach procesu selekcji aplikacji i oceny umiejętności kandydata. Twoje odpowiedzi zostaną przeanalizowane za pomocą narzędzia, wykorzystującego kryteria ustalone wcześniej przez Grupę H&M. Po ukończeniu testu będziesz mieć możliwość podzielenia się swoją opinią na jego temat. Jeśli napotkasz jakiekolwiek trudności lub preferujesz alternatywną formę przeprowadzenia oceny, skontaktuj się z recruitment_support@hm.com. Wybór alternatywnej formy nie będzie miał wpływu na rozpatrzenie Twojej aplikacji.

Aby uzyskać więcej informacji na temat sposobu przetwarzania Twoich danych osobowych, zapoznaj się z naszą Polityką Prywatności.

** Dążymy do tego, aby proces rekrutacji był uczciwy, sprawiedliwy i oparty na kompetencjach. Dlatego też uprzejmie prosimy o niezałączanie listu motywacyjnego do swojej aplikacji.​

title: Intake Coordinator - Men's Campus
description:
We transform lives.

Phoenix Rescue Mission is a place of hope, healing, and new beginnings for men, women, and children facing with hunger, homelessness, addiction, and trauma. We follow Christ’s example of servant-leadership and teamwork in our ministry of rescue and restoration. We are a community who values and celebrates one another and we strive toward excellence together as a certified Best Christian Workplace. At this moment, God is doing important and incredible things at Phoenix Rescue Mission. Do you want to be a part of it?


WHO WILL LOVE THIS JOB

title: Cleaning
description:
Traveling Maintenance Technician
Aspen Services Group | Based in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma | Full-Time | Frequent Travel Required

About Us
Aspen Services Group provides facilities maintenance to clients across multiple states. We take pride in keeping our clients' properties clean, safe, and well cared for, and we're looking for a dependable, hands-on team member to help us keep that promise.

About the Role
We're seeking a self-motivated Traveling Maintenance Technician who can handle a wide range of maintenance tasks, inspect client sites, and make sure our properties are in great shape, whether they're down the street or several states away. This role involves regular overnight travel, often several days per week, and sometimes on short notice. If you enjoy variety, take ownership of your work, and can be trusted to do the job right when no one is watching, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Perform general handyman and maintenance work, including minor repairs, fixture replacement, patching, and painting
  • Maintain and repair equipment, including commercial vacuums and other janitorial tools
  • Clean windows and perform other specialized cleaning as needed
  • Conduct inspections at caretaker properties in Oklahoma and out of state, documenting conditions with notes and photos
  • Perform quality inspections at janitorial client sites to make sure our service standards are met
  • Identify repair needs and locate, vet, and coordinate local contractors at caretaker sites
  • Report findings, completed work, and recommendations to management promptly
  • Travel on short notice to respond to client needs or urgent property issues

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in general maintenance, handyman work, or facilities maintenance
  • Ability to troubleshoot and repair a variety of equipment and building issues
  • Willingness to travel frequently, including multiple overnight stays per week and trips on short notice
  • A self-starter who can manage their own schedule and work independently without close supervision
  • Strong integrity and high personal character, since you'll often be the face of our company at client sites
  • Good communication skills and the ability to write clear inspection reports
  • Comfort using a smartphone for photos, reports, email, and scheduling
  • Valid driver's license and clean driving record
  • Ability to pass a background check
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs, climb ladders, and work on your feet for extended periods

Nice to Have

  • Experience coordinating or managing contractors
  • Background in property management, janitorial services, or facilities work
  • Basic knowledge of plumbing, electrical, or HVAC

What We Offer

  • Competitive pay: [$55,000–$65,000 per year]
  • Paid travel expenses, including lodging, mileage or company vehicle, and per diem

  • PTO / paid holidays / retirement plan, as applicable]

  • Tools and equipment provided [if applicable]
  • A varied role where no two weeks look the same

How to Apply
Send your resume and a short note about your maintenance experience and availability for travel to marianne@aspenservesyou.com, or apply on this job posting.

Aspen Services Group is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Social Services & Volunteer Coordinator - EC
description:
Overview

The Social Services & Volunteer Coordinator will serve in a critical support role to the Corps Officers and a major leadership role within the East Cleveland Corps. They will be integrally involved in the ministry of Corps and in the promotion of the Mission of The Salvation Army. The Social Services & Volunteer Coordinator should remain teachable and possess a passion to further the Mission of The Salvation Army.

The Social Services & Volunteer Coordinator will oversee all aspects of the Social Services & Volunteer Programs including but not limited to budgets, personnel & program development, under the direction of the Corps Commanding Officers.

The Social Services & Volunteer Coordinator must be able to render direct casework and/or group work service to clients recognizing their physical, emotional, spiritual and social needs-making full use of agency and community resources under the direction of the Corps Commanding Officers.

The ideal candidate should be prepared to provide hands-on leadership, in service of the Mission of The Salvation Army.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (As directed by the Corps Commanding Officers)

Social Services• Understand, promote and facilitate the Mission of The Salvation Army.• Ensure that all communications and concerns related to operation of the Social Services Program, be handled in accordance with the proper protocols for the East Cleveland Corps & Greater Cleveland Area Services• Work with the East Cleveland Corps staff to foster cooperative relationships, in meeting the holistic needs of the community• Responsible for sharing with the Corps Commanding Officers, all matters of mutual concern relating to the total welfare of the Social Services Program• Performs the full range of Social Service worker duties. This includes obtaining and recording case data, making needs assessments, developing treatment plans and goals; and carrying out the treatment process which may include making appropriate referrals and follow-ups.• Keeps up-to-date records and statistics as required by The Salvation Army and external partners• Regularly meet with supervisor for case and administrative consultation. Also, takes own initiative to contact supervisor whenever priority or emergency situations occur.• To upgrade skills through mandatory department in-service training meetings, supervisory meetings, and current relevant readings• To contribute to the development of the department by providing data from one’s own practice and other sources, suggesting areas for study and programming• May prepare written work for advancing social services in the agency• Liaise on behalf of the agency, to the social services community and present the agency’s program to public or civic groups• Contact other social service agencies regarding the client situation for the purpose of making interagency referrals and for the development of resources for the client• Provide supervision and training for assigned interns

Food Services• Provide direct oversight of the Soup Kitchen Lead, Food Pantry Lead & Food Pantry Assistant and the administration of Hot Meal & Food Pantry Programs, in accordance with internal and external policies

Volunteers• Work with other Department Heads at East Cleveland Corps to determine volunteer needs of the facility• Responsible for screening and processing applications for all individuals wishing to serve as a volunteer at the East Cleveland Corps, through the appropriate channels before assigning them to an area• Ensure all volunteers complete required training prior to commencing their service• Responsible for maintaining records of volunteers including necessary time records

OTHER DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (As directed by the Corps Commanding Officers)• Serve as a liaison for registrations for Camp NEOSA summer programming, as necessary• Responsible to coordinate with Youth Ministries Coordinator to develop and foster relationships for youth attending camping programs• Serve as a primary contact for Christmas Toys/Angel Tree Program at East Cleveland Corps• Assist with special events, as assigned to foster greater community engagement• Involvement in the total program with willingness to help in all areas as needed, including food service, outdoor/indoor activities, children with problems, classroom coverage, etc.• Promote observance of the moral and ethical code affecting program participants and staff• Must be able to liaise with external (Food Bank, United Way, etc.) and off-site (DHQ) personnel • Must attend and contribute to East Cleveland Leadership Team Meetings.• Serve as a member of the Case Management Team, during disaster emergencies• Perform related duties, as assigned.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties and may be added to, deleted, and changed as required by the Corps Officers.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The Social Services & Volunteer Coordinator will provide direct supervision to:• Food Pantry Assistant• Soup Kitchen Lead Cook• Volunteers• Assigned Interns

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Social Work (or related field) from an accredited institution and at least 1 year of supervisory experience OR a Masters’ Degree in Social Work (or related field) from an accredited institution and at least 6 months of supervisory experience• Ability to understand the obligations, functions, programs, and services of the agency and their relation to staff, clients, community, and general social welfare, and ability to appraise these relationships • Capability to recognize and to elicit psychological and physical factors, to differentiate subjective from objective factors and capability to understand the origin, meaning, significance and inter-relationship of theses factors• Potential to plan treatment appropriate to the evaluated data and to execute the treatment plan in such a manner as to aid clients to function more adequately• The ability to express and to transmit ideas and knowledge clearly• The ability to express and to maintain relationships within and outside the agency in a professional manner.• Ability to organize own tine and effort to meet assigned situations and work demands • Ability to reflect on own performance capabilities and limitations with some accuracy• Ability to use supervision constructively for one’s own professional development and growth

Salvation Army Mission Statement

The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian church.

Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God.

Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
