title: Wind Farm System Designer (Junior/Advanced Engineer)
description:
Can you turn complex data into decisions that shape the future of offshore wind?

At Vattenfall, there is a way. A way to accelerate the energy transition through innovation, collaboration and smart decision-making. As a Wind Farm System Designer, you will help define the design and value of some of Europe's largest offshore wind projects, influencing investment decisions worth billions of euros and contributing directly to a more sustainable energy system.

Business Area Wind

Within Business Area Wind, we develop, build and operate wind farms both onshore and offshore to accelerate the growth of renewable energy. We bring together international expertise, technological innovation and operational excellence to deliver world-class energy projects that support the transition to a more sustainable future.

Our System Design team combines engineering, economics, costing, sustainability and data science competencies. Investigating innovative technologies, regulatory framework, cost and price projections, we identify opportunities across Vattenfall's offshore wind portfolio from early stage of wind farm development to repowering.

Your role / what will you do?

As a Wind Farm System Designer (Junior/Advanced Engineer), you will transform complex technical and economic information into actionable insights that influence product, project and portfolio strategies. Working closely with experts within interdisciplinary teams, you will perform techno-economical assessments to create value while supporting the continued growth of renewable energy.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Performing techno-economic assessments to evaluate offshore wind farm concepts, quantify key value drivers, and support strategic project and portfolio decisions.
  • Developing offshore wind farm designs, balancing energy production, cost, technical feasibility, environmental constraints, and project requirements.
  • Driving levelised energy cost and value improvement opportunities by challenging assumptions, exploring innovative concepts, and identifying optimisation potential across projects and products.
  • Translating complex technical, economic and market information into clear recommendations through executive level reporting.
  • Building data-driven analyses and automation solutions using Python, AI-enabled tools, and modern analytics platforms to improve decision quality and operational efficiency.
  • Developing neutral reference cases to evaluate future technologies, enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions based on robust, transparent and unbiased analysis.

Qualifications

Your profile / who are you?

You are someone who enjoys tackling complex challenges and finding practical solutions. You take ownership of your work, follow through on commitments, and are always looking for ways to improve how things are done.

You thrive in a collaborative environment where different perspectives are valued and where open, honest communication helps build trust and strong relationships. Curious by nature, you are not afraid to challenge assumptions and explore new ideas.

Above all, you want your work to have a real impact. You are motivated by contributing to a safe, inclusive workplace and by playing a meaningful role in the energy transition.

We believe you'll be successful in this role if you have:

  • A Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics or another relevant field. A PhD is considered an advantage.
  • Experience within a technical, innovation-driven or cost-engineering environment.
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to convert complex information into business insights and recommendations.
  • An interest in renewable energy and the energy transition. Experience in offshore wind or a related industry is beneficial.
  • An interest in Python and applying AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency and support decision-making.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

  • Experience from offshore wind, renewable energy, infrastructure, consulting or other capital-intensive industries.
  • Knowledge of business cases, modelling, optimisation, portfolio analysis or techno-economic assessments.
  • Experience working in project, programme or portfolio environments.
  • Knowledge of tools such as Power BI, Excel, database or comparable data and analytics platforms.

Location:

Solna, London, Kolding, Hamburg

Additional Information

Our offer
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information
We welcome your application in English, no later than, October 9th 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Anne Vriesema via anne.vriesema@vattenfall.com

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

title: Principal Program Manager, Sales & Success Strategy
description:
Overview

We are looking for a highly strategic, analytical, and execution-driven Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional transformation initiatives across Product, GTM, Strategy, and Operations. This role requires exceptional ownership, structured problem-solving, effective executive communication, and the ability to bring clarity and momentum to complex and ambiguous environments. You will design and manage the operating model that aligns teams, drives accountability, and accelerates business outcomes.

Responsibilities

Own & Deliver a Connected & Transparent Transformation Portfolio

  • Maintain a unified source of truth across Product, Sales, Success, Strategy, and Operations.

  • Manage a Portfolio, leveraging Atlassian tools to deliver integrated roadmaps and cross-vector dependency tracking to ensure visibility and alignment.

Ownership & Accountability

  • Own program outcomes end-to-end, including success metrics, alignment to strategic goals, and delivery of measurable results.

  • Identify and surface risks early, facilitating conversations around tradeoffs and resource impacts.

  • Manage interdependencies across teams to protect timelines and accelerate execution.

  • Collect, analyze, and synthesize data to produce actionable insights and reports that track performance, health, and progress.

Strategic Problem-Solving

  • Tackle complex challenges by identifying root causes and developing clear, actionable solutions.

  • Make balanced, data-driven decisions that consider business, customer, and stakeholder needs.

  • Proactively identify and resolve obstacles that impact execution.

Analytical Thinking & Systems Approach

  • Apply systems thinking to understand dependencies across people, processes, and technology.

  • Identify themes, patterns, and opportunities for improvement across programs and portfolios.

  • Provide strategic recommendations that enhance impact, drive efficiency, and deliver measurable organizational outcomes.

Communication & Executive Influence

  • Communicate clearly and persuasively with diverse audiences, tailoring messages for clarity and alignment.

  • Influence executive stakeholders by presenting insights, earning buy-in, and ensuring transparency on program direction and progress.

  • Prepare executive-level updates, dashboards, and communications that support decision-making.

Program Management & Execution

  • Create structure from ambiguity and translate strategy into actionable plans with clear deliverables, milestones, and timelines.

  • Partner with program sponsors, cross-functional teams, and program managers to define scope, goals, resources, risks, and execution approaches.

  • Monitor program performance, manage risks, and deliver progress reports that demonstrate transparency and momentum.

Build & Maintain a Unified Transformation Operating Model

  • Design the end-to-end operating model for transformation across the GTM and Product teams.

  • Establish governance, DRIs, decision cadences, planning rituals, and teaming structures that drive accountability and execution.

Create Clarity Through Strategic Alignment

  • Develop program charters, problem statements, success metrics, and LRP (long-range plan) mappings for critical transformation initiatives.

  • Ensure every initiative is grounded in clear objectives and aligned to broader business goals.

Create Rigorous Prioritization & Planning Frameworks

  • Lead quarterly planning cycles (SteerCo) and portfolio prioritization processes.

  • Oversee backlog management to ensure initiatives are properly sequenced, staffed, and funded

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

In The United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A: $170,100 - $222,075

Zone B: $153,090 - $199,868

Zone C: $141,183 - $184,322

Qualifications

Experience

  • 10+ years in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Transformation, PMO, Consulting, or a similar role.

  • Demonstrated success operating within fast-paced, high-growth, or matrixed environments.

  • Experience leading multi-quarter, multi-team transformation initiatives or portfolios.

  • Background working with GTM and Product organizations (Sales, Success, Marketing, Revenue Ops, Product, Eng) preferred.

  • Consulting, PMO, Change Management, or Business Operations experience is a strong plus.

Skills & Technical Proficiency

  • Strong command of program management frameworks (OKRs, DRI models, RAID/RACI frameworks, prioritization matrices, governance models).

  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new systems and operational models.

  • Familiarity with operational framework methodologies and cross-functional product operating rhythms is helpful.

  • Experience with establishing program charters and navigating portfolio management frameworks.

Behavioral / Leadership Qualities

  • Highly structured and detail-oriented, with exceptional organizational skills.

  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence without authority.

  • Comfortable working through ambiguity and establishing clarity from the ground up.

  • High integrity, professionalism, and commitment to transparency.

  • Curious mindset, continuous improvement orientation, and commitment to learning.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.Working at Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Fire Protection Engineer
description:
About Valar Atomics

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable—unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

The Role

We're seeking a highly skilled Senior Fire Protection Engineer to join our Engineering team and accelerate the frontier of advanced power generation. In this role, you'll be responsible for designing, analyzing, and implementing fire protection systems and processes for ensuring the safety of reactor buildings and other Valar facilities. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to bring new facilities from concept to production, and serve as a domain expert for all things fire related at the company.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supporting engineering design, analysis, calculations, and specifications for facility infrastructure fire and life safety systems
  • Develop building and fire code compliance documents and fire life safety designs for Valar office and reactor facilities
  • Perform hazardous material analysis for code compliance purposes, such as chemical classification, chemical quantity analysis, chemical inventory management, and related system design support
  • Support facility construction teams to develop field solutions
  • Support commissioning activities for reactor facility builds
  • Conduct fire/life safety code reviews and analyses
  • Prepare and present technical reports and presentations
  • Review and comment on shop drawing design packages developed by contractors

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline
  • 5+ years of experience in the design and construction of fire protection systems

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Professional Engineer License (P.E.)
  • Working knowledge of Building & Fire Codes, and NFPA Codes & Standards
  • NICET certification in relevant fire protection programs
  • Knowledgeable in OSHA compliance
  • FDS software modeling capabilities
  • Construction, facility management, or consulting engineering experience
  • Proficient in Autodesk Revit

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary
  • Equity ownership in a rapidly growing advanced energy company
  • Comprehensive medical benefits
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Free daily lunch and dinner provided onsite
  • Generous PPE stipend
  • High-impact startup environment with significant ownership and autonomy
  • Opportunities for rapid career growth and internal advancement
  • Direct collaboration with experienced operators, engineers, and industry leaders
  • The opportunity to help build and scale transformative energy technology from the ground up

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Salary
$144,000—$176,000 USD

title: Kravanalytiker Östersund
description:
Om rollen

Vill du jobba med digitalisering som gör verklig skillnad?
Vi söker en erfaren kravanalytiker som vill omvandla behov till smarta lösningar i samhällsviktiga projekt.

Som kravanalytiker hos oss är du länken mellan verksamhet och utvecklingsteam. Du fångar upp behov, analyserar dem och omvandlar dem till tydliga, spårbara krav som driver utvecklingen framåt. Du skriver user stories, formulerar acceptanskriterier, prioriterar och stämmer av – alltid med affärsnytta och användarupplevelse i fokus. Du jobbar nära både kund, utvecklare och testare och får en central roll i att skapa system som fungerar i verkligheten. Våra uppdrag finns inom branscher som energi, hälsa, telekom och offentlig sektor – där tekniska lösningar möter riktiga utmaningar.

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller liknande.
  • Minst fem års erfarenhet som kravanalytiker, business analyst eller i liknande roll.
  • God vana att dokumentera både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav.
  • Erfarenhet av att skriva user stories och acceptanskriterier, gärna enligt BDD (Given–When–Then).
  • Teknisk förståelse för arkitektur, API:er och systemflöden.
  • Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande om du också har erfarenhet av:

  • Konsultrollen och kundnära arbete.
  • Systemutveckling eller teknisk bakgrund.
  • Certifieringar som IREB, CBAP eller liknande.

Varför välja Sopra Steria?
Du kommer att tillhöra vårat Tech Management-team, vi är ca 90 kravanalytiker, projektledare, scrum masters och akitekter, som hjälpas åt och ligga i teknikens framkant och driva kvalitet i våra leveranser. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar och värnar om balans mellan arbete och fritid. Kompetensutveckling är en självklar del av din vardag, både genom interna initiativ och utbildningar. title: Tolkekoordinator – aften & weekendvagter | Timeløn (4 åbne stillinger)
description:
Har du lyst til at være en del af en spændende virksomhed i rivende udvikling, hvor du rådgiver og faciliterer vigtige tolkeløsninger i et højt tempo? Trives du med ansvar, selvstændighed og en travl hverdag – også uden for normal arbejdstid? Så læs med her!

Vi søger tolkekoordinatorer til vores aftenhold, som vil blive en del af et hurtigt voksende og fagspecialiseret oversættelses- og tolkebureau, hvor høj kvalitet og troværdighed er kendetegnet. Du sikrer tryghed og den bedste kvalitet for kunder i den offentlige og private sektor – herunder Regionerne, over 60 kommuner, asylcentre og erhvervs- og privatkunder.

Om stillingen

Som en del af vores 'Partner Advisory'-team arbejder du om aftenen og tager ansvar for, at tolkeopgaver bemandes hurtigt og korrekt – selv når presset er højt og deadlines er korte. Du yder faglig rådgivning til kunder om de bedste tolkeløsninger og har det daglige ansvar for at matche kompetente tolke med de rette opgaver.

En central del af jobbet er at formidle opgaverne til vores tolke – dvs. præsentere opgaverne attraktivt, motivere og uddybe indholdet, så vi altid har den rette tolk klar til den rette opgave. Du har en naturlig evne til at skabe tillid og opbygge stærke relationer, samtidig med at du bevarer overblikket og træffer gode beslutninger – også når tempoet er højt, og situationen er kompleks.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Bemanding af tolkeopgaver i aftentimerne – hurtigt og præcist

  • Opsøgende og motiverende dialog med tolke, hvor du aktivt formidler værdien af opgaverne og sikrer den nødvendige bemanding.

  • Skriftlig og mundtlig kommunikation med kunder og tolke

  • Løbende opfølgning og sikring af kunde- og tolketilfredshed

Dine kvalifikationer

For at lykkes i denne rolle skal du kunne håndtere et travlt og uforudsigeligt arbejdsmiljø med ro og professionalisme. Du skal trives med tempo, tage ansvar selvstændigt og altid levere – uanset hvad aftenen bringer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, logistik eller lignende operationelle roller

  • Er stabil og pålidelig – vi skal kunne regne med dig, også på travle aftener

  • Er omstillingsparat og kan skifte fokus hurtigt uden at miste overblikket

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og sikrer fremdrift uden at vente på en leder

  • Har stærke samarbejdsevner og naturlig relationsfornemmelse

  • Erfaring fra oversættelses- eller tolkebranchen er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Praktiske detaljer

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

  • Lokation: Herlev

  • Arbejdstid: Aftenvagter (typisk kl. 15:00–20:00)

  • Løn: Timeløn efter kvalifikationer

Vi indkalder løbende kvalificerede kandidater til samtale – send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt!

title: Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży
description:
Jako Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży będziesz osobą, która tworzy pierwsze wrażenie i buduje atmosferę w sklepie, witając naszych klientów i uosabiając filozofię naszej marki. Twoim zadaniem będzie zapewnienie wyjątkowej obsługi na każdym etapie wizyty w sklepie: od rozpoczęcia rozmowy, przez pomoc w przymierzalni,odegrasz kluczową rolę w tworzeniu wyjątkowych doświadczeń zakupowych. Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również obsługę dostaw, uzupełnianie brakujących elementów kolekcji i ekspozycję najnowszych produktów na sali sprzedaży.

Będziesz odpowiedzialny/-a za tworzenie atmosfery, w której klienci czują się swobodnie i zainspirowani. Dzięki Twojemu entuzjazmowi i autentycznemu podejściu pomożesz im znaleźć to, czego szukają – a czasem nawet coś, o czym jeszcze nie wiedzieli, że pokochają. Wspólnie z zespołem zadbasz o to, by każda wizyta była wyjątkowym doświadczeniem.

Doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta i znajomość materiałów są mile widziane, ale nie są wymagane.

  • Zorientowanie na klienta: lubisz kontakt z ludźmi i jesteś zaangażowany /-a w zapewnianie doskonałej obsługi
  • Elastyczność i zdolność adaptacji: potrafisz reagować na zmieniające się priorytety i potrzeby
  • Zorientowanie na działanie: jesteś proaktywny/-a i zmotywowany/-a do podejmowania inicjatywy i realizowania zadań z najlepszym efektem
  • Doskonała komunikacja: jesteś ciekawy/-a ludzi, komunikujesz się jasno i aktywnie słuchasz, aby zrozumieć ich potrzeby
  • Chęć nauki: otwartość na feedback i ciągłe poszukiwanie możliwości rozwoju
  • Zaangażowanie w markę: pasjonujesz się naszą marką i kolekcjami, z chęcią będziesz dzielić się tym entuzjazmem z klientami
  • Elastyczność: gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach, w tym: wieczorami, w weekendy i w święta
  • Komunikatywnie posługujesz się językiem polskim i angielskim

Preferowane, ale nieobowiązkowe:

  • Masz doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta i wiesz, jak działa sklep dzięki wcześniejszej pracy w handlu detalicznym
  • Czujesz się pewnie, doradzając klientom w kwestiach trendów, materiałów i dopasowania rozmiarów

  • Zatrudnienie w oparciu o umowę zlecenie

  • Wymagana dyspozycyjność w weekendy oraz na zmiany poranne

  • Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV jak najszybciej, ale nie później niż do 10.10.2026r.

INKLUZYWNOŚĆ I RÓŻNORODNOŚĆ

W Grupie H&M dążymy do tworzenia inkluzywnych, różnorodnych i sprawiedliwych miejsc pracy w całej organizacji. Wierzymy, że zespoły rozwijają się, gdy łączą różnorodne doświadczenia i perspektywy. Ta różnorodność zwiększa naszą zdolność do kreatywnego rozwiązywania problemów, poszerza horyzonty i buduje wartościowe relacje z kolegami, koleżankami i klientami na całym świecie. Dlatego uwzględniamy wszystkie wymiary różnorodności w procesie rekrutacji – aby nasze zespoły odzwierciedlały bogactwo społeczności, którym służymy.

title: Panel Coordinator
description:

Review provider schedules and patient charts to assist the care team in coordinating care for visits and identifying preventive healthcare needs.

Evaluate and analyze patient records, based on Primary Care patient standards, for patients who need: preventive services, diagnostics, and follow up.

Schedule patients for preventive care needs.

Participate in team huddles and evaluation of team data for proactive panel management.

Work with clinic team on developing standards, implementation, and maintenance of programs in chronic disease management for patients.

title: Small Parcel Coordinator
description:
About ITS Logistics

Are you ready to build a successful career in a trillion-dollar global industry? ITS Logistics is one of the fastest growing, exciting logistics companies in the United States providing creative supply chain solutions to Fortune 500 companies. With unmatched agility, sense of urgency, and work ethic, ITS commits to a relentless pursuit of excellence and leading from the front to keep the world moving, every day.

What makes us different is our focus on people and culture. We are offering more than just a job, we’re offering career opportunities that you can build your life around. As part of that commitment, we equip our teams with best tools available – including modern AI technology – to help them work smarter, move faster, and focus on high-value work. We need the best talent to continue to invest, grow and win every day and are looking for people with the right mindset – honest, adaptable, and commitment.

When you join our herd, we invest in your personal and professional growth with paid training, providing resources and support to learn everything you need to know about the supply chain industry. We empower you to seize every opportunity and thrive in a fast paced, ever changing environment.

Do you have what it takes? Find out today - .

Position Summary

Join our rapidly growing Distribution & Fulfillment team as a Small Parcel Coordinator and build a rewarding career in the trillion-dollar supply chain and logistics industry—no prior experience required! We're seeking a detail-oriented, organized professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about delivering exceptional service.

Reporting directly to the Small Parcel Manager, you'll play a critical role in supporting our small parcel clients through precise coordination, proactive communication, and data-driven insights.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Shipment Tracking & Visibility: Monitor shipments throughout their entire lifecycle using carrier platforms and systems, ensuring 100% visibility and proactive updates for our customers
  • Data Management & Reporting: Maintain exceptional data integrity for monthly business reviews (MBRs), including metrics such as cost per package, cycle time, weight and dimension details, and other key performance indicators
  • Customer Service Excellence: Respond promptly to customer inquiries, provide shipment status updates, communicate delays or issues, and maintain accurate records in customer portals
  • Claims Processing: Handle carrier claims from initiation through resolution, ensuring timely and accurate documentation
  • Appointment Coordination: Schedule and manage pickup and delivery appointments at ITS facilities and off-site locations
  • Process Documentation: Organize and maintain team documents, standard operating procedures, and reference materials
  • Invoice Support: Compile and verify data for accurate client invoicing
  • Additional Responsibilities: Support team initiatives and special projects as needed

Position Requirements

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Strong customer service orientation with excellent communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook)
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment
  • Collaborative mindset with a strong work ethic and positive attitude
  • Associate degree or equivalent experience is preferred

Physical Demands

  • Constantly remains in a seated or standing stationary position at a professional desk workstation for prolonged periods (typically 80%+ of a shift).
  • Continuous use of hands and fingers to navigate a Transportation Management System (TMS), manipulate complex spreadsheets, and rapidly respond via digital communication channels.
  • High vocal and auditory stamina required to handle continuous phone communication with external carrier dispatchers, freight brokers, and delivery drivers.
  • Close visual acuity is strictly required for extensive, daily computer terminal use, tracking transit maps, and auditing freight bills of lading.
  • Work is primarily conducted in a climate-controlled office environment with low to moderate noise levels. Occasional mobility is required to navigate to on-site distribution floors or shipping windows where exposure to warehouse dust, moving equipment, and fluctuating dock temperatures may occur.

Schedule: 7am-3:30pm Monday through Friday

title: Radiologist (MRI) - Australia
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience of our clinics across North America, have allowed us to lead the charge against “we caught it too late again.”

We are looking to expand our team of Radiologists for our rapidly growing practice in Australia. Ideally you are a general Radiologist with a strong MRI foundation.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise. Join us to make an even bigger difference in patient’s lives!

Why Join Prenuvo

Prenuvo was founded by a radiologist who wanted a better way to practice - one that values quality, flexibility, and meaning. Here, your time is respected, your work is supported, and your focus stays on what matters most: helping patients.

  • Independent Contractor: Enjoy true autonomy
  • Fully Remote: We provide the workstation and IT support.
  • No Call. No Nights. No Shifts: Create a schedule that fits your life.
  • Competitive Earning Potential: High-reward compensation that recognizes expertise, accuracy, and quality with the flexibility to scale volume and income on your terms.
  • Collaborative Team: Work alongside fellowship-trained radiologists in Body MRI, Neuroradiology, Musculoskeletal, and Breast Imaging.

What You’ll Do

  • Report Prenuvo whole body MRI (or bring the desire to expand on your foundational expertise and learn)
  • Read cases on site, or have a remote radiology workstation which is approved for use by RANZCR - depending on the location you are working
  • Provide the highest level of service to our patients and referring physicians
  • Become a part of an ongoing education program for staff, including case reviews with MRI technologists
  • Utilize ancillary tools and equipment appropriately: PACS and other software systems
  • Troubleshoot PACS and IT issues to a reasonable level
  • Relay and discuss urgent findings with referring practitioners
  • Relay urgent findings and findings of interest to the MRI technologists
  • Commit to availability for reporting a minimum number of Prenuvo scans per week
  • Become an instrumental part of a culture of communication, teamwork and learning
  • Join a collegial group of radiologists from diverse specialty backgrounds to further deepen our overall collaborative expertise as a group in providing the highest quality WB-MRI diagnostic expertise for our patients

What You’ll Bring

  • Licensed with the appropriate board - must be a fellow of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists and full unrestricted registration with AHPRA. Dual licensure in other geographies would be advantageous
  • Must stay current with the RANZCR CPD program with full participation as a RANZCR MRI radiologist.
  • A body MRI fellowship is a bonus - however all subspecialists are welcome along with a willingness to expand your expertise.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

title: Doradca / Doradczyni Sprzedaży (Złote Tarasy)
description:
JAKIE BĘDĄ TWOJE OBOWIĄZKI

Jako Doradca/Doradczyni Sprzedaży będziesz odgrywać kluczową rolę w zapewnianiu klientom wyjątkowych doświadczeń podczas zakupów. Będziesz wspierać klientów podczas wizyty w sklepie i pomagać w znalezieniu odpowiednich produktów, prezentując naszą ofertę. Dzięki pracy zgodnej z naszymi wartościami przyczynisz się zarówno do własnego sukcesu, jak i sukcesu firmy.

Twoje zadania będą obejmować:

  • Dzielenie się wiedzą na temat mody i produktów oraz wspieranie klientów w podejmowaniu najlepszych decyzji.
  • Współpracę z zespołem w celu zapewniania wyjątkowej obsługi na każdym etapie wizyty klienta w sklepie.
  • Dbanie o odpowiedni stan produktów oraz porządek na sali sprzedaży.
  • Pomoc podczas otwierania i zamykania sklepu.
  • Budowanie pozytywnego wizerunku marki podczas interakcji z klientami.
  • Aktywne promowanie programu lojalnościowego – tak, by zakupy były dla klientów nie tylko przyjemnością, ale też korzyścią.

Z KIM BĘDZIESZ WSPÓŁPRACOWAĆ

Nasze sklepy stanowią fundament firmy — to właśnie w nich klienci bezpośrednio doświadczają naszej marki. Jako część dynamicznego zespołu sklepowego, każde stanowisko — od doradców/doradczyń sprzedaży, przez kierowników/kierowniczki działów i sklepów, po dekoratorów/dekoratorki i kontrolerów/-ki administracyjno-kasowych/-e — przyczynia się do tworzenia inspirującej i przyjaznej atmosfery. Współpracując z innymi sklepami oraz zespołem regionalnym, będziesz dzielić się spostrzeżeniami i osiągać wspólne sukcesy. Wraz z członkami swojego zespołu będziesz pełnić kluczową rolę, pomagając klientom czuć się pewnie i wyrażać swoją indywidualność dzięki najnowszym trendom i ponadczasowym fasonom. Budując relacje z klientami, sprawiamy, że moda staje się dostępna i zrównoważona dla każdego.

​KIM JEST DORADCA/DORADCZYNI SPRZEDAŻY

Szukamy osób, które...

  • Lubią pomagać innym, interesują się modą lub handlem detalicznym – wszystkiego innego Cię nauczymy!
  • Doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta np. w branży modowej, detalicznej lub pokrewnej, będzie mile widziane, ale nie jest konieczne.

Oraz osób, które…​

  • Chcą rozwijać się w dynamicznych i zróżnicowanych zespołach, gdzie podstawę stanowi współpraca.
  • Są komunikatywne, kreatywne, ciekawe pracy z nowymi technologiami w sklepach, zmotywowane do nauki i rozwoju.
  • Są elastyczne i nastawione na działanie.
  • Swobodnie komunikują się w języku polskim, także w kontaktach z klientami i zespołem.

KIM JESTEŚMY​

​Grupa H&M to globalna firma, która łączy silne marki modowe. Naszym celem jest pokazanie, że wyjątkowy design, przystępne ceny i zrównoważone rozwiązania mogą iść w parze. Chcemy, by moda była dostępna dla jak najszerszej grupy osób, dlatego nasi klienci stoją w centrum każdej decyzji, którą podejmujemy.

Wspieramy rozwój tysięcy współpracowników pełnych pasji i talentów, których łączy wspólna kultura i wartości. Razem chcemy wykorzystać naszą siłę, zasoby i wiedzę, aby kształtować bardziej inkluzywną i zrównoważoną przyszłość branży modowej.

DLACZEGO POKOCHASZ PRACĘ Z NAMI

W Grupie H&M jesteśmy dumni z tego, że tworzymy otwarte i pełne energii miejsce pracy. Oferujemy naszym pracownikom atrakcyjne świadczenia oraz szerokie możliwości rozwoju na całym świecie.

Zapewniamy:

  • Umowę o pracę oraz wynagrodzenie dla:

    3/4 etatu – 3606 PLN brutto (ok. 120 godzin miesięcznie)*
    1/2 etatu – 2404 PLN brutto (ok. 80 godzin miesięcznie)*
    1/4 etatu – 1202 PLN brutto (ok. 40 godzin miesięcznie)*
  • Kartę lunchową z comiesięcznym doładowaniem o wartości od 50 PLN do 150 PLN (proporcjonalnie do etatu).
  • 25% zniżki dla Ciebie i jednej bliskiej osoby na zakupy we wszystkich markach Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Program motywacyjny H&M HIP. Dowiedz się więcej o programie tutaj.
  • Bonusy za polecenie nowych pracowników (od 480 PLN do 1200 PLN brutto w zależności od stanowiska, na które polecasz).
  • Okazjonalne kupony i bonusy w ciągu roku.
  • Dopłatę do karnetów sportowych lub platformy wellbeingowej.
  • Dopłatę do prywatnej opieki medycznej.
  • Ubezpieczenie na życie w atrakcyjnej cenie.
  • Dostęp do platformy MyBenefit.
  • Dodatkowy dzień wolny (jubileuszowy).
  • Program szkoleń wstępnych i rozwojowych.

DOŁĄCZ DO NAS

​Nasza wyjątkowość wynika z połączenia wielu czynników — inkluzywnej kultury opartej na współpracy, silnych wartościach i możliwościach rozwoju. Jednak to przede wszystkim nasi pracownicy tworzą tożsamość Grupy H&M.

Oferujemy pracę w niepełnym wymiarze godzin. Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV tak szybko, jak to możliwe.

Zrób z nami kolejny krok w swojej karierze. Twoja podróż zaczyna się tutaj.

* Test Online

Aby skutecznie zarządzać dużą liczbą aplikacji na stanowisko doradcy/doradczyni sprzedaży, w procesie rekrutacyjnym korzystamy z testu online. Oznacza to, że zostaniesz poproszony/-a o jego wykonanie w ramach procesu selekcji aplikacji i oceny umiejętności kandydata. Twoje odpowiedzi zostaną przeanalizowane za pomocą narzędzia, wykorzystującego kryteria ustalone wcześniej przez Grupę H&M. Po ukończeniu testu będziesz mieć możliwość podzielenia się swoją opinią na jego temat. Jeśli napotkasz jakiekolwiek trudności lub preferujesz alternatywną formę przeprowadzenia oceny, skontaktuj się z recruitment_support@hm.com. Wybór alternatywnej formy nie będzie miał wpływu na rozpatrzenie Twojej aplikacji.

Aby uzyskać więcej informacji na temat sposobu przetwarzania Twoich danych osobowych, zapoznaj się z naszą Polityką Prywatności.

** Dążymy do tego, aby proces rekrutacji był uczciwy, sprawiedliwy i oparty na kompetencjach. Dlatego też uprzejmie prosimy o niezałączanie listu motywacyjnego do swojej aplikacji.​

title: Senior Counsel
description:
Join Tyson & Mendes – Where Insurance Defense Meets Innovation

Please note: An active bar license in the State of Texas is required.

At Tyson & Mendes, we’re more than a national litigation firm—we’re a force for change in insurance defense and trial advocacy. Known for our cutting-edge approach and bold mission to stop Nuclear Verdicts®, we set the standard for results-driven representation across the country.

As we continue our nationwide growth, we’re seeking accomplished senior attorneys who bring courtroom confidence, leadership, and a passion for strategy. If you’re ready to make a lasting impact on clients, cases, and the legal industry, this is your moment.

Why Tyson & Mendes?

  • Lead with Purpose – Step into a senior role where your voice matters and your decisions shape outcomes. We empower our senior counsel with autonomy, trust, and the tools to lead high-exposure cases.
  • Growth Built In – With our nationally recognized trial academy, ongoing executive-level development, and a firm culture that promotes from within, your next step forward is already in motion.
  • Stability + Agility – Join a firm with national reach, financial strength, and a collaborative, no-silos mindset. We move with purpose—and you won’t get lost in the shuffle.
  • Inclusive by Design – Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion is more than a policy—it’s a practice that drives innovation, strengthens teams, and delivers better results.
  • Flexible, Performance-Focused Work – Office, hybrid, or remote—we value outcomes over facetime. Your work style should support your best work.

Who You Are

You are a seasoned litigator with a defense mindset, respected by clients and colleagues for your strategic thinking, courtroom presence, and ethical leadership. You’re driven to defend justice with courage, precision, and professionalism. You thrive on complex cases, thinking several moves ahead, and turning legal challenges into opportunities. You bring proven experience managing litigation teams, mentoring junior attorneys, and navigating high-stakes matters with confidence. Above all, you are committed to excellence, collaboration, and delivering exceptional value to clients.

Make Your Move. Be part of something bigger—join Tyson & Mendes and help shape the future of insurance defense. Apply today. We’re ready for your best.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a case theme that is more compelling than any plaintiff ploy for sympathy or anger
  • Refuse to accept mediocrity, the average, the standard or the norm in anything
  • Independently handle court appearances, depositions, briefs and trials
  • Work as part of a team with all levels of experiences
  • Routine communications with clients
  • Cultivate relationships with the firm’s existing and future clients
  • Provide leadership and direction with respect to less experienced attorneys

Requirements

  • JD from an ABA approved school
  • Must be licensed in your state
  • 8+ years of solid litigation experience, specifically with litigation support, deposition and trial preparation
  • Ability to manage full case handling responsibilities, including all facets of discovery and trial
  • Experience handling insurance defense matters preferred
  • Experience with time management systems
  • Proficiency in MS Suite, specifically Word, PowerPoint and Outlook
  • Ability to think and act independently and with minimal supervision
  • Outstanding listening, verbal and written communication skills
  • Professional appearance and demeanor

Compensation Package

  • The base salary for this position ranges from $150,000 - 200,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications
  • Attorneys are eligible for an annual billable hours bonus ranging from $10,000 and then aggregating with $7,500 for every additional tier
  • Comprehensive benefits coverage offered, including plans available at zero employee cost (average annual employer contribution for health/vision/dental/life coverage is $700-$1,700)
  • Employees benefit from a 401(k) program that includes a 100% match on the first 3% contributed and a 50% match on the following 4-5%
  • Student loan repayment assistance or 529 college savings plan (full-time attorneys after one year with the firm) $100-$200/month
  • Paid parental leave at base pay
  • Employees receive a monthly technology reimbursement of $60

Benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program through HealthAdvocate
  • Comprehensive in-house training and leadership development opportunities
  • Firm Provided CLE Programs and Paid Bar License Renewal Fees
  • Flexible vacation policy for attorneys
  • Defined pathway to partnership
  • Internal diversity and inclusion programs, such as the Women’s Initiative and Young Professionals Initiative
  • Firm-wide charitable giving program
  • Numerous social and off-site events each year to enrich your relationships with your colleagues
  • Flexible Work Model: Remote, hybrid, or onsite options available

About Tyson & Mendes

Click here to learn more about the Tyson & Mendes Office! (944) The Tyson & Mendes Office - YouTube

We’re one of the fastest-growing civil defense firms in the country—known for breaking the mold of the traditional law firm. Our dynamic, diverse team of trial attorneys delivers exceptional results, from landmark cases like Howell v. Hamilton Meats to numerous defense verdicts across the nation.

But we don’t stop at great legal work—we invest in our people. With specialized training in our proven defense methods, clear paths to leadership, and robust professional development, we empower attorneys to grow their careers, build their personal brands, and become leaders in the field.

Follow along with the firm on Twitter and LinkedIn, or visit .

Equal Opportunity Employer Notice

OK, now for the legal copy (we are a law firm, after all). It is Tyson & Mendes’ policy to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, religion, color, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, family medical history or genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit-based factors. By the way, if you read all of this, congratulations – we can already tell your attention to detail is exceptional.

title: Genopslag, Pædagog til Marslev Skole og SFO
description:
Har du lyst til at hjælpe børn i gang med skolelivet? Så søger Marslev Skole og Børnehus netop dig fra den 1. december 2026 eller snarest muligt.

Marslev Skole og Børnehus søger en pædagog 37 timer om ugen. Stillingen er som Skole- og SFO-pædagog, hvilket betyder, at der er timer i henholdsvis skole og SFO.

Marslev Skole er beliggende i Kerteminde Kommune, i en mindre landsby omgivet af skøn natur med mulighed for mange gode ture. Børnene på skolen kommer hovedsagelig fra de omkringliggende villakvarterer og fra generelt velfungerende familier.

Marslev Skole har elever fra 0. – 6. klasse og omkring 140 elever. Skolen er fødeskole til Nymarkens Skole og Børnehus. Vi vægter såvel høj trivsel som høj faglighed. Vi værner om stedet og hinanden. Marslev SFO har pt ca. 70 børn. SFO'en har egne store lokaler og mulighed for at bruge skolens lokaler.

Du er en del af en Landsbyordning
Vi er en landsbyordning, hvor Børnehus, skole, SFO og klub er samlet under én institutionsbestyrelse. Det giver os en særlig mulighed for at skabe en rød tråd i børnenes liv og styrke fællesskabet på tværs, både internt og i samspillet med familierne og det lokale fritids- og foreningsliv. Landsbyordningen er en vigtig del af Marslevs udvikling i de kommende år, og derfor søger vi en pædagog, der har lyst til at engagere sig i helheden og aktivt bidrage til samarbejdet og fællesskabet omkring børnene.

At være pædagog på Marslev Skole
  • Vi arbejder ud fra en systemisk tankegang med fokus på læring og trivsel. Aktuelt deltager vi i udviklingsprojektet TOPH Skolebørn i samarbejde med Socialstyrelsen, hvor der arbejdes med vurderinger og indsatser omkring elevernes trivsel
  • På Marslev Skole arbejder vi med Co-teaching i klasserummet, og der er prioriteret tid til samarbejdet mellem lærere og pædagoger. Som skolepædagog bliver du derfor en aktiv del af klasseteamet, hvor I sammen arbejder bevidst med jeres forskellige positioner, fagligheder og roller i klasserummet. Vi forventer, at du bringer din pædagogiske faglighed i spil og er nysgerrig på, hvordan lærer- og pædagogfagligheden sammen kan skabe gode deltagelsesmuligheder for alle børn
  • Stillingen vil primært være tilknyttet 1. klasse. Du bliver en del af et nyopstartet team, hvor du får mulighed for at være med til at forme og udvikle samarbejdet omkring klasse

At være pædagog i Marslev SFO er et alsidigt job med mange arbejdskredse:
  • I SFO'en skal du have lyst til at være en tydelig og gennemgående pædagogisk figur. Du tager ansvar for både børnene, fællesskabet og den pædagogiske hverdag og er med til at skabe retning, struktur og tryghed – også når dagen ændrer sig undervejs. Vi leder derfor efter en pædagog, der kan tage initiativ, træffe pædagogiske valg og være med til at sætte aktiviteter og fællesskaber i gang frem for at vente på, at andre gør det
  • Vi varetager SFO’en og lægger stor vægt på det relationelle arbejde mellem barn/barn og barn/voksen. SFO’en er børnenes frie tid, hvor de sociale spilleregler og handlemuligheder bliver sat i fokus, og vores opgave er at facilitere behov og ønsker hensigtsmæssigt alle parter imellem. Det gør vi ved at igangsætte forløb og aktiviteter, som kræver og fordrer relationelle interaktioner, og ved at være en naturlig del af den hverdag, som børnene selv skaber
  • I SFO'en bliver du en del af et tæt kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi arbejder som et selvstyrende team. Her forventes alle at byde aktivt ind med idéer, initiativ og faglige perspektiver. Vi hjælper hinanden og er sammen om at skabe en god pædagogisk hverdag

Vi forventer at du:
  • Er uddannet pædagog og har lyst til at arbejde både i skole og SFO
  • Samarbejder godt og samtidig tør komme med dine egne faglige perspektiver
  • Kommunikerer tydeligt med børn, kolleger og forældre.
  • Forstår vigtigheden af det relationelle arbejde, der ligger til grund for den tryghed og de sociale udviklingspotentialer i hverdagen, som vi arbejder med i hele institutionen
  • Er digitalt kompetent og kan selvstændigt begå dig på de digitale platforme og værktøjer, der indgår som en naturlig del af arbejdsdagen
  • Er omstillingsparat/fleksibel og forstår, at dagligdagen i SFO'en byder på nye glæder og udfordringer hver dag

Har du lyst til at vide mere om os, så er du velkommen til at besøge os.

Du kan kontakte:
Daglig pædagogisk leder Mathies Larsen på tlf: 26 14 00 89 - matl@kerteminde.dk

Eller

Fælles leder Flemming Mahler Pedersen på tlf: 51 51 62 73 - flpe@kerteminde.dk

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest.
Ansøgningsfrist: 18. oktober 2026
Ansættelsessamtaler afholdelse den 27. oktober 2026

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelse sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst for Pædagoger ved daginstitutioner, skolefritidsordninger, klubber mv. indgået mellem KL og BUPL. Stillingen er indplaceret som pædagog på 37 timer.

Forventet løninterval: 32.000 kr. - 37.000 pr. måned eksklusiv arbejdsgiverbetalt pension, fritvalg og ferietillæg. Hertil kan komme eventuelle lokalt aftalte tillæg, kvalifikations-, funktions- og genetillæg.

Den endelige lønfastsættelse sker på baggrund af din kvalifikationer og tidligere erhvervserfaring efter konkret forhandling med den faglige organisation.

Kerteminde Kommune ligger i det nordøstlige Fyn med smuk natur, engagerede landsbyer og et aktivt forenings- og erhvervsliv og gode fritidsmuligheder. Vi er cirka 25.000 borgere og 1.800 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at skabe gode løsninger sammen med borgerne.

I Kerteminde Kommune arbejder vi ud fra visionen ”Sammen Om Kerteminde”. Læs mere om vores tilgang til samarbejde, fællesskab og udvikling her Digitalt Strategibrev

Kerteminde Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle – uanset alder, køn, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold – til at søge ledige stillinger.

Hvis dit job indebærer brug af kommunens IT-systemer, kan der i forbindelse med ansættelsen være krav om identifikation via MitID. Du vil i så fald blive kontaktet herom.

Hvis du tilbydes ansættelse, kan dine kontaktoplysninger, herunder navn, adresse, telefonnummer og eventuelt CV, efter forespørgsel videregives til den lokale tillidsrepræsentant eller den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation med henblik på korrekt indplacering og lønforhandling. Har du hemmeligt telefonnummer, vil dette også blive videregivet. Videregivelsen sker i overensstemmelse med gældende databeskyttelsesregler. Har du navne- eller adressebeskyttelse, sker videregivelse først efter dit samtykke.

title: Leasing Specialist
description:
Overview

Avanath is proud to be named one of the top property management companies that provide affordable housing for the workforce.

Cultivating the American Dream is the purpose that binds the Avanath team. At Avanath, every day is an opportunity to make a difference in someone's life. Whether helping residents call one of our communities’ homes, providing excellence in customer service, or championing our workforce, we are committed to creating an unforgettable experience as a great place to live, work, and be.

The Role: The Leasing Specialist is responsible for leasing, marketing, and maintaining positive resident relations within the community.

The incumbent in this role must possess high professionalism and positive engagement for our residents and the workforce.

  • An Aptitude for Connecting - Must possess a strong sense for creating a sense of community and the drive to go the extra mile to create a positive experience for all residents and staff. Your success and purpose are driven by the relationships that you build within your communities, including vendor partners and regulatory and social services partnerships. This includes adopting a collaborative approach to create consistently favorable circumstances that foster success and effectiveness for the Organization and the communities.
  • An Authentic Attitude - Consistently demonstrate an open and professional attitude and approach when accessing and resolving resident and staff concerns. This includes, but is not limited to, seeking resources throughout the organization via the organization's support services and senior leadership.
  • A positive and professional approach —Consistently demonstrate an active listening approach and understand that your participation and support are integral to Avanath's success. Ensure that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.

Qualifications

  • Passion for providing exceptional customer service.
  • 2+ years of sales and/or customer relations experience
  • Low-Income Housing & Tax Credit experience is highly desired.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) highly desired.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible schedule that may include evenings and weekends.
  • Solid computer knowledge, Windows (Word, Excel), internet, and e-mail
  • Working knowledge of Yardi Voyager Property Management Software

Key Accountabilities

  • Customer Service & Sales
    • At all times, regardless, provides A+ customer service.
    • Greet and qualify all prospects.
    • Record all telephone and in-person visits on guest cards.
    • Inspect models and available “market-ready” and communicate related service needs to the Community Manager.
    • Demonstrate community and apartment/model and apply product knowledge to prospect needs by communicating the features and benefits; close the sale.
    • Have the prospect complete the application and secure a deposit in accordance with the company procedures and Fair Housing requirements.
    • Update availability reports and process applications for approvals.
    • Ensure the apartment is ready for the resident to move in on the agreed date.
    • Immediately follow up on prospects that did not close and attempt to close the sale again. If unable to help the prospect, refer them to sister communities to meet the prospect’s needs.
    • Secure new resident signature(s) on appropriate paperwork prior to move-in. Orient new residents to the community.
    • Assist in monitoring renewals. Distribute and follow up on renewal notices.
  • Administrative
    • Accept rental payments.
    • Type lease, complete appropriate paperwork, and input information on Yardi System accurately and on time.
    • Maintain current resident files.
    • Distribute all company or community-issued notices.
    • Maintain accurate monthly commission records on leases and renewals for bonus purposes.
    • Assist the management team with other various tasks as required.
    • Consistently implement policies of the community.
  • Resident Retention
    • Receive all telephone calls and in-person visits. Listen to resident requests, concerns, and comments.
    • Quickly complete maintenance service requests and inform the maintenance team. Answer questions for residents about the community, repairs, rent, rules, etc. Follow up promptly if unable to respond to residents on all matters.
    • Ensure all maintenance repairs are handled satisfactorily by contacting residents with completed Service Requests daily.
    • Maintain open communication with the Community Manager and the Maintenance Supervisor.
    • Contribute to the cleanliness and curb appeal of the community on a continuing basis.
    • Assist in planning resident events. Attend events and participate as a host for any event as directed by the Community Manager.
  • Adherence to Property Management Rules, Regulations, and Guidelines
    • Conduct all business in accordance with company policies and procedures, Fair Housing, Americans with Disabilities Act, and all other laws pertaining to the apartment industry.
    • Under the direction of the Compliance department and the Community Manager, manages compliance file maintenance, where applicable.

Physical Demands & Working Conditions

  • The incumbent in this position is classified as essential staff and is expected to report to work and adhere to all safety and business protocols.
  • Frequent sitting and walking
  • Repetitive use of the computer, keyboard, mouse, and phone
  • Reading, comprehending, writing, performing calculations, and communicating verbally.
  • May work in an elevated site, may walk on uneven ground.
  • Occasional squatting, bending neck/waist, twisting neck/waist, pushing, and pulling.

title: Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)
description:
Account Director, Client Solutions (EMEA)

Location: Remote. Continental Europe or compatible time zone preferred. (roughly UTC-1 to UTC+3)

Clients: Global. Primarily EMEA and North American.

Reports to: VP of Solutions

Salary Range: $80,000 - $150,000 USD annually, plus bonus/commission based on acquisition and growth of client accounts. Compensation dependent on candidate experience and location.

About McGaw

Our Mission at McGaw.io is to help companies of all sizes realize their customer data is their most valuable business asset, and we help them realize that through customer data infrastructure, high power analytics, marketing automation, personalization, and funnel optimization.

McGaw.io supports businesses with analytics, marketing automation, customer data platforms, data piping, websites, AB testing, and all sorts of marketing operations. As we derive insights from these technical efforts, we also inform & execute growth strategies that routinely move the needle for our clients.

Our track record is impeccable, and our leadership has supported some of the fastest-growing companies in the world. McGaw.io’s core client base sells online and has complex data and marketing practices that drive our team to dig deeper every day.

Mission

Own a portfolio of client relationships. Set the strategy, keep accounts healthy and profitable, grow them, win new ones, and get the technical work delivered through the team rather than by doing it yourself.

Why this role exists

Accounts need a senior owner accountable for whether they renew and whether they grow. Outside North America that accountability sits in the wrong time zone, so the client's executive sponsor talks to us at the end of their day and the relationship runs a meeting behind.

This is the commercial and strategic owner. It is not the technical builder.

Three problems this role solves:

  1. Nobody outside North America is accountable for account health, retention, and expansion.
  2. Executive conversations happen at inconvenient hours, so they happen less often.
  3. Expansion is reactive. Nobody plans the next six months before the current scope runs out, and nobody runs discovery in European hours.

Responsibilities

Relationship ownership

  • Own the relationship at executive level. You are who the client's CMO or VP of Growth calls.
  • Run the cadence: biweekly client meetings, monthly roadmap and SOW reviews, quarterly business reviews covering results, maturity, next quarter, and risks.
  • Keep the client informed before they have to ask. Never surprise them on budget or timeline.

Strategy and consulting

  • Find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention. Map every problem to pain, metric, impact, and fix.
  • Build and defend the growth roadmap with the client, not at them.
  • Do the strategic hands-on work yourself: measurement frameworks, KPI definition, funnel and cohort analysis, lifecycle program design, experiment roadmaps, readouts.
  • Translate technical decisions into business consequences the client can act on.

Delegation and project leadership

  • Scope the work, then hand it to architects and engineers with enough detail that it gets built right.
  • Manage the project, not the build. Sprint cadence, board hygiene, dependencies, risks, critical path.
  • Review delivered work against the client's objectives before it ships. You are not the QA engineer, but you are accountable for whether the client got what they were told they would get.
  • Know enough to challenge an estimate and spot a bad technical answer. You do not write the code.

New business

  • Run pre-sales discovery. Qualify hard, and say no when a prospect is not ready.
  • Build and present proposals: scope, phasing, investment, and the business case. Presented live, never sent cold.
  • Price work so it delivers profitably. A generous estimate at proposal is a delivery problem in month three.
  • Work with Sales through qualification, discovery, and close, then take the account into delivery.

Commercial

  • Own retention and expansion on your portfolio. You are measured on both.
  • Every scope change gets estimated, documented, and confirmed in writing before work starts.
  • Run the six-month roadmap cycle so the next engagement is signed before the current one ends.

Skills and experience

Required

  • Fully fluent in English. That is the company's working language.
  • Multilingual with professional working proficiency in English as well as German, French, Spanish, or Italian.
  • 10+ years in consulting, agency, or professional services. At least 5 owning senior client relationships with a revenue number attached.
  • Understand the full marketing lifecycle: demand generation, nurturing, acquisition, retention, and growth, and where revenue leaks between the stages.
  • Understand how martech drives marketing, from ads to CDPs to marketing engagement platforms, CRM, and analytics.
  • Advise on the systems below: which to use, how they fit together, the tradeoffs, and how to get more from what a client already owns. You do not configure them. You do need to be right about them, and to spot a bad technical answer when you are given one.
  • Advanced understanding of marketing and growth analytics, attribution, and how to leverage data to improve marketing returns.
  • Track record retaining and expanding accounts, with figures a former manager would confirm.
  • Pre-sales experience: discovery, scoping, writing proposals, and presenting them to executive buyers.
  • Scope and price technical work profitably.
  • Know how European businesses buy, contract, and operate across markets, including procurement, data protection, and consent.

Systems. Advisory command of these. Depth in at least three groups.

  • Customer data platforms: Segment, Hightouch, RudderStack
  • Analytics: Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4
  • Lifecycle and marketing automation: Braze, Customer.io, HubSpot, Marketo, Iterable
  • Warehouse and transformation: Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt
  • Tag management: Google Tag Manager, server-side GTM
  • CRM: Salesforce, HubSpot
  • Consent management: OneTrust, Cookiebot, Didomi

Preferred

  • Accounts across multiple countries or regulatory regimes.
  • Work across both European and North American clients.
  • Built or seeded a regional practice before.

What you get out of this

  • You own the full commercial arc of an account, from discovery through renewal and expansion. At a larger firm that is three people's jobs.
  • The customer data layer is changing right now. Warehouse-native patterns, composable CDPs, and reverse ETL are replacing a decade of assumptions. You advise on the new pattern while most of the market still sells the old one.
  • We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors. That includes telling a client when they already have what they need.
  • Many industries and stacks in a year instead of one in five, on both sides of the Atlantic.

Observable indicators

Month 2

  • Onboarded onto your accounts, each with a current-state assessment and named client objectives.
  • Time tracked in Harvest weekly, without reminders.
  • Every account's decision-maker has met you and knows what you own.

Month 4

  • Running your accounts independently: meetings, roadmap reviews, budget conversations, scope changes.
  • Every account has three or more months of planned roadmap.
  • Zero undocumented scope changes.
  • Technical work delegated with specs good enough that it does not come back for rework.
  • Running discovery calls and contributing to proposals.

Month 6

  • 90% of client objectives hit within the project timeline.
  • Labor efficiency ratio of 3.0 across your portfolio.
  • Client approval for a case study or testimonial on at least one account.
  • Writing and presenting proposals independently.

Month 9

  • 80% retention of your accounts in recurring contracts over a rolling three months.
  • 20% of your retainers expanded over a rolling 90 days.
  • Your proposals deliver at or above target labor efficiency. Your estimates hold up.
  • Representing McGaw independently in sales and partner meetings.

What this role is not

  • Not a hands-on build seat although you will get into the tools if you need to.
  • Not a prospecting seat. You run discovery, write and present proposals, own retention and expansion, and earn commission on it. You do not cold prospect.
  • Not a people management seat at hire. You direct a project team. Managing a team comes later, if the business grows and you have shown you can.

Values

  • Never Settle, Be Amazing. Fix it properly, not just enough to close the ticket.
  • Get Better Every Day. Ask for feedback and change what you do when you get it.
  • Give Context and Set the Stage. Nobody on your account is surprised by what you already knew.
  • Let the Data Create Transparency. Recommendations come with evidence. So does bad news.
  • Show Hospitality to Build Trust. Clients and teammates get proactive, responsive treatment.

Plus extreme ownership. Own the outcome, surface blockers early, and never hand a problem back to the person who gave it to you.

Benefits

  • Flexible PTO
  • Flexible hours
  • Work remotely
  • Monthly per diem for premium health, dental, and vision coverage if not already available
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Retirement contribution of 3% of salary annually.
  • Company laptop, monitor, and remote setup equipment
  • National holidays off.
  • Radically transparent workplace
  • Room to act on your own ideas

The job in practice

McGaw is a customer data and revenue operations consultancy. Clients come to us with traffic, tools, and data, and no system connecting them. We find where revenue leaks across acquisition, conversion, and retention, then we fix it with our hands on the keyboards.

The CDP is the center of most of our work. We build on Segment, Hightouch, and RudderStack, chosen per client. We work across the full client stack, not just individual systems or specific vendors.

Our clients are in North America and Europe. Your portfolio will be a mix.

Month 1. Learn our clients, delivery model, and commercial standards. Meet every stakeholder on your accounts. Shadow client meetings, QBRs, and pre-sales calls.

Months 2 and 3. Take ownership of your accounts. Run the meetings, rebuild the roadmaps, take over the budget conversations. An experienced account owner stays close.

Months 4 to 6. Run your portfolio independently. Hit your labor efficiency target. Start running discovery and writing proposals.

After 6 months. You own the commercial arc on your accounts, from first discovery call through renewal. You help define what the next hires look like.

What is hard. You are accountable for delivery you did not perform, done mostly by people in another time zone. Managing that gap is most of the job. Pre-sales competes with delivery, and both are urgent. Work is billable by the hour, so time tracking is not optional. Expansion targets are real and measured.

  • Plattformarbeid: Du jobber med moderne dataplattformer som Databricks og Microsoft Fabric for å bygge skalerbare og vedlikeholdbare ML-løsninger.

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

  • Erfaring med ML-Ops-verktøy (MLflow, KubeFlow) og produksjonsklare ML-løsninger.
  • Erfaring med skyplattformer som Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, eller AWS SageMaker.
  • Erfaring med datahåndtering, datamodellering og arbeid med store datasett.
  • Norsk, minimum B2 nivå.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er faglig sterk og har en genuin interesse for dataplattformer
  • Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og deler gjerne kunnskap
  • Du trives i møte med ulike mennesker og samarbeider tett med både kunder og kollegaer

Hos oss får du jobbe med meningsfulle og varierte prosjekter for noen av Norges største virksomheter. title: Director of Operations
description:
Director of Operations

America’s Kids In Motion | Clovis, California
Salaried Leadership Position | Average 30–35 Hours per Week
Salary: $80,000–$90,000 annually, depending on experience

America’s Kids In Motion is looking for an experienced, people-focused Director of Operations to join our leadership team.

This is a unique opportunity for an operational leader who loves developing people, improving systems, solving problems, and helping an already established organization become even better.

America’s Kids In Motion is home to a diverse family of established children's programs, including Aquatics, Recreational Gymnastics, Gymnastics Teams, Dance, NinjaZone, Music, GymUTots, CampKids, and The Campus Preschool, along with our Facilities and Behavioral Specialist teams.

Our programs already have established leaders, teams, systems, and operations.

We are not looking for someone to personally run every program. We are looking for someone who knows how to lead the leaders who do. The right person should be able to help us grow beyond where we are without losing the things that have made AKIM, AKIM.

What You'll Own

Lead, Manage & Hold Accountable

Build strong relationships with our Program Directors and operational leaders, establish clear expectations, coach them through challenges, and hold them accountable for results.

Program Performance

Use KPIs and operational data to understand how our programs are performing, identify opportunities and challenges, and work with leaders to improve results.

Systems & Process Improvement

Look for ways to simplify how we work. Identify bottlenecks, inconsistencies, and unnecessary complexity and lead improvements that make our organization stronger and more efficient.

Customer Experience

Help ensure that what happens operationally behind the scenes results in an exceptional experience for the children and families we serve.

Staffing & Operational Resources

Work with Program Directors, HR, Facilities, Behavioral Specialists, and other leaders to ensure our programs have the people, space, equipment, supplies, and resources necessary to operate successfully.

Who We're Looking For

You may be a great fit if you:

  • Have significant experience leading & developing managers, directors, or department leaders.
  • Know how to hold people accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
  • Know how to coach someone through a problem without taking the problem away from them.
  • Are comfortable with KPIs, goals, labor efficiency, and operational performance.
  • See a broken process and naturally start thinking about how to improve it.
  • Can move between big-picture thinking and what is actually happening inside the business.
  • Can prioritize effectively when several departments need attention.
  • Are comfortable having direct conversations when something isn't working.
  • Enjoy working with different personalities, programs, and business functions.
  • Want to be part of an established organization where your leadership can make a meaningful difference.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who aligns with our Core Values:

Enthusiastic Doers
Professionally Responsible
Passionately Dedicated

This Role Is Different

This isn't a traditional desk-only Director of Operations position.

We want someone who wants to know our programs, our leaders, our facilities, and how our business actually works.

Some days that may mean reviewing performance numbers and identifying opportunities with a Program Director. Another day may involve walking through a facility, improving a process, addressing a staffing challenge, or coordinating a solution that crosses several departments.

At the same time, we don't need someone who wants to personally run everything.

We need an experienced operational leader who understands that great operations come from strong leaders, clear accountability, good systems, good decisions, and consistent follow-through.

This salaried leadership position is designed around an average 30–35-hour workweek and offers an opportunity to take on meaningful senior-level responsibility without a traditional 40+ hour executive schedule.

If you are energized by making good organizations work even better, we'd love to meet you.
