title: Head of MetOcean
description:
Help shape the future of offshore wind

At Vattenfall, we are committed to enabling fossil freedom. Offshore wind is a vital part of that journey, and behind every successful project is a deep understanding of the marine and atmospheric environments in which we operate.

As Head of MetOcean, you'll lead a talented team of specialists whose work helps shape some of Europe's most ambitious offshore wind projects. Together, you'll turn complex weather, ocean and environmental data into insights that support better decisions, safer operations and stronger project outcomes.

This is a highly visible leadership role where you'll combine people leadership, strategic thinking and technical oversight. You'll help create the conditions for your team to thrive while ensuring that MetOcean expertise continues to create value across the entire offshore wind project lifecycle.

Working closely with colleagues across Development, Engineering, Project Delivery and Operations, you'll play an important role in reducing uncertainty, managing risk and supporting the successful development, construction and operation of offshore wind projects.

Your role

As Head of MetOcean, you will lead and develop a team of highly skilled specialists while setting the strategic direction for the discipline.

You will:

  • Lead, coach and support a diverse team of MetOcean specialists, helping them grow and succeed.
  • Create an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team environment where people feel empowered to contribute and develop.
  • Define the long-term vision and capability roadmap for the MetOcean function.
  • Ensure the team has the right skills, tools and resources to meet both current and future business needs.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement across forecasting, environmental modelling and analytical approaches.
  • Establish and maintain high standards for quality, governance and delivery.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Offshore Development and other business areas to support informed decision-making.
  • Translate complex marine and weather-related information into practical insights and recommendations.
  • Support project value creation through risk reduction, forecasting excellence and improved decision-making.
  • Champion digitalisation, data-driven ways of working and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions.

Location
Amsterdam, Kolding or London

Qualifications

What you'll bring

We know that strong leaders come from a variety of backgrounds and experiences. You may not meet every single point below, and that's okay. If this opportunity excites you and you believe you can make a meaningful contribution, we'd love to hear from you.

To be successful in this role, you'll bring a combination of people leadership, strategic thinking and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

You are likely to have:

  • Experience leading, coaching and developing specialist or technical teams.
  • The ability to create clarity, inspire collaboration and enable others to perform at their best.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience influencing decisions and building alignment across functions and disciplines.
  • Experience gained within offshore wind, marine industries, energy, environmental services, large-scale infrastructure projects or a similar complex environment.
  • Experience managing programmes, budgets, consultants and strategic initiatives.
  • A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and developing people.

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable:

  • MetOcean studies and assessments.
  • Marine environmental analysis and forecasting.
  • Offshore construction support and workability analysis.
  • Risk management and uncertainty reduction.
  • Digitalisation, advanced analytics and data-driven decision-making.
  • Forecasting tools, modelling approaches or AI-enabled solutions.

Who you are

You're an empowering leader who enjoys helping people grow and succeed. You understand that great results come from creating an environment where specialists can collaborate, learn from one another and do their best work.

You are comfortable balancing strategic priorities with operational realities and can communicate complex topics in a way that is accessible to a wide range of stakeholders.

You are curious, open-minded and motivated by finding better ways of working. You see opportunities in new technologies and enjoy helping teams embrace innovation while staying focused on delivering value.

Most importantly, you're someone who brings people together around a shared purpose and creates the confidence and direction needed to achieve ambitious goals.

Why join us?

This is an opportunity to lead a strategically important function at the heart of the energy transition.

You'll work alongside talented colleagues from diverse backgrounds, contribute to major offshore wind developments and help shape the future direction of the MetOcean discipline within Vattenfall.

At Vattenfall, we believe that diverse perspectives lead to better decisions and stronger teams. We welcome applicants with different experiences, backgrounds and ways of thinking. If you're interested in this role but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. Your leadership, potential and unique perspective may be exactly what we're looking for.

Additional Information

Our offer
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information
We welcome your application in English, no later than, October 6th 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Anne Vriesema via anne.vriesema@vattenfall.com

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

title: Security Consultant (Governance, Risk & Compliance)
description:
Governance, Risk en Compliance
Binnen onze GRC‑afdeling zorg je ervoor dat organisaties gestructureerd en aantoonbaar veilig kunnen opereren. Je adviseert over securitybeleid, raamwerken en strategische keuzes, en helpt organisaties om risico’s inzichtelijk te maken en passende maatregelen te definiëren. Hiervoor werk je nauw samen met technische teams, management en diverse stakeholders, zodat securitybeslissingen aansluiten op zowel operationele als bestuurlijke behoeften.

Je werkzaamheden verschillen per opdracht: zo voer je risicoanalyses, maturity‑assessments en compliance‑checks uit, of ondersteun je audits, begeleid je verbetertrajecten en zorg je dat processen en verantwoordelijkheden helder worden vastgelegd. Ook speel je een belangrijke rol in awareness en organisatieverandering: je helpt medewerkers, management en teams begrijpen waarom beveiligingsmaatregelen nodig zijn en hoe ze bijdragen aan betrouwbare en verantwoorde digitale dienstverlening.

Wie ben jij?
We zijn op zoek naar gedreven collega’s die de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van cybersecurity en een sleutelrol willen spelen in het beschermen van organisaties tegen digitale dreigingen. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen.

We zoeken mensen met een proactieve instelling, sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om effectief te schakelen tussen de belangen van verschillende stakeholders. Je bent in staat om zelfstandig robuuste security policies en procedures te ontwikkelen en te implementeren. Je kunt daarbij ook goed omgaan met weerstand: je blijft helder, rustig en overtuigend wanneer je lastige keuzes moet toelichten of veranderingsprocessen begeleidt.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Sterke basiskennis en ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met focus op IT, Cyber Security, Security Management, of crisismanagement.

  • Certificeringen op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, zoals CISM, ISO27001 Lead Implementer, CRISC of CISSP. Aanvullend een certificering zoals OSCP, of de bereidheid om deze te behalen.

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in informatiebeveiliging.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en goede beheersing van het Engels.

Herken je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze punten? Dan kijken we alvast uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Dit krijg je van ons
Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract;

  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

Lijkt deze job iets voor jou?

Ben je klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Senior Product Manager - Search & AI Discovery (12 months parental cover)
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO
As Senior Product Manager for Search & AI Discovery, you will shape how customers find, explore and connect with our digital commerce experience — across traditional search and the next generation of AI-powered discovery. You will lead a cross-functional team focused on building strong technical foundations for discoverability while preparing the business for emerging search experiences, shopping agents and agentic commerce.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH
You will collaborate closely with developers, an Engineering Manager, an Analyst and, when needed, a Solution Architect. Together, you will work at the intersection of technical SEO, digital commerce and emerging AI-led discovery, partnering across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Content, Analytics and Commercial teams.

You will own the product strategy and roadmap for search discoverability, ensuring our digital platforms are built to be visible, scalable and high-performing across markets. This includes core technical SEO capabilities such as metadata, canonicals, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, hreflang, URL structures, pagination, faceted navigation and Core Web Vitals.

Beyond today’s search landscape, you will help define how we show up in AI-powered search, generative discovery and shopping-agent experiences. You will monitor developments from key platforms and partners, translate external change into clear recommendations, and turn emerging opportunities into experiments, product priorities and business impact.

As the digital lead for agentic commerce, you will drive alignment, clarity and adoption across teams. You will make complex SEO and AI-search topics understandable for different audiences, from engineers and specialists to business stakeholders and senior leaders, while balancing long-term direction with practical delivery, experimentation and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the product strategy and roadmap for Search & AI Discovery.
  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap across scalable digital commerce platforms.
  • Improve discoverability, site performance and search-readiness across markets and customer journeys.
  • Explore and shape opportunities within AI search, generative discovery and agentic commerce.
  • Turn developments from Google, OpenAI and other relevant platforms into product recommendations, tests and priorities.
  • Embed SEO and AI discovery considerations into relevant digital initiatives and ways of working.
  • Lead and support audits, pilots, experiments and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Partner with engineering teams to translate discovery needs into clear requirements and backlog priorities.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Content, Analytics and Commercial teams to strengthen content readiness and customer discoverability.
  • Communicate technical and strategic topics with clarity to product, business and senior leadership audiences.

WHO YOU ARE
To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

  • Experience in product management, digital commerce, SEO, search or related digital product areas.
  • A solid understanding of technical SEO and its role in e-commerce growth, performance and discoverability.
  • Good understanding of web technologies, CMS platforms and front-end fundamentals, including HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
  • Experience working closely with engineering teams in an agile product development setup.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to identify opportunities, shape priorities and evaluate impact.
  • The ability to translate complex technical topics into clear recommendations and actionable product priorities.
  • Strong communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • You are curious about the future of digital discovery and motivated by turning change into opportunity.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.

This role is 12 months parental cover and position is based in Stockholm, Sweden. We are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship for this position. Applicants must already have the right to work in Sweden.

WHO WE ARE​
H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

  • 25% Staff discount on all our H&M Group brands, both in stores and online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET).
  • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Learn more about the program here.
  • In addition to our global benefits, our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. (Example: Competitive compensation for your dedication and long-term commitment. A day off on your birthday to relax and celebrate your special day. Special gift to celebrate the birth of your child, etc.)

JOIN US​
Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

title: Dean of Academic Excellence & Effectiveness
description:
The Position

Title: Dean of Academic Excellence & Effectiveness

Position Type: Full-time

Requisition No: 27008

Category : Administration

Supervisor : VP of Learning and Instruction

Last Updated : July 2026

Job Purpose : This position leads Calbright's academic excellence and effectiveness agenda, advancing a

culture of continuous improvement, evidence-based practice, and accreditation integrity, while

helping drive cross-divisional systems, quality standards, and project management infrastructure

that support equitable student access, success, outcomes, and institutional growth.

Location: Remote, various locations throughout California

Salary Range: The beginning salary range for this position is Range M-21, (Steps 1-3) $159,314.04- $175,673.59.

**The first review of the application shall occur approximately on 10/12/2026**

Position Overview

The Dean of Academic Excellence & Effectiveness serves as an institutional leader and executive partner at Calbright College, providing strategic counsel and cross-functional guidance across program quality, institutional effectiveness, operations, accreditation, and college-wide initiatives. Working in close partnership with the VP of Learning and Instruction and the senior leadership team, the Dean plays a pivotal role in strengthening the quality and integrity of Calbright's academic programs and advancing a culture of evidence-based practice, continuous improvement, and equitable student success. The Dean serves as the College's primary Accreditation Liaison Officer (ALO) and works cross-functionally to strengthen institutional policies, procedures, and systems in alignment with accreditation standards, supporting all academic and non-academic functions in advancing Calbright's mission and growth. Success in this role requires a collaborative leader who is committed to evidence-based practice, equity, academic excellence, and the Calbright mission.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

The duties below are representative of the role and are not intended to cover all of the duties performed within the scope of work.

Academic Quality and Effectiveness

  • Lead the College's academic program review cycle, guiding frameworks, timelines, and evidence-based program evaluation processes that drive continuous improvement.
  • Support the development, assessment, and revision of programs, advising on alignment with quality standards, accreditation needs, strategic priorities, and student success goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance on program optimization and processes, including program-level data analysis and evidence-based improvement recommendations across academic and non-academic units.
  • Collaborate with administration and cross-divisional teams to support operational systems, workflows, and reporting infrastructure that advance College effectiveness and embed data-informed decision-making at all levels.
  • Provide leadership and oversight of the College's industry Advisory Councils, guiding effective council governance, engagement, and cross-functional coordination, and collaborating with academic leaders to translate council input into actionable program improvements and workforce relevance.

Strategic Initiatives & Operations

  • Provide support, as needed, to the President and the senior leadership team on relevant institutional priorities, goals, organizational effectiveness, and emerging opportunities.
  • Support and facilitate institution-wide strategic initiatives, including organizational development, technology, culture and engagement efforts, effectiveness projects, and cross-divisional priorities aligned with the College's mission and strategic plan.
  • Guide and support the College's external advisory council engagement, helping advance industry alignment, employer partnerships, and program relevance across Calbright's workforce-focused portfolio.
  • Provide strategic planning, analysis, and advisory support to the VP of Learning and Instruction and senior leadership team, informing institutional priorities, goal-setting processes, and policy development.
  • Represent the College's effectiveness, quality, and innovation agenda externally where appropriate.

Project Management and Organizational Effectiveness

  • Provide leadership and oversight of L&I project managers and cross-functional project teams responsible for strategic and operational initiatives.
  • Establish project management standards, implementation timelines, and reporting processes to support successful project execution.
  • Monitor progress toward L&I goals, key performance indicators, and operational priorities, providing regular updates and recommendations to the VP.
  • Support the development of project evaluation processes that measure effectiveness, outcomes, and organizational impact.

Accreditation Leadership

  • Serve as the College's primary Accreditation Liaison Officer (ALO), maintaining effective communication and a productive institutional relationship with all accrediting agencies.
  • Guide and coordinate all accreditation cycles, including preparation of self-study evaluations, substantive and non-substantive change requests, program approvals, site visit coordination, and required follow-up reports.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving accreditation standards and regulations, advising team members on required institutional adjustments and strategic responses.
  • Help design and support internal review processes and cross-functional action plans that ensure ongoing standards compliance and a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate on the development and facilitation of professional development for faculty and staff on accreditation standards, processes, and institutional expectations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills.
  • Strategic thinking and systems-level problem-solving, with a focus on continuous improvement, operational excellence, and equity-centered practice.
  • Knowledge of accreditation standards, institutional effectiveness practices, and continuous improvement frameworks in higher education.
  • Knowledge of higher education, curriculum development, instructional strategies, and/or assessment practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives amid competing priorities, with strong project management, implementation planning, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Knowledge of workforce development, labor market alignment, and/or employer engagement strategies.
  • Experience facilitating advisory groups, committees, councils, or stakeholder engagement processes.
  • Ability to analyze data, synthesize findings, prepare reports, and present actionable recommendations clearly and effectively.
  • Proficiency in using technology for data management, reporting, and communication.
  • Demonstrated understanding of, sensitivity to, and respect for the diverse academic, socio-economic, ethnic, religious, cultural backgrounds, disability, and sexual orientation of community college students, staff, and faculty.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Master's degree in education, administration, policy, or a related field.
  • At least five years of experience in higher education administration, with demonstrated leadership in institutional effectiveness, accreditation, academic quality, and/or strategic initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience leading accreditation processes and serving as a liaison to regional or national accrediting agencies.
  • Familiarity with online learning environments and quality standards related to distance education.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional leadership, project management, and driving institutional initiatives and operational improvement efforts across diverse stakeholder groups in higher education or a related sector.

Desired Qualifications

  • Doctorate in a related field.
  • Experience with both regional and specialized accreditation in higher education.
  • Experience in competency-based education, online education, workforce education, or innovative higher education models.
  • Experience presenting institutional effectiveness, accreditation, or project outcomes to governing boards, executive leadership teams, or external stakeholders.
  • Evidence of professional engagement and leadership in accreditation, institutional effectiveness, and/or strategic planning organizations.

Working Conditions and Travel

  • Calbright College is a statewide online college where all instruction and support are done via various online technologies both in person and remotely. Calbright College has administrative offices in Sacramento available for use. When working remotely, employees should be able and willing to use digital communication tools as used by the college and have the ability to work on a computer for extended periods of time. Although this is a primarily remote position, there may be instances in which you will be required to attend meetings or travel to in-person events.
  • Regular attendance is considered an essential job function; the inability to meet attendance requirements may preclude the employee from retaining employment.
  • The person holding this position is considered a mandated reporter under the California Child Abuse and Neglect Reporting Act and is required to comply with the requirements outlined in Calbright College policies, procedures, and Title IX.
  • Calbright College celebrates all forms of diversity and is deeply committed to fostering an inclusive environment within which students, staff, administrators,and faculty thrive. Individuals interested in advancing Calbright College’s strategic diversity goals are strongly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified applicants with disabilities who self-disclose.
  • Requires the ability to function in a remote online instructional environment performing work of primarily a sedentary nature. Requires the ability to use hearing and speech to make presentations to groups and carry on conversations over the phone and in-person. Requires speaking skills to communicate with staff and students in one-on-one and small group settings, on the phone, and to distinguish sound prompts from various types of equipment. Requires near visual acuity to read printed materials and computer screens. Requires sufficient hand/arm/finger dexterity to retrieve work materials, operate a personal computer keyboard, and operate standard office equipment. Requires the ability to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.
  • Work is performed indoors where minimal safety considerations exist.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Calbright College provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, veteran status, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Calbright College complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment.

Who We Are

Calbright College is one of California’s newest community colleges – the first statewide, online campus designed to bridge the gap between employers with unfilled positions and students who don’t have either the time or money to attend a traditional school. Our mission is to increase economic mobility and close equity gaps for working adults who lack easy access to traditional forms of higher education by offering online, flexible, affordable skills-based programs that provide tangible economic value for both working adults and hiring managers.

title: FOOD AND NURITION AIDE- FALL RIVER
location: MAYERS MEMORIAL HOSPITAL - FALL RIVER MILLS, CA 96028
description:
Reports To: Food and Nutrition Services Manager

Employee Type: EXEMPT X NON-EXEMPT

POSITION SUMMARY:

Under the direct supervision of the Food and Nutrition Manager the Dietaide prepares and mixes ingredients for salads, desserts, beverages and similar cold dishes for the hospital residents, patients, visitors and facility staff.

This job description is intended to identify some of the primary duties and responsibilities. Mayers Memorial Hospital District reserves the right to modify, supplement, delete or augment the duties and responsibilities specified in this position description, at MAYERS MEMORIAL HOSPITAL DISTRICT’S sole and absolute discretion.

POSITION QUALIFICATIONS:

  1. Must be a high school graduate or equivalent.
  2. Maintains regulatory requirements, i.e. mandatory in-services, departmental in-services, attends required staff meeting.
  3. Previous experience in food service, but not required.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:

General Competencies:

  1. Professional behavior is demonstrated, both when on duty and as a representative of MMHD outside of normal work hours.
  2. Ability to work with others, at all levels within the organization, and collaborate effectively.
  3. Above-average interpersonal, problem-solving, and written and oral communication skills.
  4. A positive working relationship with residents, patients, visitors, and facility staff is demonstrated.
  5. Organizational ability and time management is demonstrated.

  7. Demonstrates the ability to compile and organize data using Microsoft Office Applications. Ability to make appropriate recommendations or conclusions, given the data obtained.

  13. Demonstrates ability to effectively use office machines in the performance of job functions.
  14. Answers phone calls, assists public, and forwards appropriately if necessary and in a professional and friendly manner.
  15. Other duties as assigned.

Specific Competencies:

  1. Prepares beverages, salads, desserts and nourishments.
  2. Prepares food according to written and verbal instructions including type, quantity and portions.
  3. Ensures meals are ready at specified times.
  4. Consults with Food and Nutrition Manager and/or Registered Dietitian on modified diets, as necessary.

  11. Runs cash register in hospital cafeteria.
  12. Observes infection control practices at all times.
  13. Cleans and sanitizes food preparation area after use.
  14. Follows posted cleaning schedule utilizing proper sanitation and cleaning methods.
  15. Performs all aspects of patient care in an environment that optimizes patient safety and reduces the likelihood of medical/health care errors.

Professional Requirements:

  1. Adheres to dress code; appearance is neat and professional.
  2. Completes annual education requirements if applicable.
  3. Maintains regulatory requirements.
  4. Wears identification while on duty.

  6. Reports to work on time and as scheduled; completes work in designated time.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  1. Willingness to work beyond normal working hours and in other positions temporarily when necessary.
  2. Is involved with personnel, visitors and government agencies, etc., when necessary.
  3. Must function independently, have personal integrity, have flexibility and the ability to work effectively with other personnel, clients and support agencies.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  1. Works in a fast-paced environment.
  2. Push meal carts to and from patient care units.
  3. Ability to stoop, kneel, crouch, and reach as needed.
  4. Ability to stand for long periods of time.
  5. Lift up to 35 pounds when necessary.
  6. Works in warm temperatures during the summer months.
  7. Works in cold temperatures for short periods of time.
  8. Works in walk-in freezer for short periods of time.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Overview

We’re hiring a Software Engineer to build the internal products that keep the business running: automation services, API integrations, operational tooling and QA automation. You’ll work across backend, frontend and data - shipping pragmatic solutions from discovery to production.

This is an ownership role, you won’t just “hand off” projects. You’ll design, build, operate and evolve the systems you deliver with a focus on reliability, observability and long-term maintainability.

What you’ll do

  • Deliver integrations between internal platforms and third-party services (REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven workflows, data sync).
  • Develop internal web tools (with UIs) used by non-technical teams to get work done quickly and safely.
  • Build reliable automation (jobs, schedulers, queues).
  • Ship production‑grade code with reviews, testing strategy and documentation.
  • Troubleshoot and improve: debug across team‑owned systems, perform root‑cause analysis and implement fixes.

What we’re looking for

  • 2+ years professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript (primary language) in a modern ecosystem - ideally js + Vue.
  • Proven experience designing and consuming APIs (auth, pagination, rate limiting, error handling, resilience).
  • Working knowledge of databases: schema concepts, queries, migrations and data models that support real workflows.
  • Comfortable with Git and structured code review.

What we offer

  • Semi remote-friendly setup with flexibility built around outcomes and business priorities.
  • Strong ownership culture: you’ll ship meaningful systems and keep improving them after launch - no “throw it over the wall.”
  • Education budget for courses, certifications, conferences, and learning resources.
  • Team lunch once per week (on us).
  • Monthly gym allowance.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Collaborative environment: you’ll work closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders and with clear communication.

Contact us to apply

If you are a proactive and motivated individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment, we invite you to apply.

title: Cloud Data Platform Engineer
description:
From the tail of the fish to the tail of the waka, shines the sun

Thiswhakataukīspeaks to our journey across Aotearoa, one waka, one purpose, powered by the natural forces that sustain us. Meridian is Aotearoa’s largest renewable electricity producer, generating energy from the winds ofTāwhirimātea, the waters of Tangaroa, and the warmth of Tama-nui-te-rā.

Together, our two brands,MeridianandPowershopretail electricity to more than 400,000 homes, businesses and farms across New Zealand.Nowthat’sapretty impressivecombo!


Mō te tūranga | About the role

Meridian are hiring a Cloud Data Platform Engineer to deliver the engineering, operation, and administration of Meridian's Azure Databricks platform and its supporting Azure infrastructure — ensuring it is secure, reliable, and available by design, and that platform capability is delivered as code so teams can build and run data and AI workloads safely on top of it.

  • 5+ years engineering and operating cloud platforms in production, ideally shared platforms with internal end users.
  • Hands-on Azure depth: networking and private connectivity, identity (Entra ID, RBAC, PIM), storage, Key Vault, and monitoring.
  • Strong infrastructure-as-code and DevOps practice — Terraform, source control, and CI/CD as the default path to change.
  • Experience running shared platforms used by multiple teams, balancing autonomy with consistent guardrails.
  • Technical ownership at platform level: setting direction and standards and being accountable for the outcome.
  • Sound grasp of platform security and governance — access models, network isolation, secrets, and audit.
  • Hands-on experience administering Azure Databricks or a comparable data platform (e.g. Snowflake, Fabric) preferred, but not essential.
  • Degree in a relevant technical discipline (e.g. computer science, engineering) or 5+ years' relevant experience.
  • Growth mindset, collaborative and transparent, and comfortable adjusting quickly in a fast-paced environment.

We value work/life balance, so our flexible work options (where possible) make things easier for you and your whānau. We also offer:

  • An attractive and competitive salary packagethat’sreviewed annually, performance-incentive plus discounts fromseveralpartnerships
  • Southern Cross Healthcare - Wellbeing one insurance, funded scheme for eligible employees to give you that extra peace of mind
  • Enhanced leave provisions: three company paid days (over the holiday period), enhanced parentalleaveand options to buy up to 12 daysadditionalleave
  • Life,traumaand income protection insurance (which we hope youwon’tneed!)
  • Enhanced KiwiSaver contributions
  • Access to the Meridian employee share scheme
  • Excellent learning and development opportunities, we want you to be the best version of yourself and will help you get there!
  • Award winning wellbeing programme that provides support whenever and wherever you need it
  • Employee discounts off your power with Meridian, every bit counts
  • Aone-off $400 payment to support your work from home set-up (if needed)

We’re a great place to work with plenty of opportunities and career development for those that want it. We value and live by three ‘How to Be’s’: ‘be gutsy’, working together by ‘being in the waka’ and doing the right thing by ‘being a good human’.

We embrace diversity and inclusion and ensure that everyone feels like they belong, are welcomed, feel valued, and feel comfortable to bring their whole selves to work. We want all our people to be the best that they can be, so we make sure that there’s room for everyone to be exactly who they are, andwelcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences, including individuals with disabilities, diverse health needs, and those who identify as neurodiverse, because we believe our differences make us stronger. title: Contract Senior Full Stack Developer – Java 21 / React / AWS
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer.

The role is to build a new Forms capability consisting of a Java 21 / Spring Boot 3 backend service and a React / Vite / TanStack frontend portal, both deployed as containers on AWS EKS.

The solution will reuse existing platform services for users, projects, project assignments, document storage/S3, Cognito authentication and SES email, integrating with them through REST APIs and JWT.

Forms will be hard-coded for each use case, rather than generated dynamically from configuration. For each reporting period, the system will create a single immutable submission snapshot, with no version history. Project totals will only be updated once a submission is approved, using a single transactional update.

The application should use one common, scheme-independent codebase, with lightweight configuration applied for each deployment. Production deployments will be separated as required, while lower environments may support multiple configurations.

This is a contract of 1 month with 1 month extension possible.

The contractor must be UK-based and eligible to obtain BPSS clearance.

title: Embedded DSP Firmware Engineer - HW/SW Integration
description:
Imagine being part of a team that’s redefining the future of mobility—where your ideas don’t just sit in a lab but power next-generation technology. At indie, we are developing cutting-edge semiconductors, photonics, and radar sensors and systems for automotive, industrial, and adjacent markets. Our innovations are at the heart of advanced intelligent sensing and user experience applications, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

If you're passionate about groundbreaking technology and want to make a real impact alongside a fast-paced team that thrives on creativity and collaboration, we’d love to have you on board!

Do you enjoy working in a creative, fast-growing, entrepreneurial environment? With indie Semiconductor, Inc. (Nasdaq: INDI), an Autotech solutions innovator, you'll never walk alone! We place high value on our teams and pursue excellence for our employees and customers!

indie Semiconductor is a fabless semiconductor company specializing in the design of innovative mixed-signal System-on-Chip (SoC) solutions for automotive applications.

Our design team develops custom and standard SoC solutions for automotive applications that integrate advanced digital ICs (Arm® Cortex® MCUs and/or DSP) with mixed-signal devices into a single System-in-Package (SiP). The mixed signal can include power management, RF, high voltage, as well as high-speed converters, allowing us to provide complete solutions to our international customer base.

You will join a small team of highly competent engineers involved in the design, implementation, and verification of firmware for embedded systems targeting automotive driver assistance system (ADAS) applications. You will architect, design, implement, and support firmware modules and sample applications. You will also support the hardware SoC design team’s pre-silicon verification and application engineering group’s customer-facing demonstration platforms. This is an excellent opportunity for a talented and motivated firmware developer to join a growing team of engineers who strive to solve automotive problems.

Job Responsibilities

  • Design top-level simulation and FPGA tests from the test plan to ensure correct system-level integration before tape-out
  • Collaborate with digital design engineers to integrate software with SoC-specific accelerators, so firmware is ready for silicon bring-up on day 1
  • Profile and map neural-network models onto hardware accelerators when required, translating high-level framework metrics into efficient machine code and data flow
  • Design, develop, and optimize DSP embedded software for ADAS systems, including DSP techniques, data-path design, and cycle/memory profiling
  • Support customer-facing activities such as firmware customization and root-cause analysis, together with application engineering
  • Use AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, and other LLMs) to accelerate implementation, test generation, documentation, and debugging
  • Contribute to Git-based workflows and CI (build, regression, and bring-up tests)

Job Requirements

These are the skills and know-how an ideal candidate would bring. We understand that nobody is perfect! After all, your new job should challenge you, and you will have the opportunity to grow.

  • B.S. in Electronic/Computer Engineering or Computer Science (or equivalent experience)
  • 1+ years of embedded firmware experience (or equivalent depth), including bring-up and debugging on real hardware or FPGA
  • Deep understanding of computer architecture principles: pipelining, memory hierarchy (caches/MMU), interrupts/exceptions, and ISA-level behavior
  • Strong Embedded C and working Assembly for ISRs, exception handlers, and bare-metal driver development
  • Solid command of build toolchains and object-file formats (ELF), including linker scripts for memory placement and system initialization
  • Familiarity with HW/SW partitioning and mapping of neural-network models onto heterogeneous architectures (CPU/DSP/NPU)
  • Practical experience using AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent LLMs) in day-to-day engineering work
  • Excellent communication in Spanish and English (written and verbal), with a collaborative mindset for cross-site, team-based development

What Extra Skills Make You Stand Out?

The following skills are not required for the position. If you have experience in any of them, it would be a plus. The goal is to understand candidates' backgrounds and/or strengths.

  • Experience with SIMD/VLIW, fixed-point arithmetic, and cycle-accurate profiling
  • Hands-on firmware development experience with Cadence Tensilica (Xtensa), ARM Cortex-M/R/A, as well as familiarity with RISC-V (RV32/RV64), including CSRs, interrupt and exception models, toolchains, and ABI conventions
  • RTOS experience (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or AUTOSAR OS) in addition to bare-metal

Location: Córdoba City, Córdoba, Argentina

V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Portfolio Management & Compliance Tracking:
  • Own day-to-day administration across properties: rental statements, repairs follow-up, arrears tracking, tenant changeover admin, and letting agent queries.
  • Track and action safety certificates, property insurance renewals, council tax setups, and utility transitions before deadlines expire.
  • Maintain complete and accurate records across CRM platforms, mortgage schedules, shared cloud folders, and digital portfolio trackers.
Refinance & Finance Administration:
  • Maintain a 100% complete mortgage and refinance schedule across all financed properties.
  • Spot mortgage end dates early, initiating refinance preparation at least 3 months in advance.
  • Coordinate refinance progression with brokers, lenders, valuers, and legal teams, keeping documentation moving without avoidable delay.
Stakeholder Communication & Cross-Department Coordination:
  • Own day-to-day management of the portfolio inbox, ensuring incoming queries are acknowledged, prioritised, and progressed.
  • Act as the central information hub: pass key portfolio updates promptly to internal operational, finance, and marketing teams without them having to chase.
  • Build constructive working relationships with letting agents, contractors, insurers, and professional advisers.
Commercial Optimisation & Reporting:
  • Review portfolio cash flow, occupancy, and operating costs monthly—bringing forward at least one practical efficiency recommendation or cost-saving proposal each month.
  • Produce concise regular reporting on portfolio position, refinance status, risks, and upcoming actions.

Requirements

  • Proven Experience: 5+ years of experience in a high-volume administration, senior operational support, project coordination, or executive assistant role. Experience supporting international clients remotely is highly advantageous.
  • System & Tracker Proficiency: High IT competency with spreadsheets and CRM platforms. Familiarity with Google Workspace tools is a distinct advantage.
  • Tech & AI Agility: Comfortable picking up new software quickly and naturally curious about using AI tools to streamline admin workflows and drive efficiency.
  • Communication Skills: Flawless written and spoken English. You write updates that are clear, professional, and proactive enough that leadership rarely needs to ask follow-up questions.
Dedicated Remote Setup:
  • A quiet, professional home office environment free from background noise.
  • Meticulously reliable high-speed fibre internet connection.
  • Robust backup power arrangements (Inverter/UPS) and secondary data options to ensure uninterrupted working hours.
  • Modern laptop/PC, high-quality headset, and clear webcam.
This role requires a decisive self-starter who drives issues forward relentlessly, while respecting clear decision boundaries:
  • Proactive Owner: You chase outstanding items without prompting and never send an email and simply wait.
  • Process & Tracker Disciplined: Rigorous and detail-focused, you rely on CRMs, spreadsheets, and live asset trackers—never memory.
  • Commercially Curious & Tenacious: You think like a landlord—checking costs, seeking cost-effective outcomes, and holding letting agents, contractors, and brokers accountable.
  • Channel Confident: You pick up the phone when a quick call will unblock an issue faster than an email, always documenting decisions in writing afterwards.
  • Clear on Boundaries: You drive operational admin relentlessly, but escalate investment, lending, expenditure, and strategy decisions strictly to Directors.

Benefits

  • High-Performing Culture: Join an award-winning, highly supportive business with a warm, family-like team dynamic.
  • 100% Remote Stability: Full-time permanent remote contract running on a clear Monday–Friday UK daytime schedule with a dedicated 1-hour lunch break.
  • Professional Development: Continuous professional learning, financial support for training, and an assigned team buddy for ongoing onboarding support.

title: Supply Chain Planner
description:
Simtra BioPharma Solutions (Simtra) is a world-class Contract Development Manufacturing Organization, partnering with pharmaceutical and biotech companies to bring their sterile injectable products to market. With facilities in Bloomington, Indiana, US and Halle/Westfalen, Germany, we offer a wide range of delivery systems including pre-filled syringes, liquid/lyophilized vials, diluents for reconstitution, powder-filled vials and sterile crystallization.

Our product types include biologics and small molecules, cytotoxics, highly potent compounds, diluents for reconstitution and vaccines – which are all directly injected into patients worldwide. As such, there is a strong emphasis on quality and continuous improvement at Simtra. We hold ourselves to the highest quality and regulatory standards.

While our primary focus is cGMP manufacturing, we offer many support services including formulation and development, lyophilization optimization, global regulatory support and secondary packaging. Our teams are driven to help clients scale, innovate and bring life-changing medicines to patients worldwide.

Why join Team Simtra? Because we:

Make it HAPPEN – We bring a growth mindset to every opportunity, developing new skillsets and exceeding our expectations and those of our customers.

Make it TOGETHER – We work as one, respecting each voice and tapping into our unique strengths across teams—so we can solve problems in new ways.

Make it RIGHT – We hold ourselves to a high standard of excellence, fulfilling our commitments to the customer, their patients, and our team members.

Make it COUNT – We take pride in our day-to-day work, knowing the impact we make – taking on challenges big and small to improve patient health.

This role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Supply Chain Planner to develop, manage, and maintain a workable production plan that supports both customer needs and business objectives. This role partners closely with cross-functional teams to balance capacity, demand, and operational priorities in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.

The ideal candidate is analytical, collaborative, and able to effectively manage multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

The responsibilities:

  • Generate and present short‑term capacity and resource analyses.
  • Evaluate intermittent demand and customer requests to identify the best opportunities for scheduling filling and finishing activities.
  • Maintain a balanced 90‑day manufacturing plan focused on labor and equipment utilization, while accounting for preventive maintenance and other non-production activities.
  • Collaborate with Manufacturing to develop and maintain an executable production plan.
  • Open and manage work orders in the ERP system.
  • Coordinate start dates for Filling and Finishing work orders to ensure smooth material flow.
  • Prepare monthly performance metrics (e.g., Schedule Adherence, S&OP, budgeted volume).
  • Manage and maintain master data including project codes, routings, turn/run times, and other planning elements.
  • Coordinate internal non‑product production activities, including scheduling, work order management, and reporting.
  • Serve as the system owner for the internal Compass database, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
  • Create and maintain the shipping schedule.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of professional experience; experience in contract manufacturing a plus.
  • Solid understanding of business operations and strategic planning.
  • Strong ability to design reports, analyze data, and present findings.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while following established guidelines and processes.
  • Strong problem‑solving and analytical skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to identify process gaps and recommend improvements.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to work effectively across diverse functional teams.
  • Team-oriented and adaptable in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication; strong arithmetic skills.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel required.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and enterprise systems such as JDE, BPLM, Pilgrim, Trackwise, or similar.

Physical / safety requirements:

  • Ability to work overtime, including evenings and weekends, as needed.
  • Able to sit for extended periods; occasional walking or standing may be required.
  • Manual dexterity to operate office equipment.
  • Occasional lifting or moving of objects up to 20 pounds.

title: IT-konsulent
description:
Vil du være med til at udvikle kundernes IT-miljøer og omsætte deres behov til løsninger, der virker i praksis?

For Azend søger vi en IT-konsulent, der brænder for IT og trives med at kombinere teknisk arbejde med tæt kundekontakt. Du har et godt teknisk fundament, indsigt i Modern Work og Microsoft 365 og lyst til at hjælpe kunderne med at drifte og udvikle deres IT.

Din primære arbejdsplads bliver på Azend’s kontor i Ikast. Bor du i retning af Skanderborg eller Esbjerg, er der mulighed for at arbejde fra et af disse kontorer 1-2 dage om ugen.

Hos Azend bliver du en vigtig teknisk sparringspartner for kunderne. Du sætter dig ind i deres behov, deltager i kundemøder og hjælper med at finde de rigtige løsninger. Samtidig samarbejder du med salgsafdelingen om pre-sales og design af IT-løsninger, og vigtigst af alt, er du med til at implementere løsningerne hos kunderne.

Azend tror på, at de bedste løsninger skabes gennem dialog, forståelse og et tæt samarbejde. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du både har lyst til teknikken og til relationen med kunden.

Dine opgaver
Som IT-konsulent kommer du til at arbejde med en bred vifte af opgaver med hovedvægt på Microsoft-teknologier, implementering og kundernes daglige IT.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Hjælpe kunderne med deres IT og den løbende udvikling af deres IT-miljøer

  • Implementering og konfigurering af løsninger inden for Modern Work og Microsoft 365

  • Arbejde med IT-sikkerhed som en naturlig del af kundernes løsninger

  • Deltage i kundemøder og omsætte kundernes behov til konkrete tekniske løsninger

  • Understøtte salgsafdelingen med teknisk pre-sales, sparring og design af IT-løsninger

  • Planlægge og gennemføre implementeringer, migreringer og ændringer hos kunderne

  • Arbejde med og fejlfinde på grundlæggende netværksløsninger hos kunderne, herunder f.eks. LAN, Wi-Fi, firewall og VPN.

Du behøver ikke være specialist i alle områder. Det vigtigste er, at du er en dygtig IT-tekniker med et solidt teknisk fundament, som kan tage ansvar for en opgave og føre den fra behov og løsningsdesign til en velfungerende implementering hos kunden.

Derfor skal du vælge Azend
Hos Azend får du:

  • Stor frihed og ansvar i en organisation med korte beslutningsveje

  • En plads i et erfarent og engageret team, hvor videndeling og samarbejde er en naturlig del af hverdagen

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med moderne og relevante teknologier

  • En hverdag med både tekniske opgaver, kundekontakt og samarbejde med salgsafdelingen

  • Et uformelt og imødekommende arbejdsmiljø, hvor relationer er i fokus - både internt og eksternt

  • Fleksibilitet i forhold til arbejdssted, afhængigt af hvor du bor

Hvem er du?
Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring fra en teknisk IT-rolle, gerne som IT-konsulent, IT-tekniker eller lignende, og har praktisk indsigt i Modern Work og Microsoft 365. Du har desuden forståelse for IT-sikkerhed og en god grundlæggende viden om netværk samt en generel interesse for IT og nye teknologier.

Derudover lægger vi vægt på, at du:

  • Er teknisk stærk og trives med at implementere og få IT-løsninger til at fungere i praksis

  • Har indsigt i Modern Work og Microsoft 365

  • Har forståelse for IT-sikkerhed og tænker sikkerhed ind i dit arbejde

  • Har lyst til kundekontakt og kan kommunikere tekniske løsninger i et sprog, som kunden forstår

  • Har interesse for pre-sales og kan bidrage med teknisk sparring og løsningsdesign sammen med salgsafdelingen

  • Har en god grundlæggende netværksforståelse og kan arbejde med almindelige netværksopgaver og fejlsøgning. Kendskab til f.eks. Fortinet, Ubiquiti eller Cisco er en fordel

  • Er en holdspiller, der samarbejder konstruktivt med dine kolleger og bruger sparring som en naturlig del af hverdagen

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs

  • Vigtigst er din nysgerrig på IT og lysten til løbende at udvikle dig fagligt.Annoncetekst

Vil du med på holdet?
Rekrutteringen til denne stilling foregår i samarbejde med PRO&CO. Send dit CV og et par ord om, hvorfor stillingen er spændende for dig, via knappen ”Søg stillingen”.

Samtaler afholdes løbende, så send gerne dit CV hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Har du spørgsmål eller ønsker du at høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte rekrutteringskonsulent Kristine Axelsen ved PRO&CO, se kontakt oplysninger herunder.

Azend er mere end bare teknologi – Azend er en IT-alliance med fokus på mennesker og relationer. De forstår, at de bedste IT-løsninger skabes gennem stærke relationer og en dyb forståelse for kundens unikke behov. Deres menneske-fokuserede tilgang sikrer, at de altid leverer skræddersyede og skalerbare løsninger, der både skaber værdi i dag og understøtter kundens vækst på lang sigt.

Se mere om Azend her.

title: Strategy and Engagement Sr. Analyst
description:
Company Overview

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

#LI-Hybrid

Team Overview

As a Strategy and Engagement Sr. Analyst, you will translate strategic growth initiatives into high-impact operational workflows, driving execution rigour and process optimisation across DiDi Food and adjacent services; success will be measured by improvements in key operational SLAs, productivity, cost-to-serve metrics, and contribution in assigned markets. Sitting within the Regional Operations & Strategy team, you will serve as the engine bridge between high-level strategy and ground-level execution—partnering closely with Product and Field Operations to implement, scale, and iterate cross-functional initiatives that drive operational efficiency and sustainable business growth.

Role Responsibilities

  • Driving Operational Optimization & Analytics: Analyzing multi-source datasets to identify operational bottlenecks and implementing process improvements that reduce cost-to-serve and lower order cancellation rates

  • Leading Pilot Execution & Scaling: Designing, executing, and scaling operational pilots and A/B tests alongside Product and Supply teams to optimize dispatch logic, courier incentives, and merchant onboarding workflows, establishing repeatable playbooks across key cities

  • Owning Performance Management & Executive Reporting: Building automated operational dashboards and delivering data-backed reviews to senior leadership, tracking performance against key SLAs, contribution margins, and execution milestones to drive accountability and resource reallocation

  • Managing Cross-Functional Projects End-to-End: Leading the execution of high-priority strategic initiatives, aligning Commercial Operations, Product, and Field teams around strict timelines, risk mitigation, and target operational KPIs

  • Championing Process Automation & Scalability: Partnering with Product and Local Ops to standardize, automate, and document core operational workflows—transitioning manual ad-hoc fixes into scalable systems that streamline regional expansion and daily execution

Role Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred

  • Analytical skills: Proven ability to analyze large, complex datasets using SQL and Excel, and to build quantitative models that translate into business decisions in high-transaction environments

  • Technical proficiency: Hands-on experience with analytics and visualization tools such as Python, PowerBi, and experimentation platforms to design tests and present results to stakeholders

  • Strategic thinking: Demonstrated experience synthesizing key performance metric results into clear strategic recommendations for optimizations

  • Project execution: Track record of leading cross-functional projects from concept to scale with strong stakeholder management, clear timelines, and measurable impact delivery

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience preparing executive-level presentations and translating technical analysis into actionable business terms

  • Personal qualities: Proactive, results-oriented, and collaborative with a bias for experimentation, comfortable working in fast-paced and rapid-change environments typical of DiDi’s global operations

  • Experience: 3–6 years of relevant experience in strategy, operations, analytics, or engagement roles at a tech platform, consultancy, or mobility company, with experience in scaling pilots across multiple cities or regions preferred

  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

title: Multimedia Editor
description:
Position: Multimedia Editor, The London Free Press Position type: Full-time, Permanent Location: London, Ont. (Remote)

The Company:

Postmedia is a Canadian news media company representing more than 110 brands across multiple print, online and mobile platforms. Award-winning journalists and innovative product development teams bring engaging content to millions of people every week, whenever and wherever they want it. This exceptional content, reach and scope offers advertisers and marketers compelling solutions to effectively reach target audiences. We are always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our team.

The Opportunity:

The London Free Press, Southwestern Ontario’s leading news provider, is seeking a multimedia editor to oversee the late news cycle on its website, lfpress.com. The ideal candidate, working with a digital team and reporters in the field in London, a Postmedia regional news hub, is a nimble closer in a news cycle that begins early in the day on the region’s busiest news site.

The night digital editor is a wordsmith, skilled at crafting SEO headlines, and unafraid of difficult conversations, editing and helping to get others to pivot to meet newsroom needs. Driven by the demands of speed, density and online subscription growth, the position requires flexibility to juggle assignments, editing and the generation of content ideas to attract and keep readers returning. Reporting to the deputy editor, the successful candidate will work closely with the assistant news editor (digital) and a mission statement that sets out the newsroom’s priorities. Part web master, part editor, the position requires outstanding organizational and leadership skills and understanding of news that matters most to London-area readers. The ability to use digital tools to identify news needs and maximize ways to meet them is critical, as is working with the assistant news editor (digital) and the city desk.

What you’ll do:

  • Keep the website updated with edited content to attract and engage readers, and reach new audiences, on shifts that start at 1 p.m. or 11 a.m. daily, with occasional weekend work.
  • Help to hone our digital strategies for SEO, social, breaking news alerts and user-generated content.
  • In consultation with late-day multimedia journalists, ensure assignments meet breaking content needs.
  • Spot opportunities to jump on, including non-traditional explainers and live coverage that meet readers where they are.
  • Help our team develop ambitious journalism ideas, while working to hit/exceed the website's performance targets.
  • Attend meetings with editors to plan and execute content.
  • Help in the production of the newsroom’s regular reader newsletters.

Who you are:

  • Experienced in daily digital journalism and editing, or with demonstrated ability to quickly learn, fluent in digital and social platforms and eager to work under a newsroom’s fast-paced deadlines.
  • A skilled journalist and communicator, with the ability to quickly adapt to changing news needs and evolving situations requiring speed and flexibility.
  • Not just a team player, but a playmaker able to spot and make wins happen.
  • Familiar with industry content, style and legal standards, including the law of libel and defamation.

Compensation:

Employment offers presented to the selected candidate are based on a combination of qualifications, experience, responsibilities of the role and the candidate's location. Union start rate: $1514.94/weekly. This is a unionized position subject to the terms and conditions of the collective agreement. The starting salary listed in this job posting is based on the Year 1 rate outlined in the collective agreement. Offers will be made based on the candidate's qualifications and experience.

Applications:

Interested applicants should apply without delay, including a detailed resume and a covering letter explaining why they are ideal for the position.

We thank in advance all applicants for their interest, however only those candidates under consideration will be contacted. Only candidates legally eligible to work in Canada will be considered. No phone calls or agencies please.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to providing accommodations for people with disabilities in all areas of the hiring process. If you require accommodation during the hiring process, please make your needs known in advance. Accommodation requests will be provided on an individual basis.

Postmedia Network Inc. is committed to employment equity and an inclusive barrier-free selection process and work environment. Postmedia Network Inc. encourages applications from women, indigenous peoples, persons with disabilities and members of visible minorities. #Li-remote

description:
Scope of Position

About Us:

EDF power solutions North America has been providing clean energy solutions throughout the U.S., Canada, and Mexico since 1987. We are a market-leading independent power producer and service provider, serving utilities, corporations, industries, communities, institutions, and investors with reliable, low-carbon energy solutions that help meet growing demand.

From developing and building scalable wind (onshore and offshore), solar, storage (battery and pumped storage hydro), smart EV charging, microgrids, green hydrogen, and transmission projects, to maximizing performance and profitability through skilled operations and maintenance and innovative asset optimization, our teams deliver expert solutions along the entire value chain—from origination to commercial operation.

Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team environment that fosters our goal of delivering renewable solutions to lead the transition to a sustainable energy future.

Benefits & Perks:

EDF power solutions offers best-in-class employee benefits, including the following:

  • Competitive bonus incentives. This position is eligible for our annual bonus program.
  • Comprehensive health coverage. We provide low-cost health & wellness coverage for employees and their eligible dependents.
  • Rewarding 401k. We provide a generous matching contribution.

We are also proud to offer:

  • Favorable paid time off programs, including paid parental leave after one year of service.
  • Rewarding learning & career development and advancement opportunities.
  • Supportive mentorship & buddy programs.

Salary Range: The full pay range for this role is $107,200 to $178,600 annually, and the good faith estimated starting pay for this position upon hire is $128,610 to $150,045 annually. We generally base our salary decisions on factors including but not limited to, relevant work and leadership experience, education, demonstrated performance, internal equity, and in some cases, geographic location.

Scope of Job: Under the direction of the Senior Project Manager or Associate/Director - Project Management, the Project Manager is responsible for managing all aspects and phases of multiple solar EPC projects and programs simultaneously. The Project Manager is primarily responsible for collaboration with project stakeholders such as owners, utilities, landowners, municipalities, developers, consultants, subcontractors, and other project partners and internal resources such as engineering and construction professionals. The Project Manager will achieve project and corporate goals which are generally described as follows: project schedule, project scope management, budget performance, quality assurance requirements, and construction safety. The Project Manager will foster a cooperative relationship with project partners, external owners/clients, and internal resources while meeting the company strategic goals and continually messaging the value of the company services to stakeholders. This position has project P&L responsibility.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the delivery of multiple Company projects on time, on budget, and in accordance with all applicable health, safety, contract, quality, and legal requirements; coordinate, supervise, and manage project team consisting of internal resources (i.e., Project Engineers, Assistant Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Superintendents, Design Engineers, and Project Administrators) and outside partners such as subcontractors, consultants, clients, utilities, development partners; take direct responsibility for all aspects of project delivery, where necessary; secure subcontractors; lead team in vetting, qualifying, referencing, scoping, price negotiation, and contracting with subcontractors; implement and manage project administration, site safety, and field quality control, including project meetings, document control, submittals, safety and staff planning, quality control, construction team planning and documentation, and other close‑out and commissioning of projects.
  • Manage budget, expenses, revenue, margin, and schedule for multiple simultaneous projects; track project actual P&L vs. plan on a monthly basis and take corrective action to meet objectives; accurately forecast project revenues, cost, and margins. Manage subcontractor payments and project billings. Create baseline schedule and maintain weekly and monthly project schedule updates in MS Project and/or Primavera.
  • Implement health and safety along with quality assurance program for each project; manage project compliance with health and safety as well as inspection & test plans, including compliance by company personnel, subcontractors, customers, and others at the project site; assure continuous compliance by project and subcontractors with requirements of all project contracts, subcontracts, applicable laws, and applicable permits; take primary responsibility for understanding and applying federal, state, and local code and regulatory requirements.
  • Implement and manage processes to secure and maintain required approvals from customers, interconnection providers, and local authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs); assure accurate and timely submittals to customers, interconnection providers, and AHJs.
  • Support internal origination, development, financing, and engineering teams on project matters, including project pricing, technical design, compliance with site requirements, permitting, and other constraints; perform project diligence, including site reconnaissance, geotech, and investigations; attend AHJ meetings, oversee and provide input on preparation of project design and construction documentation and plans.
  • Report on projects to internal and external colleagues and project stakeholders; manage project details and update project progress on Company project management platform along with other duties as assigned.

Supervision of Others: Project task level supervision and direction of matrix-based project staff, including Project Engineers, Construction Managers, Project Coordinators, Superintendents, and Project Administrators; as well as supervision of external project subcontractors and vendors.

Working Conditions: Work time will be spent both at project sites (outdoor construction sites) and in an office environment, with use of computers, telephone, and other office equipment. Travel is expected to be 25% of overall work time.

Fiscal Responsibilities: Project Profit/Loss responsibility.

Qualifications

Education/Experience:

  • BA/BS degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related discipline required.
  • 5-7+ years progressive experience in construction and/or development, including as a Project Manager, Project Engineer, Assistant Project Manager, Development Engineer, or Project Superintendent.
  • Prior experience managing community solar and/or utility scale photovoltaic systems of greater than 3-5 MW, and preferably greater than 10 MW. Must have managed multiple community scale solar projects simultaneously.
  • Experienced in solar interconnects into the utility distribution and/or transmission grids at 12kv or greater.
  • Advanced understanding of contracts, plans, specifications, codes, design/build contracts, and construction means and methods.
  • Experienced with land development and project financial closing requirements.
  • Experience with large-scale cut and fill earthwork or landfill construction required.
  • Experience with subcontracting industrial or large commercial electrical work required.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

  • Strong knowledge of contract language and contract negotiations
  • Understanding of project cost accounting and tracking procedures
  • Ability to create and execute project work plans
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to work with both internal colleagues and external customers and subcontractors
  • Strong experience in construction logistics, scheduling, estimating, and budgeting
  • A commitment to a safe working environment
  • Ability to adapt easily and accept changing situations
  • Ability to multi-task and prioritize
  • Detail orientated
  • Prior experience utilizing Procore for solar project management, contracting, and quality control.

Physical Requirements: Frequent travel to various North American project sites having varying terrain and weather conditions. Ability to stand and walk for long periods of time. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds on occasion.

Requirements:

  • High School Diploma or GED Equivalent
  • Favorable result on Background Check
  • Basic computer skills
  • Strong customer service skills
