SUMMARY

The Patient Relations Specialist role will provide service to patients and providers via inbound and outbound calls while scheduling appointments, capturing messages for the clinic staff and providers, and addressing the needs of the customer with occasional guidance while ensuring KPI goals are met. The Patient Relations Specialist will be responsible for scheduling patient appointments, escalates patients' health concerns in accordance with individual division guidelines, provides connections to resources for clinical advice and guidance, and navigates complex situations while making sound effective decisions.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Answer calls for multiple clinics in an efficient and effective manner using standard greetings for opening of call, content of call and closure of call.
  • Demonstrate exceptional customer service and patient focus to make each encounter extraordinary.
  • Verify and accurately capture patient demographics, insurance, and appropriate medical information.
  • Schedule appointments using appropriate electronic system while following appropriate protocols for clinic/area, including prioritizing patient’s health concerns according to the department’s urgency.
  • Ensure that patient questions and problems are resolved efficiently, effectively, and expeditiously.
  • Provide information to patients and callers regarding appointment, date, time, location, clinic guidelines, parking, etc.
  • Initiate and complete service recovery as warranted to drive patient loyalty, patient satisfaction, and protect the clinic/patient relationship.
  • Interview patient/guarantor to obtain complete demographic, clinical, billing, insurance, and financial information.
  • Create patient charts by entering required information into electronic databases and maintain accurate records.
  • Relay information to relevant clinic team members through the appropriate messaging systems.
  • Ensure the quality of patient registrations by obtaining thorough and accurate information in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Maintain compliance with HIPAA rules and regulations.
  • Follow a well-established process to solve routine problems where solutions are clearly prescribed.
  • Work cooperatively with the Patient Relations, Referrals, and Clinic teams to accomplish the goals of the departments.
  • Adhere to all safety policies and procedures in performing job duties and responsibilities while supporting a culture of high quality and great customer service.
  • Perform other duties that may be necessary or in the best interest of the organization.


QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional in appearance and actions.
  • Logical and Critical thinking skills.
  • Customer-focused with excellent written, listening and verbal communication skills.
  • Enjoys learning new technologies and systems.
  • Detail-oriented, professional attitude, reliable.
  • Exhibits a positive attitude and is flexible in accepting work assignments and priorities.
  • Meets attendance and tardiness expectations.
  • Management and organizational skills to support the leadership of this function.
  • Ability to follow or provide verbal and written instructions with sufficient grammar and spelling skills to avoid mistakes or misinterpretations.
  • Interpersonal skills to support customer service, functional, and teammate support need.
  • Able to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability for basic to intermediate problem solving, including mathematics.
  • Travel to other site locations may be necessary. Thus, those needing to travel for work must have access to dependable transportation, and driving record must meet company liability carrier standards.
  • Specialty knowledge of systems relating to job function.
  • Knowledge of state and federal regulations for this position; general understanding of HIPAA guidelines.
  • Favorable result on background check required.
  • Must be able to provide proof of identity and right to work in the United States.

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent is required
  • 1-3 years related experience in a call center or as a Receptionist is preferred
  • Healthcare experience is preferred

LICENSES AND CREDENTIALS

  • Minimum Required: None

SYSTEMS AND TECHNOLOGY

  • Basic to intermediate computer operation
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook
  • Prior experience with NextGen software or other EMR is preferred

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • This role requires a variety of physical activities to effectively perform essential job functions. The position involves frequent walking (75%), sitting (50%), and standing (50%), with regular bending, stooping, and reaching (25–50%). Employees must be able to lift, carry, push, and pull items up to 25 lbs. Strong fine motor skills and full use of hands are essential, as the role demands constant grasping, writing/typing, and use of technology. Visual and auditory acuity—including color, depth, peripheral vision, and the ability to adjust focus—is required 100% of the time. Occasional driving or climbing may also be necessary.

title: Buyer, Indirect (Contract)
description:
Umoja Biopharma is an industry-leading biotech with locations in Seattle, WA and Louisville, CO, focused on transforming the treatment of cancer with a novel integrated immunotherapy platform. Our vision is to develop off-the-shelf therapies capable of treating any tumor, any time. We are a diverse and growing team working in brand-new facilities in downtown Seattle, Washington and Louisville, Colorado, and we are looking for innovative thinkers who are excited by groundbreaking science and technology, and passionate about squaring up to the challenges inherent to cutting-edge drug development. We are committed to our core values and principles that support our overall mission and strongly invite applications from enthusiastic individuals who share our commitment and help position Umoja to deliver on our goals. We at Umoja believe in the importance of stories; we are looking for great people to join our team to help us create more stories for ourselves, for you, and most importantly for patients and their families.

Umoja Biopharma – Your Body. Your Hope. Your Cure.

POSITION SUMMARY:

Umoja Biopharma is seeking an experienced Buyer to join our Procurement department. This position will be responsible for owning the purchasing activities for all indirect goods and services for our Colorado location. The Buyer will work closely with Supply Chain, Process Sciences, Facilities, and the Warehouse teams. The buyer will collaborate with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to meet business needs in a fast-paced environment. This position will require a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and planning as our company continues to build and grow. We are looking for a self-starter who brings their excellent communication skills and ability to flex and pivot in an ever-changing environment.

This is a 12-month contract position fully on site at our Louisville, CO office.

CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES:
Specific responsibilities include:

  • Responsible for procuring indirect materials, capital, and services to ensure operational requirements are met, while considering supply reliability, price, and quality
  • Review purchase requests for accuracy and compliance
  • Ensure proper contracts, documents, and justification are included on all requests for purchase
  • Track order progress and engage with suppliers to ensure timely delivery
  • Publish order progress, ETAs, and delays to stakeholders
  • Follow up on past-due orders with suppliers until delivery and receipt is completed
  • Assist the Accounts Payable department with reconciling discrepant invoices
  • Maintain accurate procurement-related data on Item records in both Coupa and NetSuite to ensure purchase orders can be processed without discrepancies
  • Identify areas where improved buying channels could be implemented, such as cXML punchout, electronic ordering, supplier consolidation, sourcing events, etc.
  • Track, document, and report out on supplier performance and supplier KPIs using internal and external supplier performance surveys and systematic reporting tools
  • Collaborate and effectively communicate with onsite stakeholders and external suppliers to ensure business needs are met
  • Support internal inventory management and improvement projects
  • Foster positive working relationship with key suppliers, communicating the business’s priorities and corresponding goods and service requirements
  • Identify areas where procurement process improvements are needed, cost savings can be achieved, or contractual agreements are required
  • Align with other members of the Procurement team to achieve optimal supplier relationships, efficient procurement strategies, company-wide pricing agreements, and system enhancements
  • Facilitate end-to-end procurement for high-priority, urgent requests; being able to expedite required tasks amongst requester, supplier, courier, and approval workstreams to achieve on time delivery for critical business activities

[[INSERT JOB DESCRIPTION HERE]]

title: Project Scheduler – Data Center Construction
description:
Mobile, AL | General Contractor | Mission Critical Construction

We are working confidentially with a General Contractor delivering a major data center project in the Mobile, Alabama area and are looking to appoint an experienced Project Scheduler to join the project team.

This is a full-time, site-based position.

Recent data center construction experience is essential.

This role requires someone who can take real ownership of the project schedule, work confidently with senior clients and project leadership, and drive accountability across the wider team.

The Role

The Project Scheduler will be responsible for developing, maintaining and driving the project schedule across a complex ground-up data center build.

This is not a purely administrative planning role. We are looking for someone who can communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions, identify schedule risks early and ensure the project team understands the impact of delays or changes.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Developing and maintaining the master construction schedule

  • Managing detailed project schedules across civil, structural, MEP, commissioning and turnover

  • Working closely with Project Executives, Project Managers, Superintendents and trade partners

  • Leading schedule review meetings with internal teams and senior client stakeholders

  • Driving accountability against key milestones and deliverables

  • Identifying schedule risks, delays and critical path impacts

  • Communicating schedule changes and project impacts clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Reviewing subcontractor schedules and integrating them into the master programme

  • Supporting recovery planning and schedule mitigation strategies

  • Monitoring progress against baseline schedules

  • Producing schedule updates, reports, look-aheads and milestone tracking

  • Supporting change management and assessing schedule impacts

  • Coordinating with commissioning teams through startup, testing and turnover

  • Ensuring project leadership has accurate and current schedule information

What We’re Looking For

  • Recent data center or mission critical construction experience is essential

  • Strong General Contractor or Construction Manager background

  • Experience scheduling large-scale ground-up construction projects

  • Strong Primavera P6 experience

  • Experience managing master schedules, critical path and schedule updates

  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing across civil, structural, MEP and commissioning

  • Confident dealing with senior clients, Project Executives and leadership teams

  • Strong communication and presentation skills

  • Ability to challenge the project team and drive accountability

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

  • Experience with recovery schedules, delay analysis and schedule risk

  • Ability to work full-time on site in the Mobile, Alabama area

This is an opportunity for an experienced Project Scheduler to take real ownership of the schedule on a major data center development and play a key role in driving project delivery.

Candidates must have recent data center construction experience and be confident operating in a highly visible, client-facing position.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the Job
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Field AI, you’ll be at the forefront of bringing our autonomous systems to life in the real world, owning deployment, integration, and ongoing performance in the field. This role is equal parts engineering and problem-solving. You’ll work hands-on with both customers and our internal teams to ensure successful operations, rapidly incorporate field feedback to improve reliability and performance, and drive adoption so our systems become mission-critical from day one. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-impact environments and want to see your work directly enable the future of autonomy, this is the role where you’ll make it happen.

What You'll Get To Do

  • 1. Field Deployment & Operations
  • Lead the end-to-end deployment of autonomous systems in customer environments.
  • Ensure systems are configured, tested, and operational under real-world conditions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues quickly to maintain uptime and mission success.
  • 2. System Reliability & Performance
  • Gather and analyze field feedback to identify areas for improvement.
  • Work closely with product and engineering teams to drive enhancements into the core system.
  • Implement monitoring and diagnostic tools to ensure sustained reliability.
  • 3. Customer Enablement & Adoption
  • Partner with customer teams to train and support operators in achieving operational readiness.
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable workflows.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to accelerate adoption and long-term value realization.
  • 4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Serve as the voice of the customer, bringing field insights back to engineering and product teams.
  • Collaborate across software, hardware, and AI research groups to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Contribute to building scalable deployment practices and playbooks for future rollouts.

What You Have

  • Master’s degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 2-3 years of experience in software engineering, systems integration in Field Robotics industry.
  • Experience in field deployment of complex technical systems.
  • Proficiency in Python, C++, Git, ROS.
  • Familiarity with Linux-based systems, containerization, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills across software, hardware, and networking layers.
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to thrive in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.

Extras That Set You Apart

  • Experience deploying, operating, or maintaining mission-critical systems in real-world environments.
  • Experience using Jira or Wrike or Confluence or other program management software tools
  • Ability to work directly with customers in high-stakes, fast-paced settings, translating needs into technical solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users.
  • Willingness to travel and work on-site with customers as needed.
Compensation and Benefits
We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary; base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Also, while we enjoy being together on-site, we are open to exploring a hybrid or remote option.
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world’s most complex challenges: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ set a new standard in perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, ensuring our approach is explainable and safe for deployment.
You will have the opportunity to work with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. With a decade-long track record of deploying solutions in the field, winning DARPA challenge segments, and bringing expertise from organizations like DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise Self-Driving, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, we are set to achieve our ambitious goals.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
To tackle such ambitious challenges, we need a team as unique as our vision — innovators who go beyond conventional methods and are eager to tackle tough, uncharted questions. We’re seeking individuals who challenge the status quo, dive into uncharted territory, and bring interdisciplinary expertise. Our team requires not only top AI talent but also exceptional software developers, engineers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators.
We are headquartered in always-sunny Irvine, Southern California and have US based and global teammates.
Join us, shape the future, and be part of a fun, close-knit team on an exciting journey!
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Regional Practice Director
description:
The Opportunity


RETTEW is seeking a Regional Director to lead a large, multidisciplinary Planning & Design team across Region 1. This key leadership position is responsible for driving the continued performance and growth of Land Development, Municipal, Survey/GIS, and Transportation services throughout southeastern Pennsylvania.


The strongest candidate will bring technical expertise, business-development acumen, and a strong understanding of the engineering-consulting business, including financial performance, operational management, and client service. Success in this role depends equally on exceptional people leadership.


We are looking for someone who builds trust, develops leaders, strengthens collaboration, and creates an environment where people can do their best work and grow their careers. This leader will model RETTEW's core values through transparent decisions, follow-through, accountability, and respect.


Reporting to the Vice President of Planning & Design, the Regional Director will collaborate with the leadership team to develop regional priorities aligned with practice and company strategy and remain accountable for regional execution, employee development, client relationships, and project delivery.


What You'll Do

  • Lead the regional Planning & Design business, aligning Land Development, Municipal, Survey/GIS, and Transportation teams around clear priorities, shared goals, strong accountability, and coordinated client service.
  • Coach, mentor, and support direct reports and emerging leaders; establish clear expectations, provide useful feedback, address performance issues, and build succession and career-development plans.
  • Stay meaningfully connected to employees across the region, listen to team needs, remove barriers, strengthen engagement and retention, and create opportunities for people to expand their skills and responsibility.
  • Develop and execute regional growth and business-development plans; strengthen key client relationships, identify must-win pursuits, expand services with existing clients, and build strategic relationships in the market.
  • Maintain visibility in the regional engineering, municipal, development, transportation, and surveying community and use market knowledge to guide investments, staffing, client pursuits, and office strategy.
  • Guide Municipal services that include engineer-of-record relationships with municipalities, counties, and authorities as well as water and wastewater engineering services.
  • Own regional financial and operational performance, including annual planning, budgets, sales, backlog, utilization, project performance, staffing, and other key metrics.
  • Foster collaboration across teams, offices, regions, and practices so RETTEW deploys the right expertise, delivers consistent quality, and presents a unified experience to clients.
  • Provide technical and project leadership on high-profile, complex, or strategically important assignments while ensuring teams follow RETTEW quality and risk-management practices.
  • Build workforce plans that anticipate business needs, identify capability gaps, support recruiting, and develop the next generation of technical, project, and people leaders.
  • Model RETTEW's core values - Act Like an Owner, Value Relationships, and Exemplify Excellence - through transparent decisions, follow-through, accountability, and respect.



Why RETTEW


  • This is an opportunity to shape the future of a strategically important region while building a leadership culture that strengthens both business performance and employee growth.
  • Lead four complementary service areas with meaningful opportunities for collaboration and growth.
  • Influence regional, practice, and company strategy, client development, workforce planning, and leadership development.
  • Build a strong bench of leaders and create lasting opportunities for employee-owners.
  • Join a multidisciplinary, 100% employee-owned company where long-term value is shared.


Work Environment


Workplace Designation: Hybrid - Minimum three days per week in a Region 1 office

Locations: Berwyn, Lancaster, or Lehigh Valley, Pennsylvania


This leadership role combines in-office collaboration, client and industry engagement, project and team meetings, focused work, and travel throughout Region 1. A minimum of three days per week in a Region 1 office is required. Because this position leads teams across multiple offices and disciplines, the Regional Director is expected to maintain a visible and consistent in-person presence with employees and clients throughout the region. Occasional travel to other RETTEW locations may be required.


About RETTEW


RETTEW is a 100% employee-owned engineering consulting firm that has been helping clients solve complex challenges since 1969. Our multidisciplinary teams deliver practical solutions that strengthen infrastructure and support the communities we serve.


Our culture is grounded in our core values: Act Like an Owner, Value Relationships, and Exemplify Excellence. RETTEW offers an Employee Stock Ownership Plan, comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, and professional-development opportunities.


RETTEW is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please contact us at jperalta@rettew.com to request assistance.

title: Senior Digital Project Manager
description:
Join a forward-thinking team where collaboration, integration and making a real impact are at the heart of what we do. We are looking for an experienced, technically founded and proactive Senior Project Manager who is passionate about driving successful project outcomes and fostering teamwork.

In this role, you will lead projects that support our mission to deliver high-quality solutions and continuous improvements across our organization.

As we are growing, we are looking for an additional member to help us deliver exciting projects, within the fields of Operation Technology (OT) anchored in SCADA, all enabling the path towards a fossil-free future.

You will work closely with colleagues and stakeholders from various backgrounds and locations, ensuring effective communication and smooth project execution. In addition, you will be working closely with maintenance and operations teams to optimize the handover of the projects, always with focus on the asset security, efficiency - performance and reliability & value realization.

Your ability to manage diverse teams, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver results will be key to your success. We value open-mindedness, a positive attitude, and a commitment to learning and growth.

If you are ready to bring your project management expertise to a dynamic environment and help shape the future with us, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring successful project delivery within scope, schedule, and budget constraints plus capturing lessons learned.
  • Manage and refine project timelines, budgets, risks and resources – transparency being key.
  • Coordinating & act as the bridge between the engineering team and internal & external stakeholders, ensuring effective communication and swift resolution of technical issues for seamless project execution.
  • Ensuring compliance with industry regulations and standards and manage all project deliverables are including quality and EHS compliance, throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Continuously identify, assess, and mitigate risks while leveraging opportunities to ensure projects are completed on time and within scope.
  • Ensure business success and customer satisfaction through professional project and stakeholder management while always maximizing value creation – a ‘win-win’ mentality.
  • Consistently contribute to internal process and team improvement initiatives within the Digital Engineering Project Management team.

Qualifications

  • Educated in Electrical Engineering or automation engineering as well as Project/Package Management disciplines.
  • Experience with automation and control systems and data pipelines preferably within the energy sector.
  • Relevant work experience and competencies within a combination of onshore & offshore technology, high voltage electrical systems and construction projects, OT & IT technical project/program management skills from the Wind, BESS or PV industry would be an advantage.
  • Knowledge & experience with design, specification, configuration and test of OT & IT.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage & communicate well to teams & stakeholders.
  • A proactive, agile approach to process improvement and problem-solving.
  • A positive attitude, good communication skills, and a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Eager to learn about new technologies & different business domains within renewable energy.
  • Ability to thrive & perform in a complex and diverse organizational set-up.
  • As we operate in an international environment, it is essential that you speak and write English fluently.

Additional Information

Our offer
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development.

More Information
We welcome your application in English, no later than 11/10/2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website as we cannot guarantee that we will be able to process applications that are not made via our website.

For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our recruiter Adam Hammond via adam.hammond@vattenfall.com

Commitment to Diversity

Vattenfall is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed on merit. We offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, staff engagement forums and services to support all our employees.

We are convinced that diversity contributes to build a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation.
We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We now want to make fossil-free living possible within one generation. To be able to reach this ambitious goal we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

description:

  • Podílet se na otevírání a zavírání prodejny
  • Reprezentovat značku H&M s pozitivním přístupem

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

KOHO HLEDÁME

Hledáme nadšené lidi, kteří:

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).
  • Baví je móda a chtějí zákazníkům zajistit skvělý zákaznický zážitek.
  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.
  • Jsou komunikativní, kreativní a otevření novým technologiím.
  • Jsou flexibilní, proaktivní a ochotní učit se nové věci.
  • Mají češtinu na minimální úrovni B2
  • Otevření odpoledním směnám (do cca 21:30) a víkendové práci
  • Mají více než 18 let.

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • 25% sleva na všechny značky skupiny H&M – nakupujte výhodně v prodejnách i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Motivační program H&M HIP – Více informací najdete zde.​
  • Stravenkový paušál 90 CZK za každou odpracovanou směnu – při plném měsíčním úvazku až 1890 CZK navíc.
  • Multisport karta – udržujte se fit s přístupem do stovek sportovišť po celé ČR.
  • Odměna za doporučení nového kolegy až 7000 CZK – pomozte nám najít nové talenty a buďte za to odměněni.
  • 21 dní dovolené + až 4 Relaxing Days navíc – čas na odpočinek je u nás prioritou.
  • Jubilejní dny volna až 3 dny – oslavte pracovní výročí s volnem navíc.
  • Rozsáhlý školící program – investujeme do vašeho rozvoje od prvního dne.
  • Skvělé příležitosti pro kariérní růst – podpoříme vás na každém kroku vaší profesní cesty.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na zkrácený úvazek (20 hodin týdně), se sídlem v Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 14.10.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Hodnocení rolí v obchodě:
Abysme, zvládli vysoký objem žádostí na pozici Prodejního poradce, používáme v našich obchodech online hodnotící metodu pro nábor založený na dovednostech. Hodnocení je součást procesu žádosti a výběru. Vaše odpovědi budou hodnoceny nástrojem, který používá předem stanovená kritéria stanovená skupinou H&M.

Po dokončení hodnocení budete mít možnost sdílet zpětnou vazbu a klást otázky. Pokud narazíte na nějaké potíže nebo preferujete alternativní metodu hodnocení, kontaktujte prosím recruitment_support@hm.com. Výběr alternativy nebude mít vliv na vaši žádost.

Pro více informací o tom, jak zpracováváme vaše osobní údaje, prosím, podívejte se na naše Oznámení o ochraně soukromí.

** Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: Senior Manager, UX Design
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care through Counterpart Assistant, our technology platform for primary care. By supporting primary care physicians and their teams, we help identify patient needs earlier, make complex clinical information actionable, and support longitudinal management of chronic conditions.

As Senior Manager of UX Design for the Interventions Pillar, you will lead the team designing how clinical insight becomes action. Your portfolio will include decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, treatment execution, care coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

You will manage talented, experienced designers who already understand our product, systems, and clinical users deeply. Your role is to help them expand their strategic ownership, make stronger decisions through ambiguity, influence across the organization, and define the future of their domains.

AI will be an important part of this work. You will guide teams in applying AI where it can help clinicians synthesize information, evaluate options, plan care, and follow through—while preserving appropriate evidence, transparency, and clinical control.

Why this role?
The Interventions Pillar addresses a central challenge in healthcare: identifying an opportunity is not enough. Better outcomes require translating insight into an appropriate decision, treatment plan, action, and durable follow-through.

This role is an opportunity to:
● Shape how Counterpart supports consequential clinical decisions and treatment workflows.
● Develop senior designers into stronger strategic and organizational leaders.
● Define how AI can responsibly assist clinical reasoning and action.
● Connect clinical expertise, product strategy, design, and technology around measurable outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, UX Design, you will:

  • Lead the clinical UX strategy. Establish a coherent direction across clinical decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, execution, coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.
  • Develop senior design talent. Coach experienced designers to lead through ambiguity, define strategy, make high-quality trade-offs, influence senior stakeholders, and increase their impact beyond their immediate product areas.
  • Advance AI-enabled clinical workflows. Help teams determine where AI should synthesize information, generate options, recommend next steps, automate work, or remain out of the workflow. Establish expectations for evidence, uncertainty, human oversight, review, and correction.
  • Create strong cross-functional decisions. Partner with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders to connect clinical needs, model capabilities, user evidence, technical constraints, and business priorities.
  • Raise the quality and effectiveness of execution. Strengthen critique, research synthesis, clinical review, prototyping, evaluation, and learning practices so teams can move efficiently without oversimplifying consequential problems.

Success in this role looks like:
This leader will bring deep expertise in clinical-product design while creating strategic alignment and design leverage across the Interventions pods.

  • In the first 90 days, establish leadership and strategic alignment by building strong partnerships with product directors, ensuring balanced workloads, and embedding design as a critical part of business strategy. Success will be measured by stakeholder feedback, stronger design integration, and improved operational effectiveness.
  • In the first 6 months, focus on delivering impact by deepening user understanding, embedding research insights into design decisions, and pushing for best-in-class UX. Accelerate iteration cycles, reducing time-to-insight by 30%, while fostering a culture of experimentation and autonomy. Guide the team in complex problem-solving, balancing constraints, and proactively shaping solutions.
  • Beyond six months, scale strategic impact and industry influence by positioning design as a key business driver, ensuring UX directly contributes to engagement, provider adoption, and overall user experience. You will push for consumer-grade, next-gen experiences that redefine digital healthcare while strengthening team expertise, fostering strategic thinking, and elevating design’s role in product direction. Success will be measured by design’s ability to drive best-in-class UX, shape industry standards, and create tangible product improvements that shift user expectations.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 7+ years of design experience in a design environment (in-house, agency, or relevant industry), with 5+ years of managing people.
  • You have led complex, high-consequence workflows in healthcare or another expert professional domain.
  • You bring strong judgment in interaction design, information design, research, and product strategy— and know how to coach others without taking over their work. You can demonstrate how you have helped experienced designers grow from strong executors into strategic decision-makers and organizational leaders.
  • You have experience with AI-enabled products or can demonstrate sound judgment about recommendations, automation, evidence, uncertainty, and human oversight.
  • You have experience in complex systems and applications, knowing how to simplify the complex and create delightful, intuitive experiences.
  • You are an advocate for collaboration, working closely with product and engineering to ensure design is a driver of business outcomes, not just execution.
  • You are excited about shaping the future of healthcare UX – bringing the same level of quality and innovation seen in leading consumer products to an industry that desperately needs it.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Cybersecurity Architect (Cyberark)
description:
Responsibilities:

  1. Define and own the enterprise‑wide CyberArk architecture (Vault, CPM, PSM, PVWA, Conjur, ) to support the banks technical accounts inventory.
  2. Design and enforce privileged‑access policies (least‑privilege, separation‑of‑duties, time‑bound access) across Windows, Linux, UNIX, databases, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  3. Provide high-availability support for the CyberArk, establishing robust monitoring, incident-response, and disaster-recovery processes that keep critical services up and running 24×7.
  4. Drive the secret‑management lifecycle – automatic password rotation, SSH key management, API‑credential vaulting, and on‑demand retrieval.
  5. Partner with engineering, application, and cloud teams to embed secure identity controls into every new service launch, migration, or platform upgrade.
  6. Automate PAM processes using PowerShell, Python, and CyberArk REST APIs (e.g., bulk onboarding/off‑boarding, credential rotation schedules).
  7. Evaluate emerging PAM technologies (e.g., CyberArk Conjur, Secret-Zero, Zero-Trust Privilege) and build business cases for adoption.

title: Project Manager - Business Development / Graduate and Early Career Starter (Remo
description:

We, the Franke company with its three divisions, are a world's leading supplier of products and services for domestic kitchens, the professional foodservice systems and the convenience store sector as well as for professional coffee making. With around 60 companies, we are at home on five continents. Over 8,000 employees constantly take on new perspectives to identify opportunities and turn them into inspiring, innovative solutions for tomorrow’s demands.

The Franke Home Solutions division is the world’s leading provider of smart systems for domestic kitchens. Drawing on a long history of reliability and expertise, we help our partners enhance their businesses and provide outstanding kitchen and cooking experiences to our consumers by offering complete solutions for food preparation and cooking.

About the job

The Business Development Project Manager role is an 18-month assignment within Franke’s Graduate and Early Career Program, designed for an early-career professional interested in sales, business development, and commercial leadership. title: Senior Project Manager
description:
We are seeking a Senior Project Manager with over 10 years of experience to join our growing Aerospace Digital Services team. In this role, you will lead complex digital transformation initiatives for our clients, ensuring that business objectives are effectively translated into sustainable and value-driven technology solutions.

You will work closely with executive stakeholders, business leaders, operational teams, and technical experts to define transformation roadmaps, optimize business processes, and ensure successful solution adoption. As a trusted advisor, you will help align business needs with technological capabilities while driving project governance, delivery excellence, and continuous improvement.

You will also lead multidisciplinary teams composed of Business Analysts, Solution Architects, and Software Engineers, fostering collaboration and ensuring the successful delivery of projects within scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.

Business Transformation Leadership

  • Lead complex digital transformation initiatives supporting quality, manufacturing, engineering, and operational business functions.
  • Drive the definition and execution of transformation strategies that improve operational performance, business efficiency, and solution adoption.

Requirements & Solution Delivery

  • Facilitate workshops with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements, and transform business needs into actionable project roadmaps and solution delivery plans.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives, operational processes, and technology solutions throughout the project lifecycle.

Stakeholder Engagement & Governance

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with business leaders, operational teams, technical experts, and executive stakeholders.
  • Lead governance activities, steering committees, and project reviews to ensure alignment on priorities, scope, risks, and delivery objectives.

Business Process Optimization

  • Analyze and improve end-to-end business processes across quality, manufacturing, and operational domains.
  • Identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement to increase efficiency and sustainability.

Solution Strategy & Standardization

  • Promote the adoption of scalable and sustainable enterprise solutions by leveraging industry best practices and standard capabilities.
  • Support decision-making by balancing business requirements, technical feasibility, operational constraints, and long-term maintainability.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
  • Foster collaboration across multidisciplinary teams and help resolve complex functional, operational, and technical challenges.

Program & Deployment Management

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of large-scale transformation programs and solution deployments.
  • Manage scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, and deliverables to ensure successful project outcomes.

Risk, Quality & Performance Management

  • Monitor project performance using defined KPIs and governance mechanisms.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks, issues, and dependencies that could impact delivery, quality, budget, or schedule.

Team Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Mentor project teams and contribute to the development of delivery best practices.

Experience

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Project Management, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Solution Delivery, Manufacturing Systems, Quality Systems, or Operational Excellence initiatives.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale business transformation programs in aerospace, manufacturing, industrial, transportation, or other complex regulated environments.
  • Demonstrated success managing multidisciplinary teams and engaging executive-level stakeholders.

  • Strong expertise in business process analysis, requirements management, and solution deployment.
  • Extensive experience delivering complex projects using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and leadership skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a results-oriented mindset.

title: Technical Project Manager (Data and AI)
description:
CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants.

We are honored to be recognized as a three-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest-growing private companies in the U.S.

We are looking for a highly technical Project Manager to drive delivery for a cutting-edge enterprise technology initiative. You will be at the forefront of a fast-paced, high-visibility project focused on delivering real-time data and advanced capabilities for end-users. Working closely with core business operations and technical teams, you will act as the crucial bridge between engineering execution and strategic business goals.

This is a senior delivery role requiring someone who is comfortable diving into technical details, managing complex dependencies, and driving cross-functional alignment in a dynamic consulting environment.

What You'll Do

  • Lead Complex Delivery: Drive the end-to-end execution of a high-visibility, real-time technology platform from inception through deployment.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner directly with diverse business stakeholders and engineering teams to manage the rapid delivery of complex technology solutions.

  • Technical Bridge: Act as a highly technical PM, interfacing seamlessly with developers to translate complex business requirements into actionable technical tasks, API specifications, and sprint backlogs.

  • Agile Orchestration: Facilitate core Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) to ensure predictable delivery cadences.

  • Risk & Dependency Management: Proactively identify project roadblocks, manage cross-team dependencies, and implement effective mitigation strategies to keep delivery on track.

  • Executive Reporting: Provide clear, transparent progress updates, milestone tracking, and project health metrics to senior leadership and client sponsors without adding unnecessary administrative overhead.

What You'll Bring

  • Proven Technical Delivery: Strong track record (7+ years) of delivering complex custom software, enterprise integrations, or data-driven technology solutions.

  • Consulting Mindset: Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, client-facing environment, adapting quickly to new technical landscapes, cultures, and business domains.

  • Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with the proven ability to build trust and influence both highly technical engineering teams and senior business leaders.

  • SDLC & Agile Expertise: Deep understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and practical experience actively managing sprint boards and Agile methodologies.

  • Strategic Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with the ability to "talk code" with developers while maintaining a focus on the broader business objectives and product vision.

  • Hybrid Availability: Must be local to Orange County/Southern California and able to work on-site 2-3 days per week at the client site in Irvine.

  • Contract Readiness: Available immediately for an estimated 6-month consulting engagement (1099/Independent Contractor preferred).

Our consultants say CompassX is a place where they can truly find their own path. As part of a smaller firm, they see the impact of their work, have an identity, and know their voice matters. They value the freedom to take the reins of their careers, shape their client work, and maintain a direct line to leadership.

With CompassX’s focus on serving local Southern California clients, consultants not only build lasting relationships but also see the results of their work in the communities where they live.

At CompassX, you won’t just follow a path - you’ll create one.

title: Business Controller to H&M Assortment
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

H&M Assortment is where we design and develop our fashion collections for a wide variety of customers all over the world. At Assortment you will be a part of a mixed team consisting of designers, pattern makers, product developers and planners, all working together to create the best customer offer while at the same time influencing H&M on a global scale. Sounds like fun? It is!

We aim to become industry leaders in creating irresistible products & assortment and are building a fast-moving & creative organization that is centered around the product. We want to build a trusted fashion brand and democratize sustainable fashion.

As a Business Controller, you will play a key role in generating sustainable sales growth and profitability for your area of responsibility both short- and long term. Through surrounding analyses and fashion forecast, this role will enable a current and commercial assortment. Together with your team, you will lead the development of our global assortment by generating growth, profitability, and customer value to optimize each region and ensure a locally relevant assortment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Optimize sustainable sales growth and profitability with the right quantity, the right timing, at the right place and at the best price.
  • Take business-minded decisions and implement actions based on commercial analyses on sales, customer behaviour, and market trends.
  • Take informal leadership responsibility, communicate insights in a clear, inspiring, and simple way. Mentor and lead your team towards our purpose and set goals.
  • Participate in defining vision, strategy, goals and timeline together with the team leader.
  • Support the team with buying follow-up securing the right assortment mix and volumes.
  • Perform ongoing sales analysis and identify future potential and risk
  • Take responsibility for the controlling and secure the balance between top-down vs. bottom-up perspective.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with:

  • A degree in business, economics, engineering or equivalent area
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify patterns, generate insights, and turn them into business actions
  • Leadership ability and a strategic mindset
  • Salesmanship and the ability to identify what our customers want
  • Experience within e-commerce is meritorious
  • Great communication skills
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

And people who are:

  • Naturally curious mindset and constantly looking for possibilities to develop new growth and more efficient ways of working
  • Working strategically and will enjoy developing our business as well as working hands-on analysing numbers
  • Communicative with ability to communicate with impact with a variety of stakeholders
  • Engaging team player and self-motivated to drive goals and thrive in an entrepreneurial setting

JOIN US

This is a fulltime position based in our office in Stockholm, Sweden reporting to Assortment Controllers. You don’t have to live in Sweden already, we welcome applications from all parts of the world and offer relocation support if needed. Apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible but latest by 20th October. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through career page.

We are constantly looking for talented people to join our team and our start date is flexible (throughout 2026 or 2027). We work proactively and review applications continuously. Therefore we encourage you to submit your application if you are completing your studies or other commitments in 2026 and 2027.

We welcome applications from both recent graduates and professionals with few years of experience, as you'll have opportunities to learn, grown and, have an impact from day one.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

  • All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound
  • In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

To ensure we provide an insightful experience to our candidates, and we support their understanding of the role scope and responsibilities for this role, we use an online assessment method for skills-based recruitment with our recruitment processes. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies predefined criteria set by H&M Group.

After completing the assessment, you will receive feedback with the score you obtained. If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

Atlassian is looking for a Senior Frontend Software Engineer to design, build, evolve and maintain our web frontend systems and tools in order to deliver great experiences to our users.

To be a 100-year company, we are proudly building a world-class engineering organization composed of empowered teams that are equipped with the tools and infrastructure to do the best work of their careers.

You will join Secoda, the team building Atlassian's AI-first data catalog and analysis product. We connect to a company's data sources, build a trustworthy picture of what that data means, and help people get grounded answers without waiting on a data team.

We are a lean product team shipping a complex UI: catalog search, lineage, knowledge, dashboards, and AI chat. We care about speed, polish, and whether the product actually feels good to use. If something is slow, unclear, or untrustworthy, that is our bug to fix.

title: Principal Product Designer, DX
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

About DX

DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.

Design at DX

Design at DX is fast, hands-on, and deeply collaborative. Designers partner with Product and Engineering from problem definition through implementation, stay close to customers and GTM partners, and help determine both what we build and how it works. We build shared understanding across the team, then use AI and code to make ideas concrete and contribute directly to the production codebase. We also participate in the broader design community across Atlassian.

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Product Designer to lead product design across DX. As an individual contributor with DX-wide influence and the design counterpart to our Head of Product and Head of Engineering, you will lead DX’s most consequential design work and set the direction and quality bar for the DX design team. A central challenge will be making complex engineering data easier to understand and act on by organizing experiences around the questions different roles need to answer and helping customers reach useful insights faster.

Responsibilities

What you’ll do

  • Set the end-to-end experience vision for DX, creating coherence across product surfaces and customer journeys while aligning with the broader Atlassian product ecosystem.

  • Partner with the Head of Product and Head of Engineering to shape product strategy, roadmap priorities, and the backlog.

  • Turn complex engineering data into coherent, persona- and jobs-to-be-done-based experiences through information architecture, interaction design, data visualization, and analytical workflows.

  • Lead customer research and involve Product and Engineering so teams develop a shared understanding of customer needs.

  • Lead high-impact work from customer discovery and problem framing through implementation, QA, and post-launch iteration.

  • Use AI-native workflows and code to make design intent concrete through working prototypes, contribute directly to production, and iterate based on live usage.

  • Shape how AI changes the DX product experience—including conversational and agentic workflows—and how our teams discover, design, build, and ship it.

  • Define and track experience outcomes—including time to insight, task success, adoption, and satisfaction—and use them to guide iteration.

  • Establish scalable patterns and frameworks that improve consistency across DX, partnering with Atlassian teams to align with the Atlassian Design System and address emerging product needs.

title: Valve Technician
description:
Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is a full-service safety relief and control valve repair center supporting the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic Region. Our team of highly skilled technicians perform a dynamic range of services to include but not limited to valve repair, in-line testing, upgrades/modifications, and turnkey outage solutions to premier leaders in the process industries.

VALVE TECHNICIAN / MECHANICAL FIELD TECHNICIAN

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) | Swedesboro, NJ & Northeast/Mid-Atlantic Region | Full-Time

Build a Career in a Specialized, Respected Industrial Trade

Are you a skilled trades professional looking for your next opportunity? Do you have hands-on experience as a mechanic, machinist, hydraulic technician, plant technician, or maintenance professional? Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is looking for motivated, technically-minded individuals to join our growing team and develop into highly skilled Valve Technicians.

Whether your background is in the military, heavy equipment repair, manufacturing, food production, refinery operations, hydraulics, automotive, shipyards, power generation, or industrial maintenance, we provide the training and support needed to build a long-term career in a specialized and respected trade.

About Atlantic Valve Services

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is a full-service safety relief and control valve repair center supporting customers throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region. We are a premier service provider for Emerson/Fisher control valves and an authorized assembler of Anderson Greenwood, Crosby, and Kunkle pressure relief valves. AVS provides repair, testing, calibration, diagnostics, upgrades, and field services for critical industrial facilities.

Our technicians work on equipment that helps keep manufacturing plants, energy facilities, pharmaceutical companies, refineries, food production facilities, and industrial operations running safely and efficiently.

Why Join AVS?

  • Paid hands-on training in a specialized, high-demand trade
  • Factory training opportunities with industry leaders (Emerson, etc.)
  • Learn highly specialized skills valued across industries
  • Work alongside experienced technicians and mentors
  • Competitive pay with overtime opportunities
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Stable, long-term career with clear advancement opportunities
  • Clean, professional work environment
  • Exposure to a wide range of industrial equipment and customer sites
  • Opportunity to work on equipment critical to major industrial operations

What You'll Do

As a Valve Technician, you'll learn to inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and test industrial valves and related equipment used in critical process industries. Working alongside experienced technicians, you will:

  • Perform maintenance, inspection, and repair activities on industrial valves and related equipment
  • Assist with the assembly and disassembly of control valves, safety relief valves, and isolation valves
  • Learn diagnostic and troubleshooting techniques to identify equipment issues
  • Conduct valve testing, calibration, and performance verification
  • Read and follow technical procedures, drawings, and service documentation
  • Complete service reports and maintenance records
  • Support customer outages, maintenance projects, and field service activities
  • Maintain high safety standards at customer facilities and AVS locations
  • Collaborate with experienced technicians and engineers to continuously develop your skills

We're Looking for Skilled Trades Professionals

We actively recruit from diverse technical backgrounds. We encourage applications from:

Military Veterans:

  • Marine Corps, Navy, Army, Air Force, and Coast Guard veterans
  • Machinist's Mate (MM), Wheeled-Vehicle mechanics, Tank mechanics, Aviation and Avionic mechanics
  • Vehicle and diesel technicians, Power generation technicians
  • Shipyard personnel

Industrial & Manufacturing Professionals:

  • Machinists and precision mechanics
  • Hydraulic and pneumatic technicians
  • Equipment technicians and maintenance professionals
  • Millwrights and heavy equipment mechanics
  • Manufacturing maintenance and production technicians
  • Field mechanics and service technicians

Plant & Facility Operators:

  • Food production plant technicians and operators
  • Refinery technicians and mechanics
  • Power plant and utility technicians
  • Petrochemical and chemical plant technicians
  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing technicians
  • Water treatment and utility operators

Other Mechanical Backgrounds:

  • Automotive repair and mechanics
  • HVAC technicians transitioning to industrial work
  • Diesel mechanics
  • Equipment repair specialists
  • Welders with mechanical aptitude
  • Any mechanically inclined individual with strong work ethic and willingness to learn

Previous valve experience is a plus, but it is NOT required. We're looking for people with strong mechanical aptitude, hands-on experience in skilled trades, and genuine interest in building a specialized career.

Qualifications

Required:

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving ability
  • Hands-on experience in a skilled trade (military service, manufacturing, maintenance, repair, plant operations, etc.)
  • Ability to use hand tools and basic mechanical equipment
  • Willingness to learn and master a specialized industrial trade
  • Strong work ethic and reliability
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Commitment to workplace safety
  • Valid driver's license and able to pass DOT test
  • Ability to travel throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region as needed

Preferred:

  • Shipyard, refinery, or plant experience
  • Military mechanical experience
  • Industrial maintenance or manufacturing experience
  • Mechanical repair or troubleshooting background
  • Experience with hydraulic, pneumatic, rotating, or process equipment
  • Experience reading technical drawings, schematics, or maintenance procedures
  • Prior valve, instrumentation, or controls experience
  • Food production or manufacturing plant background

Travel & Work Environment

This position includes work in both shop and field environments. Travel throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region may be required depending on customer needs and project schedules. Candidates should be comfortable working in industrial facilities, performing physically active work, and occasionally working overtime.

Ready to build a specialized career?

Apply Now!

title: Director, Technical Product Management (Trust & Safety)
description:
As a Director of Technical Product Management, you’ll have a specialized focus on trust and safety. In this role, you will lead all aspects of our core technology product teams, ensuring that our platform remains a secure and trustworthy place for families to find household caregivers and, for caregivers to find screened families as employers. As a leader on our Platform Product team you will drive the development and implementation of solutions that enhance background checks, continuous monitoring, payment fraud detection, and identity verification processes. The ideal candidate is data-driven, acts with a sense of curiosity and urgency, and has a background in engineering..

What You’ll be Working on:

  • Mapping the customer journeys on both sides of the marketplace to identify the experiences that drive customers to seek support from our customer-facing teams
  • Identifying and realizing opportunities for automating manual processes related to trust and safety operations, including background checks, continuous monitoring, payments fraud detection, and identity verification
  • Partnering across operations, policy, engineering, business intelligence, marketing, legal, and other product teams to develop solutions that reflect user needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility
  • Conducting market research and competitive analysis to stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in content moderation, background checks, and identity verification tools
  • Defining product benchmarks and leading the development of dashboards that will provide telemetry into our impact on customer safety, experience, and retention
  • Continuously prioritizing your roadmap and project deliverables in an environment that changes significantly in short periods of time
  • Taking initiative to drive quality improvements across different teams, even when you are not directly responsible for their features
  • Setting up processes that will ensure your ability to deliver end-to-end products on-time in an extremely fast-paced environment
  • 10+ years of product management or equivalent experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, solve complex problems, and produce high-quality results.
  • Experience with techniques to develop the right minimum viable products, as well as optimizing existing products.
  • Strong experience defining product vision & roadmaps, driving execution activities, measuring results.
  • A data-driven approach, with the ability to make decisions based on internal and external data.
  • Experience with vendor API integrations.
  • Understanding of the challenges in delivering a safe and trustworthy product with minimal friction for good actors; preference for experience with content moderation, background checks, payments fraud detection, and identity verification.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams to solve complex problems and produce high-quality results across multi-platforms (Desktop, Mobile Web, iOS/Android Mobile Applications).
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, start-up environment.
  • A strong communicator and team collaborator, with great written and verbal skills.
  • Experience working for a tech company, preferably a consumer-oriented or marketplace service.
  • Local to Dallas Texas or open to relocating is highlighy preferred

Due to business, legal, and payroll considerations, Care.com is unable to hire candidates who reside in the following states: Alaska (AK), Arkansas (AR), California (CA), Delaware (DE), Hawaii (HI), Iowa (IA), Idaho (ID), Maine (ME), Minnesota (MN), Mississippi (MS), Montana (MT), North Dakota (ND), Nevada (NV), Oregon (OR), Rhode Island (RI), South Dakota (SD), Washington (WA), West Virginia (WV), Wyoming (WY), Vermont (VT).

Salary Range: $200,000 - $225,000 - The base salary range above represents the anticipated low and high end of the national salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors including but not limited to work location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Care.com’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include annual bonuses and short- and long-term incentives. In addition, Care.com provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a generous 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, and paid time off (PTO).

Care.com is a consumer tech company with heart. We’re on a mission to solve a human challenge we all face: finding great care for the ones we love. We’re moms and dads and pet parents. We have parents and grandparents so we understand that everyone, at some point in their lives, could use a helping hand. Our culture and our products reflect that.

Care.com’s value proposition leads with safety. There are plenty of options for finding household employees, but people come to our platform to find employees they trust. In this role, you will make that value proposition a reality by partnering with our operations teams to understand the needs of our agents and customers across the various user journeys so that you can lead the strategic planning, improvement, and automation of solutions that provide our members with delightful experiences and our agents with best-in-class customer service tools.

TITLE: Ambulatory Services Auditor and CDS I

REPORTS TO POSITION: System Revenue Integrity Director

DEPARTMENT: Revenue Integrity

DATE LAST REVIEWED: May 2023


OUR VISION: Creating America’s healthiest community, together


OUR MISSION: In the spirit of love and compassion, better health, better care, better value


OUR VALUES: Accountability, Caring and Teamwork


DEPARTMENTAL SUMMARY: The Revenue Integrity department provides many services to our multi-hospital and medical group organization focusing on the patient financial experience along the entire continuum of care. Our goal is to deliver a delightful, transparent, and seamless experience to our patients and customers that captures and collects the revenue earned by SCHS in a quality, efficient and timely manner.


POSITION OVERVIEW: The Ambulatory Services Auditor and Clinical Documentation Specialist I is responsible for conducting audits of outpatient, inpatient and ambulatory service medical documentation across St. Charles Health System to ensure compliance with ICD-10-CM and CPT-4 coding regulations, rules, and guidelines. This position will also provide education, feedback, and guidance to multiple parties, as needed. This position does not directly manage any other Caregivers.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND DUTIES:

Conduct system-wide pre- visit or post-visit chart reviews of professional services to include both hospital and clinic/office settings of care.


Audit and monitor all lines of system business for coding, to include outpatient, inpatient and ambulatory services.


Perform audits on/for the HIM Professional Services Coding team and provide feedback and education as needed to ensure compliance with quality coding standards.


Evaluate medical records to ensure the accuracy of clinical documentation to support the acuity of the patient, risk profiles for HCC capture and recapture, and diagnostic and procedural code integrity in compliance with ICD-10-CM and CPT-4/HCPCs rules and guidelines.


Develop and update procedure manuals to maintain standards for correct coding.


Assist in conducting system-wide education and training in coding of professional services.


Assist in setting the direction for coding compliance and education.


Assist in providing technical guidance to physicians and other departmental staff in identifying and resolving issues such as incomplete or missing records, or codes that do not conform to approved coding guidelines.


Recommend process changes and improvements within departmental and operational policies and procedures or system changes to reduce losses or improve efficiency.


Monitor trends and prepare reports on such topics as documentation or coding issues and denied claims, for review by senior auditors and or management.


Supports the vision, mission, and values of the organization in all respects.


Supports Lean principles of continuous improvement with energy and enthusiasm, functioning as a champion of change.


Provides and maintains a safe environment for caregivers, patients, and guests.


Conducts all activities with the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality. Complies with all applicable laws, regulations, policies and procedures, supporting the organization’s corporate integrity efforts by acting in an ethical and appropriate manner, reporting known or suspected violation of applicable rules, and cooperating fully with all organizational investigations and proceedings.


Delivers customer service and/or patient care in a manner that promotes goodwill, is timely, efficient, and accurate.


May perform additional duties of similar complexity within the organization, as required or assigned.


EDUCATION

Required: High school diploma or GED

Preferred: Associates degree in Health Information Technology or related field


LICENSURE/CERTIFICATION/REGISTRATION

Required: RHIA, RHIT, CCS-P, CPC, CPMA, CRC, RN, or LPN

Preferred: CPMA CRC, RN, LPN


EXPERIENCE

Required: 0-3 years of coding experience required, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Knowledge of current Medicare regulations, including, MPFS, IPPS and OPPS.

Preferred: Inpatient, Outpatient, and Ambulatory services coding preferred. Physician Evaluation and Management coding experience preferred.


PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT

Must be able to wear appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) required to perform the job safely.

description:

The incumbent in this role must possess high professionalism and positive engagement for our residents and the workforce.
