Ensure that each resident and staff member feels seen, heard, and valued as you and the staff work to resolve challenges.

Qualifications

  • Passion for providing exceptional customer service.

  • Low-Income Housing & Tax Credit experience is highly desired.
  • Bilingual (English & Spanish) highly desired.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexible schedule that may include evenings and weekends.

title: Assistant Controller
description:
ASAHI BEER USA | OCTOPI BREWING


ASSISTANT CONTROLLER

You Keep Our Financial Story Accurate, Timely, and Trustworthy

Full-Time | Monday–Friday


ABOUT ASAHI BEER USA / OCTOPI BREWING

Founded in 2014 as a Wisconsin contract brewery, Octopi Brewing has spent over a decade brewing and packaging beer, seltzers, RTDs, and sodas for clients nationwide. In 2024, Asahi — brewers of Asahi Super Dry — acquired Octopi, making us the U.S. production home of Super Dry. Today, our 250+ person team of beverage industry pros keeps that same local, quality-first spirit alive at a state-of-the-art facility. Our Finance team keeps that growth on solid ground — with accurate books, strong controls, and reporting leadership can trust.


THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for an Assistant Controller to support our Controller in managing accounting operations, financial reporting, internal controls, budgeting, and compliance. You'll help ensure our financial close is accurate and on time, strengthen the processes behind it, and lead and develop the accounting team members who make it happen.


WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE GREAT

? Real ownership over the monthly, quarterly, and annual close, with direct visibility to the Controller

? A chance to lead and develop people, not just manage numbers

? A seat at the table on high-impact transformation projects as we grow


WHAT YOU'LL DO

? Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close, ensuring accurate and timely reporting in line with company policy and accounting standards

? Help prepare and analyze financial statements, budgets, forecasts, and management reports that inform business decisions

? Maintain and strengthen internal controls and accounting procedures to meet regulatory, audit, and governance standards

? Oversee general accounting activities — general ledger maintenance, account reconciliations, journal entries, and balance sheet reviews

? Lead, develop, and support accounting team members through work review, training, coaching, and performance management

? Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes, systems, and reporting capabilities

? Partner on high-impact transformation projects

Must-haves:

? Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

? Experience with financial statement preparation and month-end close processes

? Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP

? Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

? Experience with ERP/accounting systems

? Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with high attention to detail and accuracy


Nice-to-haves:

? Previous supervisory experience


BENEFITS & PERKS

? Medical, dental, and vision coverage — effective the 1st of the month after 30 days

? Company-paid life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance

? A free beer after shift, because you earned it

? Salary: $95,000-105,000 annually

? Schedule: Monday–Friday

title: Ophthalmic Clinic Technician
description:
Overview

Retina Consultants of Texas (RCTX) is seeking an Ophthalmic Technician to join our innovative team with the mission of Fighting Blindness For The World To See. This position will be responsible for providing accurate documentation, summarization of patient’s medical history, and performing preliminary ocular examination. The Technician is responsible for maintaining patient flow and communication regarding appointment status to patients and Clinic Managers at our Beaumont Clinic.

Candidates must be able to travel to various clinics to meet the needs of the patients and providers, and support the Clinic hours of Monday through Friday between the hours of 6:30am-6:30pm. Schedules are provided weekly and are based on the provider's clinic, patient and surgery schedules. Clinic staff are provided with the opportunity for weekend hours if available.

Retina Consultants of Texas is the largest and most respected retina-only ophthalmology practice in the United States. Our group consists of 26 world renowned physicians leading the world in retinal care. While serving two major metropolitan markets (and their extensions) our combined culture allows us to best serve our patients, referral sources and our own team of physicians. RCTX also invests heavily in diagnostic equipment, providing state-of-the-art retina imaging, laser and diagnostic capabilities to each patient. This, combined with the clinical expertise of our physicians, an outstanding and devoted staff, and 25 convenient locations to serve our patients.

We worked hard to create our culture as Retina Warriors. We strongly emphasize our core values of Hard Work, Authentic Care and Innovation in everything we do. It is our belief that by investing in our people, our people will be empowered of their own accord to provide the highest quality patient experience.

In addition to being highly challenged professionally, in joining our practice, the following competitive benefits for full-time eligible employees after a 60-day introductory period:

  • Employee Paid Benefits such as Medical, Dental, and Vision, short-term disability, voluntary life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, pet insurance, HSA pre-taxed contributions, 401 (k) retirement savings contributions both Roth and Traditional options starting date of hire.
  • Employer Paid Benefits such as long-term disability, $25,000 basic life insurance policy, 3% 401(k) safe harbor contribution, HSA employer contributions, annual performance merit increases, certification opportunities, rewards & recognition platform, WellHub Starter Plan Gym Membership, paid time off and (8) paid holidays + (1) floating holiday annually.

Pay Rate is $18.00+ per hour and eligible for overtime

RCTX is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, military service, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected class under applicable law.

Responsibilities

  • Obtains patient history to include chief complaint, history of present illness, patient and family history of both ocular and general illnesses, history of allergies, and current medications.
  • Accurately performs and documents visual acuity, confrontational visual fields, evaluation of motility, pupillary function tests, dilation, and ocular tonometry.
  • Provide compassionate patient care throughout the clinic flow
  • Performing opening and closing duties; inventory count, prepping drugs as needed, sterile instruments.
  • Maintains cleanliness in exam and procedure rooms.
  • Maintains back up levels of supply stock in exam and procedure rooms.
  • Provides back-up to the ophthalmic photographer performing OCT’s
  • Contacts patients who have no showed to appointments and reschedule as needed.
  • Maintains a smooth flow of patients to the physician, altering the test sequence as needed.
  • Troubleshoots equipment as necessary; projector, tonopen, autoclave.
  • Occasionally assists physician with laser procedures, injections, and minor procedures.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Skills/Competencies:

  • Ability to perform comprehensive work ups
  • Ability to educate patients regarding instillation of eye drops and other instructions related to physician’s treatment plan.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organization with attention to detail and ability to multitask.
  • Ability to work as a team member.
  • Ability to use multiple computer systems
  • Training and understanding of HIPAA requirements .

Education Requirements

  • High school diploma required; some college preferred.

Experience Requirements:

  • One to Two years’ experience ophthalmic assistant preferred
  • Certification as an ophthalmic assistant preferred
  • Valid CPR certification required

Physical Abilities:

  • Must be able to move frequently from standing and sitting depending on exam room configuration during clinic sessions.
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to type or write legibly in a dimly-lit setting.
  • Must be able to hear softly spoken words.
  • Must be able to add support for patients getting in and out of exam chairs.
  • Lifting required up to 50 pounds.

title: Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer (Freelance)
description:
Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project () and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world use cases. Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Senior Python Data Scraping Engineers to join the Tendem project and drive specialized data scraping workflows for real-world applications. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in web scraping, data extraction, and data processing to deliver accurate, reliable, and high-quality results. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Senior Python Data Scraping Engineer, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing tools such as Apify, OpenRouter, and other technologies, alongside your own technical expertise and approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage available tools and custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirement.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, web scraping, automation, or software development (required).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a strong technical foundation and practical experience with scripting, automation, and data extraction workflows. We are looking for specialists who can solve non-trivial problems, work confidently with modern development tools and technologies, and systematically collect, structure, and validate data from diverse sources. A methodical, detail-oriented approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Strong experience in Python web scraping (BeautifulSoup, Selenium or similar), including dynamic content (JS, AJAX, infinite scroll) and APIs via proxies
  • Proven ability to extract data from complex structures (hierarchies, archived pages, inconsistent HTML)
  • Solid background in data cleaning, normalization, and validation, delivering structured datasets (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets)

Additional requirements

  • Demonstrated experience handling anti-bot mechanisms and dynamic site structures at scale
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and containerization (Docker) as part of real workflows
  • Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, OpenRouter, or similar) applied to automation tasks
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently
  • A link to GitHub is a plus
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $45 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Jako Doradca/-czyni sprzedaży będziesz osobą, która tworzy pierwsze wrażenie i buduje atmosferę w sklepie, witając naszych klientów i uosabiając filozofię naszej marki. Twoim zadaniem będzie zapewnienie wyjątkowej obsługi na każdym etapie wizyty w sklepie: od rozpoczęcia rozmowy, przez pomoc w przymierzalni, aż po obsługę przy kasie – odegrasz kluczową rolę w tworzeniu wyjątkowych doświadczeń zakupowych. Twoje obowiązki będą obejmować również obsługę dostaw, uzupełnianie brakujących elementów kolekcji i ekspozycję najnowszych produktów na sali sprzedaży.

Będziesz odpowiedzialny/-a za tworzenie atmosfery, w której klienci czują się swobodnie i zainspirowani. Dzięki Twojemu entuzjazmowi i autentycznemu podejściu pomożesz im znaleźć to, czego szukają – a czasem nawet coś, o czym jeszcze nie wiedzieli, że pokochają. Wspólnie z zespołem zadbasz o to, by każda wizyta była wyjątkowym doświadczeniem.

  • Zorientowanie na klienta: lubisz kontakt z ludźmi i jesteś zaangażowany/-a w zapewnianie doskonałej obsługi
  • Elastyczność i zdolność adaptacji: potrafisz reagować na zmieniające się priorytety i potrzeby
  • Zorientowanie na działanie: jesteś proaktywny/-a i zmotywowany/-a do podejmowania inicjatywy i realizowania zadań z najlepszym efektem
  • Doskonała komunikacja: jesteś ciekawy/-a ludzi, komunikujesz się jasno i aktywnie słuchasz, aby zrozumieć ich potrzeby
  • Chęć nauki: otwartość na feedback i ciągłe poszukiwanie możliwości rozwoju
  • Zaangażowanie w markę: pasjonujesz się naszą marką i kolekcjami, z chęcią będziesz dzielić się tym entuzjazmem z klientami
  • Elastyczność: gotowość do pracy w różnych godzinach, w tym: wieczorami, w weekendy i w święta
  • Komunikatywnie posługujesz się językiem polskim i angielskim

Preferowane, ale nieobowiązkowe:

  • Masz doświadczenie w obsłudze klienta i wiesz, jak działa sklep dzięki wcześniejszej pracy w handlu detalicznym
  • Czujesz się pewnie, doradzając klientom w kwestiach trendów, materiałów i dopasowania rozmiarów
  • Część etatu z umową na 20 godzin tygodniowo
  • Aplikuj, przesyłając swoje CV jak najszybciej, ale nie później niż do 10.10.2026r.

Benefity:

Oferujemy atrakcyjne benefity i możliwości rozwoju. Jako członek zespołu otrzymasz 25% rabatu pracowniczego na wszystkie marki Grupy H&M – zarówno w sklepach, jak i online. Ponadto każdy pracownik jest objęty Programem Motywacyjnym H&M (HIP), który nagradza Twój wkład i wspiera rozwój w firmie. Więcej informacji o programie znajdziesz tutaj.

Dodatkowo, pracownicy w Polsce otrzymują:

  • Umowę o pracę
  • Kartę lunchową z comiesięcznym doładowaniem o wartości od 50 PLN do 200 PLN (proporcjonalnie do etatu).
  • Bonusy za polecenie nowych pracowników (od 480 PLN do 1200 PLN brutto w zależności od stanowiska, na które polecasz).
  • Okazjonalne kupony i bonusy w ciągu roku.
  • Dopłatę do karnetów sportowych lub platformy wellbeingowej – 30 PLN.
  • Dopłatę do prywatnej opieki medycznej – 49 PLN.
  • Ubezpieczenie na życie w atrakcyjnej cenie.
  • Dostęp do platformy MyBenefit.
  • Program szkoleń wstępnych i rozwojowych.
  • do 3600 zł na rok do wykorzystania na uniform pracowniczy

INKLUZYWNOŚĆ I RÓŻNORODNOŚĆ

W Grupie H&M dążymy do tworzenia inkluzywnych, różnorodnych i sprawiedliwych miejsc pracy w całej organizacji. Wierzymy, że zespoły rozwijają się, gdy łączą różnorodne doświadczenia i perspektywy. Ta różnorodność zwiększa naszą zdolność do kreatywnego rozwiązywania problemów, poszerza horyzonty i buduje wartościowe relacje z kolegami, koleżankami i klientami na całym świecie. Dlatego uwzględniamy wszystkie wymiary różnorodności w procesie rekrutacji – aby nasze zespoły odzwierciedlały bogactwo społeczności, którym służymy.

title: Verkoopmedewerker - Weekend

Wij zoeken een Verkoopmedewerker - Weekend in den Bosch, 8-16 uur.

Wat onze Verkoopmedewerkers doen

Wat we bieden

  • Tijd om te groeien toegang tot ons online leerplatform.
  • Voor nu én later deelname aan ons pensioenplan.

title: Cyber Security Specialist (Blue Team)
description:
Als Blue Teamer bij Sopra Steria werk je dagelijks aan het beschermen van organisaties tegen cyberdreigingen. Je analyseert security‑vraagstukken, monitort systemen, onderzoekt incidenten en ontwikkelt oplossingen die de digitale weerbaarheid versterken. Samen met je team zorg je ervoor dat beveiligingsmaatregelen betrouwbaar blijven en nieuwe oplossingen effectief worden geïmplementeerd.

Je werkt binnen een community van gedreven securityprofessionals, waar kennisdeling centraal staat. We stimuleren actieve deelname aan securitycommunity’s en geven je de ruimte om je expertise te verdiepen, nieuwe technologieën te verkennen en jezelf continu te ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?
We zijn op zoek naar gedreven collega’s die de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van cybersecurity en een sleutelrol willen spelen in het beschermen van organisaties tegen digitale dreigingen. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen.

Je weet hoe je bedreigingen in kaart brengt, incidenten snel en effectief onderzoekt en systemen en data beschermt volgens de hoogste beveiligingsnormen. Onze cybersecuritycollega’s blinken uit in incidentrespons, loganalyses en vulnerability management en zetten hun sterke communicatievaardigheden in om soepel samen te werken met andere teams. Jij sluit daar moeiteloos bij aan.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo of universitaire studie met een focus op IT of Cybersecurity. Of een andere studie met een sterk analytisch component.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als cybersecurity specialist op het gebied van engineering, security monitoring en/of incidentrespons.

  • Certificeringen zoals GSEC, GCIH, Security+, BTL1, CCDL1 of certificeringen in Azure (bv. AZ-900 en AZ-500), Microsoft SC-200, AWS, Splunk of Elastic.

  • Heldere communicatie, ook richting niet-technische stakeholders.

  • Teamspeler met een passie voor kennisdeling en blijven leren.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en goede beheersing van het Engels.

Herken je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze punten? Dan kijken we alvast uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Dit krijg je van ons
Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract;

  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;
  • Mogelijkheden voor fiscaal vriendelijke aflossing van jouw studieschuld;
  • Een uitgebreid aanbod aan voordelen via ons cafetariamodel, waaronder een fietsregeling, sportabonnementen, zonnepanelen en collectieve verzekeringen;
  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

Lijkt deze job iets voor jou?
Ben je klaar om samen met ons te bouwen aan een digitale wereld die veilig, betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig is? Mooi. Want bij Sopra Steria beschermen we wat écht waardevol is en jouw talent kan daar een directe impact op hebben.

We kijken ernaar uit om jouw bijdrage te zien aan onze missie: protect what’s precious.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Økonomimedarbejder til vores team i Vrå - er du klar til dit næste skridt?
description:
Vrå Økonomi & jura Fuldtid Ansøg senest 14. okt. 2026

Hyldgaard & Larsen leverer specialiserede sociale tilbud til mennesker med forskellige støttebehov. Det seneste år er vi vokset og består i dag af flere selskaber og tilbud på tværs af landet. Det betyder mere volumen, flere snitflader og større kompleksitet - også i økonomifunktionen.
Derfor leder vi nu efter en ny kollega til vores velfungerende økonomiteam.
Fælles for os er ønsket om at bidrage til et godt liv for mennesker, der står i en sårbar livssituation. Det er det fælles formål, der binder organisationen sammen, også selvom vores fagligheder og opgaver er vidt forskellige.
I økonomiteamet understøtter du den daglige drift af organisationen og er med til at sikre, at økonomien fungerer på tværs af selskaber og tilbud.
Det vigtigste for os er ikke din titel, men at du har et godt fagligt fundament og lyst til at bygge videre på det.En hverdag med økonomidrift og ansvar

Der er klassisk økonomidrift i jobbet, og det skal du selvfølgelig trives med. Samtidig får du en bred berøringsflade og mulighed for at følge opgaverne hele vejen rundt.

Du får dine egne områder, men står ikke alene med dem. Der er altid kolleger at vende spørgsmål og problemstillinger med. Og fordi organisationen vokser og forandrer sig, gør vores arbejdsgange det også. Ser du en bedre eller enklere måde at gøre noget på, vil vi gerne høre den.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Kreditor- og debitorstyring
  • Bogføring og afstemninger
  • Opgaver i forbindelse med måneds- og årsafslutning
  • Lønudarbejdelse
  • Økonomiopgaver på tværs af vores selskaber
  • Opfølgning og kvalitetssikring

Præcis hvilke områder du får ansvar for, afhænger også af, hvad du kommer med. Vi vil hellere finde den rigtige kollega og sammensætte rollen derefter end lede efter én bestemt profil.

Hvad kommer du med?

Du kan være kontoruddannet med økonomi, have en regnskabsmæssig uddannelse eller have lært faget gennem praktisk erfaring. Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er mindre vigtig for os.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en økonomi-, regnskabs- eller bogholderifunktion
  • Arbejder struktureret og har blik for detaljen
  • Er fortrolig med digitale arbejdsgange
  • Tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs
  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og tæt samarbejde

Du behøver ikke kunne det hele fra første dag. Det afgørende er, at fundamentet er på plads, og at du har lyst til at lære mere.

Et team med forskellige styrker

Du bliver en del af vores økonomiteam i Koncernservice i Vrå. Her er vi syv kolleger, der sammen varetager økonomiopgaver på tværs af organisationen.

Vi har en uformel tone, plads til humor og et godt kollegaskab. Vi sparrer, spørger og hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det - og vi forventer samtidig, at den enkelte tager ansvar for sine opgaver.

Vi skal ikke alle kunne det samme. Tværtimod ser vi en styrke i et team med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer, som vi kan bringe i spil sammen. Og vi vægter det gode samarbejde højt.

Selvom Hyldgaard & Larsen er blevet en større organisation, lægger vi vægt på at bevare nærheden. Vi vil gerne have en arbejdsplads, hvor vi kender hinanden, hjælper hinanden og ikke har langt fra en god idé til handling.

Hvad får du hos os?

Du får en fast fuldtidsstilling med varierede økonomiopgaver, egne ansvarsområder og mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt.

Derudover får du:

  • Et økonomiteam med gode muligheder for sparring
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer en god balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv og møder behov for fleksibilitet med fleksibilitet
  • Mulighed for faglig og personlig udvikling
  • Fagdage og sociale arrangementer
  • Pensionsordning og sundhedssikring
  • God personalepleje - også i hverdagen

Skal vi lære hinanden at kende?

Arbejdsstedet er Hyldgaard & Larsen Koncernservice, Borupvej 27, 9760 Vrå, og stillingen er på fuld tid.

Vi vil gerne have vores nye kollega med ombord hurtigst muligt, men venter gerne på den rette.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte økonomichef Henrik Skovsen på 54 58 85 67.

Send dit CV og din ansøgning via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Senior Konsulent – Agentisk AI
description:
Vi søker erfarne konsulenter innen agentisk AI som ønsker å spille en nøkkelrolle i noen av Norges mest spennende digitaliseringsprosjekter. Hos oss får du jobbe tett med store og mellomstore organisasjoner som ønsker å transformere forretningen sin gjennom intelligente AI-agenter, automatiserte arbeidsflyter og Microsoft Copilot-plattformen.

Hva du skal jobbe med

Du vil jobbe tett med kunder for å forstå hvordan prosessene deres fungerer i dag, og hvor Copilot og AI-agenter kan gjøre en forskjell. Sammen med tverrfaglige team designer og implementerer du løsninger basert på Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot og Azure AI Foundry, og relaterte plattformer. Du vil bidra i arkitekturvalg, utvikling og implementering av agentiske løsninger, inkludert integrasjoner og automatiserte arbeidsflyter. Rollen innebærer også å veilede kunder i valg av teknologi og sørge for gode løsninger med fokus på sikkerhet, ansvarlig bruk og langsiktig verdi.

Hvem vi ser etter

Du er en trygg rådgiver med evne til å utfordre, strukturere og skape tillit hos kunder. Du trigges av mulighetene som oppstår når AI slutter å assistere og begynner å handle – og du vet hvordan man omsetter det til verdiskaping i praksis. Du er ikke låst til én plattform eller én modell; du tenker arkitektur og utfall, og lar forretningsbehovet styre teknologivalget.

Videre har du:

  • Høyere utdannelse, gjerne innen informatikk, økonomi eller ingeniørfag
  • Minimum 3–5 års erfaring med Microsoft Power Platform og/eller Azure AI-tjenester
  • Solid erfaring med ett eller flere av følgende:
    • Copilot Studio og Microsoft 365 Copilot
    • Azure AI Foundry / Semantic Kernel / Prompt Flow
    • Power Automate og integrasjonsarkitektur (REST/API, Service Bus)
    • Praktisk erfaring med store språkmodeller som Azure OpenAI / ChatGPT, Claude og Gemini
  • God forståelse av forretningsprosesser og evne til å omsette dem til agentflyter
  • God forståelse av arkitekturprinsipper for agentiske systemer
  • God forståelse av lavkode-løsninger som Microsoft Power Platform
  • Erfaring med å designe løsninger som kombinerer AI, mennesker og systemer i operative flyter
  • Sterke kommunikasjonsevner og evne til å bygge tillit hos beslutningstakere og sluttbrukere
  • Gode ferdigheter i norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig

Gode grunner til å velge oss

Hos Sopra Steria er du ikke én av mange som jobber med AI – du er del av et fagmiljø som faktisk leder an. Vi har Norges største AI-miljø og et dedikert Microsoft-partnerskap som gir oss førstehånds tilgang til ny teknologi, roadmaps og kompetanseutvikling. Her designer du arkitektur som faktisk tas i bruk – på tvers av plattformer, modeller og sektorer.

Vi ønsker at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Hos oss får du solide forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger, inkludert privat helseforsikring. Vi gir deg seks uker ferie med lønn, tilgang til bedriftshytter og rabatter på treningssentre. Vi støtter også en rekke interne interessegrupper som driver med alt fra padel og yoga til vinsmaking og strikking.

Er du klar til å forme morgendagens digitale løsninger sammen med oss? Vi gleder oss til å lese din CV og søknad!

For spørsmål om rollen ta kontakt med: Lars Lomelde (lars.lomelde@soprasteria.com)

For spørsmål om rekrutteringsprosessen ta kontakt med: Charlotte Latini (charlotte.latini@soprasteria.com)

Søknadsfrist: 25.oktober 2026

Sopra Steria har kunder og prosjekter som kan kreve sikkerhetsklarering på ulike nivåer. Vi gjør deg oppmerksom på dette som en del av ansettelsesprosessen.

Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av bakgrunn, kjønn, alder eller etnisitet.

Vi er Norges ledende konsulentselskap innen digitalisering, innovasjon og bærekraft. I Sopra Steria bistår vi våre kunder innen privat og offentlig sektor med å bli fremtidens virksomheter. I en årrekke har vi vært rangert som en av Norges beste arbeidsplasser. Du finner oss i Oslo, Stavanger, Trondheim, Bergen, Drammen, Hamar, Fredrikstad, Kristiansand og Tromsø.

title: Full Stack Engineer

title: Dean of Culture
description:
Compensation

The salary range for this position is $95,000-$105,000. Salary is commensurate with experience, education, and expertise. A competitive benefits package is also offered.


AMPS (Amethod Public Schools) is a mission- and values-driven organization. Our mission is to provide a rigorous college preparatory education and character development program that will prepare students from underserved communities to succeed in college and beyond. Our day-to-day work is embodied in a set of core values: Students First, Be Adaptable, Perseverance, Take Responsibility, and Commitment to Distinction. We are looking for team members who exude these values and a passion for our mission.


POSITION SUMMARY

To ensure that our schools are safe, predictable, and responsive for all students, the Dean of Culture and Community Schools Programs (“Dean”) will strive to create a structured, positive, and academically focused school culture. They will model how to build strong, mutually respectful relationships with students and families and support teachers to do the same. Own and direct the identification, development, and coordination of community resources and programs for students and families. Establish and maintain community partnerships, connect families to appropriate resources and services, and monitor, document, and report on resource utilization, partnerships, and outcomes. The Dean leads and owns school culture, ensuring that the school’s norms, systems, and practices create an environment that promotes student belonging, engagement, growth, and achievement.

This position requires a creative and inspiring professional with adult leadership experience, high energy, excellent organizational abilities, and a talent for creating a warm and supportive environment for students. The Dean will serve as a member of the administrative team dedicated to cultivating excellence throughout the school and community.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Implements a school-wide behavior management system with meaningful incentives and consequences
  • Develops and administers disciplinary procedures in accordance with organizational policies and applicable laws
  • Supervises students on campus and monitors students during arrival & departure, lunch, recess, passing periods, and other activities; instructs students in appropriate behavior; disciplines students in accordance with established guidelines;
  • Communicates high expectations for both staff and students and provides appropriate motivation to reach expectations;
  • Conduct regular school and network walkthroughs to help staff maintain a high bar of excellence.
  • Prioritize academic learning, resiliency, and support for students;
  • Oversee the development and implementation of student supports, community resources, and intervention
  • Ensure clear and consistent implementation of student accountability practices amongst staff
  • Create, implement and maintain systems for collecting and tracking data on school culture metrics, including suspensions and staff /student attendance
  • Support staff to create and sustain classroom management systems that ensure a focus on learning and student success;
  • Facilitate faculty and staff development related to school culture and consistent enforcement of student discipline.

Site Administration Support

  • Oversees the Student Study Teams and Multi-Tiered Support service model at site and PBIS
  • Lead and coordinate partnerships with after-school programs, school staff, and external community agencies to ensure high-quality enrichment and extended-learning opportunities for elementary and middle school students, while coordinating college and career readiness programs, partnerships, and resources for high school students.
  • Assist the Principal with creating and executing clear and consistent grading standards and practices for staff;
  • Supervise the consistent and fair administration of school policies regarding student conduct and discipline, using restorative practices and PBIS
  • Assist the Principal in staff classroom observations and instructional coaching as needed
  • Make habits of scholars visible across the school through usage of signage
  • Plans and leads team-building activities and opportunities that strengthen staff relationships, collaboration, morale, and school community culture.

Community Relations and Resources

  • Works with the Family Staff Team (FST) to support parent trainings, workshops, and requirements (LCAPS, Single Site Plan, WASC);
  • Serves as liaison to parents and facilitates parent education and involvement, including reinforcing the need for parents to support the school’s policies and practices for student discipline, dress code, homework, and events
  • Works with Family Student Team (FST) to promote student outcomes, scholar habits, and school accountability
  • Advances the educational mission of the school by participating in duties and responsibilities consistent with building, upholding, and promoting a strong community connection
  • Maintains communication with the appropriate home office administrators, informing them of school activities and problems such as transportation, special services, discipline
  • Keeps the community informed about school activities through newsletters, news releases, and attendance at parent meetings, etc.

EXPECTATIONS

  • Establishes and maintains productive, collaborative relationships with others.
  • Relates to students with mutual respect while carrying out a positive and effective disciplinary program.
  • Models standards of ethics, confidentiality, and professionalism.
  • Meets schedules and deadlines.
  • Excellent communicator with site and network-wide staff
  • Plans and organizes work.
  • Takes ownership of assigned directives and ensures they are carried through to completion.
  • Maintains consistent, punctual, and regular attendance.

title: AI Operations & Systems Architect (Job ID: ARSBEN1EA)
description:
🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring an AI Operations & Systems Architect! 🌟

Are you an operational builder and AI systems architect who excels at untangling complex funnels, building custom automations, and deploying pragmatic AI agents? We are seeking an AI Operations & Systems Architect based in LATAM or South Africa to sit directly beside the Founder & CEO of a fast-growing, high-volume investment property lending firm!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: AI Operations & Systems Architect ("Ops Savage" / AI Systems Builder)

  • Job ID: ARSBEN1EA

  • Industry: Business-Purpose Investment Property Lending (DSCR, RTL, Fix-and-Flip, Bridge)

  • Location: LATAM / South Africa

  • Job Status: Full Time

  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (PST) (Flexible)

  • Salary: $2,800 – $3,200 USD / month 💰

  • Target Start Date: ASAP 🚀

🏢 About the Client

Our client is a fast-growing, high-volume investment property lending firm specializing in business-purpose real estate loans. Having generated ~$45M in year-to-date loan volume, backend operations are currently capped at 15 deals per month due to manual processes. Leadership has intentionally paused outward marketing to build a scalable operational foundation that can handle 50 deals per month ($100M+ volume) without adding redundant headcount.

💼 About the Role

Forget the traditional Executive Assistant or "AI prompter" mental model. You will act as a systems architect and operational implementer—mapping our full customer journey (lead → sales → setup → processing → closing → funding), pinpointing where data leaks out, and building the tools, automations, and grounded AI agents that close those gaps.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 🔍 Days 1–30 Focus (Funnel Visibility): Map the current workflow across sales, processing, and closing; audit CRM/LOS platforms and ad attribution to fix data breakdowns so marketing can safely restart.

  • ⚙️ Scalable Operations & Product Building: Redesign infrastructure to support a 3x deal growth (15 to 50 deals/month); prototype internal tools/interfaces using low-code/no-code, APIs, webhooks, and AI-assisted environments (Lovable, Open Code).

  • 🧠 Company Knowledge Base & "Company Brain": Build a centralized, searchable database of lender guidelines, rate sheets, overlays, and checklists for human staff and AI agents.

  • 🔄 Departmental Optimization & Handoffs: Clean CRM data (Close), automate lead scoring, build sizing/pricing tools, standardize qualification gates between sales/setup/processing, and develop internal condition-clearing copilots.

  • 📊 Lender Matching & Deal-Health Intelligence: Architect dynamic lender-matching logic (top 3–5 lenders per transaction) and real-time deal-health dashboards to predict closing probability.

  • 🤖 Pragmatic AI Agent Deployment: Incrementally build and deploy grounded AI agents (intake, guideline research, pricing copilots, condition clearing) with strict human-in-the-loop approvals.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • RevOps & Systems Mastery: Proven background in RevOps, CRM architecture (Close, HubSpot, GoHighLevel), and lifecycle workflow design.

  • Technical & AI Capability: Experience connecting systems via APIs, webhooks, and automation engines (Make, n8n); proficient in shipping working tools using AI-assisted development environments (Lovable, Claude, Open Code).

  • Pragmatic Architecture Mindset: Clear framework for "simple automation vs. full AI agent"—prioritizing data quality, security, and cost-efficiency over model hype.

  • Product & Operator Mindset: Ability to take vague founder problems, scope an MVP, build it, ship it, and drive internal adoption independently.

  • Communication & Hours: Native-level English fluency with full availability during US Pacific Time (PST) hours.

🌟 Preferred / Bonus Qualifications:

  • Domain experience in loan origination, real estate finance, or private money lending (metrics like LTV, LTC, LTARV, DSCR, debt yield).

🛠️ Tech Stack Used:

  • Close CRM, GoHighLevel, LendingWise (LOS), Make, Custom APIs/Webhooks, Lovable, Claude, ChatGPT, SendBlue, Google Workspace, Attio.

title: Brigádník/brigádnice (DPP), Praha Galerie Butovice
description:
Jako Brigádník/brigádnice v H&M budete součástí týmu a pomůžete zákazníkům najít to, co hledají. Přivítáte je v prodejně, poradíte jim s výběrem a zajistíte, aby měli skvělý zákaznický zážitek. Svou energií a přístupem přispějete nejen k vlastnímu úspěchu, ale i k úspěchu celého týmu.

  • Pomáhat zákazníkům s výběrem a sdílet své znalosti o módě
  • Spolupracovat s kolegy a zajistit, aby byl obchod vždy přehledný a dobře zásobený
  • Podílet se na otevírání a zavírání prodejny
  • Reprezentovat značku H&M s pozitivním přístupem
  • Pomáhat s přípravou letního slevového oddělení

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

KOHO HLEDÁME

Hledáme nadšené lidi, kteří:

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).
  • Baví je móda a chtějí zákazníkům zajistit skvělý zákaznický zážitek.
  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.
  • Jsou komunikativní, kreativní a otevření novým technologiím.
  • Jsou flexibilní, proaktivní a ochotní učit se nové věci.
  • Mají 18 let a více
  • Mají češtinu na minimální úrovni B2.
  • Mají možnost pracovat převážně na odpoledních směnách (max do 21:30) a o víkendu.

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • Rozsáhlý školící program – vše tě naučíme.
  • Možnost kombinace práce a osobního života (flexibilita směn).
  • Občerstvení na pracovišti.
  • Šance být součástí unikátní H&M společnosti a její kultury.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na DPP (300 hodin ročně), se sídlem v Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 14.10.2026.

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: Maintenance Reliability Specialist
description:
• Work Close to Home - Stable and Growing FMCG

  • Hands-on Role working with a terrific Leadership Team

Real Pet Food Company (RPF) is passionate about feeding our pets the real food they deserve – filled with nutrients, free from harmful substances and full of flavour. At RPF we believe in staying real and doing the right thing by our pets, our fellow pet parents, and our planet. We strive to lead the industry through thoughtful innovation with real and recognisable ingredients, ethical and sustainable sourcing, and limiting processed food our pets consume. We want pets to live their best lives – helping them to grow up strong, healthy, and happy.

We are a fast-growing, innovative FMCG Manufacturer with strong ethics and a love for keeping it real. Our success comes from having a great team of people behind some pet favourite brands such as Ivory Coat, Farmers Market, Nature’s Gift, Trilogy & Fussy Cat!

This is where you come in:


We are looking for an experienced, disciplined and innovative Maintenance Reliability Specialist who is looking to join a busy and fast-paced food manufacturing site based at Yatala.

The focus of this business-critical role is to ensure the reliability of the plant to meet the required KPI’s in a safe and cost-effective manner. This role will also establish and drive maintenance practices in accordance with the corporate procedures to ensure standardisation of site maintenance and reporting. Ensuring compliance with processes and procedures to ensure identification of business improvements and RCA practices to eliminate repeated issues is a major focus.

Responsibilities include:

  • Enhance plant safety by conducting regular equipment inspections, hazard assessments, and risk mitigation measures.

  • Increase production efficiency by developing and implementing equipment reliability plans, ensuring minimal downtime and maximum output.

  • Provide technical support during equipment breakdowns, facilitating timely repairs and minimizing production losses.

  • Implement predictive maintenance programs utilizing vibration analysis, infrared thermography, and oil analysis techniques for early fault detection and prevention.

  • Coordinate shutdown planning activities to optimize resource utilization during planned outages, reducing downtime duration without compromising work quality or safety standards.

  • Conduct thorough failure analysis to identify root causes of equipment malfunctions and implemented corrective actions.

  • CAPEX and OPEX management from $50,000 to $250,000

  • Installation and modification of production line machinery and equipment to adapt process changes and R&D requirement

  • Process engineering and management for New Product Development

  • Direct supervisor for trades (both electrical and mechanical) team of up-to 20 members

  • Maximise line efficiencies through the establishment of an effective planned maintenance program


The ideal candidate:

  • MUST HAVE Experience within the FMCG industry

  • MUST HAVE RCA Experience - 5 Whys/Fishbone

  • Excellent communication skills, high level interpersonal skills and sound judgement

  • Ability to deal with multiple stakeholders and handle competing priorities

  • Excellent organisation and time management skills

  • Able to influence, manage and challenge ideas and existing business processes

  • Experience in implementing systems and process changes

  • Experience in managing projects

  • Sound knowledge across the Microsoft office suite

  • Experience in managing maintenance operations utilising computerised maintenance management systems (CMMS)

  • Comprehensive understanding of maintenance planning, including budget control

  • Recognised trades qualifications are essential

What we’re about

Welcome to RPF, where we believe in keeping it Real.

Since 1994, we have been Australia and New Zealand’s pioneers in fresher dog and cat nutrition. Our story is one of passion for a better way to care for pets, a belief in fresher nutrition, and an unwavering commitment to delivering this to pet parents and pets worldwide.

We're dedicated to fostering authentic partnerships, encouraging real ambition, and providing real career opportunities for our employees to make a difference.

Real means fresher ingredients and fresher methods. We'll never stop expanding, innovating, and trying new things. We compete in every pet category and channel, creating favourite brands such as Ivory Coat, Nature’s Gift, V.I.P. Petfoods, and Love ‘Em & Fussy Cat!

Why join us?

Do work that matters. We’re pioneering in a new area of pet food, always striving for fresher. We’re restless, creating a better life for our pets.

Make an impact and change the game. You won’t be another ‘cog in the wheel’ here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to do your best work – and to make a real difference. Do you have a great idea for a new product or system improvement? We’re all ears!

Work with a pack of awesome, genuine people who are passionate about what they do.

Grow your career with us. We’re big believers in lifelong learning. You’ll be given access to LinkedIn Learning, plus opportunities for internal mobility and leadership training to fast-track your career.

Pets our part of our family: Access our Pawrental leave when you adopt a new cat or dog, pet carer and compassionate leave.

Generous perks including day off for your anniversary, product discounts, volunteering days to help the community, novated leases, a rewards program and parental leave.

What’s next?


If you're ready to unleash your potential and make a real difference in the booming pet industry, then we want to hear from you! Next steps will include:

  • An initial telephone interview followed by up to 2 face to face interviews and site visit

  • 2 work references

  • A Pre-Employment Medical

  • Q-Fever Vaccination (this can be provided for the successful candidate)

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Diversity’s not a buzzword here, it’s in our DNA. Diverse perspectives shape our culture and make our work better. That’s why we’re committed to building inclusive teams that represent a variety of backgrounds and skills. If you need any reasonable adjustments, accessibility assistance or would like to note which pronouns you use at any stage of our hiring process, just contact us at accommodations: people&culture@realpetfoodco.com.au. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Tilsynschef med blik for drift, følgeskab og den fælles retning
description:
Som tilsynschef får du ledelsesansvaret for en gruppe tilsynsførende, der arbejder selvtilrettelæggende og på distancen. Du skal omsætte den fælles retning til en stabil drift med høj faglig kvalitet og skabe følgeskab og sammenhæng i gruppen. Samtidig bliver du en del af en chefgruppe, der har et fælles ansvar for Tilsynscenter Syds samlede opgaveløsning.

Motiveres du af et sikkert og sundt arbejdsmiljø i Danmark? Som en del af Arbejdstilsynet vil du være med til at fremme et sikkert og sundt arbejdsliv på de danske arbejdspladser. Du bidrager ved at sikre en effektiv tilsynsdrift med høj faglig kvalitet, udvikle opgaveløsningen sammen med medarbejdere og lederkolleger og indgå i stærke samarbejdsrelationer både internt i Arbejdstilsynet og med eksterne samarbejdspartnere.

Arbejdstilsynet er en politisk ledet organisation. Det betyder, at vores opgaver og prioriteringer blandt andet formes af politiske aftaler, lovgivning og den løbende udvikling på arbejdsmiljøområdet. Som tilsynschef skal du kunne navigere sikkert i disse rammer og omsætte overordnede mål og beslutninger til en velfungerende daglig opgaveløsning.

Din ledelsesopgave Som tilsynschef har du ansvar for, at gruppens opgaver bliver løst effektivt og med høj faglig kvalitet. Du skal sætte retning, prioritere og følge op og samtidig skabe gode rammer for medarbejdernes opgaveløsning, samarbejde, trivsel og udvikling.

I Tilsynscenter Syd er der sammenlagt ca. 100 tilsynsførende, som er inddelt i tilsynsgrupper på baggrund af virksomhedsbrancher.

Du bliver chef for en tilsynsgruppe med ca. 15-20 tilsynsførende med forskellige uddannelsesmæssige og faglige baggrunde. Medarbejderne fører tilsyn med arbejdsmiljøet på danske arbejdspladser og undersøger arbejdsulykker. De er geografisk fordelt i Syd- og Sønderjylland og på Fyn og tilrettelægger i høj grad selv deres arbejde. Det stiller særlige krav til din ledelse. Du skal kunne være tydelig og nærværende, selvom du ikke møder medarbejderne fysisk hver dag. Du skal skabe sammenhæng gennem løbende dialog, opfølgning, møder og faglig koordinering – både fysisk, telefonisk og virtuelt.

Du bliver en del af Tilsynscenter Syds chefgruppe, som består af seks tilsynschefer og en tilsynsdirektør. Vi arbejder tæt sammen og har et fælles ansvar for centrets drift, udvikling og resultater. Det betyder, at du både skal tage et tydeligt ansvar for din egen gruppe og bidrage aktivt til prioriteringer og løsninger på tværs af centret. Vi tilpasser løbende fordelingen af ledelsesopgaverne, når centrets opgaver og behov ændrer sig. Din ledelsesopgave kan derfor udvikle sig over tid. Det vil altid ske i dialog med dig og den samlede chefgruppe.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver at:

  • sikre en stabil og effektiv tilsynsdrift med høj faglig kvalitet
  • sætte retning, prioritere og følge op på gruppens opgaver og resultater
  • lede og udvikle medarbejdere, der i høj grad arbejder selvtilrettelæggende og på distancen
  • omsætte politiske beslutninger samt Arbejdstilsynets mål og strategiske prioriteringer til den daglige opgaveløsning
  • bidrage til at udvikle og implementere nye arbejdsgange og indsatser
  • skabe gode samarbejdsrelationer i gruppen, på tværs af centret og med relevante interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere.
Den leder, vi søger Du er en tydelig og samlende leder, som kan skabe følgeskab og har mod til at træffe beslutninger. Du kan sætte retning, prioritere og følge op – også når opgaver, hensyn og forventninger trækker i forskellige retninger. Du har blik for både drift, faglig kvalitet og medarbejdernes trivsel og udvikling.

Du har erfaring med at arbejde i en politisk ledet organisation og forstår de særlige rammer, der følger med. Du kan omsætte politiske beslutninger og strategiske prioriteringer til konkret opgaveløsning og kommunikere klart om både baggrunden, retningen og de praktiske konsekvenser.

Du er inddragende og samarbejdsorienteret i din ledelse og formår at sætte medarbejdernes forskellige kompetencer i spil. Du kan skabe sammenhæng og fællesskab, også når medarbejderne arbejder på distancen, og du bidrager aktivt og loyalt til den fælles ledelse af centret.

Derudover forestiller vi os, at du:

  • har en relevant akademisk uddannelse eller tilsvarende og erfaring med personaleledelse
  • har faglig interesse for og gerne indsigt i arbejdsmiljø og myndighedsudøvelse
  • kan bevare overblikket over ressourcer, drift og komplekse opgaver
  • kan uddelegere og give medarbejderne et tydeligt ansvar
  • har integritet, god dømmekraft og en høj personlig etik
  • bidrager aktivt, konstruktivt, engageret og åbent til samarbejdet i en ligeværdig chefgruppe
  • har stærke samarbejdsevner og kan opbygge gode relationer internt og eksternt.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling. Vi vil gerne have, at du starter den 1. januar 2027.

Du ansættes på kontraktvilkår med aflønning i løngruppe 1 (lønramme 37), og ansættelsen sker på åremål for en femårig periode. Der er knyttet et rådighedstillæg til stillingen, og der er mulighed for forhandling af kvalifikationstillæg. Ansættelsen sker efter rammeaftalen om kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten.

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan sikkerhedsgodkendes og efterfølgende kan opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen i hele din ansættelsesperiode.

Dit daglige arbejdssted er Eltangvej 232, 6000 Kolding.

Spørgsmål og ansøgning Fik du ikke svar på alle dine spørgsmål? Så er du velkommen til at kontakte tilsynsdirektør Sine Langskov Hansen på tlf. 72 20 88 81 eller tilsynschef Kirstine Lindved på tlf. 72 20 99 70.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkårene, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR-partner Maria Køel Jensen i Beskæftigelsesministeriets HR på tlf. 21 63 15 34.

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer alle interesserede ansøgere uanset personlig baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Vi har valgt at gøre ansøgningsprocessen enkel. Du skal derfor kun sende et motiveret CV og dine eksamenspapirer. I dit CV skal du indledningsvis kort beskrive din motivation for at søge stillingen, og hvordan dine kompetencer og erfaringer matcher opgaven. Du skal ikke sende en særskilt ansøgning.

Send dit motiverede CV og dine eksamenspapirer elektronisk senest søndag den 18. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at holde første samtaler 28. oktober og anden samtaler 6. november. Der vil indgå et testforløb mellem første og anden samtale.

Vi ser frem til at læse dit CV.

title: Service Coordinator (VGE) Children's Unit
description:
Company Overview


Promoting Opportunities, Supporting Choices

At North Bay Regional Center, we believe all people with developmental disabilities should have the same opportunities as are available to all other citizens. As one of the 21 nonprofit Regional Centers throughout California, we offer a comprehensive program supporting the needs of our communities, provided by driven and passionate employees who ensure we achieve our goals daily.


Who We Serve
North Bay Regional Center provides advocacy, services, support, and care coordination to children and adults diagnosed with intellectual and developmental disabilities and their families in Napa, Sonoma and Solano counties.

We partner with community-based organizations and agencies to empower our clients to thrive and live as independently as possible within the geographically, culturally, and ethnically diverse communities we serve. North Bay Regional Center is a nonprofit private corporation that contracts with the Department of Developmental Services to coordinate services and supports for individuals with developmental disabilities. At North Bay, we’re promoting opportunities by supporting choices for people with developmental disabilities.


North Bay Regional Center serves over 13,000 people living within the geographic boundaries of Napa, Sonoma and Solano counties. Guided by our NBRC Mission and Values to assist people with developmental disabilities to obtain the services and supports needed to live as others do in the community, NBRC has established Strategic Goals to guide our efforts in focused areas: employment, independence, community access and family supports.


NBRC is committed to being a culturally and linguistically competent agency, striving to provide the services that our diverse clients and families need in their unique circumstances. We also value the contributions that our diverse staff bring to the agency.

Note: Bilingual Spanish/English skills are preferred.


Job Description

Are you passionate about providing support and caring for individuals with developmental disabilities? Are you looking for an organization where we help our clients achieve their goals and dreams? North Bay Regional Center is a nonprofit private corporation that contracts with the Department of Developmental Services to coordinate services and supports for individuals with developmental disabilities. We are looking for a Social Services Case Manager to join our dedicated team of Service Coordinators.


At North Bay, we promote opportunities by supporting choices for people with developmental disabilities. In the role of Social Services Case Manager you will be responsible for managing the delivery of services to regional center clients including those with intensive physical or emotional needs, ensuring client’s Individual Program Plan and its objectives are pursued.


Job Responsibilities

Our Social Services Case Managers/Service Coordinators are responsible for using person-centered planning to assists clients in use of public and private resources before using regional center funds to purchase services.


Additional responsibilities of the Social Services Case Manager include:

  • Monitoring vendor services and verifying that services are delivered in accordance with the purchase of service authorizations
  • Evaluating the effectiveness of clients’ Individual Program Plans; ensuring that appropriate community resources are made available to the client
  • Conducting annual reassessments of clients’ developmental status in conjunction with the interdisciplinary team
  • Conducting client assessments on an occasional basis

title: Google Cloud AI Engineer - USA
description:

Cogniify is hiring a Google Cloud AI Engineer to build and deploy Generative AI applications and AI agents that work with real business data. In this hands-on role, you will use Vertex AI, Python and BigQuery to take solutions from design to production.

We are looking for an engineer who has built production AI or machine learning applications, can connect them securely to enterprise data, and enjoys working with both engineering teams and business stakeholders.

title: Robotics AI Engineer – Calibration, Localization, and Mapping
description:
Field AI is transforming how robots interact with the real world. We are building risk-aware, reliable, and field-ready AI systems that address the most complex challenges in robotics, unlocking the full potential of embodied intelligence. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-based architectures, and are charting a new course, with already-globally-deployed solutions delivering real-world results and rapidly improving models through real-field applications.

Robotics AI Engineer – Calibration, Localization, and Mapping
About Field AI
Field AI is at the forefront of robotic embodied AI, transforming industries like construction, security, mining, and manufacturing. Our autonomous robots operate globally, often in harsh environments, delivering critical insights to customers. Whether monitoring construction progress, ensuring safety compliance, or conducting predictive maintenance, Field AI is advancing technology to make a meaningful impact.
Learn more at .
About the Job
Field AI is seeking passionate scientists and engineers to play a vital role in the development of advanced geometric robot perception algorithms. As a member of our Calibration, Localization, and Mapping (CLAM) team, you will work with a team of high-focused individuals in a fast-paced environment to deliver production-quality code within our calibration, localization, and mapping subsystems. You will work with a variety of different sensing modalities and help streamline our calibration pipeline and/or develop environment-agnostic localization and mapping algorithms for our downstream autonomy modules. The specific project and work that you will be doing will depend on your specific skill set and area of interest. The ideal candidate will not only have a deep theoretical understanding of modern calibration, localization, and mapping algorithms, but also the practical skills to deliver high-quality and maintainable code on a small, focused team in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Get To Do

  • Design and implement state-of-the-art calibration, localization, and mapping algorithms for our autonomous quadrupeds and humanoids
  • Develop various tools and metrics to continuously validate and benchmark the performance of our various subsystems
  • Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in C++ and Python
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate and deploy your algorithms into real-world systems

What You Have

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with expertise in calibration, localization, and/or 3D mapping
  • Strong mathematical foundation in linear algebra, probability theory, numerical optimization, 3D geometry, Lie theory, and 3D kinematics
  • Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with different linear and non-linear state estimation frameworks for sensor fusion
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art LiDAR-inertial odometry and SLAM algorithms
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art visual-inertial odometry and SLAM algorithms
  • Experience with sensor calibration (intrinsics and extrinsics) and time synchronization
  • Strong proficiency in C++ and Python and modern best practices, with the ability to write maintainable and efficient code
  • Strong understanding how ROS works and experience with designing, building, and deploying your own nodes into a complex robotic system
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and being able to work independently while managing multiple priorities
  • Strong work ethic, highly self-motivated, and excellent written and verbal communication skills

The Extras That Set You Apart

  • Publications and/or patents in calibration, state estimation, odometry, and/or SLAM
  • Experience working with noisy sensor measurements and designing outlier-resilient algorithms
  • Experience working with computationally constrained platforms and designing efficient, real-time algorithms with low computational complexity
  • Experience with other sensing modalities (e.g., radar, doppler-LiDAR, GPS, etc.)
  • Experience with modern version control and project management tools
Field AI Onsite Work Philosophy:
Field AI believes in-person collaboration is essential for tackling complex challenges. This is a fully onsite role based in our Irvine, CA office, with flexible hours to support work-life balance.
We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation and Benefits
We take into consideration an individual's background and experience in determining final salary; base pay offered may vary considerably depending on geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Also, while we enjoy being together on-site, we are open to exploring a hybrid or remote option.
Why Join Field AI?
We are solving one of the world’s most complex challenges: deploying robots in unstructured, previously unknown environments. Our Field Foundational Models™ set a new standard in perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, ensuring our approach is explainable and safe for deployment.
You will have the opportunity to work with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. With a decade-long track record of deploying solutions in the field, winning DARPA challenge segments, and bringing expertise from organizations like DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise Self-Driving, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, we are set to achieve our ambitious goals.
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
To tackle such ambitious challenges, we need a team as unique as our vision — innovators who go beyond conventional methods and are eager to tackle tough, uncharted questions. We’re seeking individuals who challenge the status quo, dive into uncharted territory, and bring interdisciplinary expertise. Our team requires not only top AI talent but also exceptional software developers, engineers, product designers, field deployment experts, and communicators.
We are headquartered in always-sunny Irvine, Southern California and have US based and global teammates.
Join us, shape the future, and be part of a fun, close-knit team on an exciting journey!
We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Prototype. Experiment. Build Gallup’s next generation of products.

As a senior software engineer at Gallup, you’ll push the boundaries of what our technology can do. You’ll design and deliver full-stack solutions, use rapid feedback loops to test ideas and help turn successful prototypes into scalable, production-ready systems. Your code, ideas and technical decisions will shape solutions that measure people’s work and life experiences, influence leaders’ decision-making, and deliver insights to customers more frequently and in a more personal way.

If you’re driven by curiosity, collaboration and the chance to create technology that empowers millions around the world, apply today.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build and ship experimental product features end-to-end, from database schema and API endpoints to UI components and deployment pipelines
  • Write production-quality code across the stack: Node.js/Python backends, data models, RESTful APIs and modern JavaScript front ends with hands-on debugging and performance optimization
  • Prototype with emerging AI technologies (e.g., LLMs, embeddings, agents) by implementing working integrations, running experiments and providing technical recommendations based on real performance data
  • Architect and implement scalable systems from scratch, making concrete decisions on frameworks, infrastructure, caching strategies and deployment approaches

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Technical leadership: You’ve guided teams through complex, fast-moving projects.
  • Tool versatility: You’re fluent in multiple languages and frameworks and know how to choose the right tool to deliver results.
  • Collaborative mentorship: You share knowledge generously, explain technical concepts clearly and help others level up their expertise.
  • Startup drive:You thrive among high achievers who believe experimentation and iteration fuel progress.

What You Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience, required
  • At least five years of experience building production software with a strong back-end focus required
  • Hands‑on experience designing and implementing scalable, secure APIs serving web, mobile and third‑party integrations required
  • Solid front-end development skills (e.g., React, TypeScript, modern CSS) to build interactive prototypes and experimental UIs required
  • Demonstrated expertise in cloud-native architecture and AWS services (e.g., Lambda, API Gateway, RDS, S3) required
  • Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases, with practical schema design and data modeling skills required
  • Proficiency with CI/CD automation and observability tools for tracing, metrics and structured logging preferred
  • Security-minded development approach, with experience implementing authentication, authorization and secrets management best practices preferred

About Gallup

At Gallup, we change the world, one client at a time, through extraordinary analytics and advice on everything important facing humankind. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup offers a robust benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and other insurance options; a fully vested 401(k) retirement savings plan with company matching; an employee stock ownership program; mass transit reimbursement; family-building benefits; an employee assistance program; and various reimbursements and activities that enhance our associates’ wellbeing. We also offer an estimated annual salary range of $180,000-$230,000 for this role. Salaries are based on a variety of factors, including an individual’s education, experience and skills.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.
