title: PR & Influencer Specialist
description:
As a PR & Influencer Specialist you will set develop and execute, our PR and influencer marketing efforts across global and local markets.

In this role, you will drive strategic PR & Influence communication, build meaningful relationships with creators and media, and bring the Weekday brand closer to our community through impactful storytelling and collaborations.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Develop and execute Weekday's global and local PR and influencer marketing strategy aligned with the brand direction and business objectives.
  • Set goals, manage budgets, monitor performance, and optimize activities based on results.
  • Lead and coordinate influencer collaborations, brand partnerships, events, activations, and PR initiatives.
  • Build, nurture, and maintain strong relationships with influencers, creators, media contacts, agencies, and industry partners.
  • Manage press relations, media outreach, press releases, gifting programs, and media monitoring.
  • Foster close cross-functional collaboration with Social Media, Creative, Assortment, and external partners to drive brand impact and business growth.
  • Identify new opportunities, emerging talents, and cultural moments that strengthen Weekday's relevance and visibility.
  • Monitor industry trends across fashion, music, art, culture, and social media to continuously evolve the PR and influencer strategy.
  • Analyze campaign performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You will be part of the Weekday Marketing team and work closely with colleagues across Brand, Media, Content Production, Assortment and E-commerce. You will also collaborate with external agencies, media representatives, influencers, creators, and strategic partners across multiple markets.

QUALIFICATION

  • Experience within PR, Influencer Marketing, Brand Communications, preferably within fashion, lifestyle, retail, or consumer brands.
  • Proven experience developing and executing PR and influencer strategies, including campaign planning, influencer partnerships, media relationship, events, and activations.
  • Strong understanding of the influencer marketing landscape, social media platforms, creator ecosystems, and earned media strategies.
  • Experience managing budgets, agency relationships, campaign reporting, and performance analysis, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Established network and experience building press and media relationships, as well as planning and executing PR events targeting KOLs and relevant press within fashion, culture, and music.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal, and proficiency in relevant tools such as influencer marketing platforms, media monitoring tools, social analytics tools, and Microsoft Office.

Behaviours based on our values

  • Delivery & Execution: Ability to produce high-quality, accurate work, prioritise effectively and meet deadlines. You should also be able to demonstrate resilience under pressure.
  • Problem Solving & Judgment: Ability to analyse issues logically, use data and evidence to guide decisions & anticipate and address issues before they arise.
  • Communication: Able to communicate clearly in writing and verbally, you should be able to explain technical or complex points simply and keep stakeholders informed and updated.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work constructively with other colleagues, share knowledge and support teammates. You should also be openminded and accept feedback professionally.
  • Adaptable & Curious: You should be able to adjust to changing priorities, learns new tools and processes quickly and show curiosity and self-development

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

This is a full time permanent position based at our Head Office in Stockholm.

If you feel this opportunity is exciting, feel free to apply by sending in your CV and Portfolio in English as soon as possible, but no later than 9th of Oct. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through our career page.

We value collaboration and believe that great ideas thrive when we work closely together. Therefore, this role is primarily office based, with four days per week at the office to foster teamwork and engagement. One day per week, you’ll have the flexibility to work remotely.

Please note this position is offered on a local contract; therefore, you should have the legal right to work in Sweden before applying. Other candidates are welcome to register their interest, and we will keep you in mind for future opportunities.

WHO WE ARE

Weekday is a creative multi-space featuring Weekday, Cheap Monday, Monki, exclusive drops, second hand and more. A mix of culture inspired brands that evolve with the now and embrace the many true expressions of youth. Weekday is more than fashion — it’s a platform for moods, moments, and culture in motion. Learn more about Weekday here.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with broad development opportunities. All our employees receive a staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition, all employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

Weekday based colleagues also receive:

  • 30 days holiday

  • A collective agreement which includes pension and life insurance

  • Wellness benefit 4000kr/year

  • Benify Benefits Portal

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Administrator, Telecom Automation Operations
description:
The Aspen Group (TAG) is one of the largest and most trusted retail healthcare business support organizations in the U.S. and has supported over 20,000 healthcare professionals and team members with close to 1,500 health and wellness offices across 48 states in four distinct categories: dental care, urgent care, medical aesthetics, and animal health. Working in partnership with independent practice owners and clinicians, the team is united by a single purpose: to prove that healthcare can be better and smarter for everyone. TAG provides a comprehensive suite of centralized business support services that power the impact of five consumer-facing businesses: Aspen Dental, ClearChoice Dental Implant Centers, WellNow Urgent Care, Chapter Aesthetic Studio, and Lovet. Each brand has access to a deep community of experts, tools and resources to grow their practices, and an unwavering commitment to delivering high-quality consumer healthcare experiences at scale.


Job Description:


The Administrator, Telecom Automation Operations is a hands-on technical role responsible for the day-to-day support and optimization of the organization's Telecom Automation Operations. Administrators operate within a break/fix model to resolve incidents and service disruptions, while also contributing to business optimization activities that improve platform efficiency and business outcomes for the Telecom division.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor, triage, and resolve incidents and service requests related to Telecom Automation Operations in accordance with established SLAs
  • Perform root cause analysis on recurring issues and document findings to drive permanent resolution
  • Execute routine platform health checks, maintenance tasks, and configuration updates
  • Support onboarding and change management activities when new AI capabilities are deployed or updated
  • Document procedures, known issues, workarounds, and resolutions in the team knowledge base
  • Collaborate with Automation Operations vendors on technical issues requiring escalated support
  • Identify and surface opportunities for platform optimization, process improvement, or automation
  • Assist in the development and testing of solutions that improve platform reliability and business performance
  • Participate in on-call rotation and support coverage as needed to maintain platform availability
  • Contribute to operational reviews by providing incident data, trend analysis, and status updates
  • Manages hierarchy for all lines of business
  • Contact Center support for technical challenges
  • Manages Opera rules for all lines of business
  • Weekly calibration sessions with analysts for alignment

Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience in IT support, platform administration, or technical operations
  • Hands-on experience working with AI/ML platforms, intelligent automation tools, or enterprise SaaS applications
  • Familiarity with ITSM processes including incident management, problem management, and change management
  • Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose technical issues across integrated systems
  • Comfortable working with data and logs to investigate platform behavior and performance
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to document technical issues clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-motivated and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience supporting platforms in a Telecom environment (e.g., network automation, AI-driven customer support, revenue assurance tools)
  • ITIL Foundation certification
  • Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, or scripting languages (Python, SQL, or similar) for diagnostic or automation purposes
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, or equivalent)

Reporting Structure:

This role reports directly to the Manager, Telecom Automation Operations. Administrators work collaboratively as a two-person team, sharing responsibilities for platform coverage, incident response, and optimization projects.


Annual Salary Range: $75,000-$88,000/year, with a generous benefits package that includes paid time off, health, dental, vision, and 401(k) savings plan with match.

title: Part Time Satış Danışmanı (Akbatı AVM)
description:
NELER YAPACAKSIN

Satış Danışmanı olarak, mükemmel müşteri deneyimi yaratmada önemli bir rol oynayacaksın. Müşterileri karşılayacak, mağazanda onlara rehberlik edecek ve sergilenen ürünlerimiz arasından ihtiyaç duyduklarını bulmaları için yardımcı olacaksın. Değerlerimiz doğrultusunda hareket ederek, hem kendi başarına hem de şirketin başarısına katkıda bulunacaksın.

Senden beklenenler:

  • Müşterilerin bilinçli seçimler yapmalarına yardımcı olmak için moda ve ürün bilgini paylaşmak.
  • Müşteri Sadakat programını (H&M Member) aktif olarak tanıtarak, müşteri yolculuğunun her adımında ekibinizle işbirliği yaparak olağanüstü hizmet sunmak.
  • Satış alanının ve arka ofisin doğru stok seviyesine sahip, düzenli ve davetkar olduğundan emin olmak.
  • Mağazanın açılış ve kapanışını desteklemek.
  • Tüm müşteri etkileşimlerinde kendinini ve markayı olumlu bir şekilde temsil etmek.

​KİMLERLE ÇALIŞACAKSINIZ

Mağazalarımız şirketimizin kalbidir, müşterilerimizin markamızı doğrudan deneyimlediği yerlerdir. Dinamik Mağaza Ekibinin bir parçası olarak, Satış Danışmanlarından, Departman Müdürlerinden, Mağaza Müdürlerinden ve Görsel Düzenleme Sorumlularından, Kasa Ofis Sorumlusuna kadar her rol, ilham verici ve misafirperver bir ortam yaratmaya katkıda bulunur. Ayrıca, iç görüleri paylaşmak ve birlikte başarıya ulaşmak için mağazalar arasında iş birliği yaparak Bölge Ekibiyle bağlantı kuracaksın. Birlikte çalıştığın ekiple birlikte, müşterilerin kendilerini güvende hissetmelerine ve en son trendler ve zamansız stillerle bireyselliklerini ifade etmelerine yardımcı olmakta önemli bir rol oynayacaksın. Mağazalarımızdaki müşterilerimizle anlamlı bağlantılar kurarak, modayı herkes için erişilebilir ve sürdürülebilir hale getiriyoruz.

SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ

İşte senden beklediğimiz özellikler…

  • Moda, perakende veya benzer alanlarda müşteri hizmetleri deneyimi tercih sebebi olarak değerlendirilebilir.
  • Müşterilere yardımcı olma tutkusu ve moda veya perakende ile ilgili olmak – geriye kalanları sana biz öğreteceğiz!

Ve…

  • İş birlikçi ve dinamik ortamlarda başarılı.
  • İletişimi güçlü, yaratıcı, mağazacılık teknolojisiyle çalışmaya meraklı, öğrenmeye ve gelişmeye istekli.
  • Esnek ve eylem odaklı.

BİZ KİMİZ

H&M Group, güçlü moda markaları ve girişimlerinden oluşan küresel bir şirkettir. Amacımız, olağanüstü tasarım, uygun fiyatlar ve sürdürülebilir çözümler arasında hiçbir taviz olmadığını kanıtlamaktır. Modayı birçok kişi için özgürleştirmek istiyoruz ve müşterilerimiz aldığımız her kararın merkezinde yer alıyor.

Paylaştığımız kültür ve değerlerle birleşmiş binlerce tutkulu ve yetenekli meslektaşımızdan oluşuyoruz. Birlikte, gücümüzü, ölçeğimizi ve bilgimizi kullanarak moda endüstrisini daha kapsayıcı ve sürdürülebilir bir geleceğe taşımak istiyoruz.​

BURADA ÇALIŞMAYI NEDEN SEVECEKSİN

H&M Group'ta, canlı ve misafirperver bir şirket olmaktan gurur duyuyoruz. Çalışanlarımıza dünya çapında kapsamlı gelişim fırsatlarıyla, cazip avantajlar sunuyoruz.

  • Tüm H&M Grubu markalarında hem mağazalarda hem de online olarak (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ve ARKET) %25 personel indirimi.
  • H&M Teşvik Programı HIP. Program hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin. H&M Incentive Program.
  • Yemek Yardımı
  • Ulaşım Yardımı
  • Doğum Yardımı
  • Mazaret İzni (Ücretli)
  • Taşınma İzni
  • Doğum Günü İzni (1 yıl boyunca bizimle çalışma sonrası)
  • Özel durumlar için ilave ücretli izinler (Örnek: ek doğum, hamilelik izinleri)
  • Yıl Dönümü Kutlaması – 10 yıl ve üzeri bizimle çalışan ekip arkadaşlarımız

BİZE KATILIN

Bizim benzersizliğimiz, birçok şeyin birleşiminden gelir – kapsayıcı ve işbirlikçi kültürümüz, güçlü değerlerimiz ve büyüme fırsatlarımız. Ancak en önemlisi, bizi biz yapan insanlarımızdır.

Bu, Akbatı AVM'de bulunan yarı zamanlı bir pozisyondur. Başvurunuzu en kısa sürede, ancak en geç 11 Ekim 2026 tarihine kadar CV'nizi göndererek yapmanızı rica ederiz. Veri politikaları nedeniyle, yalnızca kariyer sayfası üzerinden yapılan başvuruları kabul ediyoruz.

​Birlikte kariyerinizde bir sonraki adımı atalım. Yolculuk burada başlıyor.​

*Mağaza Rollerinin Değerlendirilmesi

Satış Danışmanı pozisyonu için beklenen yüksek başvuru hacmini etkin bir şekilde yönetmek amacıyla, tüm mağazalarımızda yetkinlik bazlı işe alım için çevrimiçi değerlendirme yöntemini kullanıyoruz. Bu, başvuru ve eleme sürecinizin bir parçası olarak çevrimiçi bir değerlendirmeden geçeceğiniz anlamına gelir.Yanıtlarınız, H&M Group tarafından belirlenen önceden tanımlanmış kriterleri uygulayan bir değerlendirme aracı tarafından puanlanacaktır.

Değerlendirmeden sonra geri bildirimde bulunma ve soru sorma fırsatına sahipsiniz. Çevrimiçi değerlendirme yöntemiyle ilgili herhangi bir zorluk veya endişeniz varsa, recruitment_support@hm.com adresinden alternatif bir değerlendirme yöntemi talep edebilirsiniz. Alternatif bir yöntemi seçmek, pozisyon için değerlendirilme şansınızı etkilemeyecektir.

Kişisel verilerinizin tarafımızca nasıl işlendiği hakkında daha fazla bilgi için lütfen Gizlilik Politikamızı inceleyin.

** Adil ve eşit bir süreç yürütüyoruz ve bu nedenle bilinçsiz önyargılara neden olabilecek bir ön yazıyı başvurunuza eklememenizi rica ediyoruz.

title: AVS Valve Technician
description:
Proconex is the exclusive Emerson Impact Partner for Emerson Automation Solutions in the Mid-Atlantic region. We provide a full portfolio of Process Automation Control Systems, Valves and Control Devices, and related technologies and services to a range of customers—in the Life Sciences, Chemical, Power, Refining, Oil & Gas, Food & Beverage, Paper, Metals, and other industries, as well as commercial enterprises and campus facilities. With three strategically located offices, Proconex maintains a deep dedication to its 200+ employees, a sharp focus on safety and quality, and the drive to deliver.

VALVE TECHNICIAN / MECHANICAL FIELD TECHNICIAN

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) | Swedesboro, NJ & Northeast/Mid-Atlantic Region | Full-Time

Build a Career in a Specialized, Respected Industrial Trade

Are you a skilled trades professional looking for your next opportunity? Do you have hands-on experience as a mechanic, machinist, hydraulic technician, plant technician, or maintenance professional? Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is looking for motivated, technically-minded individuals to join our growing team and develop into highly skilled Valve Technicians.

Whether your background is in the military, heavy equipment repair, manufacturing, food production, refinery operations, hydraulics, automotive, shipyards, power generation, or industrial maintenance, we provide the training and support needed to build a long-term career in a specialized and respected trade.

About Atlantic Valve Services

Atlantic Valve Services (AVS) is a full-service safety relief and control valve repair center supporting customers throughout the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic region. We are a premier service provider for Emerson/Fisher control valves and an authorized assembler of Anderson Greenwood, Crosby, and Kunkle pressure relief valves. AVS provides repair, testing, calibration, diagnostics, upgrades, and field services for critical industrial facilities.

Our technicians work on equipment that helps keep manufacturing plants, energy facilities, pharmaceutical companies, refineries, food production facilities, and industrial operations running safely and efficiently.

Why Join AVS?

  • Paid hands-on training in a specialized, high-demand trade
  • Factory training opportunities with industry leaders (Emerson, etc.)
  • Learn highly specialized skills valued across industries
  • Work alongside experienced technicians and mentors
  • Competitive pay with overtime opportunities
  • Premium medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Stable, long-term career with clear advancement opportunities
  • Clean, professional work environment
  • Exposure to a wide range of industrial equipment and customer sites
  • Opportunity to work on equipment critical to major industrial operations

What You'll Do

As a Valve Technician, you'll learn to inspect, maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and test industrial valves and related equipment used in critical process industries. Working alongside experienced technicians, you will:

  • Perform maintenance, inspection, and repair activities on industrial valves and related equipment
  • Assist with the assembly and disassembly of control valves, safety relief valves, and isolation valves
  • Learn diagnostic and troubleshooting techniques to identify equipment issues
  • Conduct valve testing, calibration, and performance verification
  • Read and follow technical procedures, drawings, and service documentation
  • Complete service reports and maintenance records
  • Support customer outages, maintenance projects, and field service activities
  • Maintain high safety standards at customer facilities and AVS locations
  • Collaborate with experienced technicians and engineers to continuously develop your skills

We're Looking for Skilled Trades Professionals

We actively recruit from diverse technical backgrounds. We encourage applications from:

Military Veterans:

  • Marine Corps, Navy, Army, Air Force, and Coast Guard veterans

title: QA/QC Project Manager – Civil & Structural
description:
We are working confidentially with a General Contractor delivering a major data center project in the Mobile, Alabama area and are looking to appoint an experienced QA/QC Project Manager with a strong Civil and Structural background.

This is a full-time, site-based position.

Recent data center construction experience is essential.

The Role

The QA/QC Project Manager will take ownership of quality assurance and quality control across the civil and structural packages, working closely with Project Managers, Superintendents, engineers, inspectors and trade partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Managing QA/QC across civil and structural construction packages

  • Developing and maintaining project quality plans, inspection procedures and documentation

  • Performing site inspections and quality audits

  • Overseeing quality across concrete, foundations, structural steel and associated structural systems

  • Reviewing drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs and approved shop drawings

  • Ensuring work complies with contract documents, specifications, codes and project standards

  • Supporting punch lists, turnover, closeout and final quality documentation

  • Working closely with civil and structural subcontractors to resolve quality issues

  • Maintaining QA/QC logs, reports and project records

What We’re Looking For

  • Recent data center or mission critical construction experience is essential

  • Strong civil and structural construction experience

  • General Contractor or Construction Manager background preferred

  • Experience in QA/QC, Quality Management, Construction Quality Control or Project Management

  • Strong knowledge of concrete, foundations, structural steel and civil/sitework

  • Experience with earthwork, underground utilities, grading and site development

  • Experience with inspections, ITPs, NCRs and corrective action processes

  • Strong understanding of construction drawings, specifications and quality requirements

  • Experience coordinating testing agencies, inspectors and subcontractors

  • Strong documentation and reporting skills

  • Experience on large-scale ground-up construction projects

  • Must be able to work full-time on site in Mobile, Alabama

This is an opportunity to take ownership of Civil and Structural QA/QC on a major ground-up data center development.

Candidates must have recent data center construction experience and a strong Civil and Structural quality background.

title: SCADA Server Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Are you an experienced server infrastructure professional who wants to help secure the reliable operation of business-critical systems? Would you like to apply your technical expertise in an operational technology environment supporting the future of renewable energy?

As our new SCADA Server Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for engineering, maintaining and continuously improving the virtual and physical server infrastructure underpinning Vattenfall’s business-critical renewable-energy Fleet-Level SCADA and related Fleet-Level Operational Technology applications in Esbjerg.

You will help ensure that our server platforms provide a stable, secure, scalable and high-performing foundation for business-critical OT environments. Your work will cover areas such as system availability, backup and restore, disaster recovery, monitoring and infrastructure lifecycle management.

A key part of your role will be applying structured engineering, security and lifecycle-management principles to keep the platforms reliable, supportable and compliant with Vattenfall standards and operational requirements. You will work closely with internal colleagues, external stakeholders and suppliers, while supporting our BA Wind Operational Control Centre and Maritime Control Centre in Esbjerg in their daily operations.

Be in your element with BA Wind

Our wind, solar and batteries business offers a unique opportunity to be in your element, working to help harness the forces that will take us to fossil freedom.

As part of BA Wind, you will play a key role in one of the most exciting pipelines in the industry, with 24 GW of capacity stretching out more than a decade ahead across our key European markets.

You will not only be involved in developing projects but also in pioneering cutting-edge innovation, new business models and new ways of working with communities and the environment. Working as part of a leading European utility also means you could be helping a growing number of major businesses and brands achieve their own sustainability goals through partnerships.

Qualifications

Your role

As a SCADA Server Infrastructure Engineer, you will take ownership of server infrastructure throughout its lifecycle, from initial analysis and engineering through implementation, operation, improvement and eventual replacement or decommissioning.

You will combine hands-on technical work with structured planning, documentation and collaboration. Your focus will be on maintaining secure and reliable server environments and proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen performance, availability and operational resilience.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the daily operations of the BA Wind Operational Control Centre and Maritime Control Centre in Esbjerg.
  • Engineering, deploying, maintaining and continuously improving virtual and physical Fleet-Level OT server environments.
  • Performing infrastructure lifecycle assessments and developing maintenance, upgrade, replacement and decommissioning roadmaps.
  • Planning and executing server replacements, migrations, upgrades and decommissioning activities.
  • Designing, validating and maintaining backup, restore, high-availability and failover solutions.
  • Monitoring server performance, health, capacity and availability, and proactively identifying improvement needs.
  • Analysing server incidents, performing root-cause analysis and implementing corrective, preventive and proactive improvement actions.
  • Planning, tracking and documenting assigned tasks, technical changes, procedures, results and operational knowledge.
  • Contributing to purchasing activities, technical solution validation and collaboration with external suppliers.
  • Supporting internal and external audit activities.
  • Participating in the team's on-call rotation, providing specialist OT infrastructure support for business-critical services outside normal working hours.

Your profile

You hold a degree in IT Infrastructure, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline, or have built equivalent expertise through relevant professional experience. You have a strong technical foundation in server infrastructure and thrive when taking ownership of solutions from analysis and design through to implementation, operation, and continuous improvement. You are equally comfortable working independently and collaborating with colleagues, suppliers, and stakeholders across the organisation. To succeed in this role, you must have excellent written and spoken English skills. You should also be able to communicate professionally in Danish and be comfortable understanding Danish in both spoken and written form. As the Operational Control Centre supports multiple locations, a valid driver's licence and access to a car are required. The role may also be subject to security clearance, and candidates must be able to meet the applicable screening requirements.

You bring knowledge and experience in:

  • Windows and Linux system administration.
  • Virtualisation, virtual desktop, secure remote-access and Privileged Access Management (PAM) technologies, such as VMware, Omnissa Horizon, Citrix, BeyondTrust and Remote Desktop Services (RDS), together with multi-factor authentication (MFA) solutions.
  • Enterprise server hardware, such as Dell, HPE or IBM.
  • Device-management software for thin-client environments.
  • Backup, disaster recovery, patch management and restore validation, for example using Veeam.
  • Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, certificates and domain-services integration within Windows Server environments.
  • Maintaining, upgrading and managing server infrastructure across its lifecycle.
  • Preparing technical documentation and maintaining documentation of server architectures, configurations and procedures.
  • Supporting technical purchasing and solution-validation activities.
  • Security and logging solutions, such as Trend Micro, Splunk or Syslog.
  • Infrastructure monitoring tools, such as SolarWinds, OpenManage or OneView.
  • Basic OT network concepts.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation or scripting, for example PowerShell, is advantageous.

Personal traits

To succeed in this role, we believe that you:

  • Bring strong analytical skills and approach technical challenges through proactive and structured problem-solving.
  • Communicate clearly and can connect technical, operational and supplier-related perspectives.
  • Are comfortable taking end-to-end responsibility, from analysis and planning through implementation and delivery.
  • Work independently while contributing actively to collaboration with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Are organised, reliable and committed to high-quality documentation.
  • Take a proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  • Value secure, stable and supportable infrastructure in business-critical environments.

Location: Kolding, Denmark.

Additional Information

Our offer

Looking for a career with growth?

Looking for a role where your superpowers can be leveraged to the maximum and with limitless opportunities for growth?

The scale and ambition of our wind, battery and solar business means you can really find your element with us. We’ll also provide you with all the learning and development you need to expand your horizons.

We strive to be the best place to work in the industry with highly competitive pay and conditions and an open, supportive culture. A commitment to a healthy work-life balance aims to ensure everyone plays to their strengths, whatever their background and experiences.

You will be part of a growing team of 1,700+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities where our positive approach to diversity is reflected in the fact that more than a quarter of staff are women.

More Information

We welcome your application in English no later than 04.10.2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website.

At Vattenfall we are convinced that diversity contributes to building a more profitable and attractive company and we strive to be a good role model regarding diversity. Vattenfall works actively for all employees to have the same opportunities and rights regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, transgender identity or expression, religion or other belief, disability or sexual orientation. Click here for further information.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Since Vattenfall is a part of the Swedish critical infrastructure, many of our services are security classed. If this position is security classified the final candidates might be subject to a security vetting process, according to Swedish legislation.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a leading European energy company driving the transition to a sustainable energy system. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. We employ around 21 000 people mostly in our core markets in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK.

title: Senior Hardware Engineer: High Speed Mixed Signal Designer
description:

Responsibilities

  • Design high level system architectures for instruments with particular focus on driving definition of analog and RF front end designs, including signal conditioning and amplification stages, DAC and ADC selection, power and clocking schemes, as well as control and monitoring circuitry.
  • Own the research, simulation, prototyping, evaluation, and design of high speed mixed-signal front ends used for driving high speed and high resolution analog signals used to interface with the lasers and actuators that control our quantum computers.
  • Collaborate with quantum engineers and other groups to understand system needs, discuss solutions and define hardware design requirements.
  • Board-level circuit design, schematic capture, and PCB layout (working with a PCB layout designer) in Altium Designer of custom control system hardware.
  • Actively participate in the bring-up, verification, and testing of control system hardware systems, collaborating closely with FPGA, firmware, and software engineers.

Experience & Education

  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 5+ years of relevant postgraduate professional experience in board-level analog and digital circuit design, preferably with Altium Designer.

Required Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and driven to work effectively in a fast-growing startup environment.
  • Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse team of experimental physicists, hardware, and software engineers.
  • Experience in a full design cycle, from concept and schematic capture through to layout, fabrication, and initial board bring-up.
  • Working knowledge of PCB design best practices and a keen attention to detail.
  • Mixed signal design experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency with electronic test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum and logic analyzers, signal generators) for the bring-up and debug of prototype electronics assemblies.
  • Experience working on boards with complicated ICs (FPGAs, processors, etc) requiring several power supplies, high speed busses, and high speed memory interfaces

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with RF design concepts and/or software defined radio
  • Experience designing for and characterizing high-speed data-converter systems for low phase noise, low spurious content, and high linearity.
  • Experience with multi-gigabit serial transceiver lane design, evaluation, equalization
  • Experience with IBIS-AMI modeling and correlation for multi-gigabit serial interfaces
  • Experience designing high speed memory interfaces
  • Experience with high speed digital and analog I/O and connector/cable selection and characterization
  • Capable in scripting languages (e.g., Python) for basic data acquisition, instrument control, and automating hardware test and characterization.
  • Experience working in a Linux environment
  • Familiarity with the MicroTCA, PXIe, or similar pluggable instrument standards

Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day!

The base salary range for this position is between $140,000 - $160,000 annually, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company.

title: Senior Blade Engineer – Wind Turbine Operations Technology
description:
Vattenfall is looking for a Senior Blade Engineer with broad rotor and blade knowledge for our Business Area Wind within the WTG Systems Engineering department. If you are interested in a job with potential, possibilities, and want to be a part of an organization with special focus on Renewables, you may be the person we are looking for. You will be collaborating with colleagues located across the various European locations.

The WTG Systems Engineering department is the technical WTG knowledge centre within Business Area Wind, setting the standards and guidelines as well as being embedded within our projects, both through the development and implementation phase and later taking over the support to the operations as backoffice. On the technical level the department covers all engineering aspects of the WTG.

The challenge

As a Senior Blade Engineer in WTG Engineering, Operations Technology, you will shape the reliability, safety, and lifecycle performance of the rotor systems across Vattenfall’s operational wind portfolio. You will combine deep technical expertise with fleet-wide strategic influence, turning operational experience, risk assessments, and technical investigations into practical engineering decisions.

You will be a trusted technical partner, strengthening collaboration, knowledge sharing, and an inclusive working environment. Working closely with engineering, asset management, operations, and external suppliers, you will translate specialist expertise into coordinated solutions across the organization.

The role combines fleet-level asset management with hands-on technical problem-solving. You will support rotor systems throughout their operational lifecycle by shaping maintenance strategies, defining inspection and repair requirements, improving performance, managing technical risk, and evaluating new technologies.

Continuous improvement is at the core of this position. You will identify opportunities to enhance maintenance strategies, improve asset performance, reduce operational risk, and deliver greater long-term value from our renewable assets.

What you'll do

This role offers a unique opportunity to move beyond individual projects or site-level support and take a fleet-wide perspective on blades and rotor systems. As one of Vattenfall’s technical authorities in this field, you will influence maintenance strategies, risk management, and technology adoption across a diverse operational wind portfolio.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Define technical requirements for blade inspections, repairs, monitoring systems, and maintenance activities

  • Assess technical risks and support data-driven decision-making across the fleet

  • Optimize maintenance strategies and asset management plans

  • Maintain blade-related OPEX assumptions, budgets, and cost models

  • Support supplier selection, contract development, and technical performance evaluations

  • Lead technical investigations and Root Cause Analyses (RCA) for blade and rotor-related failures and performance issues

  • Evaluate, test, and implement innovative technologies incl. inspection and repair solutions

  • Share lessons learned and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization

Success in this role means helping to reduce operational risk, improve technical availability, optimize maintenance costs, and ensure technical learnings are effectively transferred across Vattenfall's wind fleet.

The position includes occasional international travel to wind farms, supplier facilities, technical workshops, and investigations. Expected travel activity is typically less than 25 days per year.

Qualifications

What we're looking for

You are an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise in wind turbine blade and rotor systems, combined with a passion for improving asset performance throughout the operational lifecycle.

We believe you will bring:

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Engineering, Wind Energy, or a related discipline

  • Significant experience within the wind energy industry, preferably covering multiple stages of the blade lifecycle, including design, manufacturing, inspection, repair, and operations

  • Strong knowledge of blade degradation mechanisms, structural integrity, inspection methodologies, and repair techniques

  • Experience in leading technical investigations and Root Cause Analyses

  • The ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Experience in working effectively across multidisciplinary teams and influencing technical decisions

  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English

It will be an advantage if you also have:

  • Offshore wind experience

  • Experience developing or blade maintenance strategies

  • Experience with structural health monitoring systems

  • The ability to adapt effectively to changing operational environments, procedures, and digital tools

  • Familiarity with IEC standards relevant to blades and rotor systems

  • Experience working with OEMs, service providers, certification bodies, and other technical stakeholders

Additional Information

What We Offer

We offer a challenging and rewarding role in an international and collaborative environment where technical expertise is highly valued, where you will have the opportunity to:

  • Influence blade reliability and innovation across a large and diverse renewable energy portfolio

  • Take a key expert role within Offshore Engineering and contribute to strategic technical decisions

  • Work with some of the industry's most challenging blade and rotor-related topics

  • Collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across Europe

  • Develop your technical expertise and professional network in a growing renewable energy business

  • Enjoy attractive employment conditions and excellent opportunities for personal and professional development

At Vattenfall, knowledge sharing is fundamental to how we work. Our "Ask & Share" culture encourages collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.

Location:

Kolding

How to Apply

We welcome your application in English, including your CV, via the application button on the vacancy page. Please do not submit applications through other channels, as we cannot guarantee that they will be processed. The application deadline is 8th of October 2026.

For more information about the position you are welcome to contact Manager of WTG Engineering Operations Technology Morten Kildeberg, morten.kildeberg@vattenfall.com

At Vattenfall we are convinced that striving for diversity helps building a more profitable, efficient and attractive company. Therefore we seek a harmonious balance of employees in terms of age, religion, gender identity & expression, sexual identity, disability and ethnic background.

The security of Vattenfall and its employees is essential. For that reason, a pre-employment screening will be part of your recruitment process. The screening is based on the role you will fulfill within Vattenfall and will be performed by a third party, DISA Global Solutions AB.

Energy is our contribution to quality of life – day after day. With around 20,000 colleagues Vattenfall provides comprehensive electricity and heating offerings to several million customers in northern Europe. For the work ahead we need people who are fully dedicated to our customers and to a sustainable society – people like you.

We look forward to your application!

Company Description

Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. For more than 100 years we have electrified industries, supplied energy to people’s homes and modernized our way of living through innovation and cooperation. We are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful corporate mission.

Business Area Wind is responsible for Vattenfall’s Onshore and Offshore Wind as well as other non-hydro Renewable activities like solar PV and batteries. Today we develop, construct and operate wind generation in Sweden, Denmark, Germany, the Netherlands and the UK. In addition, we have a clear strategy to develop our solar PV and battery operations further.

title: Service and Installation Dispatch Coordinator
description:
Service and Installation Dispatch Coordinator
Doug Anderson Plumbing and Heating

SCHEDULE: Monday-Friday, 7:30 AM-4:30 PM, one-hour unpaid lunch
PAY: $27-$29 per hour, based on experience

Position Overview
Doug Anderson Plumbing and Heating is looking for an experienced Service and Installation Dispatch Coordinator to manage the daily office and dispatching flow for our Service and Installation departments.

This position will be a primary office contact for customers and field technicians. Responsibilities include answering and booking customer calls, gathering accurate job information, scheduling and dispatching technicians, creating and following up on customer leads, and completing recurring administrative work.

This is more than answering phones. We need someone who understands home-service operations, communicates clearly, stays organized, and makes sure customers, technicians, and important office tasks are properly followed through.


Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming Service and Installation customer calls.
  • Ask the right discovery questions to understand the customer's needs.
  • Turn appropriate customer inquiries into booked Service or Installation appointments.
  • Create clear booking summaries and useful technician notes.
  • Book appointments and maintain accurate customer and job information in Service Titan.
  • Create, track, and follow up on customer leads using the company's established procedures.
  • Schedule and dispatch Service and Installation technicians based on availability, location, job requirements, customer needs, and urgency.
  • Confirm technician assignments with management while learning each technician's abilities.
  • Manage the daily dispatch board, appointment changes, emergency calls, technician availability, and
  • Move or reschedule appointments when needed while keeping customers and technicians informed.
  • Communicate job details, schedule updates, and customer concerns to technicians and management.
  • Provide office support to Service and Installation technicians with invoicing, estimate preparation, job documentation, and related follow-up as needed.
  • Complete next-day appointment confirmation calls.
  • Follow up with customers and respond to customer reviews.
  • Complete equipment, product, and warranty registrations.
  • Help coordinate employee training, employee recognition, company events, and other recurring office responsibilities.
  • Handle routine customer concerns and bring complaints or larger issues to management
  • Follow up on unfinished tasks and make sure important details do not fall through the cracks.


What We Offer

  • Health and dental insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% company match.
  • Company-provided lunch on Fridays.
  • Consistent Monday-Friday daytime schedule.
  • Stable, full-time position with an established local company.
  • Hands-on support while learning our technicians, customers, and procedures.
  • Opportunity to take on additional responsibility as the company continues to grow.

Qualifications

  • Previous office experience with a plumbing, HVAC, electrical, or other home-service company.
  • Strong Service Titan experience.
  • Experience booking customer calls and scheduling and dispatching field technicians.
  • Ability to gather accurate information and turn it into useful job notes.
  • Strong telephone and customer-service skills.
  • Good judgment when prioritizing schedule changes, customer needs, emergency calls, and technician requests.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Comfortable communicating with customers, technicians, field managers, and office leadership.
  • Able to manage customer follow-up, scheduling, dispatching, and recurring administrative work without losing track of unfinished items.
  • Dependable, professional, and willing to take responsibility for the position.

About Doug Anderson Plumbing and Heating
Doug Anderson Plumbing and Heating is an established local company continuing to grow and expand its operations. We value dependable employees, clear communication, quality work, and taking care of our customers.

Our procedures continue to improve as the company grows. This position will have support from management and the existing office team while becoming familiar with our technicians, customers, and daily operations.

title: Lead Data Center Cooling Engineer
description:
Työpaikan kuvaus

Are you excited about Data Centers, and working with state-of-the‑art technology? Are you motivated by challenging the ordinary and creating more sustainable solutions? Do you thrive when you work in a multicultural team with international talents?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Data Center Facilities department as our new Senior Mechanical Engineer and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new Lead Mechanical Engineer, you will work to create Data Center solutions for our clients. You will be part of our Nordics group for Data Center Facilities in Finland, Sweden, Denmark and Norway. You will work as part of passionate teams filled with talents from all over the world, your core colleagues are in locations across all four Nordic countries, but you’ll also become part of our Global Data Center Spearhead and will benefit from +150 Data Center specialists in the U.K., U.S.A., India, Germany and Asia as your new colleagues.

We have a flexible and hybrid working model where we work from within Ramboll’s offices, from home and online. We travel as needed but also respect family and other personal responsibilities to support a strong work-life balance for everyone.

Our team is growing, and we are shaping it together as we grow to become stronger. We see our continuously improvement as team responsibility. We celebrate wins, milestones and our colleague’s special occasions, so when you join you can expect a very open, friendly and social atmosphere ready to welcome your own ideas and preferences.

Your key responsibilities will be:

  • Lead the design and delivery of data center cooling and HVAC infrastructure.
  • Develop innovative thermal management solutions for AI, HPC, hyperscale, and colocation facilities.
  • Ensure cooling systems achieve required resilience, efficiency, sustainability, and uptime targets.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentoring to engineering teams across multiple projects.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients on cooling strategy, liquid cooling adoption, and future-ready data center design.

About You

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, experience and capabilities that will set you up for success:

  • Experience with designing or constructing data center facilities.
  • Experience working as a consulting mechanical engineer.
  • A thorough understanding of digital design delivery through Revit/BIM 360.
  • Excellent communicator capable of explaining complex technical concepts to our clients and project team partners in plain language, verbally and in writing.

What We Can Offer You

  • Flexible working and the opportunity to work hybrid hours.
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company combined with the opportunity to shape our local approach to the data center industry.
  • Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles focussed on people and work-life balance.
  • Investment in your continued professional development.
  • A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are.
  • Inspiration focussed on data centres from colleagues, clients, and projects across the globe.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we help shape the societies of tomorrow.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us atjob.advert.accessibility@ramboll.comwith such requests.

Ready to join us?

We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply. We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team. If you have any questions please feel free to contact Head of Department, Aleksi Nyman, +358 40 7506937. And thank you for taking the time to apply. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Total Rewards Partner
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO​
As a Total Rewards Partner, you will partner with the business to deliver and govern Total Rewards practices that are consistent, compliant, competitive, and aligned with global frameworks. You will support leaders with insights, data, and expert guidance to drive fair and business‑relevant reward decisions. In this role, you will be responsible for the Sales Market, consisting of the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania and Hungary.

You will:

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH​

As a Total Rewards Partner, you will work closely with HR leaders, business stakeholders, Finance teams, and Global Total Rewards team, to ensure a consistent and strategic Total Rewards approach that supports business goals and an attractive employee experience.

WHO YOU ARE​

  • Strong communication and influencing skills, enabling you to explain complex topics in a clear and engaging way.

And people who are…

  • Collaborative team players who enjoy working cross‑functionally and building strong relationships.
  • Structured, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple timelines and priorities.
  • Curious, analytical, and committed to continuous improvement in processes and data quality.
  • Clear communicators with a solution‑oriented mindset and passion for fairness and transparency.

WHO WE ARE​

H&M group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

  • Educational Learning Studio platform, including LinkedIn Learning.
  • Structured year-round development process with goal setting, performance evaluation, and achievement review.
  • Career opportunities, with 70% of our recruitment processes filled through internal promotions.

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

This is a full-time role based on a local contract in Prague, Czech Republic. The Total Rewards Partner reports to the People Manager.

If you feel that this is an opportunity that will drive you, please apply with your CV in English no later than 11th Oktober 2026. Due to data privacy policies, we only accept applications via our career page.

Take the next step in your career with us. The journey starts here.

title: Postdoctoral Fellow (Lin Lab)
description:
Postdoc positions are available in MMRI Lin lab to investigate the role of cardiomyocyte innate immune responses in heart diseases.

Lin lab Introduction

Cardiomyocytes (CMs) are building blocks and functional units of the heart, and their dysfunction or loss is the root of heart failure. Similar with other specialized innate immune cells, CMs have their own innate immune molecular machinery. Ischemic or non-ischemic pathological stress activates CM innate immune signaling pathways, which stimulate pro-inflammatory cytokine release and reactive oxygen species (ROS) production. These innate immune responses are beneficial for defending CMs against pathogen invasion and for tissue repair, but can also cause myocardial damage.


Dr. Lin's lab’s long-term goal is to define novel molecular mechanisms that regulate CM innate immune responses, which will shed light on the pathogenesis of pathogen or non-pathogen related cardiomyopathy. To reach our goal, we perform tissue-specific gene gain- and loss-of-function studies to analyze the pathophysiological roles of Hippo-YAP pathway in the heart. We also use Adeno-associated-virus (AAV) and modified messenger RNA as gene delivery platforms to carry out translational studies, aiming to develop drug candidates for treating cardiovascular diseases.

title: Head Coach
description:
Classification: Non-Exempt Management Level: Entry Level Reports to: Regional Head Coach

Summary/Objective The Head Coach serves as the fitness leader and culture champion within their assigned studio, responsible for driving coaching excellence, member engagement, and business performance through effective leadership of the fitness team. This role oversees the full coach lifecycle, including recruitment, hiring, onboarding, scheduling, development, performance management, succession planning, and retention, while fostering a high-performance culture grounded in accountability, inclusivity, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Through consistent observation, feedback, coaching, and development, this role ensures coaches deliver exceptional member experiences, execute the Orangetheory Fitness workout as designed, and embody the brand standards that drive member satisfaction and long-term loyalty. Utilizing strong business acumen, analytical thinking, and data-driven decision-making, the Head Coach monitors key performance indicators, identifies opportunities for operational and team improvement, and implements strategies that enhance coach effectiveness, member retention, studio utilization, and revenue growth. This role is accountable for maintaining fitness excellence, executing company initiatives, and ensuring consistent delivery of the Orangetheory Fitness experience across all classes and member touchpoints. As the primary fitness subject matter expert within the studio, the Head Coach leads by example, develops future coaching talent, and creates an environment where both team members and members can thrive. This position reports directly to the Regional Head Coach or Regional Fitness & Retention Manager.

Essential Functions Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Team Member Experience

· Provide day-to-day leadership, guidance, and support to the coaching team to ensure consistent execution of fitness standards, member experience expectations, and company initiatives.
· Conduct regular class observations and coaching conversations to provide feedback, support development, and reinforce accountability.
· Assist with coach recruitment, onboarding, training, scheduling, and retention efforts.
· Foster a positive, inclusive, and high-performing team culture that promotes engagement, collaboration, recognition, and professional growth.
· Establish clear expectations and support coach performance through ongoing communication, coaching, and development.
· Partner with Studio Managers and regional leadership to support studio goals, member retention, and operational success.
· Champion a member-first mindset by modeling exceptional customer service and ensuring consistent delivery of the Orangetheory Fitness experience.
· Support the implementation of new programs, initiatives, and operational changes within the studio.
· Demonstrate Austin Fitness Group’s (AFG) leadership principles while maintaining compliance with Orangetheory Fitness standards, policies, and procedures.
· Understanding of and commitment to exceptional customer service and the core values at AFG.

Financial Performance

· Support studio performance goals by delivering exceptional member experiences that drive member engagement, retention, and class utilization.

· Collaborate with Studio Managers and regional leadership to support company initiatives, promotional campaigns, and operational priorities that contribute to studio performance.

Member Experience

· Partner with Studio Managers and studio teams to support member events, challenges, promotions, and engagement initiatives that strengthen member relationships and studio culture.

Studio Operations

· Support day-to-day studio operations by ensuring consistent execution of Orangetheory Fitness standards, company policies, and operational procedures.
· Maintain a safe, clean, and organized fitness environment by monitoring studio presentation, equipment condition, and workout space readiness.
· Assist in identifying and reporting facility, equipment, and operational issues to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to members and staff.
· Monitor fitness-related performance metrics and partner with Studio Managers to identify opportunities to improve coaching consistency, class effectiveness, and overall studio performance.
· Support operational compliance through adherence to company policies, safety standards, and Orangetheory Fitness requirements.
· Utilize reporting tools, meetings, and communication platforms to stay informed, communicate priorities, and support operational consistency.
· Support the implementation of new fitness initiatives, operational processes, technology updates, and company programs.
· Partner with Studio Managers and regional leadership to maintain operational excellence and deliver a consistent member experience.

Core Competencies

· Leadership & Coaching – Ability to motivate, develop, and hold team members accountable while fostering a positive and high-performing team environment.
· Communication – Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills with the ability to provide clear direction, feedback, and support.



· Member Focus – Demonstrates a commitment to delivering exceptional service and creating positive experiences that build member satisfaction and loyalty.
· Relationship Building – Builds and maintains effective working relationships with team members, members, and cross-functional partners.

· Results Orientation – Takes initiative, follows through on commitments, and focuses on achieving individual, team, and studio goals.
· Resilience & Composure – Maintains a positive attitude and professional demeanor while managing stress, conflict, and unexpected challenges.

Supervisory Responsibility This position directly supervises and develops Coaches.

Work Environment This role is primarily based in a fitness studio environment and involves frequent interaction with members, guests, and team members. Responsibilities are performed both at the front desk and throughout the studio floor, requiring extended periods of standing, walking, and engaging with others in a dynamic, high-energy setting. The environment may include moderate to loud noise levels due to music and group fitness classes. title: Associate Measurement Partner

We use this information to help the world’s leading brands make data-informed decisions in content planning, media planning, audience activation, content and ads measurement, and more.

The Associate Measurement Partner offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of media analytics through direct client impact: crafting compelling insights and recommendations that optimize future campaign strategies. Leveraging your 2-3 years of experience, you'll be instrumental in translating complex data into actionable stories for our largest global publishers and advertising platform partners. This position is ideal for someone eager to develop deep expertise in presenting measurement insights, understanding the publisher and platforms advertising ecosystem, and contributing to industry benchmarking and trend forecasting.

What You'll Do

  • You possess a strong aptitude for analyzing information and distilling complex data into concise, compelling, and actionable insights for non-technical audiences

  • You are a natural storyteller with strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable and confident in presenting findings to clients and internal stakeholders

  • You're curious and keen to understand the "why" behind the data, identifying patterns and insights across different publishers and studies to inform client strategy

  • You maintain a high level of accuracy and organization in your work, managing multiple client deliverables simultaneously

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, economics, or a related area of study

  • 2-3 years of experience in project management / research or measurement analyst role

title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI
description:
About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled and driven Software Engineer with a strong background in full-stack development, particularly in backend technologies and Agentic AI, to join our AI/ML team. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of engineering, data science, and real-world impact, partnering directly with clients and internal stakeholders to design and deploy ML-powered tools that solve meaningful problems.

This role combines hands-on model development with robust backend engineering and infrastructure work. You’ll help build scalable systems, support R&D initiatives, and ensure rapid iteration and deployment of machine learning solutions in dynamic, production-ready environments. You will work embedded with our top clients and the client teams to conduct use case discovery with senior stakeholders directly, developing solutions that address complex client needs.

What You’ll Do

  • As part of the Forward Deployed Engineering team, you’ll contribute during a phase of rapid growth as we focus on scaling models and improving platform performance. You’ll help build backend systems, support client-facing deployments, and enable smoother workflows for machine learning solutions.
  • Develop and Maintain AI/ML Systems: Build robust, scalable backend systems that support machine learning operations and data processing pipelines.
  • Cloud Operations and Management: Oversee and optimize cloud infrastructure to ensure efficient deployment and operation of ML models.
  • Problem Solving: Independently explore and address complex problem spaces to improve system capabilities and performance without extensive guidance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with ML engineers and data scientists to integrate advanced ML technologies, ensuring seamless operations across various platforms.
  • Client Engagement: Collaborate directly with Invisible’s clients, working embedded with client teams to support use case discovery, product development, and AI deployment.
  • Innovation and R&D: Actively participate in research and development of new tools that can enhance our AI capabilities and workflows.

What We Need

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on ML engineering and deploying machine learning models in production.
  • Extensive experience in full-stack development, particularly in backend environments that support AI/ML workloads.
  • Prior experience working directly with clients in use case discovery, product development, and leading client engagements.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python, with deep expertise in LLMs, AI Agents, and ML model development.
  • Experience designing and deploying scalable ML systems, such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines and production-grade AI applications.
  • Extensive experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and operational best practices for ML workloads.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and other container management tools.
  • Ability to write well-structured, organized code and automated unit/E2E tests.
  • Comfortable with polyglot persistence models (SQL vs. NoSQL).
  • ML Operations: Experience with MLOps frameworks and best practices; familiarity with DevOps principles as applied to machine learning models, including model versioning, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Problem Solving: Ability to operate independently in unstructured environments, demonstrating a proactive and investigative approach to tackling challenges.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in dynamic, cross-functional teams, including data scientists, researchers, and software engineers.

What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

The annual salary range for this position, depending on level, is: R$ 249.000 - R$ 409.000 BRL

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

*Bonuses and equity are included in all full-time offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like to Work at Invisible:

At Invisible, we’re not just redefining work—we’re reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won’t just execute tasks—you’ll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We’re not for everyone, and we’re okay with that. If you’re looking for predictable routines, this isn’t the place for you. But if you’re driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you’ll fit right in.

Country Hiring Guidelines:
Invisible is a hybrid organization with offices and team members located around the world. While some roles may offer remote flexibility, most positions involve in-office collaboration and are tied to specific locations. Any location-based requirements or hybrid expectations will be communicated by our Talent Acquisition team during the recruiting process.

AI Interviewing Guidelines:
Our hiring team thoughtfully uses AI to support an efficient, engaging, and inclusive interview process. Since AI can also be a helpful tool for candidates, we've outlined expectations for using it ethically throughout your interview journey. Click here to learn more about how we use AI and our guidelines for candidates.

Accessibility Statement:
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. If you require an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please submit your request using our accommodation request form. A member of our team will follow up to support your request. Equal Opportunity Statement:
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law.

Due to a high volume of candidates, Invisible may use automated decision-maker technologies to filter candidates based on response to our application questions and other provided information. title: Chief Engineer
description:
Overview

The general purpose of the Chief Engineer is managing the maintenance of all the mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems throughout the hotel and managing the Engineering department, establish and maintain preventative maintenance programs for all equipment, systems, guestrooms and public areas/ general maintenance; lead effective safety programs; coordinate and implement capital MEP improvement projects. Provide leadership, mentoring, training, career development and annual evaluations for all Associates within the Division. Further, it includes the distribution and follow-up of work orders to related individuals and departments. In order to meet the general purpose of this position an individual must be able to multi-task, be flexible and adaptable to differing situations. #Magnoliahotelstlouis #Magnolia

Coordinate carpentry projects and control all painting and decorating projects.

  • Back support belts, protective gloves, eye protection, breathing protection, hearing protection, lock-out/tag-out protection and any other equipment as necessary to provide a safe working environment.
  • All work duties conducted by Engineering personnel will be evaluated and regularly scheduled training and refresher training will be conducted as required by law. Associates will be trained as to the use and care of any and all required PPE equipment. The Hotel / Resort provides this required PPE and it is the responsibility of engineer to wear this equipment as it relates to daily work assignments. It is your responsibility to report defective, damaged or lost PPE to your Manager. Follow all Safety Policies and Procedures

Qualifications

  • Ability to motivate and lead staff to achieve a common goal.
  • Ability to maintain hotel standards, policies and procedures with team members, and promote positive work relationships with other departments and associates alike
  • Ability to compute mathematical calculations.
  • Ability to read and understand blueprints and schematics.
  • Ability to organize, direct, plan and control all engineering activities.

title: AR and Revenue Specialist
description:

FMX is looking for an Accounts Receivable & Revenue Specialist to join our Accounting team.
