title: IT Helpdesk Support Technician
description:
Job Title: IT Helpdesk Support Technician

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports to: IT Technical Operations Manager


Company Summary: Ascend Medical, founded in 2021, has a mission to elevate body, mind and soul. Our advanced primary care clinically integrates behavioral, metabolic and lifestyle aspects of health to keep you well physically, mentally and emotionally. Ascend started as a convenient, hybrid delivery model spanning digital and at home modalities, meeting patients where they are: at home, at work or anywhere else. We have since evolved and now partner with traditional primary care providers to augment their offering, allowing patients to experience Ascend through brick-and-mortar, digital and at-home channels.

Unlike your typical healthcare system, Ascend is designed to innovate. Innovation starts with a culture that is excited to reimagine healthcare and is not afraid to disrupt. We try to avoid any micro-management of employees but rather embrace a core set of values that empower our team-members to make smart decisions:

Our values:

  • Patients before Profits
  • Empathy before Expedience
  • Progress before Stagnation
  • Team before Individual
  • Safety before Everything

At Ascend Medical, you’ll be part of a team of caring and innovative professionals who are forging a new path in healthcare – one that is patient-centered, affordable, and highly convenient. Ascend boasts the highest patient satisfaction scores in the industry (net promoter score consistently above 95) and we excel in delighting patients.

Company benefits: We offer a competitive benefits package to our employees:

  • Medical
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • 401k w/ Match
  • Generous PTO, paid parental leave, company holidays

Position Summary: The IT Helpdesk Support Technician is the first point of contact for clinical and administrative staff across all Ascend Medical locations. The role resolves hardware, software, network, and access issues that interrupt patient care and business operations, escalating complex problems to senior engineering staff while keeping the requester informed. Because the environment spans multiple sites, the technician balances on-site support at a corporate headquarters location with remote support for staff elsewhere, and travels between sites for equipment deployments, moves, and issues that cannot be resolved remotely.

Success in this role is measured by responsiveness, resolution quality, and the technician’s ability to work calmly with clinical staff during time-sensitive situations. All work is performed in a HIPAA-regulated environment, so careful handling of protected health information and adherence to security policy are inseparable from the technical duties.


Key Responsibilities:

Service Desk Operations

  • Serve as the initial point of contact for incoming support requests by phone, email, chat, and the ticketing system, logging every request with accurate categorization and priority.
  • Triage and resolve Tier 1 and Tier 2 incidents covering desktops, laptops, thin clients, printers, scanners, mobile devices, peripherals, and clinical workstations.
  • Escalate incidents that exceed the scope of the role to network, systems, or application teams with complete documentation of steps already taken.
  • Maintain ticket hygiene: timely updates, clear resolution notes, and confirmation with the requester before closure.

End-User and Clinical Application Support

  • Support the organization’s productivity suite, electronic health record, practice management, and telehealth applications at the end-user level.
  • Troubleshoot login, permission, printing, scanning, and device-integration issues affecting clinical workflows, coordinating with application owners and vendors as needed.
  • Provide floor support during clinic hours at the assigned location and remote support to staff at other sites.

Account and Access Administration

  • Process onboarding, transfer, and termination requests, including account creation, group membership, distribution lists, and multifactor authentication enrollment.
  • Perform password resets and account unlocks in line with identity verification procedures.
  • Apply the principle of least privilege and route any access request outside standard role templates to the appropriate approver.

Asset and Deployment Support

  • Image, configure, deploy, and retire end-user hardware; track assets from receipt through disposal in the asset management system.
  • Support office moves, new clinic openings, and equipment refresh projects across locations.
  • Coordinate warranty repairs and vendor service calls, and maintain appropriate spares at each supported site.

Security, Compliance, and Documentation

  • Handle protected health information in accordance with HIPAA and Ascend Medical security policy, and report suspected security incidents or privacy concerns immediately.
  • Verify endpoint protection, patch status, and encryption on supported devices, remediating gaps within defined timeframes.
  • Contribute to the knowledge base by writing and updating clear troubleshooting articles and end-user guides.
  • Deliver brief training and orientation sessions for new staff on supported systems and security practices.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent, plus two years of hands-on end-user or helpdesk support experience; an associate’s degree in information technology or a related field may substitute for one year of experience.
  • Demonstrated troubleshooting ability across Windows desktop operating systems, current productivity and collaboration suites, mobile devices, and common peripherals.
  • Working knowledge of directory services, group membership, and multifactor authentication concepts.
  • Practical understanding of basic networking: IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, wireless connectivity, VPN, and cabling.
  • Experience working within a ticketing system and following defined service-level targets.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical steps to non-technical clinical and administrative staff.
  • Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel between company locations.
  • Ability to pass a background check and meet the health screening and immunization requirements applicable to staff working in clinical settings.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior support experience in a healthcare, clinical, or other regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with electronic health record platforms and the peripherals that integrate with them, such as label printers, signature pads, and document scanners.
  • Industry certification such as CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, or a Microsoft endpoint administrator credential.
  • Exposure to endpoint management and imaging tools, remote support tooling, and scripting for routine task automation.
  • Experience supporting multiple physical sites or a distributed workforce.
  • Experience supporting any of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Copilot, or athenaOne a plus.

Competencies

  • Service orientation. Treats every request as an interruption to patient care or business operations and responds accordingly.
  • Judgment under pressure. Distinguishes a routine issue from one that threatens clinical operations, and escalates without hesitation when the situation warrants it.
  • Discretion. Works daily with confidential patient and employee information and protects it without being reminded.
  • Follow-through. Owns an issue from intake to confirmed resolution, including the follow-up no one asked for.
  • Adaptability. Moves between remote and on-site work, shifting priorities, and varied clinical environments.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment: Work is performed in offices and clinical settings across multiple locations. The role requires sitting or standing for extended periods, frequent use of a computer, and the ability to lift and move equipment weighing up to 50 pounds with or without reasonable accommodation. The technician may work under workstations, on ladders, or in equipment rooms, and may be exposed to a clinical environment where standard infection-control precautions apply. After-hours, weekend, and on-call work is required on a rotating basis. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.


Equal Employment Opportunity: Ascend Medical is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

title: Designer - Runway
description:
As a Designer within the Runway team, you'll play a key role in shaping and evolving the most directional expression of the COS collection. Combining a strong creative point of view with technical expertise, you'll create exceptional product that feels distinctly COS while continually moving our design language forward.

Working closely with cross-functional partners, you lead the design process from concept through to final product, ensuring every piece reflects the highest standards of design, quality and craftsmanship. You inspire and develop junior team members, champion innovation and contribute to building a cohesive collection that balances creativity, desirability and commercial relevance.

What you will do:

  • Lead the creative development of your category each season, translating research and emerging ideas into a distinctive Runway collection.
  • Bring a strong design point of view that evolves the COS aesthetic through silhouette, proportion, colour, fabrication and detail.
  • Develop extensive research, concepts and sketches that establish a clear and compelling design direction.
  • Work hands-on through draping, mock-ups and experimentation to explore new silhouettes, construction techniques and product ideas.
  • Partner closely with Design, Buying, Pattern Cutting and Product Development to bring concepts to life while maintaining the integrity of the original design vision.
  • Work with Buying to develop product with a strong understanding of the COS customer, collection architecture and commercial opportunity.
  • Lead fittings, using strong technical knowledge to refine silhouette, proportion, construction and finish through to final product.
  • Guide, inspire and develop Assistant and Junior Designers, creating an environment where ideas are shared, challenged and developed with confidence.
  • Continually explore new techniques, materials and ways of working that can progress the Runway collection and wider COS design direction.

What you need to succeed:

  • Proven experience as a Womenswear Designer within a luxury or premium fashion brand, with experience developing elevated ready-to-wear collections.
  • Experience designing fluid and soft product across a refined multi-product wardrobe, ideally spanning woven, jersey and knitwear.
  • Strong knowledge of silhouette, proportion, fabrication, construction, and finishing, with an eye for detail and perceived value.
  • A sharp eye for colour, detail, and proportion, with the ability to translate concepts into refined, modern designs.
  • Ability to balance directional fashion and brand elevation with customer relevance, commerciality, and a considered collection architecture.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across multiple cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise, delegate and manage multiple projects within seasonal timelines.

Please kindly note that in order for us to consider your application, you will need to include a portfolio or examples of your work most suited to the COS design aesthetic. This should demonstrate strong research and concept development, silhouette and proportion, draping or three-dimensional development, fabric and material exploration and examples of finished product.

This is a full time permanent role based at our Head Office in London, 5 days per week.

Benefits

We offer all our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a 25% staff discount usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to this UK based colleagues also receive:

  • Up to 25 days holiday
  • Annual health checks
  • Pension scheme
  • Discounts on various activities and financial/lifestyle products via our benefits hub
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Discounted gym membership
  • Employee assistance via retail trust
  • Private health & dental care

Inclusion & Diversity

At COS we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

Company Description

COS offers a wardrobe of ready-to-wear and accessories rooted in exceptional quality and lasting design. The creative soul of the brand is fuelled by a deep connection to modern culture, dynamic global cities and compelling fashion movements. With an emphasis on expert craftsmanship, innovation and materiality, collections are created with a mindful approach, seamlessly blending contemporary and timeless. Learn more about COS here.

Ready to register interest? Click on the I’M INTERESTED link where you can upload your CV and portolio securely. Once we have received your application, we will keep you updated regularly about the status of your application so please look out for our email.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Full Stack developer - Categorie protette - Bologna
description:
Oncode Srl è un’azienda di consulenza specializzata nella progettazione e sviluppo di soluzioni software dedicati ad aziende nel settore industriale e dei servizi IT.

Descrizione della posizione

La ricerca è aperta a candidature appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi della Legge 68/99.

Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Full Stack Developer per la nostra sede di Bologna con esperienza nella progettazione e programmazione software, che possa seguire in modo indipendente la realizzazione di progetti di sviluppo in tutte le fasi del suo ciclo di vita, dalla raccolta dei requisiti alla messa in produzione.

Il ruolo prevede la gestione dei task assegnati e l'interfacciamento diretto con clienti.

Nel dettaglio la persona inserita si occuperà di:

  • Progettare e gestire piattaforme software complesse in più contesti di sviluppo, in particolare piattaforme software dove interagiscono più (micro) servizi tra cui applicazioni web, servizi client/server e servizi di stateful stream processing (Kafka) o di indexing (stack ELK)
  • Entrare a far parte del nostro team di specialisti del settore, affrontando tematiche di Data Science, Big Data Analytics, Cloud Computing, Deep Learning & Machine Learning
  • Sviluppare progetti occupandosi di tutte le fasi del loro ciclo di vita, dalla raccolta requisiti alla messa in produzione

Cosa vi offriamo

  • RAL da 30.000 a 45.000 in base alla seniority
  • Contratto a tempo indeterminato
  • Buoni pasto da 8 euro / giorno
  • Welfare aziendale
  • Orario di lavoro flessibile e smart working
  • Possibilità di crescita professionale in un ambiente dinamico e meritocratico
  • Assicurazione medica integrativa
  • Premio annuale in linea con i risultati aziendali
  • Budget per l'acquisto di libri relativi al mondo software/automazione
  • Formazione specifica
  • Partecipazione a conferenze in Italia ed Europa
  • Eventi di team building

Requisiti richiesti

  • Laurea triennale/specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica e/o discipline attinenti (Automazione, Telecomunicazioni, Elettronica)
  • Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo software e di lavoro in team
  • Esperienza di almeno 5 anni di programmazione general-purpose (preferibilmente Python, Java oppure C#)
  • Buona conoscenza Database SQL e NoSQL
  • Conoscenza delle basi di Ingegneria del Software, metodologie di sviluppo e OOP
  • Conoscenza di strutture dati e algoritmi
  • Spiccate capacità di problem solving e reverse engineering
  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese
  • Capacità relazionali e gestionali

Due parole su di noi

I nostri team con forti competenze software e automazione si occupano di progetti complessi in diversi ambiti. Per il settore IT: Healthcare, Banking, Energy, Ticketing, Automotive. Per il settore Automation: building, packaging, aeronautics, logistics.

Ci occupiamo di progettazione e sviluppo software per le aziende che puntano alla digitalizzazione e interconnessione dei processi. Al centro di ogni progetto mettiamo le competenze, costantemente aggiornate dei professionisti.

Grazie al nostro approccio “Skills as a Product”‑ che si fonda su un asset fondamentale ovvero che le capacità uniche e distintive dei singoli membri del team sono il punto fondamentale per costruire un vantaggio competitivo - supportiamo i clienti nell’intraprendere attivamente un percorso di crescita.

Vision

Avere un impatto significativo nel mondo ed essere parte attiva nel generare progetti che emozionino le persone, una riga di codice alla volta.

Mission

Crediamo che ognuno debba esprimere a pieno il proprio potenziale. Per questo, creiamo un ambiente di lavoro ideale in cui coltivare con passione le nostre competenze per lo sviluppo di software, al fine di supportare e affiancare i nostri clienti rendendoli più competitivi, efficienti e autonomi. Stabiliamo con i clienti un rapporto a lungo termine per agevolarli nello sviluppo di nuove opportunità di business future.

Valori

  • Crescita
  • Responsabilità
  • Trasparenza
  • Coraggio
  • Eccellenza
  • Attenzione al cliente
  • Collaborazione e condivisione

Note

L'offerta è da intendersi nel rispetto delle norme sulle parità di trattamento in materia di occupazione e di condizioni di lavoro (L.903/77, L.125/91, D.Lgs. 216/03 e D.Lgs. 198/2006).

title: IT Support Engineer Level 1 Healthcare
company: The Oncology Institute of Hope and Innovation
description:
Starling Oncology (NASDAQ: STLN) is advancing oncology by delivering highly specialized, value-based cancer care in the community setting. Formerly known as The Oncology Institute, Starling Oncology offers cutting-edge, evidence-based cancer care to a population of approximately 2.1 million patients, including clinical trials, transfusions, and other care delivery models traditionally associated with the most advanced care delivery organizations. With more than 400 employed and network clinicians and over 100 clinics and network locations of care across five states and growing, Starling Oncology is changing oncology for the better. For more information, visit .

Join an oncology practice where your technical expertise directly supports compassionate, life-changing patient care. As an IT Coordinator, you will play a vital role in keeping critical systems secure, reliable, and efficient so clinicians and staff can focus on delivering exceptional cancer care. In return, we offer meaningful work with real impact, close collaboration with healthcare professionals, opportunities to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment, and the chance to help advance innovation in a mission-driven organization.

JOB PURPOSE AND SUMMARY:

The IT Support Engineer I provides secure, reliable support for endpoints, identity, connectivity, Microsoft 365, and business and clinical applications. The role resolves incidents, protects PHI, documents work, and supports service improvement, automation, cloud operations, and security within approved controls.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide Level 1 and developing Level 2 technical and customer support through approved ticketing, phone, chat, remote, and onsite channels.
  • Research, diagnose, resolve, document, and escalate hardware, software, account, application, and connectivity issues.
  • Set up, secure, maintain, and retire Windows workstations, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and conferencing equipment.
  • Support Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, groups, licensing, and authorized account lifecycle tasks.
  • Provide first-line support for assigned business and clinical applications while following privacy, downtime, and patient-safety procedures.
  • Document and track incidents, requests, assets, troubleshooting history, customer communication, and resolution details.
  • Create and maintain knowledge articles, user guides, SOPs, and runbooks.
  • Perform approved entry-level Azure, monitoring, backup, security, remediation, reporting, scripting, automation, and data-quality tasks.
  • Protect PHI, PII, credentials, and confidential information; recognize and escalate security or privacy events.
  • Assist with projects, implementations, migrations, clinic openings, go-lives, planned maintenance, vendor coordination, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities.
  • Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve service, controls, standardization, and automation.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, identity, Microsoft 365, connectivity, applications, and user workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune concepts, MFA, role-based access, networking, and secure remote support.
  • Ability to use logs and diagnostic tools, document findings, and distinguish symptoms from probable root causes.
  • Foundational knowledge of Azure, cloud operations, monitoring, backup, scripting, automation, APIs, JSON, and cybersecurity principles.
  • Understanding of HIPAA-aligned PHI handling, least privilege, secure sharing, auditability, and healthcare downtime procedures.
  • Clear communication, sound prioritization, accountability, teamwork, and willingness to learn.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in IT, cybersecurity, cloud computing, health informatics, or a related field preferred.
  • Two or more years of IT service desk, desktop support, or technical support experience; relevant internships, military experience, labs, or applied projects may be considered.
  • Experience with ticketing systems, Windows, Microsoft 365, user accounts, endpoints, peripherals, connectivity, and defined escalation and change procedures.
  • Ability to support scheduled onsite, implementation, maintenance, go-live, or after-hours activities as needed.

Relevant certifications or applied experience in service management, Microsoft 365, networking, endpoint management, identity, cloud, security, automation, or healthcare IT are preferred.

PHYSICAL WORKING REQUIREMENTS:

The position involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, extensive computer use, and phone or virtual interaction. The role may require travel between supported locations and occasional lifting, moving, or installation of office technology equipment weighing up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

The estimate displayed represents the typical wage range of candidates hired. Factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role.

Pay Transparency for hourly teammates
$25—$27 USD

title: Business Analyst II

Join our team of dedicated professionals who provide services and operational support to award winning hospitals through roles in supply chain, IT and cybersecurity, clinical engineering, capital procurement, medical coding, project management and more. We provide services to clinically excellent community hospitals across the country that are dedicated to ensuring quality, compassionate care for every patient, every time.

title: Outpatient Psychiatrist (Adult or Child & Adolescent)
description:
At LifeStance Health, we believe in a truly healthy society where mental and physical healthcare are unified to make lives better. Our mission is to help people lead healthier, more fulfilling lives by improving access to trusted, affordable, and personalized mental healthcare. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in behavioral health.
Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing behavioral health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our clinical team!

We are seeking a part-time (15+ hours/week) or full-time (30+ hours/week) Adult Psychiatrist or Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist to join our growing outpatient group in Walnut Creek, California, with additional locations across the surrounding area for convenient commuting.

This is an opportunity to practice psychiatry your way—with flexibility, autonomy, and strong clinical support in a modern, patient-centered environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide outpatient psychiatric care to adult or child/adolescent populations

title: Sr. Product Manager, DAM
description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

This role drives the product strategy, roadmap, and delivery for Digital Asset Management (DAM). The Sr. Product Manager owns the lifecycle of atomic assets and metadata management, while leading integrations with key content management, marketing, and activation platforms. Acting as the owner of atomic assets, this role ensures content is seamlessly managed and discoverable across the content supply chain.

The Sr. Product Manager is responsible for assessing market needs and inspiring cross-functional product teams to find the fastest way to achieve value around those needs. The role focuses on delivering business value to drive sales, improve efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction through the production of quality products. Within their designated enterprise product line, Sr. Product Managers work closely with teams of developers, designers, and business partners. They support in-depth business reviews, communicate and present across all levels of the organization and support cross-functional product teams. Importantly, the Sr. Product Manager, must be able to work at the strategic level (generating innovative ideas for growth, change management) and at the tactical level (analyzing data, solving problems, being a force multiplier and leader of their teams). The Sr. Product Manager is often responsible for products that are higher-profile and/or that are larger in scope.

Key Responsibilities:

  • 50% Strategy & Planning:
  • Seeks to empathize with and understand the end user deeply and use that knowledge to determine the fastest path to deliver value
  • Translates business goals and end user needs into product strategy; communicates direction and product priorities to the development team, other matrixed teams, and third-party partners
  • Identifies goals, metrics and analytics to determine product value; continually makes recommendations and refinements to the product backlog based on learnings
  • Manages and grooms the product backlog; makes future decisions based on the value that will be delivered
  • Partners with Finance to understand financial needs and assist in the creation of business plans for new opportunities
  • Monitors research as well as the competitive landscape to recommend the best solutions and ensure that products remain or become best in class
  • Ensures that product directions balance both the user needs and business goals of driving sales, improving efficiency and enhancing customer satisfaction
  • 20% Delivery & Execution:
  • Formulates, tests and refines assumptions and hypotheses through user research and testing
  • Documents, reviews and ensures that all quality and change control standards are met
  • Creates, prioritizes and accepts user stories; incorporate them into release planning
  • Makes product decisions that drive value on a daily basis
  • Identifies and considers pros, cons, issues, obstacles, dependencies and value associated with features and enhancements
  • Participates in standups, iteration planning sessions, product demo, and retrospectives
  • Condenses complex technical concepts into non-technical language for stakeholders
  • 30% People:
  • Fosters collaboration with team members (Engineering, UX, etc.) to drive value and identify and resolve impediments
  • Acts as a proponent of modern software development practices
  • Advocates for the end user and stakeholder by becoming associated with the product, empathizing with and understanding user needs
  • Works with the product team to continuously assess progress, disseminate lessons learned, and understand next steps
  • Manages cross functional team and stakeholder expectations to execute on product strategy and provides education to requestors to determine prioritization based on tangible benefits and/or user experience
  • Guides more junior team members in strategy, alignment, analysis and execution tasks
  • Participates in and contributes to learning activities around modern software design and development core practices (communities of practice)
  • Participates in talent acquisition, development and retention activities in support of team

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

  • Typically reports to the Product Management Manager or Sr. Manager.

Travel Requirements:

  • Typically requires overnight travel less than 10% of the time.

Physical Requirements:

  • Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

  • Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen years of age or older.
  • Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 3–6 years of relevant work experience in Product Management.
  • Hands-on experience managing and scaling Digital Asset Management (DAM) platforms.
  • Deep knowledge of content supply chain processes, including content creation, asset intake, metadata governance, distribution, and activation across channels.
  • Experience with Product Information Management (PIM) systems, asset intake workflows, and Content Management Systems (CMS) with bidirectional asset syncing.
  • Demonstrated experience with data modeling for asset cleanliness/governance and leveraging AI-powered metadata enrichment and automated tagging.
  • Experience building intuitive search experiences and taxonomy structures for enterprise DAM environments.
  • Experience working as a Product Manager in a modern software development–based enterprise environment.
  • Proficiency in working in a fast-paced, fluid environment where priorities shift on a regular basis.
  • Proficiency in communicating with and influencing functional and technical team members at all levels in the organization.
  • Proficiency in working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional, modern software design and development team.
  • Proficiency in creating, prioritizing, and accepting user stories.
  • Proficiency in conducting user research and testing to understand needs.
  • Proficiency in identifying goals, metrics, and analytics to measure product value.
  • Proficiency in conducting competitive research and analysis.
  • Experience guiding more junior team members through Product Management fundamentals in a professional setting.

Minimum Education:

  • The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.

Preferred Education:

  • No additional education

Minimum Years of Work Experience:

  • 3

Preferred Years of Work Experience:

  • No additional years of experience

Minimum Leadership Experience:

  • None

Preferred Leadership Experience:

  • None

Certifications:

  • None

Competencies:

  • Balances Stakeholders: Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders
  • Business Insight: Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals
  • Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
  • Communicates Effectively: Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences
  • Cultivates Innovation: Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful
  • Customer Focus: Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
  • Drives Vision and Purpose: Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action
  • Interpersonal Savvy: Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people
  • Manages Complexity: Making sense of complex, high quantity and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems
  • Nimble Learning: Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder
  • Organizational Savvy: Maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process and people-related organizational dynamics
  • Situational Adaptability: Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations
  • Empathy: Understands the needs of multiple stakeholders and is responsive in meeting their needs with the most optimal resolution

title: Assistant Project Manager
description:
Job Title: Assistant Project Manager

Reports to: Project Manager

Grade Level: [ ] FLSA: Exempt


POSITION SUMMARY

The Assistant Project Manager supports the Project Manager throughout the full project lifecycle, from job kickoff and mobilization through construction, commissioning, and closeout. This role coordinates equipment and material procurement, maintains project controls and documentation, tracks budgets, production, purchase orders, pay applications, submittals, and guaranteed milestones, and works closely with internal teams, Owners, engineers, vendors, and subcontractors to support safe, compliant, and successful project delivery.


KEY JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:


Project Planning & Execution

  • Support job kickoff activities, including scope review, responsibility assignments, schedule alignment, document setup, and communication of project requirements. Coordinate project mobilization by ordering and tracking equipment, materials, temporary facilities, and other resources required for field startup.
  • Support all phases of solar EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) projects to maintain alignment with project scope, schedule, budget, and guaranteed milestones.
  • Maintain project schedules, production trackers, action-item logs, and other job-tracking tools; identify variances and follow up on required corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with internal design, procurement, logistics, and field teams to support timely project execution and material availability.
  • Track submittal packages from preparation and submission through review, approval, revision, and release for construction.
  • Maintain complete and current job books, logs, and supporting records, ensuring required documentation complies with contractual and guaranteed milestone requirements.

Financial & Contract Management

  • Support the Project Manager in maintaining project budgets, commitments, cost forecasts, cost-to-complete projections, and change-order tracking.
  • Prepare, issue, and track vendor purchase orders, including approvals, delivery status, invoice alignment, and resolution of discrepancies.
  • Maintain procurement logs and coordinate with vendors to confirm equipment and material quantities, required-on-site dates, shipping, and delivery.
  • Assist with preparation, supporting documentation, submission, and tracking of owner pay applications.
  • Track subcontractor pay applications against contracts, approved changes, schedule of values, completed work, stored materials, lien-waiver requirements, and project progress.
  • Reconcile project budgets, purchase orders, invoices, production data, and pay applications and promptly communicate variances to the Project Manager.
  • Help prepare recurring reports on project financials, production, schedule, progress, procurement status, and risks for leadership and Owners.

Team Coordination & Communication

  • Support and coordinate with field construction managers, superintendents, project engineers, procurement personnel, and accounting staff.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of coordination for subcontractors and vendors, communicating schedule, documentation, procurement, quality, and closeout requirements.
  • Help facilitate project kickoff, coordination, progress, and closeout meetings with internal teams, clients, vendors, and subcontractors; document and track action items.
  • Follow up with subcontractors on submittals, pay applications, change documentation, schedules, deliveries, punch-list items, and turnover deliverables.
  • Maintain timely, professional communication across all project stakeholders and escalate issues that may affect safety, quality, cost, schedule, or guaranteed milestones.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Promote the company safety culture and assist in enforcing all jobsite safety standards.
  • Support and properly document pre-task planning and required project compliance procedures.
  • Support implementation and documentation of the project QA/QC plan, including inspections, testing records, deficiency tracking, and corrective-action closeout.
  • Coordinate commissioning readiness, schedules, test documentation, issue logs, and required participation by internal teams, vendors, and subcontractors.
  • Help ensure project activities and records comply with drawings, specifications, contracts, permits, and applicable local, state, and federal requirements.

Project Closeout

  • Support project closeout planning and maintain a closeout tracker covering punch lists, testing and commissioning, as-built drawings, manuals, warranties, training records, and turnover packages.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors to obtain, review, correct, and submit required closeout and commissioning documentation on schedule.
  • Verify that project records and job books are complete, organized, and compliant before turnover, including documentation required to substantiate guaranteed milestone achievement.
  • Track completion and closure of outstanding punch-list, QA/QC, commissioning, contractual, and financial items.
  • Participate in lessons-learned reviews and support archiving of final project records to drive continuous improvement.

title: Senior konsulent – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
description:

title: Staff UX Designer
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes for patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

Our UX Designers thrive on solving hard problems. We deliver products and experiences by combining personal care with modern technology to give people the healthcare they deserve. We work closely to define emerging patterns, interactions, and visual systems from the ground up to solve problems that haven’t been solved yet. It’s an opportunity to not only design better healthcare software, but to design a whole new way to work.

We are seeking a talented and experienced Staff UX Designer to join our team and lead impactful design initiatives across our product suite. As a key member of the design leadership team, you will shape the quality of the user experience, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to ensure our products are intuitive, user-centered, and aligned with business goals. You will be responsible for solving complex design challenges, elevating design quality by mentoring other designers, and driving a user-first mindset throughout the organization.

If you are a design leader who thrives in a fast-paced, outcome-driven environment and has a passion for creating products that make a meaningful impact, we would love to meet you!

As a Staff UX Designer, you will:

  • Provide leadership in introducing consumer-level experiences into the enterprise healthcare space, setting a new standard for design quality with a refined sense of taste.
  • Lead the exploration and solutioning of undefined problem areas, driving innovation to tackle complex user and business challenges.
  • Own and lead large-scale design projects, utilizing rapid prototyping and fast learning cycles to deliver impactful, scalable solutions.
  • Bring differentiated expertise to elevate the overall design quality and introduce breakthrough experiences, pushing the team toward new levels of excellence.
  • Establish yourself as a design leader by demonstrating mastery, strategic thinking, and confidence in making intelligent design decisions.
  • Champion design excellence and innovation throughout the organization, influencing cross-functional teams and setting the standard for high-impact solutions.

Success in this role looks like:

  • In the first 90 days, you have partnered with senior engineering to deliver multiple prototype iterations, which are now actively in the hands of end users. You have dramatically elevated the user experience and are setting a new benchmark for design excellence. Your deep collaboration with leadership and data science teams has been essential in weaving ML features into the design and breaking new ground.
  • By six months, you have seamlessly integrated next-gen design patterns into the workflows of other designers and PMs. You’ve also incorporated these patterns and improvements into the Design System as a member of the Design System Team, while retiring or updating outdated patterns. You are now balancing the fine-tuning of next-gen experiences with launching new, high-impact projects, demonstrating your strategic vision and agility across the organization.
  • Long term, you continue to lead groundbreaking exploration projects with substantial potential. You are working collaboratively with senior leadership and data science teams to drive strategic design advancements. As a key player in the Design System, you are elevating design quality, consistently pushing the envelope and setting new standards for excellence.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 7+ years of in-house design experience, including working autonomously with senior technical teams and integrating complex features like ML to deliver consumer-level, best-in-class experiences.
  • You have a portfolio that demonstrates industry mastery (healthcare experience is a plus but not required), showcasing advanced expertise in interaction and visual design, with a track record of creating outstanding, next-level user experiences.
  • You possess strategic thinking skills and have experience leading early-stage exploration projects with high-value potential, showcasing your ability to drive impactful design innovations.
  • You have a proven track record of managing and reconciling conflicting stakeholder feedback, resulting in cohesive and innovative design solutions.
  • You are adept at working with design systems, with experience in contributing to and maintaining high-quality, scalable design standards.
  • You are a natural leader who thrives on sharing your knowledge with others, helping to elevate the design capabilities of your team.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

#LI-REMOTE

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are an E-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc.

$188,500—$245,000 USD

description:

title: FINANCE - FRACTIONAL CONTROLLER
description:
America’s Kids In Motion | Clovis, California

Approximately 10–15 Hours per Week
Compensation: $70–$85 per hour, depending on experience

Help Us Turn Good Financial Information Into Better Business Decisions

America’s Kids In Motion is looking for an experienced Fractional Controller to provide financial oversight, reporting, forecasting, controls, and analysis for our established, multi-program organization.

AKIM is a growing Clovis-based company, serving thousands of children and families through Aquatics, Gymnastics, Dance, NinjaZone, Music, Preschool, CampKids, GymUTots, and other youth programs.

We already have established accounting, bookkeeping, and payroll support.

We are not looking for another bookkeeper.

We are looking for an experienced financial professional who can make sure our numbers are accurate, help us understand what those numbers are telling us, and give ownership and our Leadership Team accurate financial visibility as we plan for the future.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Financial Accuracy & Monthly Close

You'll oversee our monthly close process and ensure our financial statements are timely, accurate, organized, and reliable.

When something doesn't look right, we want someone who notices it, investigates it, and gets it corrected.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

You'll help us understand more than what we spent and what we earned.

We want meaningful insight into:

  • Revenue and expense trends
  • Labor and payroll performance
  • Budget variances
  • Program and business-area performance
  • Margins and profitability
  • Financial KPIs
  • Areas of financial concern and opportunity

We want financial information that helps leadership understand what happened, why it happened, and what we should pay attention to next.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow

You'll lead our annual budgeting process, maintain useful forecasts, provide cash-flow visibility, and help us look forward rather than only backward.

You'll also help evaluate the financial impact of significant staffing decisions, investments, new programs, and growth opportunities.

Financial Controls & Processes

You'll evaluate and strengthen our accounting processes and internal controls.

We want financial systems that protect the company, reduce errors, create accountability, and support growth—without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

Financial Leadership

You'll work directly with the Owner/Visionary, Integrator, Leadership Team, and our existing financial support team.

You'll help our leaders understand their numbers and provide an objective financial perspective when important decisions are being made.

We value someone who is willing to say:

“Here's what the numbers are telling us.”

Even when the answer isn't necessarily what we hoped to hear.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

This could be an excellent fit for an experienced Controller who wants meaningful, senior-level financial work without a traditional full-time schedule.

You may be:

  • An experienced Controller looking for a fractional role.
  • A former Controller or Finance Director who no longer wants a full-time executive schedule.
  • A financial professional who works with several fractional clients.
  • A semi-retired Controller who still enjoys helping businesses make smart financial decisions.

You should have strong experience with:

  • Monthly close and financial statement review
  • Accounting and financial controls
  • Budgeting and forecasting
  • Cash-flow management
  • Financial reporting and analysis
  • Payroll and labor-cost analysis
  • Identifying financial risks and irregularities
  • Working with bookkeepers, payroll professionals, and outside CPAs
  • Communicating financial information to non-financial leaders

Experience with a multi-location, multi-department, service, education, recreation, or similarly complex organization would be especially valuable.

A CPA or accounting degree is valuable, but we place significant importance on Controller-level experience, sound financial judgment, and the ability to turn numbers into useful information.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a full-time accounting position.

It is not primarily a bookkeeping position.

Our existing team handles established transactional bookkeeping and payroll responsibilities.

We need someone who can operate above the transactions—reviewing, analyzing, forecasting, questioning, improving, and helping leadership see the bigger financial picture.

ABOUT AMERICA'S KIDS IN MOTION

America’s Kids In Motion is an established Clovis organization serving children and families through a diverse group of youth programs.

Our mission is Creating Proud, Impactful Moments for Families, and our Core Values are:

Enthusiastic Doers
Professionally Responsible
Passionately Dedicated

We've built an organization with established programs, experienced leaders, and a strong foundation. As we continue to evolve, we want our financial systems and financial visibility to be just as strong.

If you are an experienced Controller who enjoys making financial information accurate, understandable, and useful—and you're looking for a flexible fractional role—we'd love to meet you.

Location: Clovis, California
Schedule: Approximately 10–15 hours per week
Compensation: $70–$85 per hour, depending on experience

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About Invisible

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Invisible Technologies makes AI work. Our end-to-end AI platform structures messy data, automates digital workflows, deploys agentic solutions, measures outcomes, and integrates human expertise where it matters most.

Our platform cleans, labels, and structures company data so it is ready for AI. It adapts models to each business and adds human expertise when needed, the same approach we have used to improve models for more than 80% of the world’s top AI companies, including Microsoft, AWS, and Cohere.

Our successes span industries, from supply chain automation for Swiss Gear to AI-enabled naval simulations with SAIC, and validating NBA draft picks for the Charlotte Hornets.

Profitable for more than half a decade, Invisible reached $134M in revenue and ranked as the number two fastest growing AI company on the 2024 Inc. 5000. In September 2025, we raised $100M in growth capital to accelerate our mission of making AI actually work in the enterprise and to advance our platform technology.

About The Role

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you'll own a domain of the Invisible platform — such as identity, compute, delivery, or agent infrastructure — and set the direction for how it works. You'll define the patterns that engineering teams across the company adopt, and be accountable for their reliability, security, and cost.

This is a role where judgement matters more than throughput. Deciding which problems are worth solving, recognising when the unremarkable solution is the correct one, and knowing when to decline a bespoke request from a client engagement are the day-to-day of the job.

We are looking for engineers with a first-principles understanding of platform practice, not just fluency in it. Code review, staged rollouts, change management, and least privilege were all designed around human engineers working at human speed. Those assumptions no longer hold cleanly. A meaningful part of this role is determining what still applies, what needs reworking, and what has to be built from scratch.

What You’ll Do
  • Own a platform domain end to end, including architecture, roadmap, reliability, security posture, and cost
  • Lead design and trade-off discussions across performance, scalability, cost, security, and reliability, and document the decisions
  • Build multi-tenant infrastructure that client engagements can self‑serve onto without the Platform team becoming a delivery bottleneck
  • Advance our agent‑native engineering model - safe execution environments, credential and secret handling, internal tooling and MCP servers, and evaluation of where agents genuinely improve outcomes
  • Set standards for how the engineering organisation works with coding agents, including review practice, context engineering, and what should and shouldn't be automated
  • Partner with client-facing engineering teams to understand their infrastructure requirements and translate them into reusable platform capability
  • Mentor engineers on the team, review their designs, and raise the technical bar without absorbing their work
  • Own on-call and post-incident review practice
What We Need
  • Kubernetes & Cloud: Proven experience designing and operating production Kubernetes at multi-team scale, on GCP, Azure, or AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code: Deep experience with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps delivery, including a clear view of how these degrade when implemented poorly
  • Platform Security: Strong grounding in identity and SSO, workload identity, secrets management, and network policy. You can reason about a threat model directly rather than through a compliance checklist
  • Programming: Strong Python. You build tooling, not only configuration
  • AI Coding Agents: Exceptional practical command of agentic coding tools, and a track record of making other engineers more effective with them. You've built the harnesses, guardrails, and internal tooling, and you have a considered view of where agents deliver value and where they quietly cost more than they save
  • Engineering Judgement: A first-principles grasp of why platform practices exist. You can identify which survive contact with agentic engineering, which need reworking, and which were only ever ceremony
  • Communication: Excellent written communication. You can take an ambiguous problem and produce a document that makes the decision clear to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike
  • A track record of shipping infrastructure that other engineers depend on, and the willingness to challenge an approach when the room has already agreed on it
  • We weight demonstrated capability over years of experience or formal qualifications
What’s In It For You

Invisible is committed to fair and competitive pay, ensuring that compensation reflects both market conditions and the value each team member brings. Our salary structure accounts for regional differences in cost of living while maintaining internal equity.

  • Offers will also include bonus + equity

You can find more information about our geographic pay tiers here. During the interview process, your Invisible Talent Acquisition Partner will confirm which tier applies to your location. For candidates outside the U.S., compensation is adjusted to reflect local market conditions and cost of living.

Bonuses and equity are included in all offers. Final compensation is determined by a combination of factors, including location, job-related experience, skills, knowledge, internal pay equity, and overall market conditions. Because of this, every offer is unique. Additional details on total compensation and benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

What It's Like To Work At Invisible

At Invisible, we're not just redefining work—we're reinventing it. We operate at the intersection of advanced AI and human ingenuity, pushing the boundaries of what's possible to unlock productivity and scale. Ownership is at the core of everything we do. Here, you won't just execute tasks—you'll build, innovate, and shape the future alongside world-class clients pushing the boundaries of AI.

We expect bold ideas, relentless drive, and the ability to turn ambiguity into opportunity. The pace is fast, the challenges are big, and the growth is unmatched. We're not for everyone, and we're okay with that. If you're looking for predictable routines, this isn't the place for you. But if you're driven to create, thrive in dynamic environments, and want a front-row seat to the AI revolution, you'll fit right in.

title: Flight Dynamics Engineer (m/w/d) [26170]
description:
We are looking for a Flight Dynamics Engineer to join our team supporting satellite operations primarily at ESA’s European Space Operations Centre (ESOC) in Darmstadt, Germany.

The team supports a wide range of missions, including ESA Earth Observation missions, the Copernicus Sentinel satellites and interplanetary scientific missions.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Perform routine flight dynamics operations, including processing and monitoring telemetry, tracking and GNSS data.
  • Perform orbit and attitude determination and prediction, including spacecraft state and AOCS parameter estimation.
  • Support orbit manoeuvre optimisation, calibration and analysis, as well as the generation of spacecraft telecommand files.
  • Perform spacecraft sensor calibration and validate flight dynamics calculations and results.
  • Maintain, configure and further develop flight dynamics systems, software, tools and operational procedures.
  • Support routine satellite operations, including participation in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • Prepare and support special operations and mission-end campaigns, including technical studies, analyses and simulations.
  • Support the preparation and launch of new missions through flight dynamics system setup, software validation, procedure development and simulations.
  • Contribute to the maintenance, development, testing and validation of flight dynamics software.
  • Collaborate closely with flight control teams and other technical teams within an international, multidisciplinary environment.

Mandatory skills and experience:

  • University degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mathematics, Physics or another relevant engineering or scientific discipline.
  • Strong knowledge of classical mechanics, with knowledge of orbital mechanics and spacecraft attitude dynamics/control.
  • Strong knowledge of linear algebra, differential and integral calculus, and numerical methods.
  • Ability to analyse and solve complex technical problems using analytical and numerical methods.
  • Ability to define, implement, validate and operate software for engineering and flight dynamics applications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work autonomously and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Excellent communication skills and a proactive approach.
  • Ability to prioritise tasks, meet deadlines and work effectively under pressure..
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Valid authorisation to work in Germany.
  • Willingness to undergo the required security clearance.

Additional skills considered an asset:

  • Professional experience in flight dynamics, satellite operations or Space Situational Awareness.
  • Knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming languages.
  • Practical experience with orbit determination, attitude determination or spacecraft manoeuvre operations.
  • Experience supporting operational satellite missions or mission preparation activities.

This position is based in Darmstadt, Germany.

If you believe you meet the requirements for this position, please send your CV in English and in Word or PDF format to Andrés Izquierdo by clicking the Apply for this job button and quoting the relevant job reference.

An exciting and dynamic international working environment awaits you!

title: Data 360 - Lead Forward Deployed Engineer, Italian Speaking
description:
About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we’re looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce’s core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you've come to the right place.

About the Role

Production implementation experience required. Builder mindset non-negotiable. Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers focused on Data 360, Salesforce’s real‑time data engine that unifies data from any source. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will be a hands‑on Technical Builder who configures, builds, tests, and deploys Data 360 directly inside enterprise customer environments. You will turn approved solution designs and acceptance criteria into working implementations across ingestion, harmonization, identity, insights, activation, retrieval, security, and operational readiness. Data 360 is also the data foundation for Agentforce - and grounding agents in accurate, real‑time enterprise data is deep data engineering. You'll go further into RAG, vector search, MCP, and agent‑to‑agent integration than most data roles ever touch, because the agents are only as good as the layer you build. You'll work within a delivery team that includes architects, deployment strategists, Agentforce FDEs, account teams, and customer technical teams. Engagements may span a focused proof, production rollout, and stabilization. The common thread is real customer data, disciplined testing, and a supportable handoff. This is a hands‑on data and software engineering role. You will build in real enterprise customer environments - writing SQL, Python, and Apex; building ingestion pipelines; debugging identity resolution; and shipping working implementations from sandbox through production. If you're looking for a purely declarative configuration role or a pure advisory role, this isn't it.

What You’ll Do

  • Build in customer environments. Configure and develop directly in customer sandboxes and production - using Data 360 configuration, SQL, Apex, Flow, Python, the REST Query API, the Interaction SDK, Salesforce DX, CLI, Git, Data Kits, and deployment tooling as required - following security, change-management, and release controls.
  • Engineer the data layer. Build ingestion, harmonization, and identity resolution across batch and streaming sources. Materialize views of data optimized for specific application, analytical, and agentic workloads, tuning latency and cost tradeoffs to meet use‑case requirements.
  • Work with customer data and AI teams to ensure implementations align with their existing strategies (e.g., data mesh, data fabric).
  • Prove it works. Create representative test data and validate expected outcomes across happy paths, edge cases, access boundaries, hierarchy behavior, failure conditions, and customer‑scale volumes.
  • Ground the agents. Design, build, and maintain the AI data integration layer — RAG (Retrieval‑Augmented Generation), vector databases, search indexes, and knowledge bases — that grounds Agentforce solutions in accurate, real‑time enterprise data.
  • Orchestrate agent communication. Design and implement the protocols — including Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent‑to‑agent communication — that govern, monitor, and ensure efficient collaboration among specialized AI agents.
  • Connect the ecosystem. Implement robust, scalable, and secure data integration patterns that connect Agentforce to a wide range of enterprise applications and enable communication between AI agents.
  • Govern the data. Apply deep data management expertise to ensure the secure integration, transformation, and governance of structured and unstructured data across the Salesforce ecosystem (CRM, Data Cloud) and external systems.
  • Build for scale and security. Apply knowledge of message queues, event‑driven architecture, and distributed systems to build resilient workflows and implement secure authentication and authorization protocols (OAuth, SAML) so that all agent actions are secure and comply with enterprise security policies.
  • Debug the hard problems. Troubleshoot ingestion failures, mapping defects, schema drift, identity anomalies, query behavior, activation latency, API errors, permissions, and consumption issues - methodically, with logs and query evidence, isolating product behavior from configuration error.
  • Own implementation decisions. Compare viable techniques within the approved architecture, document measured tradeoffs and recommend the most maintainable implementation to the responsible architect or technical lead.
  • Accelerate with AI. Use AI tooling — including Data 360 APIs and MCP Servers — to automate the build process and compress customers' time to value.
  • Co‑build and hand off. Work alongside customer technical teams and partners through pairing, code reviews, and configuration reviews. Package reusable metadata, scripts, queries, tests, and runbooks so the solution can be reproduced and supported. Support deployment, validation, production handoff, and early stabilization, leaving clear ownership and known limitations.
  • Feed the roadmap. Surface reproducible platform gaps and edge cases — with live evidence, impact, and expected behavior — directly to Product and Support. You’re our Data 360 Forward Deployed Engineer.

You’re Our Data360 Forward Deployed Engineer

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or technical implementation, including a production data solution you can explain in detail.
  • You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • You have hands‑on experience implementing Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud) or a comparable enterprise data platform across ingestion, modeling, identity, insight, activation, and operations.
  • You have hands‑on experience building data pipelines and integrations using at least one enterprise data platform or technology, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Kafka, cloud object storage, or an enterprise MDM platform.
  • You are proficient in SQL and can build, debug, and optimize multi‑table queries, joins, filters, transformations, and validation checks.
  • You are fluent in at least one implementation language used in enterprise delivery — Apex, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript — and are willing to learn the others as needed.
  • You understand data modeling, APIs, integration patterns, batch and streaming processing, and the practical differences between copied, federated, and Zero Copy data access.
  • You’ve built retrieval systems for AI applications — vector databases, search indexes, embedding pipelines, or knowledge bases — and can explain the design decisions behind chunking, indexing, and relevance.
  • You’ve implemented secure service‑to‑service integration patterns (OAuth, SAML, event‑driven architectures) and are conversant in emerging agent protocols like MCP and agent‑to‑agent communication.
  • You can implement secure data access and rigorously test it, including permissions, entitlements, consent, user context, restricted populations, and negative test cases.
  • You diagnose technical problems methodically, use logs and query evidence, isolate product behavior from configuration errors, and document a reproducible result.
  • You can implement against a documented architecture, explain what you built to customer technical teams, and recognize when a question requires an architect or security owner.
  • You have delivered alongside customers, partners, professional services, or internal implementation teams in deadline‑driven environments.
  • You are excited to work directly with customer administrators, developers, data engineers, and architects.
  • You have relevant certifications in Salesforce Agentforce, Data 360, and the Salesforce Platform.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love.

Accommodations

Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non‑discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education. At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions. With a focus on service, to our clients as well as our communities, our culture is defined by supporting each other. In this team-driven environment, Amwins creates the perfect place for you to grow your career with built-in support and opportunity to advance your knowledge base.

At Amwins, our people are our greatest asset. We hire the best talent in the industry and provide our employees with the tools to deliver innovative insurance solutions. We believe that by taking care of our employees, they will take care of our clients and the cycle will perpetuate.

Learn more about us at .

Join our Amwins Brokerage team in Scottsdale as an Associate Broker!

None of our positions are commission-based or involve cold calling.

Each Associate Broker provides vital team functions:

We are looking for people with:
