title: HR Admin Specialist
description:
WAT JE GAAT DOEN
Als HR Admin Specialist zorg je dat contracten, personeelsgegevens en andere HR-administratie voor onze collega’s in Nederland nauwkeurig worden verwerkt. Je ondersteunt de HR-afdeling en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor Store Management en Afdelingshoofden. Met jouw werk draag je bij aan heldere processen en een goede ervaring voor onze collega’s.

Jij:

  • beheert het contractproces voor nieuwe en bestaande medewerkers binnen management, inclusief contractwijzigingen.
  • houdt personeelsgegevens bij en verwerkt vertrouwelijke documenten zorgvuldig.
  • ondersteunt bij instroom, uitstroom en vragen van collega’s, in samenwerking met onder meer Store Management, People Relations en Payroll.
  • legt HR-cases vast en handelt Insite-taken, inkomende post en UWV-correspondentie af.
  • verwerkt facturen voor de HR-afdeling.
  • helpt HR-processen te verbeteren, met aandacht voor nauwkeurigheid, efficiëntie en naleving van wet- en regelgeving.

MET WIE JE GAAT SAMENWERKEN
Je wordt onderdeel van het Payroll-team en werkt nauw samen met Store- en Area Teams en andere lokale collega’s. Je rapporteert aan de Payroll Team Leader.

WIE JIJ BENT
We zoeken talenten met...

  • ervaring in HR-administratie en goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels.
  • sterke communicatieve en digitale vaardigheden.
  • een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde manier van werken.

En talenten die...

  • zelfstandig werken en zorgvuldig omgaan met vertrouwelijke informatie.
  • makkelijk samenwerken met verschillende teams en informatie helder overbrengen.
  • proactief meedenken over verbeteringen en goed omgaan met deadlines en verandering.

Ervaring met HR-systemen en HR-processen is een pré.

WAAROM JE HIER GRAAG WILT WERKEN
Je krijgt de kans om ervaring op te doen binnen HR en samen te werken met verschillende teams in onze organisatie. Het gaat om een tijdelijk contract van 6 maanden, voor een fulltime functie van minimaal 4 dagen per week.

De gewenste startdatum is zo snel mogelijk. Je werkt vanuit Amsterdam en bent ongeveer 60% van je werktijd op kantoor aanwezig.

We zijn trots op ons levendige en open karakter. Onze teams profiteren van aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden en diverse ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden wereldwijd.

  • Personeelskorting op al onze producten en merken
  • 25 vakantiedagen
  • HIP – H&M Incentive Program (bonusprogramma)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) voor een gezonde werk-privébalans
  • Corporate Benefits (exclusieve kortingen bij veel merken)
  • Bedrijfspensioenregeling
  • Reiskostenvergoeding

WIE WIJ ZIJN
De H&M Group is een wereldwijd bedrijf met sterke modemerken en innovatieve businesslijnen. Wij geloven dat excellent design, betaalbare prijzen en duurzame oplossingen hand in hand kunnen gaan. Onze klanten staan centraal in alles wat we doen. Onze bedrijfscultuur wordt gevormd door duizenden gepassioneerde en getalenteerde teamleden. Samen gebruiken we onze schaal en kennis om de mode-industrie te leiden richting een inclusievere en duurzamere toekomst.

KOM ERBIJ
Onze kracht en uniciteit zitten in veel dingen – in onze inclusieve cultuur, onze sterke waarden en onze ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Maar bovenal zijn het onze teams die ons maken tot wat we zijn.

*Assessment voor functies in winkels: Voor sommige functies in onze winkels maken we gebruik van een online assessment als onderdeel van een competentiegericht selectieproces. Je vult dit assessment in als onderdeel van je sollicitatie. Je antwoorden worden getoetst aan vooraf vastgestelde criteria van de H&M Group.
** Meer informatie over de verwerking van uw persoonlijke gegevens vindt u in onze mededeling over gegevensbescherming.
*** We streven naar een eerlijk en gelijk proces en vragen je geen sollicitatiebrief mee te sturen, omdat deze vaak informatie bevat die gemakkelijk kan leiden tot onbedoelde vooroordelen.

title: Lagermedarbejder til JYSK Distributionscenter i Uldum - Daghold
description:
Vil du arbejde i en af Nordens største og fuldautomatiske distributionscentre? Vi tilbyder en dynamisk arbejdsplads hvor personlig udvikling, engagement og teamspirit er i fokus. Vi distribuerer produkter til mere end 400 butikker og online kunder i både Danmark, Norge, England, Irland, Holland og Belgien, samt franchise. Distributionscentret er i alt 91.000 m2 med plads til 214.819 paller. Vil du være en del af vores mere end 600 kollegaer?

Så er du måske den næste lagermedarbejder, som vi er på udkig efter til dagholdet!

HVAD TILBYDER VI DIG

  • En skandinavisk kultur, som skal opleves! Her har du mulighed for at blive hørt og komme med dine holdninger til dit arbejdsmiljø

  • Et struktureret introprogram, som hjælper dig godt i gang på din nye arbejdsplads

  • Omgivelser hvor ”Safety First” er en naturlig og vigtig del af dagligdagen. Vi har arbejdsmiljøet i fokus, fx i forhold til hjælpemidler, ryddelige arbejdsforhold, etc.

  • En mulighed for kantineordning med sund og varierende kost, når du holder pause til en fordelagtig pris

  • En tilrettelagt arbejdsdag med god struktur og procedurer, hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at udvikle og skabe værdi i organisationen

  • Faste arbejdstider, så du kan skabe en god work-life balance

  • En konkurrencedygtig løn jf. 3F-overenskomst. på gode vilkår samt bonuspakke.

  • Adgang til fitnessrum på arbejdspladsen

  • 20% rabat på alle dine køb i JYSK butikker

  • Sundhedsforsikring

HVAD GÅR DIT NÆSTE JOB UD PÅ

Som lagermedarbejder spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre et professionel og effektiv flow af varer på lageret, som i sidste ende sørger for en høj leveringsevne til vores kunder ved at:

  • Tømme lastbiler, og efterfølgende placere varerne korrekt på lageret

  • Tjekke indgående varer

  • Plukke ordre ved hjælp af en scanner

  • Klargøring af paller til forsendelse

  • Loading af lastbiler

  • Leve op til vores JYSK Values; Købmand, Kollega og korpsånd

HVAD FORVENTER VI AF DIG

Har du allerede erfaring med logistik? Perfekt! Hvis ikke, så lærer vi dig helt sikkert det som du har brug for.

Det vigtigste er at du:

  • Er en hjælpsom kollega, som bidrager til et godt teamwork

  • Går den ekstra mil for, at nå i mål når vi har travlt

  • Er dedikeret til at gøre dit absolut bedste på arbejde

  • Er god til at følge procedure og processer, som giver effektivitet og sikre god kundeservice

  • Har truckcertifikat eller er villig til at tage et kursus

  • Er engageret og fleksibel til at arbejde med forskellige opgaver

  • Arbejdstider på dagholdet er 06:00-14:15 (mandag-torsdag) og 06:00-13:45 (fredag)

  • At kunne begå sig på engelsk er en fordel, men ikke et krav

LYDER DETTE SOM DIT NÆSTE JOB? Ansøg i dag!

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, så send en mail til DCU HR og vi vil med glæde hjælpe.

Rekrutteringsproces:

Vi behandler ansøgningerne løbende og afslutter forløbet, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi holder altid ansættelsessamtaler og på udvalgte positioner kan du forvente at få vurderinger og/eller en videosamtale om din motivation for jobbet.

OM JYSK

Vi tror på, at vores ansatte er nøglen til den succes at gå fra en butik i 1979 til mere end 3600 butikker fordelt i hele verden. Vi har distributionscentre placeret ud over Europa for at dække vores markeder – både butikker og online – så effektivt som muligt. Vi bestræber os på at tilbyde udvikling og karrieremuligheder i JYSK, og vi sætter en ære i at belønne engagement og en stor indsats blandt vores medarbejdere. Vores tre grundlæggende JYSK værdier – Købmand, kollega og korpsånd – udtrykker den holdning, som vi kan forvente af hinanden. Vi stoler på hinanden, og tror på uddelegering og frihed under ansvar.

JYSK ønsker at inkluderer alle, uanset alder, kønsidentitet, race, seksuel orientering, fysisk eller mental formåen, etnicitet og erfaring. Sammen sikrer vi vores inkluderende kultur, der opmuntrer, støtter og hylder vores medarbejders forskellige stemmer. Fordi en fantastisk blanding af sind, talenter og unikke personligheder gør os til et stærkere team.

For mere information besøg: Career page

title: Litigation Associate - Los Angeles, California (4 years of experience)
description:
About the job

Role Description

We are seeking a Litigation Associate with 4 years of litigation experience to join our California Litigation Practice Group. This role is ideal for a litigator with a strong background in medical malpractice defense and experience handling complex litigation matters in both state and federal court.

This is a hybrid position with the flexibility to work from any of our Southern California offices, including Los Angeles, San Diego, or Irvine.

What You’ll Do

  • Manage all phases of complex medical malpractice and healthcare litigation matters in both state and federal court, including pleadings, motion practice, discovery, depositions, and trial preparation.
  • Defend healthcare providers, hospitals, physicians, and long-term care facilities in medical malpractice, elder abuse, and catastrophic injury matters.
  • Take and defend fact and expert witness depositions and manage written discovery.
  • Draft and argue substantive motions, including Motions for Summary Judgment and Summary Adjudication.
  • Participate in client meetings, hearings, mediations, and litigation-related proceedings throughout California.
  • Collaborate closely with partners, clients, experts, and insurance carriers on high-exposure healthcare litigation matters.

What We’re Looking For

  • 4 years of litigation experience with a background in medical malpractice, long-term care, elder abuse, and/or catastrophic injury defense
  • Active California bar admission required; federal court admissions in the Central and Southern Districts of California preferred
  • Experience taking and defending depositions, experience taking expert depositions preferred
  • Experience with trial preparation and/or second-chair trial responsibilities, preferred
  • Exceptional writing, analytical, and verbal communications skills

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Opportunity to build a specialized practice in medical malpractice, long-term care facility, and elder abuse defense
  • Early ownership of cases and substantive litigation responsibilities with meaningful client exposure
  • Collaborative culture with strong mentorship and accessible leadership
  • Consistent exposure to complex, high-stakes healthcare litigation matters
  • Clear path for long-term professional growth and advancement

Featured Benefits

  • Medical insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • 401(k) and Company Match
  • Paid parental leave

Interview Process Timeline

Application

Our team will review your application. Please submit your resume and cover letter.

First Interview

Our Director of Recruiting will reach out to you to schedule a preliminary 30–45-minute interview with the hiring manager(s).

Second Interview

Here you’ll meet some of the team who will evaluate your skillset and assess if you are a good culture fit for the firm. You will have the opportunity to tour our office and meet with the entire team in person.

Offer

Congratulations! If the hiring team thinks you’re a good match, we will extend an offer to join the firm.

About Life At Tressler

Tressler LLP is an award-winning law firm with ten offices located in six states - California, Illinois, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, and Pennsylvania. Trusted for 40 years, our firm has significant depth and experience in the resolution of disputes through mediation, arbitration, litigation, and trials.

The majority of Tressler attorneys devote their practice to the representation of the insurance industry in coverage analysis and resolution, litigation, underwriting consultation, product development, claims management, and reinsurance. In addition, Tressler attorneys represent clients in commercial litigation, defense litigation, corporate transactions, government law, employment law and litigation, intellectual property, and condominium and common interest community association law. Tressler has been named to the prestigious Best Lawyers “Best Law Firms” lists for the past six years. We are proud to be a Certified Great Place to Work© in the U.S.A., a ranking based on our employee happiness scores and positive reviews of our management team.

title: Civil Superintendent – Data Center Construction
description:
We are working confidentially with a General Contractor delivering a major data center project in the Mobile, Alabama area and are looking to appoint an experienced Civil Superintendent to join the site team.

This is a full-time, site-based position.

Recent data center construction experience is essential.

The Role

The Civil Superintendent will take ownership of day-to-day field operations across the civil and sitework scope, working closely with Project Managers, subcontractors, engineers and the wider site team.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Managing civil and sitework activities across the project

  • Overseeing earthwork, excavation, grading and site preparation

  • Coordinating underground utilities, stormwater and drainage

  • Managing roads, paving, concrete and external works

  • Supervising civil subcontractors and trade partners

  • Driving daily site coordination, sequencing and short-term planning

  • Reviewing drawings, specifications and field requirements

  • Monitoring progress against the construction schedule

  • Identifying field issues and driving practical solutions

  • Coordinating civil works with structural, MEP and building teams

  • Maintaining quality and safety standards across the site

  • Supporting inspections, testing, punch list and closeout

  • Leading subcontractor meetings and field coordination

  • Reporting progress, risks and issues to project leadership

What We’re Looking For

  • Recent data center or mission critical construction experience is essential

  • Strong General Contractor or Construction Manager background

  • Experience as a Civil Superintendent, Site Superintendent or General Superintendent

  • Strong background in earthwork, excavation, grading and site development

  • Experience with underground utilities, stormwater and drainage

  • Experience managing civil subcontractors and field crews

  • Strong knowledge of construction sequencing and site logistics

  • Experience on large-scale ground-up construction projects

  • Strong safety, quality and field coordination experience

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills

  • Ability to work full-time on site in the Mobile, Alabama area

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a major civil package on a large-scale ground-up data center development.

Candidates must have recent data center construction experience and a strong civil field background.

title: Adjudication Supervisor
description:
The Supervisor, Adjudication supports the accurate and timely adjudication and billing of prescriptions by overseeing daily workflow, monitoring productivity, and serving as a technical resource to the adjudication team. The role helps ensure prescription rejections, payer changes, billing issues, and related work are completed accurately and on time. The Supervisor partners with the Adjudication Manager to support workflow execution, training, process consistency, and department performance.

Job Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily adjudication workflow and help ensure prescription rejections and billing issues are addressed accurately and timely.
  • Monitor workflow, productivity, and department priorities and partner with the Adjudication Manager to address gaps or changing business needs.
  • Help ensure billing cut-offs and operational deadlines are met to support timely prescription processing and deliveries.
  • Support implementation of new procedures, policies, and workflow changes and monitor consistent execution.
  • Coordinate staffing coverage and recommend schedule adjustments based on workflow, business needs, and approved time off.
  • Support payroll and timekeeping activities as assigned.
  • Identify performance, attendance, workflow, or conduct concerns and escalate them to the Adjudication Manager for appropriate follow-up.
  • Train and support technicians and help maintain current training materials, procedures, and job resources.
  • Serve as a technical and workflow resource to team members and assist with resolution of more complex adjudication or billing issues.
  • Support effective coordination between adjudication and other pharmacy or operational teams.
  • Identify workflow and process improvement opportunities and recommend solutions to department leadership.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and support consistent billing practices.
  • Perform other activities assigned by leadership.

title: Verkoopmedewerker
description:
Hi, wij zijn Ace & Tate – en ja, we maken brillen. Maar belangrijker nog, we zorgen ervoor dat werken hier de moeite waard is.

Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een Verkoopmedewerker in Amsterdam Beethovenstraat, 16-32 uur. Onze winkel opent in november en je kunt er vanaf dag één bij zijn.

Wat onze Verkoopmedewerkers doen

  • Breng de juiste vibe door klanten zich direct welkom en enthousiast te laten voelen in de winkel.
  • Geef duidelijk stijladvies door klanten te helpen monturen te vinden die bij hen passen en handige stijltips te delen.
  • Deel je kennis door de verschillen uit te leggen tussen glazen, coatings en pasvormen zodat klanten de juiste keuze kunnen maken.
  • Let op elk detail door glazen te slijpen, monturen af te stellen en elke bril in perfecte staat af te leveren.
  • Maak elke verkoop persoonlijk door klanten te helpen de juiste glasupgrades, coatings en extra’s te kiezen zodat ze precies vinden wat bij hen past.
  • Vloeiend Nederlands (basis Engels is een plus) is essentieel voor effectieve klantcommunicatie en een goede samenwerking binnen het team.

Wat we bieden:

  • €17,81 per uur inclusief 8% vakantiegeld en 10% compensatie voor vakantiedagen. Plus een maandelijkse bonus tot 16% wanneer de store targets worden behaald.
  • Vrije tijd die telt 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (fulltime), met de mogelijkheid om op te lopen tot 30 dagen op basis van dienstjaren.
  • Reizen zonder zorgen met reiskostenvergoeding bij een afstand van meer dan 10 km van de werkplek.
  • We geven om jou via samenwerking met ClassPass, de optie om een online consult in te plannen met een psycholoog via OpenUp en gezonde snacks.
  • Zie er stijlvol uit tot twee gratis brillen per jaar, plus korting voor vrienden en familie.
  • Benefits at Work toegang tot dit platform voor kortingen op producten en diensten
  • Een cultuur om van te houden met regelmatig en memorabele teamevenementen.
  • Tijd om te groeien toegang tot ons online leerplatform.
  • Voor nu én later deelname aan ons pensioenplan.

title: Senior Backend Engineer II - Data
description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer II - Data to design, build, and maintain the data foundation that powers our clinical products and workflows.

This is a software engineering role at its core. You will play a key role in building and evolving our Medical Data Server, working alongside the existing Medical Data Platform team across its Python services, APIs, database architecture, and production operations. You will also apply industry best practices to design the data models, integrations, and pipelines that make complex clinical information reliable and accessible across Prenuvo products.

You will work with complex healthcare data, including FHIR and HL7, to build reliable data models, integrations, and pipelines. Your work will make clinical information accessible and trustworthy across clinical applications, reporting, analytics, and AI-enabled workflows.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Build and Evolve the Medical Data Server: Collaborate with engineers across the Clinical Data team to design, build, and operate the Python backend services and RESTful APIs responsible for managing clinical data.
  • Clinical Data Architecture: Partner closely with the Architecture team and other engineering stakeholders to design and evolve scalable clinical data models using healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7. Help establish clear boundaries, ownership, and contracts across clinical data domains.
  • Data Pipeline Development: Build and maintain reliable batch and event-driven pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver clinical data across operational systems, data platforms, reporting tools, and downstream applications.
  • Data Quality and Reliability: Establish automated validation, testing, reconciliation, and monitoring to identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicated, or incorrectly mapped clinical data before it affects users or downstream systems.
  • Data Modeling and Transformation: Develop maintainable transformation layers and curated datasets that support clinical reporting, operational analytics, product functionality, and AI use cases.
  • Data Governance and Lineage: Implement practices for data documentation, lineage, provenance, versioning, retention, and auditability. Help ensure clinical data remains trustworthy and explainable throughout its lifecycle.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with clinical, product, application engineering, architecture, data analytics, and AI teams to translate clinical workflows and business needs into durable technical solutions.
  • Technical Leadership: Lead design discussions, contribute to architectural decisions, review technical implementations, mentor engineers, and help establish engineering standards for clinical data development.

What You’ll Bring

  • Backend Engineering Experience: 6–8 years of software engineering experience, including ownership of production services and databasesPython Expertise: Strong experience building production Python applications and APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
  • Data Engineering: Experience designing and operating scalable ingestion, transformation, and delivery pipelines using batch, streaming, or event-driven patterns.
  • Healthcare Data: Hands-on experience working with clinical or healthcare data, including a strong understanding of FHIR resources, HL7 standards, terminology, and interoperability challenges.
  • Data Modeling: Experience designing normalized, dimensional, and domain-oriented data models. You understand how modeling decisions affect data quality, usability, and system performance.
  • Engineering Ownership: Ability to independently lead complex initiatives, make sound technical decisions, and balance short-term delivery with long-term maintainability.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with FHIR servers, clinical data repositories, electronic health record systems, or medical imaging and reporting workflows.
  • Familiarity with healthcare terminology standards such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, or DICOM.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, and clinical reporting or AI-enabled healthcare products.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role is $165,000 to $180,000 in local currency, depending on experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to jobs@prenuvo.com.

title: Data Engineer – Cloud & AI Solutions
description:
Se anche tu vuoi dare forma al futuro con noi lavorando su importanti progetti per prestigiosi brand e ti riconosci nel profilo che stiamo cercando, accetta la sfida e candidati! Stiamo cercando:
Data Engineer – Cloud & AI Solutions


IL TUO RUOLO:

Entrerai a far parte del team Data Analytics & AI, contribuendo alla progettazione, realizzazione ed evoluzione di architetture dati moderne in ambienti cloud. Sarai coinvolto/a in iniziative di trasformazione digitale, migrazione e valorizzazione dei dati, lavorando a stretto contatto con Data Engineer, Data Scientist e specialisti AI.

In particolare ti occuperai di:

  • Progettare e sviluppare pipeline ETL/ELT scalabili, affidabili e sicure su piattaforme Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e AWS.
  • Implementare processi di acquisizione, integrazione ed elaborazione dei dati sia in modalità batch sia real-time streaming.
  • Gestire e ottimizzare ecosistemi di Data Warehouse, Data Lake e moderne piattaforme Lakehouse, con particolare riferimento a BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena e, preferibilmente, Databricks.
  • Collaborare con i team di Data Science e Artificial Intelligence per integrare modelli di Machine Learning e supportare soluzioni basate su Generative AI e sistemi agentici.
  • Garantire qualità, sicurezza e compliance del dato lungo tutto il ciclo di vita, applicando le migliori pratiche di governance e protezione delle informazioni.
  • Automatizzare deployment e processi operativi attraverso strumenti di Infrastructure as Code, monitoraggio e pipeline CI/CD.
  • Partecipare attivamente all'evoluzione delle architetture cloud e delle piattaforme dati dei nostri clienti.


IL TUO PROFILO:

Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, orientata all'innovazione e appassionata al mondo dei dati e delle nuove tecnologie.

Hai:

  • Una laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Statistica, Fisica o discipline affini.
  • Da 2 a 3 anni di esperienza come Data Engineer in contesti aziendali strutturati o di consulenza.
  • Una buona capacità di lavorare in autonomia, gestendo attività progettuali nel rispetto delle scadenze.
  • Un approccio analitico e orientato al problem solving.
  • Ottime capacità relazionali e predisposizione a collaborare in team multidisciplinari e multiculturali.
  • Interesse verso le tecnologie emergenti e una forte motivazione ad approfondire gli sviluppi nell'ambito AI, GenAI e Agentic AI.
  • Una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.
  • Costituisce titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di piattaforme di data engineering e analytics moderne quali Databricks.

LE TUE COMPETENZE:

Requisiti fondamentali

  • Esperienza su Google Cloud Platform (GCP) con particolare riferimento a:
    • BigQuery
    • Cloud Storage
    • Cloud Dataflow
    • Cloud Pub/Sub
    • Cloud Composer
  • Esperienza su AWS, in particolare:
    • Amazon S3
    • AWS Glue
    • Amazon Athena
    • AWS Lambda
    • Amazon Redshift
  • Ottima conoscenza di SQL.
  • Buona padronanza di almeno uno dei seguenti linguaggi di programmazione:
    • Python (preferenziale)
    • Go
    • Node.js
    • C/C++
  • Esperienza con strumenti di orchestrazione dei workflow, come Apache Airflow o Cloud Composer.
  • Conoscenza di Git, versionamento del codice e pipeline CI/CD.

Costituiscono un plus

  • Conoscenza o esperienza nell'utilizzo della piattaforma Databricks per lo sviluppo di pipeline dati, elaborazioni distribuite e gestione di architetture Lakehouse.
  • Familiarità con Apache Spark e con i principali pattern di Data Engineering in ambienti cloud.
  • Conoscenza dei paradigmi e delle tecnologie di Generative AI, inclusi:
    • Large Language Models (LLM)
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
    • Vector Database
  • Esperienza con framework per lo sviluppo di applicazioni agentiche e orchestrazione di LLM, come:
    • LangChain
    • LlamaIndex
    • CrewAI
    • AutoGen
  • Esperienza in progetti di migrazione dati complessi, integrazioni multi-cloud o modernizzazione di sistemi legacy.
  • Conoscenza delle tematiche di sicurezza del dato, crittografia e processi di re-encryption.
  • Esperienza con strumenti di Infrastructure as Code, come Terraform.
  • Certificazioni cloud, quali:
    • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer
    • AWS Certified Data Engineer
    • Databricks Certified Data Engineer (Associate o Professional)
    • Certificazioni equivalenti in ambito Data & Cloud.

LA NOSTRA PROPOSTA:
Ti offriamo l’opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico, su progetti nazionali ed internazionali, che ti permetta di approfondire continuamente le tue conoscenze e di sviluppare le tue competenze.
Se vuoi dare una spinta alla tua carriera ed entrare a far parte di una società di servizi IT leader in Europa ed in continua crescita, inviaci il tuo curriculum!

Per questa posizione è prevista una RAL (retribuzione annua lorda) compresa tra €33.000 e €40.000.
La sede di lavoro è ASSAGO (MI). E’ comunque richiesta la disponibilità a compiere trasferte sul territorio nazionale e internazionale.

description:
Overview

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity. Interviews and onboarding are conducted virtually, a part of being a distributed-first company.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Analyze business objectives, enterprise customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.

  • Analyze architectural bottlenecks to define the long-term technical strategy and multi-year roadmaps for core Sales, Commerce & Finance systems (e.g., billing engine, quoting/CPQ, subscriptions, and platform APIs).

  • Translate complex quote-to-cash business models and compliance/financial requirements into clear, prioritized technical system problems and architecture roadmaps.

Qualifications

title: Services Coordinator at Cahill Place Apartments
description:
Center City Housing Corp. is a statewide leader and innovator of affordable supportive housing, and at CCHC we believe that affordable housing isn’t just a place to live, it’s a place where life can start moving forward.
This is a full-time job with benefits including paid sick and vacation time,and health, dental, life, and long-term disability insurance.
The Services Coordinator position actively participates in carrying out the mission of CCHC by providing direct support to tenants of a supportive housing apartment building serving homeless families. The Services Coordinator provides direct services as a member of a team and implements the program goals based on "Housing First" and "Harm Reduction" philosophies. This position will assist the Site Director with general provision of service coordination in the building including all aspects of tenant case management.
Duties and Responsibilities:1. Understand “Housing First" and "Harm Reduction" philosophies and apply to specific duties.2. Must be able to work independently and as a member of a team to effectively advocate for tenants.3. Act as coordinator of tenant and family services provided by case managers, partners, and other staff to ensure quality and continuity of support.4. Provide daily tenant advocacy/case management and support including encouragement of goal completion.5. Initiate and participate in tenant/staffing meetings to implement Harm Reduction strategies, tenant follow up, progress notes and record keeping.6. Assist Site Director to resolve and document tenant grievances, issues, and lease violations.7. Create, facilitate, recruit, and document tenant and family activities, special events, and supportive programming.8. Respond to building alarms, emergencies, and disturbances in an appropriate and timely manner.9. Network with other providers within limits of confidentially.10. Develop and maintain tenant case files.11. Assist tenants in understanding the responsibilities associated with housing and explain how it is imperative to abide by lease and house rules and assist them as needed.12. Assist tenants to obtain health services, social services, mental health services, and financial benefits.13. Teach or refer for needed independent living skills.14. Complete Intake and ongoing assessments and tenant surveys.15. Compile and perform data entry statistical information for required reporting for various funding sources including, but not limited to, Homeless Management Information System (HMIS).16. Demonstrate ability to prioritize and complete all job duties efficiently.17. Attend and participate with routine staff and tenant meetings.18. Maintain professional expertise through staff training and development opportunities.19. Respond to and resolve issues of controversy that may arise between tenants and/or guests using non-violent crisis intervention strategies.20. Manage difficult tenant issues by de-escalating potentially volatile situations and seeking additional assistance as needed.21. On call as needed.

title: Senior Director, Commercial Legal - Americas Region
description:
Overview

We are looking for a talented attorney and experienced people manager to join our Commercial & Global Business Operations (GBO) Legal Team to lead the team responsible for supporting our rapidly expanding Americas enterprise business. In this role you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior Sales leaders operating regionally and globally, as well as work closely with leaders across the Legal department and other segments of the business to shape and drive our efforts to accelerate enterprise cloud adoption, enabling customers to scale securely and unlock the full value of Atlassian’s Cloud platform and System of Work. At the same time, you will be a thought leader who sets the course and helps implement innovation in all aspects of how we provide legal support for our commercial endeavors, to help Atlassian scale and continue its growth.

Are you a curious, agile and forward-looking leader excited about the opportunity to build for the future and effect change, while at the same time growing your and your teams' careers in a dynamic and values-oriented environment? Then you might be the person we're looking for!

This position will report directly to the Deputy General Counsel, Commercial & Global Business Operations Legal Team.

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

In this role, you'll get to:

  • Serve as business partner for the Americas Region leaders across all sales segments, and contribute as a member of the regional and global extended Sales leadership teams.

  • Lead the Americas-based Enterprise Sales & International Operations Legal team in the provision of practical and business-oriented legal advice for all customer-facing commercial related matters in the region, including management of U.S. public sector and Latin American operations and programs. You will partner closely with Sales leaders at all levels as well as an array of cross-functional business leaders including those in Finance, Trust & Security, Commerce, Channel & GTM Ecosystems, Product, Engineering, and Marketing.

  • Support compliance in our day-to-day activities in the Americas, including providing training and counseling to sales professionals and driving compliance initiatives.

  • Manage and develop a growing team of 15+ seasoned attorneys.

  • Budget management, coordination of external counsel, goal setting, metric reporting, and organizational planning for delivering efficient, scalable legal support for Atlassian’s rapidly expanding and evolving business.

  • Set a course and lead key projects on behalf of the Legal team that support our cloud and AI transformation efforts, from initial brainstorming and engagement of stakeholders through building project roadmaps, change management, execution, measuring ROI, and communicating results.

  • Serve on the leadership team for the Commercial & GBO Legal Team, participating in all facets of team planning, including building out long-term growth plans, setting team OKRs, and managing strategic priorities.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

In The United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A: $300,600 - $392,450

Zone B: $270,540 - $353,205

Zone C: $249,498 - $325,734

Qualifications

  • You are a broad-based business attorney with substantial commercial and contract law experience, strong business acumen, and a pragmatic approach focused on delivering business-oriented results.

  • You are highly curious and a quick learner, who thrives in ambiguous, complex, challenging and/or changing environments.

  • You have exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, and are able to work effectively with, and gain the respect of, stakeholders at all levels.

  • You are a strong collaborator, and use your collaboration and communication skills to inspire change across teams.

  • You have demonstrated excellent leadership, along with superior organizational and communication skills, in leading teams and programs to deliver successful outcomes.

  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment, operate with a sense of urgency, and can ruthlessly prioritize when needed.

  • You take ownership, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.

  • You are forward-thinking and creative, not afraid to try new things, and love to innovate ways of working to optimize not only efficiency, but also team happiness and job satisfaction.

  • You are passionate about technology, and stay abreast of what’s happening in the industry.

  • You operate with the highest integrity.

  • You have a sense of humor and value building strong relationships with your colleagues.

On your first day, we'll expect you to have:

  • 15+ years of experience as a practicing attorney, with at least eight years practicing as an in-house lawyer (preferably for a multinational, publicly-listed company).

  • 3+ years of management experience with legal teams.

  • In depth knowledge of commercial and contract law based on working in a law firm and/or in-house on complex technology transactions for a software and/or cloud services provider; expertise in other legal fields like government contracting, intellectual property, privacy, and data protection law an additional benefit.

  • Experience working in a matrixed environment, with remote, global, and cross-functional teams.

  • JD from an accredited law school and be a member in good standing of at least one state Bar

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Construction Inspector / Resident Project Representative
description:
The Opportunity

RETTEW is seeking an experienced Construction Inspector / Resident Project Representative III to provide construction observation and field representation for municipal infrastructure projects in southeastern Pennsylvania.


This position is ideal for a construction professional who understands utility installation, can independently interpret construction plans and specifications, and communicates effectively with contractors, engineers, municipal representatives, and clients.


You will serve as RETTEW’s representative in the field, monitoring construction activities, documenting project progress, identifying deviations from approved plans and specifications, and helping project teams resolve issues before they affect quality, schedule, or cost.


This is a field-based position supporting an immediate and steady workload for established municipal clients. The position may be based from RETTEW’s Berwyn, Lancaster, or Lehigh Valley location, depending on the selected candidate’s location and assigned projects.


What You’ll Do

As a Construction Manager / Resident Project Representative III, you will:

  • Provide construction observation and field representation for municipal infrastructure and utility projects.
  • Observe work in progress to determine whether construction procedures, workmanship, and materials conform to approved plans and specifications.
  • Monitor the installation of water, wastewater, stormwater, roadway, and other municipal infrastructure improvements.
  • Interpret construction plans, specifications, details, and applicable project requirements in the field.
  • Discuss deviations, questions, and changed conditions with contractors and promptly communicate significant issues to the Project Manager.
  • Measure distances, dimensions, quantities, and installed work to verify construction accuracy and project progress.
  • Examine completed installations for conformity with approved plans, specifications, and applicable standards.
  • Maintain accurate daily logs of construction activities, personnel, equipment, weather, materials, progress, conversations, and field conditions.
  • Prepare photographs, sketches, quantity records, observation reports, and other required project documentation.
  • Document installations or field conditions that differ from the approved plans and provide the information needed for record drawings.
  • Review contractor-reported quantities and assist with preparing or verifying estimates of completed work for payment.
  • Compare observed construction progress with project schedules, reports, and contractual requirements.
  • Identify work that may not conform to the contract documents and communicate observations through the appropriate project channels.
  • Coordinate with contractors, municipal representatives, engineers, property owners, utility representatives, and other project stakeholders.
  • Provide clear, timely updates to Project Managers concerning construction progress, potential risks, field conflicts, and client concerns.
  • Participate in constructability and design-finalization reviews.
  • Support project closeout activities, including punch-list observations and documentation.
  • Serve as a technical resource to less-experienced Resident Project Representatives when needed.
  • Follow RETTEW’s quality-management procedures, safety requirements, and project-specific documentation standards.
  • Use RETTEW systems and applicable software to complete and submit field documentation accurately and on time.
  • Maintain professional and productive relationships with clients, contractors, and project-team members.



What We’re Looking For

Required

  • Significant construction experience involving underground utilities or municipal infrastructure.
  • Experience providing construction observation, inspection, field representation, construction coordination, or comparable project-site oversight.
  • Ability to independently interpret construction plans, details, specifications, and project requirements.
  • Ability to identify, document, and communicate construction deviations, changed conditions, quality concerns, and potential project risks.
  • Experience maintaining daily construction records, photographs, quantity documentation, field reports, or similar project records.
  • Ability to measure and verify installed work and construction quantities.
  • Strong verbal communication skills and the confidence to communicate appropriately with contractors, clients, engineers, and municipal representatives.
  • Clear and accurate written communication skills.
  • Working computer skills and the ability to complete construction documentation electronically.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while maintaining consistent communication with the Project Manager and project team.
  • Strong organization, judgment, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to provide dependable field coverage for active construction projects.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather, terrain, traffic, and construction-site conditions.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Valid driver’s license and ability to meet RETTEW’s requirements for operating a company vehicle.
  • Ability and willingness to drive daily to municipal construction sites and other project locations.

Candidates may qualify through one of the following combinations of education and related experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, civil engineering technology, engineering, or a related field and at least four years of relevant experience;
  • Associate’s degree in a related field and at least six years of relevant experience; or
  • At least eight years of relevant construction experience without a degree.

Equivalent combinations of directly related education, training, and experience may also be considered.

Preferred

  • Experience observing municipal water, wastewater, stormwater, roadway, or utility construction.
  • Experience representing an engineering consultant, municipality, authority, or public infrastructure owner during construction.
  • Experience reviewing or verifying contractor quantities, progress estimates, or payment applications.
  • Experience preparing sketches or documentation for record drawings.
  • Experience supporting project closeout and punch-list activities.
  • Experience participating in constructability reviews.
  • Familiarity with Pennsylvania municipal construction practices and public-infrastructure projects.
  • Experience providing technical guidance to less-experienced inspectors or field representatives.
  • Experience working with consistent municipal clients across multiple construction assignments.

No professional license or certification is required for this position.



Why RETTEW

Construction observation protects the quality of the finished project and helps municipalities receive the infrastructure they contracted to build.

At RETTEW, you’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Support a steady workload with established municipal clients.
  • Represent RETTEW on meaningful public-infrastructure and utility projects.
  • Work directly with contractors, engineers, municipal representatives, and Project Managers.
  • Apply your construction knowledge and professional judgment in the field.
  • Help project teams identify and address construction issues before they become larger problems.
  • Build long-term relationships with clients and project stakeholders.
  • Share your experience with developing field professionals.
  • Work with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, water and wastewater, transportation, environmental, and construction services.
  • Build ownership in the company through RETTEW’s Employee Stock Ownership Plan.

RETTEW also offers competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, and professional-development opportunities.



Environment

Workplace Designation: Field

Locations: Berwyn, Lancaster, or Lehigh Valley, PA


This is a 100% field-based position. The selected candidate will report directly to assigned municipal construction sites rather than following RETTEW’s standard hybrid office schedule.


The position requires daily driving for company business. A company vehicle will be provided in accordance with RETTEW policies.

Work locations and schedules may change based on construction activity, client needs, weather, project schedules, and contractor operations. Assignments may require early starts, extended workdays, or work outside standard office hours.


Fieldwork may involve active construction sites, roadways, excavations, underground utilities, heavy equipment, uneven terrain, varying weather conditions, noise, dust, and other typical construction-site conditions.


Safety & Compliance Requirements

This position is designated as safety-sensitive. The selected candidate must successfully complete all required pre-employment screenings, which may include a background check, drug and alcohol testing, and motor vehicle record review, where applicable.

Ongoing compliance with RETTEW’s safety policies, client requirements, traffic-control procedures, project-specific safety requirements, and applicable regulations is required.


About RETTEW

RETTEW is a 100% employee-owned engineering consulting firm that has been helping clients solve complex challenges since 1969. Our teams collaborate across disciplines to deliver innovative, practical solutions that strengthen infrastructure and support the communities we serve.


Built on a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we empower our employee-owners to grow their careers while delivering meaningful results for our clients.


RETTEW is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, including pregnancy, sexual orientation or gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please contact us at jperalta@rettew.com to request assistance.

description:

Are you ready to shape a market-leading, integrated patient experience for Rare Diseases? OneSource at Alexion Canada delivers exceptional support for patients living with rare diseases. As the Director, Patient Experience Program, you will establish the vision and strategy to enhance the entire patient journey. This role calls for an enterprise leader who can listen deeply, understand evolving organizational needs, and inspire teams to shape the strategies, capabilities, and resources that will define our future.

You are an enterprise leader who anticipates organizational needs, builds future ready capabilities, and deploys resources to deliver impact across therapeutic areas. Reporting to the Head of Market Access and Patient Experience, you will be the executive owner of OneSource outcomes, risk, compliance, and value realization.

Accountability

  • Drive patient and customer centricity: Embed a relentless patient and HCP focus, create a culture with the team to continuously scan guidelines and competitive moves, and translate insights into strategies and tactics that extend OneSource’s leadership.

Build and cultivate senior relationships with key parters, converting needs and insights into scalable business opportunities and differentiation.

Own enterprise P&L elements and multi-year funding models, demonstrating impact, productivity, and cost-to-serve optimization, drive benefits realization and scenario planning.
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance: Facilitate governance forums; ensure compliance with regulatory, pharmacovigilance, privacy (e.g., PIPEDA/GDPR), and information security requirements.

Essential Skills/Experience

  • Proven ability to articulate and align franchise/divisional vision and priorities.
  • Track record of building high-impact external relationships that unlock growth.
  • Advanced analytical skills to translate patient, customer, and market data into strategic actions.
  • History of designing and implementing customer solutions that drive measurable business impact.
  • Strong command of P&L, forecasting, ROI, and value creation.
  • Demonstrated critical thinking, decision-making, and persuasive communication.
  • Proven ability to build high-performing teams and prioritize engagement and development.
  • Diverse cross-functional experience (beyond sales/marketing) and bilingual French considered assets.

Your work will power rapid patient impact and shape the future of rare disease care in Canada and beyond. You will experience the true meaning of redefining lives - every day.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we redefine bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines.

In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace, and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

With tailored development programs designed for skill enhancement and empathetic understanding of patient journeys, you'll be empowered to make a difference. Supported by exceptional leaders and peers ready to lift you in marketing compliance and beyond.

title: Test Engineer
description:
Do you want to help strengthen software quality at JYSK and ensure that testing is an integral part of the development lifecycle? Are you experienced in turning test methodologies and test design techniques into clear quality insights for your team and stakeholders?

We are looking for a Test Engineer to join an agile IT team working with order processing and SAP. You will have an important role in strengthening our shift-left quality approach and ensuring reliable software solutions that support our business. The position is based at our Head Office in Aarhus, Denmark.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

At JYSK, you will join a collaborative IT environment where quality, continuous improvement and professional development are part of how we work. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility for software quality, influence how your team approaches testing and continue developing your expertise as a Test Engineer.

Furthermore, we offer you:

  • An opportunity to further develop your software testing and quality assurance expertise

  • A key role where you can influence testing practices and quality within your agile team

  • The opportunity to support and shape our shift-left quality journey

  • Collaboration with colleagues and stakeholders across IT and the business

  • Opportunities for both professional and personal development

  • A workplace with a strong focus on teamwork and work-life balance

WHAT YOUR NEXT JOB WILL BE ABOUT

As a Test Engineer at JYSK, you will help ensure testing excellence within your agile team. You will take responsibility for the team's approach to testing and contribute to a quality-focused culture by applying structured test methodologies, identifying risks and providing stakeholders with clear insights into software quality.

Your tasks and responsibilities in the job include:

  • Safeguarding and developing the overall test strategy within the agile team

  • Creating test designs as an integrated part of the software development lifecycle

  • Specifying logical and physical test cases based on structured test analysis

  • Executing test cases and maintaining relevant testware

  • Identifying quality risks and providing stakeholders with clear quality insights

  • Working with developers and other team members to strengthen shift-left testing and quality practices

  • Coaching team members and stakeholders on software testing and quality assurance

You can read more about our department here.

WHAT SHOULD YOU BRING

We are strengthening our shift-left quality culture as part of JYSK's IT modernisation. To succeed in this position, you have a structured testing mindset and know how to turn established test methodologies into practical testing activities. Experience with SAP or another ERP system will be an advantage, particularly if you understand sales order processing and the retail customer journey.

We are looking for a new colleague who:

  • Has proven experience with software testing and quality assurance

  • Has experience establishing and applying test strategies for software deliverables based on structured test analysis

  • Can apply test methodologies and test design techniques to achieve relevant test coverage

  • Ideally has experience with sales order processing in SAP or another standard ERP system

  • Ideally understands retail processes and the customer journey

  • Works independently and proactively, reaching out to colleagues and stakeholders to gather information and discuss risks

  • Communicates clearly, can coach others on software testing and understands Danish

IS THIS YOUR NEXT OPPORTUNITY? Apply today!

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Senior Test Manager, Christina Andersen Nexø at +45 2679 6129.

We kindly ask you to only attach your CV. With us, there is no need to write a traditional cover letter when applying for a job.

Instead, when you click “I’m interested/Apply”, you will have the option to write a brief message to the hiring team. If you wish, you can use this space to share your motivation for applying or highlight anything else you feel is relevant.

ABOUT US

We believe our employees are key to our success. That is why we strive to offer development and possibilities of growing and finding new challenges within JYSK. Since our founder, Lars Larsen, opened his first store in Denmark in 1979, JYSK has expanded our global presence with stores and web shops in countries around the world.

Our three fundamental JYSK Values – Tradesman, Colleague and Corporate Spirit – express the behaviour and attitude that we can expect from each other. We trust each other, and we believe in Empowerment and freedom with responsibility. We also take pride in rewarding engagement and a great effort among the employees. With the right attitude, opportunities abound in JYSK.

JYSK wants to include everyone, no matter the age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and experience. Together, we secure our inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of the employees. Because a great mix of minds, talents and unique personalities makes us a stronger team.

For more information, please visit our career page.

title: Senior Environmental Scientist 2-NEPA
description:
The Opportunity

RETTEW is seeking an experienced Environmental Scientist III to join our Natural Sciences team.


In this role, you will support environmental review and clearance for transportation and infrastructure projects, with a primary focus on compliance with the National Environmental Policy Act.


You will prepare environmental documentation, coordinate technical studies, evaluate potential impacts, and work with clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary teams to move projects through the environmental-clearance process.


This opportunity is well suited for an environmental professional who can independently manage assignments while collaborating with others and asking questions when project conditions or requirements are unclear.



What You'll Do

As an Environmental Scientist III, you will:

  • Prepare and coordinate NEPA clearance documents, environmental assessments, technical reports, agency correspondence, and other project deliverables.
  • Evaluate project plans and environmental data to identify affected resources, potential impacts, permitting considerations, and project risks.
  • Determine the technical studies, agency coordination, and documentation needed to support environmental decisions.
  • Coordinate studies involving wetlands, waterways, threatened and endangered species, cultural resources, hazardous materials, noise, agricultural resources, and other applicable environmental considerations.
  • Conduct or support field investigations, environmental assessments, sampling, monitoring, and data collection.
  • Coordinate with clients, transportation agencies, regulatory agencies, engineers, planners, scientists, and other technical specialists.
  • Support Section 4(f) evaluations, environmental commitments, mitigation tracking, public-involvement activities, and project meetings.
  • Develop and manage scopes, budgets, schedules, and assigned tasks while meeting project deadlines and quality requirements.
  • Direct or coordinate tasks completed by other technical and field staff.
  • Support environmental work for transportation, energy, and other infrastructure clients based on project needs.



What We're Looking For

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in environmental science, environmental studies, biology, ecology, natural resources, environmental planning, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of relevant environmental experience, including qualifying internship experience.
  • Professional experience supporting environmental review and clearance under the National Environmental Policy Act.
  • Experience preparing or contributing substantively to NEPA documents and supporting technical studies.
  • Understanding of the environmental-clearance process for transportation or comparable infrastructure projects.
  • Ability to independently manage defined assignments, identify environmental requirements, and coordinate work across multiple disciplines.
  • Strong technical writing, research, organization, communication, and computer skills.
  • Ability to perform office and field assignments and travel to project sites and meetings.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet RETTEW's requirements for operating a company vehicle.
  • Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.


Preferred

  • Experience supporting NEPA clearance for transportation projects.
  • Experience working with PennDOT, the Federal Highway Administration, the Pennsylvania Turnpike Commission, or comparable transportation agencies.
  • Experience preparing categorical exclusions, environmental assessments, environmental impact statements, reevaluations, or Section 4(f) documentation.
  • Experience with wetland, waterway, ecological, cultural-resource, or related environmental studies.
  • Experience submitting Chapter 105 permits in PA GreenPort and Keystone Environmental ePermitting System.
  • Experience organizing and participating in public involvement activities.
  • Professional Wetland Scientist certification or OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER training.
  • Section 4(f) experience is helpful but is not required at the time of hire.[ES1.1]



Why RETTEW

At RETTEW, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Help transportation and infrastructure projects move forward responsibly.
  • Take meaningful ownership of environmental-clearance assignments.
  • Work with clients, agencies, and multidisciplinary technical teams.
  • Expand your experience across NEPA, Section 4(f), environmental studies, and regulatory coordination.
  • Build ownership in the company through RETTEW's Employee Stock Ownership Plan.
  • RETTEW also offers competitive compensation, comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits, disability and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, paid time off and holidays, and professional-development and certification support.



Work Environment

Workplace Designation: Hybrid

Locations: Lancaster, Mechanicsburg, State College, or Williamsport, PA


This position follows RETTEW's standard hybrid schedule and combines office and remote work with field assignments, project meetings, and occasional travel.


Approximately 25% of the position may involve fieldwork. Driving is an essential function and is expected approximately once per week, depending on workload. A company vehicle will be provided in accordance with RETTEW policies.

Field assignments may involve outdoor work in varying weather and terrain, uneven surfaces, vegetation, waterways, traffic, construction activity, and other project-site conditions.



Safety and Compliance Requirements

This position is designated as safety-sensitive. The selected candidate must successfully complete all applicable pre-employment screenings, which may include a background check, drug and alcohol testing, and motor vehicle record review.

Ongoing compliance with RETTEW's safety policies, client requirements, project-site procedures, and applicable environmental regulations is required.



About RETTEW

RETTEW is a 100% employee-owned engineering consulting firm that has been helping clients solve complex challenges since 1969. Our multidisciplinary teams deliver practical solutions that strengthen infrastructure, protect natural resources, and support the communities we serve.


Our culture is grounded in our core values: Act Like an Owner, Value Relationships, and Exemplify Excellence. We empower our employee-owners to grow their careers while delivering meaningful results for our clients.


RETTEW is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, including pregnancy, sexual orientation or gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.


If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, please contact us at jperalta@rettew.com to request assistance.
