title: Staff Product Analyst
description:
Hover helps people design, improve, and protect the properties they love. With proprietary AI built on over a decade of real property data, Hover answers age-old questions like “What will it look like?” and “What will it cost?” Homeowners, contractors, and insurance professionals rely on Hover to get fully measured, accurate, and interactive 3D models of any property — all from a smartphone scan in minutes.

At Hover, we’re driven by curiosity, purpose, and a shared commitment to serving our customers, communities, and each other. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives and are proud to cultivate an inclusive, high-performance culture that inspires growth, accountability, and excellence. Backed by leading investors like Google Ventures and Menlo Ventures, and trusted by industry leaders including Travelers, State Farm, and Nationwide — we’re redefining how people understand and interact with their spaces.

Why Hover wants you

Hover's product suite has expanded significantly in recent years. We've launched new solutions across the Pro workflow, introduced AI-driven design visualizations, and scaled to serve homeowners, contractors, and insurance carriers. Our Product Analytics team partners closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, and Data Science to keep product decisions grounded in solid data and a real understanding of how people use what we build.

This role owns the analytics behind our most magical product and our biggest open opportunity. Hover turns a phone scan of a house into an accurate 3D model, and that model into the measurements and estimates a contractor bids from. Homeowners look at their own home in that model, which makes it the most consumer-facing thing we build. Today, the flow from 3D model to finished estimate converts poorly, and nobody owns the analytics behind it. We know usage is low. We don't yet know where it leaks, what the real blockers are, or how success should be measured. That's what you'd figure out.

This role demands an owner mindset. You'll define the measurement framework rather than inherit one, build our experimentation practice for 3D from scratch, and work directly with senior product and engineering leaders to shape the roadmap. You'll handle a wide range of analytical needs along the way: tracking plans, dashboards, experiment design, and deep-dive product analyses.

Your background likely spans product analytics, experimentation, data science, or product strategy, and you're looking for broad scope with a short distance between your analysis and a real decision. Final leveling will be determined based on experience and alignment during the interview process.

You will contribute by

You'll own the analytical backbone of Hover's 3D and Estimates experience, embedded in the product team rather than sitting beside it. You'll scope your own questions, do the data work, and tell the story that changes what we build. Our stack is Segment, Split, dbt, and Hex, and all of it is in active development, so you'll shape it instead of inheriting it.

  • Define how we measure the flow from 3D model to Estimates, find where it leaks, and make the case for the product changes that fix it
  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Leads to define success metrics, design experiments, and evaluate product performance
  • Lead experiment design and analysis for A/B tests and quasi-experimental studies, and write the playbook that sets how we design, run, and read tests across the company
  • Evaluate the new 3D experiences arriving as our Inspections product begins to inform the model, including damage assessment, and think through how they interact at a systems level
  • Improve the telemetry we depend on in Segment, and run cleaner experiments through Split
  • Build frameworks that help stakeholders align around insights and prioritize the work that moves user and business outcomes
  • Raise the bar for data-driven decisions across the product organization by extending our semantic layer in dbt and Hex Context Guides, improving self-serve analytics, and mentoring peers

Your background includes

  • 7+ years in product analytics, data science, or a related role, focused on user behavior and experimentation
  • Expert-level SQL for complex extraction and analysis, with real comfort in messy, evolving data
  • Hands-on ownership of experimentation, including experimentation platforms and statistical methods (A/B testing, causal inference). You choose the metrics and guardrails, read the results, and tell the team what to do next
  • Strong familiarity with BI and analytics notebook environments (Hex, Mode, Tableau, Looker, or similar), and the judgment to build analysis others reuse
  • Experience with modern data stacks (dbt, Snowflake, Hex) and product analytics platforms (Amplitude, Mixpanel)
  • Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI to accelerate analysis, surface insights, or improve how you work
  • Strong product sense, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences through clean decks, documentation, and visualizations
  • A track record where your analysis changed what a team built, not only what a team knew, and a willingness to bring that perspective to cross-functional rooms rather than waiting to be asked for numbers

Nice-to-haves

  • Python for analysis or automation
  • Experience with Segment or another CDP, and with Split, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Eppo
  • Consumer product experience, especially where UX decisions drove conversion
  • Comfort with quasi-experimental methods where a clean A/B test isn't possible
  • Exposure to 3D, spatial, or computer vision products
  • Exposure to construction, home services, insurance, or another operationally complex industry

Benefits

  • Compensation - Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a fast-growing company
  • Healthcare - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and dependents
  • Paid Time Off - Unlimited and flexible vacation policy
  • Paid Family Leave - We support work/life balance and offer generous paid parental and new child bonding leave
  • Mandatory Self-Care Days - A day set aside each month to allow employees to recharge
  • Remote Wellbeing Resources - We provide recurring fitness classes, meditation/ mindfulness tools, virtual therapy, and family planning assistance
  • Learning - We encourage continued education and will help cover the cost of management training, conferences, workshops, or certifications

Hybrid roles at Hover

Hover has Hubs in San Francisco and New York City, where we expect that all employees living within a 50-mile radius of our offices will come into their local Hover office at least three times a week to build rapport and foster organic connection. At this time, Hover is not considering fully remote roles.

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $172,000-$212,000 annually. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all applicable US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
About Everything Bagel Partners LLC

At Everything Bagel, we build and support breakthrough brands that disrupt categories and captivate audiences across digital, social, and beyond. Our brand team leads strategy and messaging for some of the most exciting startups and scaling companies across wellness, beauty, CPG, and education and more. We believe in brand-building that’s strategic, deeply human, and creatively fearless.

About the Role

The Creative Strategist sits at the intersection of consumer insight, performance data, and creative leadership. You will be responsible for shaping what we say, who we’re saying it to, and why it will convert — while guiding teams on how that strategy comes to life.

Unlike junior strategy roles, this position does not focus on copywriting or briefing execution. Instead, you will own the high-level creative strategy, oversee strategic output, lead client conversations, and manage the creative ecosystem that brings paid social campaigns to market.

This is a highly collaborative, client-facing role for someone who can confidently speak to creative from a strategic lens, translate performance insights into actionable direction, and lead teams toward stronger, smarter creative.

Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Creative Strategy & Messaging

  • Own the end-to-end creative strategy for a portfolio of clients across paid social for video and static/animation assets (Meta, TikTok, emerging platforms)
  • Define and evolve messaging frameworks based on consumer archetypes, customer psychology, platform behavior, trends and performance data
  • Translate insights from historical performance, testing learnings, and trends into clear strategic direction for video and static ads
  • Identify creative opportunities, gaps, and scalable angles to inform ongoing testing and iteration
  • Conduct competitive research using tools like Magicbrief, TikTok trend trackers, Meta Ad Library, etc.
  • Align with internal teams (Lifecycle, Copy, Video) to shape cross-channel messaging strategies

Performance, Insights & Reporting

  • Analyze creative performance across client portfolios to identify patterns, learnings, and opportunities
  • Lead creative performance reporting in internal meetings, turning data into strategic insights and recommendations
  • Use reporting to inform future creative direction, testing roadmaps, and messaging evolution
  • Partner closely with Lifecycle and analytics teams to ensure creative strategy aligns with media performance

Client-Facing Strategy & Communication

  • Serve as the strategic creative lead in client relationships
  • Confidently present creative strategy, messaging decisions, performance insights, and recommendations
  • Guide clients through the “why” behind creative direction, testing approaches, and iteration plans
  • Act as a trusted strategic partner, balancing brand goals with performance realities

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage and mentor a team of junior strategists, editors, and graphic designers
  • Provide strategic feedback and direction to ensure creative execution aligns with overarching strategy
  • Collaborate closely with the Creator Manager to ensure creator-led content is on-brand, on-message, and strategically aligned
  • Partner with Lifecycle, brand, and creative leadership to ensure cohesion across strategy, execution, and performance

Production, QA, and Delivery

  • Collaborate with design and video teams to ensure visuals align with strategy and messaging
  • Lead QA for all creative assets; reviewing layout, copy placement, specs, and brand consistency
  • Send and manage client approvals; incorporate feedback while maintaining project momentum
  • Present weekly reports to clients on creative strategy, upcoming campaigns, testing insights, and performance trends

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years in paid social creative strategy, performance marketing, or brand strategy — agency side preferred
  • Demonstrated experience building messaging frameworks and creative direction for video and static/animation ads on Meta and TikTok
  • Experience working with performance data to inform creative decisions (not just reporting on it)
  • Some exposure to client-facing work — presenting strategy, fielding feedback, managing approvals — even if not as the sole strategic lead

Strategic & Analytical Skills

  • Ability to translate performance data and testing learnings into clear creative direction
  • Understanding of consumer psychology, archetypes, and platform-specific behavior
  • Comfort identifying creative gaps and scalable angles from competitive research
  • Working knowledge of tools like Meta Ads Manager, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Ads Manager, and ideally Magicbrief or a similar competitive intel tool

Communication & Collaboration

  • Strong presentation skills can walk a client through the "why" behind a creative decision, not just the "what"
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with copy, video/design, and lifecycle or media teams
  • Comfortable giving structured feedback to editors/designers on creative execution against strategy

Leadership

  • Some experience mentoring or giving direction to junior team members (full people management not required)
  • Ability to manage QA and creative approvals process with attention to brand consistency and platform specs

title: Senior Manager, UX Design
description:
At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care through Counterpart Assistant, our technology platform for primary care. By supporting primary care physicians and their teams, we help identify patient needs earlier, make complex clinical information actionable, and support longitudinal management of chronic conditions.

As Senior Manager of UX Design for the Interventions Pillar, you will lead the team designing how clinical insight becomes action. Your portfolio will include decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, treatment execution, care coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.

You will manage talented, experienced designers who already understand our product, systems, and clinical users deeply. Your role is to help them expand their strategic ownership, make stronger decisions through ambiguity, influence across the organization, and define the future of their domains.

AI will be an important part of this work. You will guide teams in applying AI where it can help clinicians synthesize information, evaluate options, plan care, and follow through—while preserving appropriate evidence, transparency, and clinical control.

Why this role?
The Interventions Pillar addresses a central challenge in healthcare: identifying an opportunity is not enough. Better outcomes require translating insight into an appropriate decision, treatment plan, action, and durable follow-through.

This role is an opportunity to:
● Shape how Counterpart supports consequential clinical decisions and treatment workflows.
● Develop senior designers into stronger strategic and organizational leaders.
● Define how AI can responsibly assist clinical reasoning and action.
● Connect clinical expertise, product strategy, design, and technology around measurable outcomes.

As a Senior Manager, UX Design, you will:

  • Lead the clinical UX strategy. Establish a coherent direction across clinical decision support, treatment planning, intervention selection, execution, coordination, and longitudinal follow-through.
  • Develop senior design talent. Coach experienced designers to lead through ambiguity, define strategy, make high-quality trade-offs, influence senior stakeholders, and increase their impact beyond their immediate product areas.
  • Advance AI-enabled clinical workflows. Help teams determine where AI should synthesize information, generate options, recommend next steps, automate work, or remain out of the workflow. Establish expectations for evidence, uncertainty, human oversight, review, and correction.
  • Create strong cross-functional decisions. Partner with Clinical, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Research leaders to connect clinical needs, model capabilities, user evidence, technical constraints, and business priorities.
  • Raise the quality and effectiveness of execution. Strengthen critique, research synthesis, clinical review, prototyping, evaluation, and learning practices so teams can move efficiently without oversimplifying consequential problems.

Success in this role looks like:
This leader will bring deep expertise in clinical-product design while creating strategic alignment and design leverage across the Interventions pods.

  • In the first 90 days, establish leadership and strategic alignment by building strong partnerships with product directors, ensuring balanced workloads, and embedding design as a critical part of business strategy. Success will be measured by stakeholder feedback, stronger design integration, and improved operational effectiveness.
  • In the first 6 months, focus on delivering impact by deepening user understanding, embedding research insights into design decisions, and pushing for best-in-class UX. Accelerate iteration cycles, reducing time-to-insight by 30%, while fostering a culture of experimentation and autonomy. Guide the team in complex problem-solving, balancing constraints, and proactively shaping solutions.
  • Beyond six months, scale strategic impact and industry influence by positioning design as a key business driver, ensuring UX directly contributes to engagement, provider adoption, and overall user experience. You will push for consumer-grade, next-gen experiences that redefine digital healthcare while strengthening team expertise, fostering strategic thinking, and elevating design’s role in product direction. Success will be measured by design’s ability to drive best-in-class UX, shape industry standards, and create tangible product improvements that shift user expectations.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 7+ years of design experience in a design environment (in-house, agency, or relevant industry), with 5+ years of managing people.
  • You have led complex, high-consequence workflows in healthcare or another expert professional domain.
  • You bring strong judgment in interaction design, information design, research, and product strategy— and know how to coach others without taking over their work. You can demonstrate how you have helped experienced designers grow from strong executors into strategic decision-makers and organizational leaders.
  • You have experience with AI-enabled products or can demonstrate sound judgment about recommendations, automation, evidence, uncertainty, and human oversight.
  • You have experience in complex systems and applications, knowing how to simplify the complex and create delightful, intuitive experiences.
  • You are an advocate for collaboration, working closely with product and engineering to ensure design is a driver of business outcomes, not just execution.
  • You are excited about shaping the future of healthcare UX – bringing the same level of quality and innovation seen in leading consumer products to an industry that desperately needs it.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program, 401k matching, and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. Your health matters to us, and we invest in ensuring you have access to quality healthcare.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, monthly company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous flexible time-off policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: Developing internal talent is a priority for Clover. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) offering discounted equity opportunities
  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Monthly cell phone & internet stipend
  • Remote-first culture, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

title: Principle Machine Learning Architect | Enterprise Agentic Search
description:
Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Your future team

Rovo helps people and AI agents find, understand, and act on enterprise knowledge. We build the search and machine-learning capabilities that connect agents with relevant information across Atlassian products and connected applications.

Enterprise search presents a distinctive challenge for agents. Information is scattered across documents, conversations, tickets, and other systems. Questions depend on company-specific terminology, relationships, permissions, and information that changes over time. Agents need to discover the right sources, refine their searches as they learn, and gather enough reliable evidence to complete a task efficiently.

We are hiring a Principal Architect to define how enterprise search powers AI agents. You will own some of the followings : the architecture and technical direction connecting retrieval, agent orchestration, context construction, evaluation, and large language model (LLM) training. Your work will help agents search effectively, gather reliable evidence, and reason over enterprise knowledge across products and applications.

This is a hands-on architect role with impact across multiple teams. You will make foundational design decisions, validate them through prototypes and production evidence, and guide engineers and scientists through implementation and adoption. You will establish a coherent architecture that teams can evolve as models, enterprise data, and customer needs change.

Responsibilities

You will be working on some of the following areas:

  • Own the architecture for enterprise agentic search. Define how query understanding, source discovery, retrieval, agent orchestration, tool use, and context construction work together. Establish system boundaries, interfaces, and reusable capabilities that support multiple agent experiences.

  • Design for enterprise complexity. Make architectural decisions for heterogeneous content, permissions, tenant isolation, freshness, domain-specific language, and information needs spanning multiple systems. Balance search quality and agent effectiveness with scalability, latency, cost, and reliability.

  • Architect evaluation and experimentation. Define the benchmarks, datasets, evaluation environments, and observability needed to assess retrieval quality, agent search behavior, evidence coverage, and task success. Guide teams in building reproducible experiments and calibrated evaluators that inform architecture, model, and launch decisions.

  • Set the direction for training LLMs for agentic search. Define model capabilities, learning objectives, training data requirements, and the architecture connecting training, evaluation, and serving. Lead technical decisions on supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning to improve search planning, tool use, iterative evidence gathering, and grounded reasoning. Partner with engineers and scientists to train, validate, and deploy these improvements.

  • Design the continuous improvement loop. Connect production interactions, agent trajectories, and failure analysis to evaluation cases, training data, and model updates. Establish data and feedback interfaces that preserve permissions, privacy, and evaluation integrity.

  • Validate architecture through implementation. Build prototypes and reference implementations, investigate difficult system failures, and work directly with teams on critical components. Use experiments and production results to resolve trade-offs and guide incremental adoption.

  • Lead technical direction across teams. Set a multi-quarter roadmap, align search, agent, and ML platform teams on shared architecture, and guide implementation through design reviews and technical mentorship. Take accountability for architectural outcomes and measurable improvements in agent task success.

Compensation

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.

Please visit go.atlassian.com/payzones for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

Pay Ranges

In The United States, we have three geographic pay zones. For this role, our current base pay ranges for new hires in each zone are:

Zone A: $236,700 - $309,025

Zone B: $213,030 - $278,123

Zone C: $196,461 - $256,491

Qualifications

What we are looking for

  • Substantial hands-on industry experience architecting, delivering, and evolving production RAG or agentic search systems used by real customers, with particular depth in enterprise applications.

  • A record of owning architecture from ambiguous customer needs through system design, implementation, launch, and evolution, with measurable improvements in search quality, task success, or customer outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to define system boundaries, interfaces, and shared capabilities across teams, and to make sound architectural decisions about scalability, reliability, extensibility, and operational complexity.

  • Practical experience with enterprise knowledge and workflows, including heterogeneous data sources, access permissions, freshness, domain-specific terminology, and complex information needs spanning multiple systems.

  • Deep understanding of LLM-based search and agent systems, including retrieval, tool use, multi-step search, context construction, and grounded reasoning, and how these components affect end-to-end performance.

  • Practical experience adapting and deploying LLMs, with the technical depth to guide training data design, supervised fine-tuning or other post-training methods, evaluation, and serving decisions. Experience improving search or tool-use behavior is especially valuable.

  • Strong evaluation and experimental skills: you can design useful benchmarks, assess label and judge quality, recognize leakage and confounding factors, and connect offline results to product impact.

  • Strong software and distributed-systems engineering skills, with the ability to validate designs in code and work deeply with data pipelines, model serving, and production observability.

  • A record of influencing technical direction across multiple teams, guiding architecture through production adoption, and mentoring senior engineers and scientists.

  • Sound judgment about trade-offs across model quality, data availability, latency, cost, reliability, privacy, and access control.

Benefits & Perks

Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits.

About Atlassian

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit go.atlassian.com/crh.

title: Associate Director, Device Development
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Marea Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in South San Francisco with a growing pipeline of first-in-class therapies to address genetically validated cardioendocrine disease targets. Our therapies have the potential to serve as transformative treatment options for significant patient populations living with cardioendocrine diseases.

The company’s lead program, MAR001, is being developed for the treatment of severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG), a condition characterized by very high triglyceride levels and elevated risk of acute pancreatitis. Preclinical models with MAR001 demonstrated reduction in triglycerides, remnant cholesterol and ectopic fat, and improved insulin sensitivity. MAR001 has demonstrated strong and a differentiated profile in patients and is approaching Phase 3 development. Our second clinical asset, MAR002, is a monoclonal antibody targeting excess growth hormone produced by the pituitary gland in the rare hormonal disorder, acromegaly. MAR002 has potential to become best-in-disease and is quickly progressing into Phase 2/3 clinical development. We also have a third asset that is swiftly advancing through research discovery, with DC nomination expected this year.

At Marea, we believe in the power of collaboration and the importance of leading by example. We are a tight-knit team that values the contributions of every member, from interns to senior leaders. Our environment is dynamic, with each day presenting new challenges and opportunities for growth. Every role is “Hands-On”, and the successful candidate will be able to work alongside team members, regardless of level, to understand challenges and drive results.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a key role within our Technical Operations team as we aggressively advance our two lead assets into mid- and late-stage clinical development. Both assets include a transition from vial to prefilled drug delivery devices with a subcutaneous route of administration.

The Associate Director, Device Development will be Marea’s technical lead for the device constituent of both programs, responsible for driving development of combination product configurations through Phase 3 clinical readiness and on toward the BLA and commercial readiness. The role owns device design controls end-to-end: user needs and design input requirements, risk management, design verification, human factors, and the device content of regulatory submissions. It also carries primary and secondary packaging development, container closure integrity, and shipping and distribution testing for both programs. The individual will work closely with the Drug Product, Analytical, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical Development, and Supply Chain teams and will direct the day-to-day technical work of Marea’s external combination product partners.

Marea operates a lean, outsourced model. External partners support combination product design and development, device platform supply, verification testing, and clinical assembly and packaging under Marea’s design controls. This role is Marea’s technical owner across all of them. We expect the candidate to be hands-on: writing and reviewing requirements, protocols, and reports; running technical reviews with partners; and working at partner sites during critical builds and studies.

This is a full-time, South San Francisco-based position with the expectation of working on-site at least three days per week.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as Marea’s technical lead for combination product development of these programs, owning the design and development files for all product configurations
  • Define user needs and design input requirements that integrate drug product attributes, such as viscosity, fill volume, and container closure, with device performance, and keep them traced through verification and validation
  • Lead device risk management to ISO 14971:2019, including the use-related risk analysis, design FMEA, and process risk assessments with partners
  • Plan and oversee design verification for Phase 3 clinical readiness to ISO 11608-1:2022 and program requirements: test method development and validation, statistically justified sample sizes and acceptance criteria, preconditioning and aging, and review of protocols and reports executed by partners and test laboratories
  • Work with human factors specialists to plan formative and summative studies to IEC 62366-1:2015 and FDA human factors guidance, and carry the findings into design, labeling, and the instructions for use
  • Direct the day-to-day technical work of external design and development partners, device constituent suppliers, and test laboratories, including statements of work, technical reviews, deliverable acceptance, and tracking against timeline and budget
  • Support selection and technical oversight of the clinical assembly and packaging CMO, including design transfer, assembly process development, equipment qualification, and on-site support during clinical builds
  • Lead primary and secondary packaging development, covering container closure integrity strategy and testing as well as shipping and distribution simulation testing
  • Define the device portion of combination product stability and shelf-life studies with the Drug Product and Analytical teams
  • Author and review device content for IND amendments, IMPDs, and the BLA and represent combination product development in meetings and correspondence with FDA and other health authorities
  • Work with Quality on nonconformance, investigations, and CAPAs arising from development and clinical builds
  • Plan and develop scope of work for external partners in alignment with internal CMC team and project team, work with the partners on execution and on-time delivery of the SOW scope.
  • Travel to partner sites in the U.S. and abroad, approximately 10% of the time (with potential peaks during builds and critical studies.

QUALIFICATIONS
  • B.S. in Mechanical, Biomedical, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline with 10+ years of relevant experience, an M.S. with 8+ years, or a Ph.D. with 6+ years, in combination product or drug delivery device development in the biotech, pharmaceutical, or medical device industry
  • Hands-on development of prefilled syringe and autoinjector combination products through design verification into Phase 3; BLA or NDA device experience strongly preferred
  • Working command of design controls under 21 CFR Part 4 and 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485:2016, ISO 14971:2019, IEC 62366-1:2015, and the ISO 11608 series

title: Client Lead
description:
Richard L Johnson Associates (RLJA), a GMB team, is hiring a Client Lead to join our team in Rockford, Illinois. Our ideal candidate is a proactive and relationship-driven sales leader passionate about education and community impact. They excel at identifying opportunities, building client trust, and guiding projects from inception to completion. They embody the characteristics of our ideal teammate: humble, hungry and smart.


We believe that the foundation of any relationship is built on trust and commitment which is reflected in our team-based approach to client care. Client Leads get a front row seat to experience how our work with communities equips students for lifelong learning. Does this resonate with you? Read on!


Why Work with Us? This is the part where most job descriptions jump into the responsibilities and requirements for the role being posted - and we'll get there shortly! But we like to start with the why instead of the what.


Our purpose is helping build strong communities through educational opportunity. We focus on projects within the educational ecosystem, from Pre-K through Higher Education and projects in our community that support lifelong learning. GMB’s Ecosystem of Teams provides planning, architecture, engineering, branding, and enrollment marketing services to educational institutions across the country, holistically impacting how they maximize their learner success.


About the team: GMB’s Richard L. Johnson Associates brand is an education-focused architecture partner serving K-12 schools and community colleges across Northern Illinois for the past 45 years. We know the communities we serve, understand the realities of educational facilities, and work alongside our clients as part of their team - not simply as a consultant.


As a Client Lead with Richard L. Johnson Associates you will:

  • Generate leads, communicate RLJA’s value proposition, and provide thought leadership to establish trusted advisor relationships.
  • Build and expand relationships within client and prospective client organizations, identifying who we know, who we need to know, and where stronger connections could create future opportunities.
  • Bring the right disciplines from across all GMB teams, specialists, market knowledge, and leadership into client relationships based on their needs and opportunities, including referendum planning and campaign support.
  • Maintain and strengthen client relationships throughout project execution.
  • Promote a culture of trust, creativity, and knowledge sharing through open communication and mentorship.
  • Oversee the transition from proposal and interview phases to project team formation with the Project Lead.
  • Collaborate with internal Client Lead and K-12 and Higher Ed teams across GMB’s Ecosystem of Teams to develop client leadership strategies and best practices.


What type of knowledge do I need to succeed in this role?
More than a specific degree and exact number of years of experience, we're most excited about what kind of knowledge you bring. For this role, we are seeking someone with an advanced knowledge level who works independently and identifies and proactively tackles challenges in their area.

Some components that may help indicate you are at this knowledge milestone include more tangible items like:

  • 10+ years of experience in AEC business development, sales, client relations, or related field.
  • Professional degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction Management, Educational Administration, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Experienced in identifying and pursuing new business opportunities in the education sector, with a history of winning significant projects.
  • Understanding of the marketing process, client interviews and relationship building strategies.
  • Communication/presentation skills to lead meetings with clients and facilitate user engagement.
  • Outstanding organization, collaboration, communication (both verbal and written) and planning skills. Ability to keep all stakeholders engaged and informed.
  • Understanding of project scope in relation to client contracts and any impacts to company liability.


What might set you apart from other candidates?

  • Certified Professional Services Marketer (CPSM) or similar credentials in sales and business development
  • Familiarity with referendum planning and campaigns
  • Familiarity with documentation tools (Revit, SketchUp) and graphic programs (InDesign, Adobe Creative Suite) as they relate to client presentations.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook and Teams
  • Experience with both K-12 and Higher Education markets


We might be a great match for each other if you are:

  • A self-starter with great time management skills who thrives in an environment with team-based decision making.
  • An individual who strives to learn and grow, is motivated by their team's success and works hard to ensure it.
  • Someone who enjoys trying new ideas and constantly improving.

What you might also like to know is that:

We're an employee-owned company. This means that 100% of the ownership at Richard L. Johnson Associates, a GMB team, is held by us as employees. Our creativity, skills, and expertise have a direct impact on our value and growth. Your role as a teammate will have a direct impact on the company's actions and result in a share in its profits.


We don’t operate within a hierarchical pyramid structure; instead, we operate like a network of teams that come together around specific goals working toward our overarching purpose. We think this is a better way to work and help everyone reach their potential.


Finally, we embrace a flexible workplace that empowers each person to decide where and how they work best. Our inclusive, people-first culture encourages teams to collaborate, communicate and find fulfillment personally and professionally, regardless of location or schedule.


This is a direct hire, full time, permanent position. Salary will be commensurate with experience, including an excellent benefit package. Must have current and continuing right to work in the United States without sponsorship. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Lærer til Stubbæk Skole udskolingen - barselsvikariet
description:
Er du læreruddannet og brænder du for at undervise i dansk, matematik og idræt i udskolingen? Kan man mærke i din undervisning, at du er en engageret og faglig kompetent lærer? Vil du være med til at sikre den fortsatte udvikling af en god skole og være medskaber af en god hverdag for vores 300 elever, deres forældre og kollegaer? Så er det måske netop dig vi står og mangler.

Barselsvikariatet er fuld tid og skemaet omfatter som udgangspunkt matematik i 9., dansk i 8., idræt i 9., lokale valgfag 8.-9. og billedkunst 5.-6.

Om Stubbæk Skole
Stubbæk Skole er placeret i et aktivt lokalsamfund lige uden for Aabenraa og har særdeles gode og velholdte faciliteter både inde og ude.
Vores skole er en velfungerende, mellemstor skole, hvor trivsel, faglige kompetencer og tydelige værdier vægtes højt. Skolen har et stærkt fundament og er et samlingspunkt for flere mindre bysamfund nær Aabenraa by. Vi nyder godt af, at vi som skole har et godt ry, og derfor oftest vælges til. Vi har gode ressourcer, og i de fleste af lektionerne er der to voksne i klassen.

Skolen har 0.- 9. klasse i ét til to spor, SFO og SFO2 og rummer 300 elever. Til at varetage undervisning og aktiviteter med vores elever er vi 50 medarbejdere på skolen.

På Stubbæk Skole er der en stabil og dygtig medarbejderstab, hvor erfaring og nytænkning går hånd i hånd. Med frihed under ansvar bidrager det pædagogiske personale med deres forskellige kompetencer i en positiv ånd. Hos os er vi ambitiøse på elevernes vegne og går gerne den ekstra mil for vores elever.

Om dig
Vi forventer, at du
  • kan skabe motivation og arbejdsglæde og du er kreativ og løsningsorienteret.
  • kan se værdien i et ligeværdigt, tæt og forpligtende samarbejde.
  • finder det relevant at have fokus på det gode fællesskab i klassen.
  • vil arbejde med, at alle elever møder passende udfordringer både fagligt og socialt.
  • er tydelig og omsorgsfuld og har blik for elevernes forskelligheder.
  • finder et tæt samarbejde med elevernes forældre naturligt og relevant.
  • er positiv og med til at skabe god stemning blandt elever og kolleger.

Hvad tilbyder vi til gengæld?
Hvis du bliver vores nye lærer, skal du arbejde på en skole
  • der kan mere for flere
  • hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden.
  • som ud fra et ressourceperspektiv har fokus på kerneopgaven
  • med fokus på elevers og medarbejderes trivsel
  • der prioriterer samarbejdet mellem skole og hjem højt
  • med en engageret og arbejdsom skolebestyrelse og forældregruppe
  • hvor der er en god stemning, og hvor der er plads til alle

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Tiltrædelse: 1. december 2026

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastlægges efter gældende overenskomst.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at der forud for ansættelsen vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest, og at ansættelse er betinget af, at disse er tilfredsstillende.

Vil du vide mere?
Interesserede ansøgere er velkomne til at kontakte skoleleder Morten Kier Asmussen for at høre mere om jobbet. Tlf: 23 29 53 83.
Vi bor på Stubbæk Skolegade 3, 6200 Aabenraa. Tlf.: 7376 8500.

Ansøgning
Send din ansøgning via linket senest den 25. oktober 2026.
Samtaler finder sted onsdag den 28. oktober fra 17.00 - 19.00

Kommunens mission er, at vi sammen skaber Det Gode Liv.
Er du tilflytter, vil vi gerne, at du falder hurtigt og godt til. Derfor har vi en række tilbud til dig - og dem der eventuelt flytter med.

title: Energy Marshal
description:
South Bend, IN | Data Center Construction | General Contractor

We are working with a General Contractor delivering a major 350,000 sq. ft. data center development in the South Bend area and are looking to appoint an experienced Energy Marshal to join the project team.

This is a critical site-based role responsible for managing and overseeing energy isolation, energization and electrical safety procedures throughout construction, startup and commissioning.

Recent data center or mission-critical construction experience is essential.

The Role

The Energy Marshal will work closely with the project team, electrical contractors, commissioning teams and client representatives to ensure all energized and de-energized work is planned, controlled and carried out safely.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Managing and enforcing Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures across the project

  • Coordinating energy isolation and energization activities

  • Reviewing and approving switching procedures, energization plans and Methods of Procedure

  • Maintaining energy isolation records, permits and tracking documentation

  • Verifying systems are safely isolated before work begins

  • Coordinating electrical shutdowns, startups and power transitions

  • Supporting commissioning and system energization activities

  • Conducting field audits and ensuring compliance with energy control procedures

  • Coordinating closely with electrical contractors, commissioning teams, Superintendents and Project Managers

  • Ensuring compliance with site safety procedures, OSHA requirements and NFPA 70E

  • Communicating changes in system status and energization activities across the wider project team

  • Identifying risks associated with energized systems and driving corrective action where required

Systems May Include

  • Medium and low-voltage electrical distribution

  • Switchgear and switchboards

  • UPS systems

  • Generators and paralleling gear

  • Transformers

  • Busway and electrical distribution equipment

  • Mechanical plant and associated powered systems

  • Temporary and permanent power systems

What We’re Looking For

  • Recent data center or mission-critical construction experience is essential

  • Previous Energy Marshal, Electrical Safety, Commissioning or similar experience

  • Strong understanding of LOTO and hazardous energy control

  • Experience supporting energization and commissioning of complex electrical systems

  • Strong knowledge of electrical construction and site safety procedures

  • Familiarity with NFPA 70E and OSHA electrical safety requirements

  • Ability to review switching procedures, MOPs and energy isolation plans

  • Strong communication skills and confidence coordinating multiple contractors and project stakeholders

  • Ability to work full-time on site in the South Bend area

This is an opportunity to take ownership of energy control and safe energization activities across a major ground-up data center project.

If you have recent data center experience and a strong background in electrical safety, commissioning or energy isolation, we would be keen to speak with you.

description:

Wie ben jij?
We zijn op zoek naar gedreven collega’s die de grenzen willen verleggen op het gebied van cybersecurity en een sleutelrol willen spelen in het beschermen van organisaties tegen digitale dreigingen. Bij Sopra Steria krijg je de kans om te werken aan impactvolle projecten en je vaardigheden te ontwikkelen in een constructieve teamomgeving. Jij wilt tot de besten behoren. Dat is waarom jij altijd naar manieren zoekt om jouw kennis uit te breiden en op de hoogte te blijven van de laatste trends en ontwikkelingen.

Wat breng jij mee?

  • Minimaal 7 jaar ervaring als cybersecurity consultant of in een vergelijkbare rol.

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bij voorkeur met focus op IT of cybersecurity.

  • Certificeringen zoals CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor of ISO 27001 Lead Implementer.

  • Een proactieve houding met een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring met projectleiding en het coachen van teamleden.

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en commercieel inzicht.

  • Affiniteit met zowel technische inhoud als strategische vraagstukken.

  • Vloeiend Nederlands en goede beheersing van het Engels.

Herken je jezelf in (de meeste van) deze punten? Dan kijken we alvast uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

Dit krijg je van ons
Bij Sopra Steria zorgen we ervoor dat jij je werk met plezier én in balans kunt doen. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een vast contract;

  • Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. Zo zorgen we voor een eerlijke en transparante beloning die past bij jouw achtergrond en de impact van je rol.
  • Vakantiegeld van 8%;
  • Een winstdelingsregeling met een target-uitkering van 8% van het bruto (parttime) jaarsalaris, afhankelijk van bedrijfsresultaten;
  • Een mobiliteitsregeling met de keuze uit een elektrische leaseauto of een alternatieve vervoersregeling, passend bij jouw situatie;
  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen aan- of te verkopen;
  • Flexibele hybride werkomstandigheden: thuis, op kantoor of bij de klant, afhankelijk van de functie en de mogelijkheden binnen opdrachten;
  • Een thuiswerkpakket met laptop, telefoon en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Volop mogelijkheden voor professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling via trainingen, certificeringen, kennissessies en inspirerende events;
  • Diverse sociale activiteiten met collega’s, van informele borrels tot sportieve en inhoudelijke evenementen;

  • Een pensioenregeling met een werkgeversbijdrage en de mogelijkheid om vrijwillig aanvullende pensioenopbouw te realiseren.

Lijkt deze job iets voor jou?
Zie je het al voor je? Verschillende projecten, nationaal en internationaal. Een team dat je inspireert en jij in het middelpunt van dit alles. Zo is het om bij Sopra Steria te werken. Bovendien maak je deel uit van een team dat er alles aan doet om impact te maken bij onze klanten.

Ben je klaar om samen met ons de wereld vorm te geven? Fantastisch! We kijken nu al uit naar jouw sollicitatie.

______

Sopra Steria is een werkgever die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in aanmerking genomen voor een job zonder rekening te houden met leeftijd, afkomst, nationaliteit, huidskleur, verlof voor familie- of medische zorg, geslachtsidentiteit of -uitdrukking, genetische informatie, immigratiestatus, burgerlijke staat, medische toestand, nationale herkomst, fysieke of mentale handicap, politieke voorkeur, beschermde veteranen- of militaire status, ras, etniciteit, religie, geslacht (inclusief zwangerschap), seksuele geaardheid of enig ander kenmerk dat wordt beschermd door toepasselijke lokale wetten, voorschriften en verordeningen. We koesteren een werkomgeving die inclusief is en alle verschillen respecteert.

title: Member Success Representative
description:
Who We Are

For over 20 years, SPINS has been a leader in recognizing the transformative power of data in retail. We offer our clients cutting-edge tools to attract attention from a fast-growing segment within the Health & Wellness industry, the values-based consumer. Nearly half of shoppers prioritize products that emphasize wellness, social responsibility, and sustainable practices. SPINS retail consumer insights, analytics, and consulting services give our clients a competitive advantage to increase their share of this growing market. Our data is the most comprehensive and accurate in the industry, allowing clients to power AI models and machine learning algorithms that help them better understand and meet their customers' needs. At SPINS, behind all of our impressive data is our real differentiator, our people. We pride ourselves on our collaborative, flexible, and communicative culture that puts people at the center of everything we do.

Member Success Representative

The Member Success Representative serves as a primary point of contact for SPINS IX ONE members throughout their relationship with our organization. This role goes beyond traditional customer support. Member Success Representatives are responsible for helping members successfully navigate the SPINS IX-ONE Platform, understand their membership, resolve account and operational challenges, and receive the guidance needed to get value from our services.

This is a relationship-focused role that requires strong communication, organization, judgment, and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing multiple accounts and priorities, communicating with members by email and phone, navigating difficult or sensitive conversations, and coordinating across internal teams to drive issues through resolution.

Member Success Representatives support members across onboarding, product submission, platform adoption, billing and account questions, renewals, retention, and ongoing membership needs.

What You’ll Do

Own the Member Experience

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for assigned and incoming member inquiries.
  • Manage member cases from initial outreach through resolution using our CRM platform.
  • Provide timely, clear, and professional communication through email, phone, and scheduled meetings.
  • Take ownership of member concerns by identifying the issue, determining the appropriate path forward, and coordinating with internal teams when escalation is required.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed CRM documentation, including member communications, decisions, next steps, and account activity.
  • Proactively follow up with members rather than waiting for them to re-engage.

Support New Member Onboarding

  • Guide new members through their first 60 days with SPINS IX-ONE.
  • Help members understand platform access, available resources, product submission requirements, and next steps.
  • Educate members on the SPINS IX-ONE Platform and available support resources.
  • Monitor onboarding progress and identify accounts that may require additional outreach or intervention.
  • Help members understand product submission and Professional Capture requirements, including required product information, and shipping processes.
  • Set clear expectations around product processing, publication, review, and ongoing account support.

Manage Renewals and Retention

  • Support assigned membership renewals and communicate renewal information to members.
  • Confidently explain membership pricing, services, and overall value.
  • Have professional conversations with members regarding pricing increases, billing concerns, account changes, and renewal questions.
  • Identify potential cancellation or retention risks and work with leadership and appropriate internal partners to determine next steps.
  • Conduct proactive outreach to non-responsive or at-risk members.
  • Escalate pricing exceptions, contractual questions, or complex retention situations when appropriate.
  • Ensure renewal and retention activity is accurately documented within the CRM.

Resolve Account and Billing Questions

  • Assist members with questions related to invoices, payment status, account standing, and membership status.
  • Partner with Finance, Billing, Sales, and other internal teams to resolve account discrepancies or outstanding issues.
  • Help members understand next steps when an account is past due, suspended, inactive, or requires additional action before services can resume.
  • Recognize when a question requires specialized support and route or escalate appropriately while maintaining ownership of the member experience.

Provide Platform and Product Guidance

  • Educate members on the SPINS IX-ONE Platform and available tools and resources.
  • Assist members with product submission questions and general workflow guidance.
  • Help identify and remove blockers preventing members from successfully submitting, updating, or publishing product content.
  • Provide general guidance related to retailer and distributor participation within the SPINS IX-ONE ecosystem.
  • Help members understand where specialized services such as GDSN, Product Capture, Data Maintenance, or technical support fit into their overall membership.

Collaborate Across Teams

Member Success works closely with teams across the organization, including:

  • Sales
  • Finance and Billing
  • Sales Enablement
  • Product
  • Product Capture and Studio Operations
  • Quality Assurance
  • GDSN Support
  • Data Operations
  • Technology and Platform Support

The Member Success Representative is expected to coordinate across these teams while maintaining clear ownership and communication with the member.

What We’re Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ year of experience in Customer Success, Member Success, Account Management, Client Services, Customer Support, or a similar customer-facing role.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable speaking directly with customers by phone and video.
  • Ability to confidently navigate difficult, sensitive, or potentially escalated customer conversations.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, cases, and follow-ups simultaneously.
  • Ability to investigate issues, gather information, and determine an appropriate path toward resolution.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate documentation.
  • Comfortable learning multiple systems, workflows, and business processes.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while remaining highly collaborative with the broader team.
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection and the ability to work Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Customer Success or Account Management within a SaaS, data, retail, CPG, technology, or membership-based organization.
  • Experience working with retailers, distributors, brands, manufacturers, or consumer packaged goods companies.
  • Experience managing renewals, retention, or customer account health.
  • Experience discussing pricing, contracts, invoices, or account status with customers.
  • Experience using CRM or case-management platforms.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Teams, SharePoint, Excel, and related business tools.
  • Familiarity with product content, product data, UPC/GTIN information, GDSN, or product syndication is a plus but not required.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Enjoy building relationships and helping customers solve problems.
  • Are comfortable saying, “I don’t know yet, but I will find the answer,” and then following through.
  • Can explain complicated processes in a simple and approachable way.
  • Know how to remain professional and solutions-focused when a customer is frustrated.
  • Are comfortable discussing money, pricing, billing, and renewals without avoiding difficult conversations.
  • Take ownership rather than simply passing an issue to another team.
  • Are naturally organized and diligent about follow-up.
  • Can balance empathy for the customer with company policies and business requirements.
  • Adapt well when products, processes, and procedures evolve.
  • Enjoy working collaboratively across multiple departments.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Member Success Representatives create a member experience where customers understand what is happening, what they need to do next, and who is helping them.

Success in this role means:

  • Members receive timely and accurate responses.
  • Cases are actively managed through resolution.
  • Follow-ups do not fall through the cracks.
  • New members successfully complete onboarding.
  • Members understand the value of their SPINS IX-ONE membership.
  • Renewal risks are identified early.
  • Difficult conversations are handled professionally and confidently.
  • CRM records clearly reflect member history and next steps.
  • Internal teams receive the information they need to resolve escalated issues.
  • Members feel that someone is taking ownership of their experience.

Compensation

The hourly compensation range for this position is $21.00–$23.00 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

This is a remote position with working hours of 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, Monday through Friday.

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-AO1 #LI-Hybrid

What SPINS Offers

We have enjoyed tremendous growth over the years and, as a leader in a fast-growing industry, we have no plans to slow down! While all that growth brings excitement, it is also an opportunity for SPINS to show it values the health and wellness of its team members.

  • We embrace hybrid work options so that you have the flexibility to create a work/life balance that actually works!
  • Each employee is allotted paid time to use to volunteer with an organization of their choice and charitable donations are matched.
  • Semi-annual company-wide employee survey that is used to shape company programs, perks, and culture.

The SPINS Way

  • Direct – We communicate with clarity, honesty and respect in all situations and embrace opportunities to provide solution-oriented feedback.
  • Determined – We are committed to overcoming all obstacles to achieve results. We adapt to change, seek opportunities to learn and rapidly translate that learning into action.
  • Passionate – We go above and beyond to help our partners achieve their goals. We challenge assumptions and are comfortable forging new paths.
  • Collaborative – We leave our egos at the door, believing that working together we will produce an outcome that’s greater than each individual contribution.

For details about the information SPINS’s collects about our applicants and how we use it, please see the SPINS Privacy Policy here.

title: Die Cutting Operator 1 Night Shift (56406)
description:
Get to Know Us

About Mill Rock Packaging

Mill Rock Packaging Partners is a specialty packaging growth platform formed in August 2020 by Mill Rock Capital to invest in growing businesses with advanced service and product capabilities in the consumer packaging industry. MRP’s operations include production facilities located in Renton, WA, Aurora, CO, Salt Lake City, UT, St Paul, Hutchinson, MN and most recently Hartford, CT. (

About Impressions

Impressions, based in St. Paul, MN and founded in 1967, is a market leader in the design, engineering and production of high-end paperboard packaging and commercial printing products for a variety of end markets. The company’s core offering spans a broad range of high-end, ecofriendly, customized folding cartons for consumer staples, pharmaceuticals, health and beauty and other daily-use products. Impressions offers lithographic printing and a host of value-added services, including product engineering, prototyping and post-print production. The company operates state-of-the-art production facilities in St. Paul and Hutchinson, MN.

Opportunity

Mill Rock Packaging is excited to start our search for our new Die Cutting Assistant to support our Operations Teams in setting up tooling, assisting in machine change-overs, and moving loads in and out of the die cutter. This list of duties and responsibilities is not all inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties:

  • Assist the Die Cutting Operator by preparing loads for die cutting, checking product part number and loading stock into the feeder.
  • Off-load die cutter and inspect every load of die cut product for die cutting and printing errors.
  • Perform quality checks in full compliance with all requirements of the quality system.
  • Use centerline system to perform proper tooling setups.
  • Setup top strippers, bottom stripping pins, as well as top and bottom blankers.
  • Store die cutting tooling and maintain order in the tooling storage areas.
  • Maintain a clean and organized work area, clean die cutters, tooling and die cutting area during idle times.
  • Assist with routine die cutter maintenance, including thoroughly cleaning machine during scheduled maintenance times.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Job Essentials

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities

  • Possess an ability to work together as a Die Cutting Team and embrace how your job impacts the whole team. You are the person “behind the scenes” making it happen.
  • Can accept feedback and use it to grow in your position.
  • Adept at working with your hands on tooling and machines.
  • Must have basic computer skills or the ability to learn basic skills.
  • Excellent endurance to stand and move about the work area all day.
  • Must be able to lift up to 35-40 pounds.

Cultural Traits

  • Passionate and positive “can do” attitude and loves to work with your hands.
  • Show a willingness to work overtime when the workload makes it necessary to cover others on vacation or absent or help get a big job out the door.

Work Environment

Work exclusively in the production area, with light and heavy equipment where you stand and walk during your entire shift. Bending, lifting and reaching as needed. Exposed to elevated noise levels throughout work shift, hearing protection use is mandatory while in production area. May bend, squat, climb up onto the machine as needed for general maintenance and set up, or as directed by the Die Cutting Operator.

title: Medicare Risk Adjustment Compliance Auditor (CPC, CCS, or CCS-P Required)
description:
Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. It takes an entire team of passionate and caring people, united in our mission to put the senior first.We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. In this fast-growing company, you will find ample room for growth and innovation alongside the Alignment Health community. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together.

The Remote Risk Adjustment Compliance Auditor is to conduct provider and coder level reviews and audits to ensure accurate risk adjustment data is being submitted to the CMS. Develops and maintains tracking tools, reviews and audits outcomes / findings and monitors any corrective active plans implemented due to review or audit findings. Monitors internal reporting for outliers, stays up to date with CMS audit processes and actively participates in all audits as they relate to risk adjustment.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

1. Monitors coding prevalence reporting for coding outliers.
2. Reviews IPA Policies and procedures to ensure programs are compliant.
3. Monitors internal coding staff accuracy percentages to ensure they are tracked and maintained.
4. Monitors coding vendor’s accuracy percentages to ensure the coding accuracy and quality of the data submitted to CMS.
5. Works with Risk Adjustment Management on any data validation and /or RADV coding audit(s) to ensure completeness and coding accuracy of all submissions to CMS.
6. Maintains a comprehensive tracking and management tool for Risk Adjustment Compliance.
7. Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state & and local regulations, as well as institutional/organizational standards, practices, policies & procedures.
8. Works with Risk Adjustment Management to monitor HCC Corrective Action Plans as needed.
9. Suggests customizations of Risk Adjustment education for support staff, PCPs, specialists, employees, contracted employees and central departments.
10. Utilizes, protects, and discloses Alignment Healthcare patients’ protected health information (PHI) only in accordance with Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) standards.
11. Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies.
12. Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
13. Represents the department in RADV and other risk adjustment related audits.
14. Other duties as assigned to meet the organization’s needs.

Job Requirements:

Experience:

• Required: Minimum 3 years of professional coding experience in a medical group or health plan setting.

• Preferred: None.

Education:

• Required: Bachelor’s degree in business administration, health care management or in a related field or 4 years additional experience in lieu of education.

• Preferred: None.

Training:

• Required: Certified Coder required - CPC, CCS & CCS-P.

• Preferred: Certified Auditor.

Specialized Skills:

• Required:

  • Experience with strategic planning in risk mitigation.
  • Previous use of Epic, Allscripts, EZCap a plus.
  • Proficient user in MS office suite, MS access a plus.
  • Ability to communicate positively, professionally and effectively with others; provide leadership, teach and collaborate with others.
  • Effective written and oral communication skills; ability to establish and maintain a constructive relationship with diverse members, management, employees and vendors;
  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to perform mathematical calculations and calculate simple statistics correctly
  • Reasoning Skills: Ability to prioritize multiple tasks; advanced problem-solving; ability to use advanced reasoning to define problems, collect data, establish facts, draw valid conclusions, and design, implement and manage appropriate resolution.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Effective problem solving, organizational and time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Report Analysis Skills: Comprehend and analyze statistical reports.

Licensure:

• Required: Certified Coder required - CPC, CCS & CCS-P.

• Preferred: None.

Essential Physical Functions:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

1. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee regularly is required to stand, walk, sit, use hand to finger, handle or feel objects, tools, or controls; and reach with hands and arms.

2. The employee frequently lifts and/or moves up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Pay Range: $64,384.00 - $96,577.00

Pay range may be based on a number of factors including market location, education, responsibilities, experience, etc.

Alignment Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation.
