title: ROI Service Administrator
description:
Overview

The ROI Service Admin is responsible for fielding inbound inquiries regarding release of information (ROI) requests for medical records while maintaining consistent excellent customer service standards. The ROI Service Admin provides issue resolution, status updates concerning requests for medical records, and posts corrective actions in the corporate database to facilitate timely release of information processing. The ROI Service Admin will work within ROI Online and various Electronic Medical Systems.

Responsibilities

  • Receives inbound phone inquiries from requesters regarding medical records.
  • Answers questions regarding status of the request. Ensures that calls are answered promptly and courteously within prescribed standards and metrics.
  • Works with Supervisor to escalate complex elevated issues.
  • Maintains and ensures positive relationships with clients (hospitals) and requestors of ROI (attorneys, insurance companies, state disability offices, record copy services, peer organizations, doctor’s offices, and others).
  • Maintains strong knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, state/federal rulings, and statutes, as well as facility requirements and nuances.
  • Participates in weekly customer service meetings to assess, discuss, and analyze trends, training opportunities, skill enhancement and client/requester issues.
  • Access and navigate through multiple EMR(s) systems to check status of inbound phone inquiries from requesters.
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.
  • College courses beneficial but not required.
  • Experience with MRO daily processes and model. 6 months’ experience preferred.
  • Ability to make independent decisions and apply critical thinking based on practical knowledge and business acumen.
  • Computer knowledge. Accurate data entry skills and attention to detail.
  • Prior customer service experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong problem-solving skills.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and capacity to build effective relationships with co-workers and requesters.
  • Ability to work effectively and independently in high volume production environments.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in verbal communication.

This job function requires the ability to sit, while using a computer, for extended periods of time.

*This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. It does not prescribe or reflect the tasks that may be assigned.

Total CompensationBase pay is one element of the total compensation package. Eligible employees may also have access to a comprehensive benefits offering, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and a 401(k) plan.

Salary RangeIt is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range. Individual pay may be influenced by factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and internal equity.

Applicant Privacy Notice

Pay Range

USD $16.00 - USD $22.00 /Hr.

title: Department Supervisor - Dayton Mall
description:
About the Role

As a Department Supervisor, you will be responsible for for supporting the Sales and Profit goals in the store by executing a plan to deliver the Best Customer Experience in the department and overall store. The Department Supervisor will work in accordance with legal requirements and H&M standards, policies, and procedures to meet the expectations of customers and colleagues.

A Day in the Life

Working at H&M means no two days are ever the same, but a typical day will include the following responsibilities*

Customer Sales & Profit

  • You are responsible for supporting the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to global guidelines.
  • Representing yourself and the H&M brand positively during customer interactions
  • Be aware of and take responsibility of your department's strengths and identifying commercial opportunities and working with your Department Manager to act on them
  • Ensure customer service is provided in all areas of the store and that your team has the ability to work towards actively promoting and selling products to customers
  • Following up that your team is actively promoting our Customer Loyalty App (Hello Member) & in-store sustainability initiatives
  • Ensure correct routines in fitting room and checkout, including transaction, returns and exchanges
  • Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way


Fashion & Trend Awareness

  • Keep up-to-date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors and relevant influencers, etc
  • Ensure your team provides product and fashion knowledge as well as other relevant information during customer interactions


Team & Development

  • Retain and share your knowledge and skills with the Store team
  • Collaboration, planning & teamwork with in-store Visual Merchandiser team
  • Give & receive feedback with your colleagues to learn, develop & support each other
  • Regular communication to store colleagues to inform, motivate and inspire – daily, weekly meetings, etc
  • Ensure all procedures, routines, and legal requirements in all areas of the store are followed


Retail Operations/ Visual & Commercial Execution

  • Secure a clean and tidy sales floor and back of house including stockroom areas
  • Ensure high fashion quality, visual and commercial product presentation, with good garment care
  • Secure good stock levels and provide input on allocation to Area team
  • Ensure the full garment cycle – from delivery to garment presentation – and fitting room routines are according to our standards and routines set internally, utilizing all tools and technology provided
  • Upkeep & follow best practice for any in-store OMNI Services & in-store tech services/tools, etc (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store etc)
  • Secure a strong balance and the maintenance of price signs in-store and throughout the sales floor/store following guidelines according to global and local strategies & sales market/regional requirements to ensure a strong and consistent price perception throughout store
  • Updating & upkeep of BOH Areas for all colleagues (key information, health & safety, tidiness etc)
  • Responsible for opening & closing of store daily

Who You Are

  • To be a successful and effective Department Supervisor, you’ll be an emerging leader who enjoys taking responsibility.
  • You must be ambitious, an effective communicator, supportive, an analytical solution finder, capable of working with numbers and managing statistics.
  • You are achievement-oriented, motivated by performance and competition to be truly customer centric.


Why You’ll Love Working at H&M

  • We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability
  • We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years
  • You’ll have access to our Colleague Resource Groups (CRGs) to find community and networking opportunities among colleagues
  • We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work
  • You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits
  • We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness and family support programs, company match retirement plan, paid leave programs, and paid time off, including a community day to serve your local community
  • You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M, & Other Stories, and COS

Compensation: expected base salary range is $17.05-$19.86 hourly**
EEOC Code: SLS
Pay Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly


*This job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job and is not all-inclusive. There may be additional duties, and responsibilities assigned for this job at the company’s discretion.

**H&M, in good faith, has assessed this posted range of compensation as the accurate range for this role and location at the time of this posting. H&M may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range depending on candidate qualifications. This range may be modified in the future.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact us at https://hm.ethicspoint.com, and use Ask a Question.

Benefits:

We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment type and countries.

We offer: 25% Staff Discount - Medical, Pharmacy Vision and Dental Coverage – Employee Assistance Program - Vacation, Wellness, Holiday and Parental Pay – 401K – Commuter Benefits, Health and Dependent Care FSA. Plus, additional Voluntary Benefits.

Inclusion & Diversity:

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.

We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

Company Description:

At H&M, our purpose is to liberate fashion for the many. We want to shape a new world in Fashion. A world with one ultimate goal: to unleash your self-expression. As an H&M colleague, you’re encouraged to be yourself & more. You’ll take on new responsibilities from day one, learn skills for life, and find new ways to make your big dreams come true.

Our company is committed to fostering a culture of inclusion and belonging, and we actively seek colleagues who share our commitment.

title: Ophthalmic Technician
description:
Join Our Growing Ophthalmology Team as an Ophthalmic Technician!


Hours of Practice are Mon-Fri 7:30a-5p. Up to 29 hours per week. We need 3 days a week for this role.


Likely travel to Hatboro and Collegeville


Our established multi-specialty Ophthalmology group is seeking a skilled professional to join our friendly and dedicated team. If you're passionate about providing exceptional patient care and eager to grow in a supportive environment, we want to hear from you!


Your Impact:

  • Elevate patient care: Work closely with our ophthalmologists to gather comprehensive patient information, ensuring accurate diagnoses and personalized treatment plans.
  • Master ophthalmic testing: Conduct thorough preliminary examinations, including visual acuity, pupillary responses, and more.
  • Perform advanced diagnostics: Administer a range of diagnostic tests, such as OCT, perimetry, and ophthalmic photography.
  • Assist in surgical procedures: Support ophthalmologists during minor surgeries, laser procedures, and crosslinking.
  • Streamline patient flow: Efficiently manage patient flow in clinic and imaging rooms, collaborating with clinical staff.
  • Administer eye drops: (Certification Required)
  • Contribute to clinic efficiency: Perform clinical and administrative tasks, ensuring a smooth and organized workflow.

What You'll Bring/Requirements:

  • A passion for patient care and a commitment to excellence.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Proven experience as an Ophthalmic Technician.
  • Knowledge of medical office procedures.
  • Ability to perform indirect activities, administrative tasks and any other assigned duties that contribute to the efficient & high-quality performance of the medical practice.
  • High School Diploma or equivalent.

Bonus Points:

  • Certified Ophthalmic Assistant (COA) Certification.

Key Skills:

  • Reliability and a strong work ethic.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with a diverse team.
  • Proficiency in data entry and typing.
  • Outstanding customer service skills.

We Care: We prioritize patients, colleagues, and families with compassionate, leading care and treat all with dignity and respect.

We Collaborate: We work together with patients, seeking diverse input to share and grow innovative ideas.

We Elevate: Committed to excellence, we exceed expectations by delivering leading eye care research, innovation, education, and outreach.

Refocus is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity.

title: Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa, hlavný pracovný pomer 38,75h týždenne, Trnava City Arena
description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ
Ako Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

  • Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
  • Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
  • Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
  • Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
  • A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

  • Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
  • Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

  • Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
  • Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
  • Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

  • 25 %zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v predajniach aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
  • H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.
  • Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
  • Športová karta Multisport,
  • Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
  • Rozsiahly program školení,
  • Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
  • Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
  • Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
  • Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
  • Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
  • Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
  • 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Ide o pozíciu na hlavný pracovný úväzok v rozsahu 38,75 hodín týždenne. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, s nerovnomerne rozvrhnutou pracovnou dobou, pričom sa pracuje na ranné aj poobedné zmeny počas pracovného týždňa.

Miesto výkonu práce je v Trnave.

Mzdové ohodnotenie je 1040 € brutto/mesiac, vrátane príplatku za víkend nad rámec zákona.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 14.10.2026.

Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­­­­­­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

title: Outpatient Psychiatrist (Adult or Child & Adolescent)
description:
At LifeStance Health, we believe in a truly healthy society where mental and physical healthcare are unified to make lives better. Our mission is to help people lead healthier, more fulfilling lives by improving access to trusted, affordable, and personalized mental healthcare. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in behavioral health.
Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing behavioral health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our clinical team!

We are seeking a part-time (15+ hours/week) or full-time (30+ hours/week) Adult Psychiatrist or Child & Adolescent Psychiatrist to join our growing outpatient group in Sacramento, California, with additional locations across the surrounding area for convenient commuting.

This is an opportunity to practice psychiatry your way—with flexibility, autonomy, and strong clinical support in a modern, patient-centered environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide outpatient psychiatric care to adult or child/adolescent populations
  • Customize your practice: medication management, psychotherapy, or a blend
  • Set your own pace: determine your preferred caseload and patient volume
  • Collaborate with a supportive, multidisciplinary team

Compensation & Benefits

  • Compensation range of $375,000 to $440,000, compensation model based on productivity.
  • Sign-On Bonus

title: Senior Solution Architect
description:
We are looking for a Senior Solution Architect to act as the technical bridge between client and market requirements and our Development & Integration delivery teams.

Positioned at the heart of execution, you ensure that proposed solutions are architected, built, and integrated effectively, safeguarding quality, consistency, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

You provide technical credibility throughout the sales cycle and translate customer needs and commercial commitments into realistic, sustainable solutions that our delivery teams can successfully implement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Bid & Proposal Support: Lead technical responses to RFPs, RFIs, and tenders, including solution design, technical documentation, architecture diagrams, effort estimation, and risk identification. Ensure a clear and well-documented handover of won opportunities to the Development & Integration teams, preserving the technical intent and commitments made to the client.
  • Solution Definition: Take ownership of the solution architecture from bid handover through delivery, ensuring that the solution delivered remains aligned with agreed client requirements.
  • Feasibility & Estimation: Assess the technical feasibility of proposed solutions in collaboration with delivery teams, ensuring that scope, cost, timelines, and technical assumptions are realistic.
  • Solution Architecture: Design end-to-end solution architectures across applications, integrations, data, and infrastructure that are technically sound, cost-effective, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Integration Architecture: Design robust integration solutions using APIs, middleware, event-driven patterns, and data flows to connect client systems, internal platforms, and third-party services.
  • Delivery Governance: Define and promote architecture standards, design patterns, and technical guardrails across development and integration projects.
  • Technical Leadership: Guide development squads and integration teams on architecture decisions and facilitate design and architecture reviews throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Risk & Quality: Identify technical risks early, recommend mitigation strategies, and safeguard non-functional requirements including performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Vendor & Tooling: Contribute to the evaluation and selection of integration platforms, middleware, and development tooling in line with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Cross-Project Consistency: Promote architectural consistency, reusable patterns, and knowledge sharing across multiple development and integration projects.
  • Client Technical Relationship: Act as a trusted technical point of contact for clients during delivery, supporting discussions around architecture, scope, technical decisions, and change requests.
  • Extensive experience in solution architecture, software architecture, or technical leadership within software development and systems integration environments.
  • Strong knowledge of application architecture, API and integration design, and modern software engineering practices, including microservices, event-driven architecture, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating business and commercial requirements into concrete, feasible technical solutions and delivery plans.
  • Experience providing architecture guidance or governance across multiple projects and development teams.
  • Solid understanding of non-functional requirements, including performance, scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Experience with integration platforms and patterns such as ESB, iPaaS, API gateways, and message brokers.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks and modelling approaches such as TOGAF, ArchiMate, UML, or the C4 model.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with both business and commercial stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Relevant certifications, such as TOGAF or cloud and integration certifications such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud or MuleSoft, are an advantage rather than a requirement.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • You build strong connections between clients, commercial stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams.
  • You can translate commercial requirements and commitments into pragmatic and achievable technical solutions.
  • You provide clear technical direction while enabling development and integration teams to take ownership.
  • You combine a strong focus on quality and long-term maintainability with a pragmatic approach to delivery.
  • You are comfortable navigating evolving requirements and finding the right balance between client expectations, technical feasibility, and delivery constraints.
  • You communicate complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: AI Engineer
description:
Om stillingen

Er du nysgjerrig, kreativ og liker å følge med på den nyeste teknologien og takten i KI-utviklingen? Vi søker nå en AI Engineer som vil være med å utvikle agentiske systemer som skaper reell forretningsverdi.

Hos Sopra Steria blir du en del av et inspirerende og inkluderende miljø – et av Norges råeste tech-miljøer – hvor vi kombinerer utfordrende prosjekter med en kultur preget av nysgjerrighet, læring og samarbeid. Her bygger vi KI-løsninger som går fra chatbot til autonom agent – fra pilot til produksjon. Hos oss vil du bidra i varierte oppdrag på tvers av bransjer og sektorer, og være med på å utvikle sammen med noen av Norges fremste fageksperter.

Vi ser etter deg som vet hvordan man får språkmodeller til å slutte å bruke tankestrek.

Ansvarsområder

  • LLM og Agentutvikling: Du vil designe og implementere intelligente agenter ved hjelp av moderne rammeverk som LangGraph og Anthropic Agents SDK. Du bygger systemer som kan planlegge, resonnere og utføre handlinger autonomt.
  • RAG-arkitektur: Du utvikler avanserte RAG-løsninger (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) som kombinerer store språkmodeller med bedriftsdata for å skape presise og pålitelige svar.
  • MCP og A2A-protokoller: Du jobber med Model Context Protocol for standardisert verktøytilgang og Agent-to-Agent kommunikasjon for orkestrering mellom flere agenter.
  • Governance og sikkerhet: Du implementerer guardrails, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) godkjenningsflyter, og komplett sporbarhet gjennom tracing for alle agentoperasjoner.
  • Prompt Engineering og Evaluering: Du optimaliserer prompts, setter opp evalueringsrammeverk og måler agentytelse systematisk.

I prosjektene våre vil du kombinere denne tekniske kompetansen med evnen til å forstå kundens behov, samarbeide godt med ulike fagmiljøer og levere løsninger som er robuste, optimaliserte og som skaper tydelig verdi for kundene våre.

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Høyere utdanning innen IT, datateknologi, maskinlæring eller beslektede fagområder.
  • Teknisk erfaring med språkmodeller og erfaring med API-kommunikasjon.
  • Sterk programmeringskompetanse i Python, med erfaring fra agentrammeverk (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, eller lignende).
  • Kjennskap til RAG-arkitektur, vektordatabaser og embedding-teknologier.
  • Erfaring med skyplattformer som Azure (Azure OpenAI), AWS, eller Google Cloud.
  • Fordel med erfaring fra MCP, A2A-protokoller, eller multi-agent systemer.
  • Vi setter pris på erfaring innen AgentOps, LLMOps, MLOps og selv-hostede modeller.
  • Norsk, minimum B2 nivå.

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er faglig sterk og har en genuin interesse for KI
  • Du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og deler gjerne kunnskap
  • Du trives i møte med ulike mennesker og samarbeider tett med både kunder og kollegaer
  • Du kommuniserer klart og skaper tillit i dialog med andre

title: Bygningskonstruktør
description:
Ambitiøs profil til afdelingen ”Design & Bæredygtighed”

Vil du gerne arbejde i en kvalitetsbevidst entreprenørvirksomhed, hvor fokus er på innovativt og bæredygtigt byggeri?

Vil du gerne arbejde i en virksomhed, som dyrker fagligheden og giver medarbejderne gode udviklingsmuligheder?

Så kan det være dig, vi søger til jobbet som Bygningskonstruktør i Daugaard Pedersen A/S’ afdeling for Design & Bæredygtighed.

Virksomheden

Daugaard Pedersen er en velkonsolideret entreprenørvirksomhed med hovedkontor i Kolding. Virksomheden arbejder med erhvervsbyggeri – produktion, kontor/domicil, butik og lager/logistik -samt boligprojekter i hele Danmark.

Daugaard Pedersen har en fin referenceliste og en solid kundebase. Aktuelt er virksomheden i gang med en række spændende byggerier, og den kommende periode byder på flere gode projekter, hvortil der er behov for at styrke organisationen langsigtet.

Virksomheden beskæftiger ca. 45 medarbejdere med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding. Læs mere om virksomheden på

Jobbet

Som Bygningskonstruktør får du en spændende og afvekslende hverdag, hvor du bliver dybt involveret i at skabe bæredygtige byggeprojekter. Du vil blive udfordret fagligt, og det forventes, at du tager ansvar, udfordrer og bidrager til at sikre høj kvalitet i byggeprojekterne.

Du kommer bl.a. til at arbejde med udarbejdelse af følgende:

· Disponeringsforslag fra indledende volumenstudier til skitseforslag

· Salgsvisualiseringer

· Myndighedsprojekter samt håndtering af myndighedsdialog

· Udførselsprojekter

· Bygningsdelsdetaljer (arkitektdetaljer)

· Sikring af bygbarhed og koordinering med eksterne rådgivere og leverandører

· Tværfaglig sparring med egen byggeledelse og kalkulation

Din daglige gang bliver på kontoret i Kolding. Der vil i et vist omfang være mulighed for hjemmearbejde efter en indkøringsperiode.

Personen

Du har et stærkt fagligt fundament. Uanset om du lige er blevet færdiguddannet eller har flere års erfaring fra en arkitekt- eller ingeniørvirksomhed, vil der være masser af muligheder for at udvikle dig hos Daugaard Pedersen, hvor projekterne er komplekse og hvor der kræves stor detaljegrad.

Du trives i dialogen med både kolleger og samarbejdspartnere, og du motiveres af at skabe gode løsninger sammen med andre. Du tager gerne initiativ og følger op, når projekterne bevæger sig fremad. Du kan lide at få ting til at ske.

Som person kan man sige om dig, at du:

· Er ambitiøs og arbejder løsningsorienteret

· Arbejder struktureret og vedholdende

· Trives med at arbejde med høj detaljegrad og har blik for de rigtige løsninger

· Tager ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrager fagligt og socialt i teamet

· Behersker Revit og har generelt gode IT-kompetencer

Dine muligheder hos Daugaard Pedersen

Du bliver en del af en særdeles veldrevet entreprenørvirksomhed, hvor der er et godt og udviklende fagligt miljø med både yngre og mere erfarne medarbejdere. Det gode byggeri prioriteres, og der bruges tid på at ’nørde’ med det byggetekniske i projekterne. I afdelingen for ”Design & Bæredygtighed” får du ca. 10 gode kolleger, der udvikler og projekterer spændende og bæredygtige byggerier inden for erhverv og bolig.

Virksomheden er kendetegnet ved en uformel kultur, hvor samarbejde og kommunikation vægtes højt. Her er et inspirerende og fagligt stærkt miljø, som åbner for gode muligheder for både personlig og professionel udvikling. Du får chancen for virkelig at sætte dit præg på projekterne, både gennem din viden og dit engagement.

Ansøgning

Daugaard Pedersen samarbejder med GML A/S om denne rekruttering. Du er velkommen til at kontakte Konsulent hos GML A/S, Mads Nielsen, på telefon 2364 4649 for at høre mere om stillingen. Enhver henvendelse behandles fortroligt. Send dit CV og gerne lidt materiale af hvad du har arbejdet med via ’Søg Stillingen’. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

title: Medical Editor
description:
Under the direction of the Editorial Director, the Medical Editor is primarily responsible for ensuring the overall editorial quality of medical communications content by providing medical editing for accuracy, clarity, consistency, grammar, and style. Primary responsibilities include working independently to fact-check content, proofread and edit copy, and ensure adherence to client and project requirements, American Medical Association (AMA) Manual of Style, client corporate and brand style guides, and agency standards. The Medical Editor is also responsible for Veeva Vault submissions and reference library upkeep, as well as permissions requests. The Medical Editor works closely with members of the Editorial Services, Medical Services, and Creative Services teams to ensure deliverables meet the highest standards of quality and accuracy.

Job Duties

  • Fact-check, substantively edit, and proofread all medical communications materials (eg, slide presentations, meeting materials, video scripts, flashcards, websites)
  • Check layouts and digital programming for completeness and accuracy against manuscript drafts and client-approved files
  • Check incorporation of changes into layout document or programmed digital files by Creative Services at various stages of the project lifecycle
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of reference lists
  • Determine and communicate need for copyright permissions to reproduce figures/tables and obtain permissions from publishers; communicate costs to Account Services to ensure communication to clients as appropriate
  • Prep and submit pieces through the Veeva Vault system
  • Serve as subject-matter expert regarding client and AMA style, grammar, and usage, as well as agency standards
  • Create, maintain, and adhere to project-, product-, and client-specific style guides where applicable to ensure consistency across projects
  • Collaborate with Medical Services and Creative Services department personnel to ensure accuracy of content and convey editorial comments
  • Assist colleagues with editorial problem-solving, troubleshooting, and brainstorming
  • Attend product status meetings to keep abreast of upcoming or in-progress editorial projects

Key Competencies

  • Ability to coordinate and execute multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment to serve many therapeutic teams and meet project goals
  • Attention to detail and ability to work under tight timelines
  • Familiarity with general scientific concepts and ability to grasp more complex scientific applications
  • Excellent knowledge of grammar and usage, medical writing style guidelines (ie, AMA Manual of Style), and promotional activity regulations and specifications
  • Expert knowledge of Microsoft (MS) Word and PowerPoint applications
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and Adobe® Acrobat applications
  • Working knowledge of Veeva Vault preferred, but training will be provided
  • Working knowledge of permissions process preferred, but training will be provided
  • High level of integrity, confidentiality, and accountability
  • Well-developed professional communication skills, including written and interpersonal
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to master various content management systems
  • Desire to meet professional goals and acquire new skills

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree (science or English degrees preferred)
  • 3-5 years’ pharmaceutical/medical editing experience

Preferred Skills/Experience

  • 2 years’ experience specifically working as an editor for a medical communications agency or pharmaceutical company marketing department
  • Familiarity with agency workflow process
  • Familiarity with electronic document review systems

Working Conditions

  • Ability to commit to extra hours and/or nontraditional hours as client needs require

title: Azure Platform Architect
description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Senior Azure Architect får du en central rolle i platformens tekniske udvikling. Du bliver medansvarlig for, at FMP har en tydelig arkitektur, kan skaleres på tværs af kunder og samtidig er sikker, driftsvenlig og enkel at videreudvikle.

Du arbejder både strategisk og hands-on. Du skal kunne drive en designproces og træffe tekniske beslutninger, men også være tæt nok på implementeringen til at sikre, at arkitekturen fungerer i praksis.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sætte teknisk retning for FMP og omsætte den til konkrete, prioriterede forbedringer

  • Designe standardiserede og skalerbare løsninger på tværs af kundemiljøer

  • Drive teknisk afklaring og udarbejde korte, præcise designdokumenter

  • Sikre sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, sikkerhed, governance, drift og kundeoplevelse

  • Kvalificere komplekse kundekrav og omsætte dem til genanvendelige funktioner og services

  • Foretage tekniske reviews og sikre kvalitet i design og implementering

  • Identificere teknisk gæld, risici og muligheder for automatisering

  • Understøtte onboarding af komplekse kunder og håndtere tekniske eskalationer

  • Sparre med kunder, arkitekter og interne interessenter om roadmap og løsningsvalg

  • Mentorere kolleger og bidrage til at løfte teamets tekniske niveau

  • Skabe fælles standarder, dokumentation og beslutningsgrundlag

  • Bidrage aktivt til implementering, fejlsøgning og proof of concepts, når opgaven kræver det

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Det betyder blandt andet, at vi skaber fælles kontekst, før vi implementerer, begrænser mængden af igangværende arbejde og prioriterer små leverancer, der hurtigt kan valideres.

I rollen får du et særligt ansvar for, at designafklaringen har den rette kvalitet. Det handler ikke om at producere tunge arkitekturdokumenter, men om at gøre mål, afhængigheder, risici, test og væsentlige beslutninger tydelige, mensdet stadig er billigt at ændre retning.

Du bliver ikke den eneste, der må træffe tekniske beslutninger. En vigtig del af rollen er netop at skabe rammer, viden og fælles principper, så teamet kan tage et bredere teknisk ejerskab.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får en central rolle i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande, og platformensbeslutninger skal derfor kunne fungere i flere organisatoriske og kundemæssige sammenhænge.

Vi lykkes som team og forventer, at du bidrager med både teknisk retning og plads til andres perspektiver. Rollen handler ikke om at være den person, der har alle svarene, men om at hjælpe teamet med at stille de rigtige spørgsmåog træffe holdbare beslutninger.

Om dine komptencer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en solid baggrund inden for Azure, cloudarkitektur eller platform engineering og har erfaring med at tage teknisk ansvar for løsninger, der skal være robuste, sikre og skalerbare over tid. Du har arbejdet hands-on med Azure-platformen og designet arkitekturer, hvor sikkerhed, governance, drift og fleksibilitet har været centrale hensyn. Samtidig er du komfortabel med Infrastructure as Code, automatisering og CI/CD og ser værdien i at bygge platforme, der er enkle at vedligeholde og nemme at videreudvikle.

Som person er du i stand til at omsætte komplekse forretningsmæssige og tekniske krav til en klar teknisk retning. Du kan hurtigt identificere de væsentligste risici og afvejninger i en løsning og træffe velbegrundede beslutninger på den baggrund. Derudover formår du at kommunikere arkitektur og tekniske valg på en måde, der giver mening for både specialister, kunder og beslutningstagere.

Det er også vigtigt for os, at du trives i en rolle, hvor du gør andre bedre. Du har erfaring med faglig sparring, tekniske reviews eller mentoring og motiveres af at dele viden og skabe retning uden selv at blive en flaskehals for teamet. Du arbejder godt i krydsfeltet mellem langsigtet platformudvikling og konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du både bidrager strategisk og får tingene til at ske i praksis.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har dyb erfaring med flere af følgende områder:

  • Azure landing zones og platformarkitektur

  • Azure Policy, management groups, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID

  • Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende Infrastructure as Code

  • Azure DevOps, Git, branchingstrategier og CI/CD

  • Platform engineering og self-service-koncepter

  • Security by design og Zero Trust

  • Monitorering, logging, observability og incident management

  • Cloud Adoption Framework og Well-Architected Framework

  • FinOps og optimering af cloudforbrug

  • Produktudvikling eller udvikling af fælles platformskapabiliteter

Om dig

Du tager ansvar for helheden og interesserer dig både for den tekniske løsning, teamets arbejdsgang og den værdi, kunden oplever.

Du kan træffe beslutninger, når det er nødvendigt, men er samtidig nysgerrig på andres perspektiver. Du bruger review og faglig uenighed til at forbedre løsningen frem for til at forsvare dit eget forslag.

Du er pragmatisk og kan skelne mellem beslutninger, der kræver grundig afklaring, og detaljer, der med fordel kan vente. Du ved også, at en arkitektur først har værdi, når teamet kan forstå, implementere og drive den.

Når noget går galt, søger du efter årsagen i systemet og arbejdsformen frem for efter den skyldige. Du deler din viden aktivt og arbejder bevidst på at gøre teamet mindre afhængigt af enkeltpersoner.

title: Principal Hardware Engineer: High Speed Mixed Signal Designer
description:
At Atom Computing, we build quantum computers using arrays of optically trapped neutral atoms that will empower customers to achieve unprecedented computational breakthroughs. Join a world-class team of scientists, engineers, and business professionals to advance the state-of-the-art in quantum computing.

Atom Computing is seeking a hands-on Principal Hardware Engineer with specific expertise in high speed mixed-signal design to lead the architecture, implementation, and deployment of custom electronic assemblies for the control system of our quantum computer. In this role, you will drive hardware strategy across multiple concurrent projects while remaining deeply engaged in the tactical engineering work

This position is located in Boulder, Colorado, and will report to the Control Systems Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Drive high level system architectures for instruments with partitioning functions across PCBAs, guiding FPGA/control selection, and setting power, clocking, and interconnect strategy
  • Advise or guide technical approach for high-speed mixed-signal front ends, including analog/RF signal chains, DAC and ADC selection, and the noise, linearity, and phase-noise requirements
  • Lead and mentor the team through instrument design, including early brainstorming, simulation, and prototyping, actively participating in schematic and layout design reviews, and collaborating during board bring-up and characterization.
  • Collaborate with quantum engineers and other groups to understand system needs, discuss solutions and define hardware design requirements.

Experience & Education

  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 10+ years of relevant postgraduate professional experience in board-level analog and digital circuit design, preferably with Altium Designer.
  • Direct experience designing boards with large, high pin count ICs (FPGAs, processors) with interfaces to high speed communication busses, memory, sophisticated clocking, and high speed analog / RF circuitry

Required Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and driven to work effectively in a fast-growing startup environment.
  • Experience teaching and mentoring others in hardware design concepts and process
  • Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with a diverse team of experimental physicists, hardware, and software engineers.
  • Strong grasp of PCB design best practices across the full design cycle, from concept through fabrication and bring-up and production
  • Mixed signal design experience
  • Demonstrated proficiency with electronic test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum and logic analyzers, signal generators) for the bring-up and debug of prototype electronics assemblies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with RF design concepts and/or software defined radio
  • Experience with high speed digital and analog I/O and connector/cable selection and characterization
  • Experience with multi-gigabit serial transceiver lane design, evaluation, equalization
  • Experience with IBIS-AMI modeling and correlation for multi-gigabit serial interfaces
  • Capable in scripting languages (e.g., Python) for basic data acquisition, instrument control, and automating hardware test and characterization.
  • Experience designing high speed memory interfaces
  • Experience working in a Linux environment
  • Familiarity with the MicroTCA, PXIe, or similar pluggable instrument standards

Atom Computing provides a wide variety of perks and benefits, including fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for our employees and their dependents. Additionally, unlimited paid time off, 401K company matching, short- and long-term disability, FSA, dependent care benefits, and life insurance. We also offer drinks, snacks, and catered team lunches in our offices, every day!

The base salary range for this position is between $180,000 - $220,000 annually, commensurate with experience. In addition to salary, we offer an annual bonus and equity in the company.

title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description:
ISA is seeking a highly skilled and motivated FPGA Firmware Developer to join our growing team. This position involves designing, developing, and testing high-performance signal processing applications using Xilinx RFSoC, MPSoC, and Versal devices. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in FPGA development, a deep understanding of signal processing algorithms and implementations, and experience working with modern Xilinx FPGAs in complex systems.

Responsibilities:

  • FPGA Design & Development:
    • Design, implement, and optimize signal processing applications on Xilinx RFSoC, MPSoC, and Versal platforms.
    • Develop high-performance FPGA firmware using VHDL/Verilog, leveraging Xilinx development tools such as Vivado, Xilinx SDK, and Vitis.
    • Implement digital signal processing (DSP) algorithms and interfaces for high-speed data processing, including but not limited to filtering, modulation, demodulation, and error correction.
  • System Integration:
    • Integrate FPGA designs with embedded systems and software applications.
    • Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure efficient data flow between FPGA and host processors.
    • Develop and test interfaces to external peripherals, including ADCs, DACs, and RF components.
  • Testing & Debugging:
    • Create comprehensive testbenches to validate FPGA designs.
    • Perform functional verification and debug issues related to signal processing operations and hardware-software integration.
    • Use debugging tools such as Vivado Logic Analyzer and other software tools to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues.
  • Performance Optimization:
    • Optimize firmware for performance, including resource utilization (LUTs, BRAM, DSP slices), clock rates, and power consumption.
    • Conduct timing analysis and work to meet stringent timing and throughput requirements for signal processing applications.
  • Collaboration & Documentation:
    • Work closely with software engineers, hardware designers, and system architects to ensure seamless integration of FPGA-based solutions into larger systems.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in FPGA firmware development.
    • Proven experience in FPGA firmware development with Xilinx RFSoC and/or MPSoC devices.
    • Experience with signal processing algorithms and their implementation on FPGA platforms.
    • Experience with system integration and debugging tools (e.g., Vivado, serial protocol analyzers, Oscilloscopes, logic analyzers).
  • Technical Skills:
    • Strong proficiency in VHDL or Verilog for FPGA design.
    • Hands-on experience with Xilinx Vivado, Vitis, and SDK tools.
    • Knowledge of digital communication systems and DSP algorithms (e.g., FIR/IIR filters, FFTs, modulation techniques).
    • Familiarity with high-speed serial interfaces such as JESD204B, PCIe, or similar.
  • Soft Skills:
    • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
    • Team player with excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with technical teams, leadership and customers.
    • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Other:
    • Position requires TOP SECRET/SCI security clearance. Employment at ISA requires US citizenship.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Python and/or C/C++ for embedded software development.
  • Familiarity with Matlab for design and analysis
  • Experience with RFSoC and Versal devices
  • Experience with high-speed data converters (ADC/DAC) integration.
  • Experience with multi-core processor systems and embedded real-time operating systems (RTOS).
  • Prior experience with real-time FPGA-based signal processing applications.
  • Knowledge of RF signal processing and related hardware interfaces.
  • Experience in the defense, telecommunications, or aerospace sectors.

We offer a compensation package that includes a competitive base salary plus annual performance bonus and benefits. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as candidate's work experience, education, training & skills, as well as market and business considerations. We are also open to considering candidates with experience and qualifications at a different level than required in a job posting, which may affect the compensation package offered.

Salary Range
$145,000—$185,000 USD

Company Overview:

Innovative Signal Analysis, Inc. is a leading provider of real-time signal and image processing systems for the government and remains dedicated to the development of high performance signal processing solutions. ISA works in all phases from concept design, through development and integration, to operations and maintenance of challenging mission critical systems.

Innovative Signal Analysis & HawkEye 360 are committed to hiring and retaining a diverse workforce. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, making decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

title: Senior Product Manager - Seller Experience
description:
StubHub is on a mission to redefine the live event experience on a global scale. Whether someone is looking to attend their first event or their hundredth, we’re here to delight them all the way from the moment they start looking for a ticket until they step through the gate. The same goes for our sellers. From fans selling a single ticket to the promoters of a worldwide stadium tour, we want StubHub to be the safest, most convenient way to offer a ticket to the millions of fans who browse our platform around the world.

To enable millions of users to explore, interact with, and participate in live events worldwide, StubHub is seeking a Senior Product Manager to manage the development of next-generation technologies and innovative, impactful features. You’ll lead our Seller Experience, Post-Purchase org, responsible for delivering on the strategy and execution of the end-to-end seller experience, after sellers list their tickets on our platform. You will build and launch products that drive trustworthy, low-friction buyer and seller experiences, and evolve our incentives and policies for sellers. This is an opportunity for a strong PM to lead and build AI/Automation capabilities that result in improved seller experiences, provide faster and clearer decisions and drive more efficient operations on a global scale.

Location: Hybrid (3 days in office / 2 days remote) – Century City, CA

About the Team:

We provide a world class end-to-end post-purchase seller experience designed to deliver a consistently great buyer experience. We solve for the largest seller pain points with holistic product led solutions and build clear, fair policies and incentives that elevate seller performance. Our work balances accountability with enablement: we reduce friction for good sellers through better education and incentives while increasing the effectiveness of enforcement when standards aren’t met.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the strategy for the Seller Experience, Post-Purchase and translate it into a prioritized, measurable roadmap aligned to company goals.
  • Reduce seller friction via proactive policy communications, in-product guidance, and self-serve payment and dispute workflows that resolve issues quickly and teach best practices.
  • Design, automate, and evolve policy architecture from one-size-fits-all to targeted frameworks that vary by seller segment, geo, event type, and risk profile, enabling faster iteration and better outcomes.
  • Refine and build our incentive mechanisms for sellers and subsequent innovations, including rules, punishments, and positive incentives.
  • Increase enforcement effectiveness by improving issue detection and collections flows – raising the recoup rate of seller fines while minimizing impact on good-faith sellers.
  • Lead cross-functional execution with Engineering, Operations, CS, Strategic Finance and Legal; write crisp specs, sequence delivery, and manage trade-offs.
  • Measure and analyze end-to-end customer experience and policy funnels, running experiments to improve the seller experience and tune incentives and penalties.
  • Champion a culture that moves fast responsibly – shipping iteratively while safeguarding marketplace trust and the bottom line.
  • Assist with building and developing a more mature seller experience organization.

What You’ve Done:

  • 6+ years in Product Management (or equivalent) with experience in two-sided marketplaces, policy & incentives design, enterprise customers or workflow/UX systems.
  • Shipped scaled, enterprise products, with highly technical foundational, platform-like services.
  • Customer obsessed, with demonstrable results in building product led solutions to improve the customer experience.
  • Able to break down complex systems into understandable components; excellent written specs and stakeholder communication across Engineering, Legal, Risk, Finance, and Ops.
  • Strong analytical chops; comfortable defining metrics and digging into data with tools like SQL, Snowflake, and Tableau to solve problems and analyze experiments.

What We Offer:

  • Accelerated Growth Environment: An environment designed for swift skill and knowledge enhancement, where you have the autonomy to lead experiments and tests on a massive scale.
  • Top Tier Compensation Package: Competitive base, equity, and upside that tracks with your impact.
  • Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited Flex Time Off, giving you the flexibility to manage your schedule and take time to recharge as needed.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package: Prioritize your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package, featuring 401k, and premium Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance options.

The anticipated gross base pay range is below for this role. Actual compensation will vary depending on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, experience, and competencies. Base annual salary is one component of StubHub’s total compensation and competitive benefits package, which includes equity, 401(k), paid time off, paid parental leave, and comprehensive health benefits.

Salary Range
$175,000—$270,000 USD
About Us
StubHub is the world’s leading marketplace to buy and sell tickets to any live event, anywhere. Through StubHub in North America and viagogo, our international platform, we service customers in 195 countries in 33 languages and 49 available currencies. With more than 300 million tickets available annually on our platform to events around the world -- from sports to music, comedy to dance, festivals to theater -- StubHub offers the safest, most convenient way to buy or sell tickets to the most memorable live experiences.   • Installation og idriftsættelse af sikringsløsninger

For dig, der vil udvikle dig teknisk og fagligt

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Commerce is a foundational platform at Atlassian that powers how millions of users and enterprise customers discover, try, buy, and manage products. title: Part Time Satış Danışmanı (Bursa Anatolium)
description:
NELER YAPACAKSIN

Satış Danışmanı olarak, mükemmel müşteri deneyimi yaratmada önemli bir rol oynayacaksın. Müşterileri karşılayacak, mağazanda onlara rehberlik edecek ve sergilenen ürünlerimiz arasından ihtiyaç duyduklarını bulmaları için yardımcı olacaksın. Değerlerimiz doğrultusunda hareket ederek, hem kendi başarına hem de şirketin başarısına katkıda bulunacaksın.

Senden beklenenler:

  • Müşterilerin bilinçli seçimler yapmalarına yardımcı olmak için moda ve ürün bilgini paylaşmak.
  • Müşteri Sadakat programını (H&M Member) aktif olarak tanıtarak, müşteri yolculuğunun her adımında ekibinizle işbirliği yaparak olağanüstü hizmet sunmak.
  • Satış alanının ve arka ofisin doğru stok seviyesine sahip, düzenli ve davetkar olduğundan emin olmak.
  • Mağazanın açılış ve kapanışını desteklemek.
  • Tüm müşteri etkileşimlerinde kendinini ve markayı olumlu bir şekilde temsil etmek.

​KİMLERLE ÇALIŞACAKSINIZ

Mağazalarımız şirketimizin kalbidir, müşterilerimizin markamızı doğrudan deneyimlediği yerlerdir. Dinamik Mağaza Ekibinin bir parçası olarak, Satış Danışmanlarından, Departman Müdürlerinden, Mağaza Müdürlerinden ve Görsel Düzenleme Sorumlularından, Kasa Ofis Sorumlusuna kadar her rol, ilham verici ve misafirperver bir ortam yaratmaya katkıda bulunur. Ayrıca, iç görüleri paylaşmak ve birlikte başarıya ulaşmak için mağazalar arasında iş birliği yaparak Bölge Ekibiyle bağlantı kuracaksın. Birlikte çalıştığın ekiple birlikte, müşterilerin kendilerini güvende hissetmelerine ve en son trendler ve zamansız stillerle bireyselliklerini ifade etmelerine yardımcı olmakta önemli bir rol oynayacaksın. Mağazalarımızdaki müşterilerimizle anlamlı bağlantılar kurarak, modayı herkes için erişilebilir ve sürdürülebilir hale getiriyoruz.

SENDEN NELER BEKLİYORUZ

İşte senden beklediğimiz özellikler…

  • Moda, perakende veya benzer alanlarda müşteri hizmetleri deneyimi tercih sebebi olarak değerlendirilebilir.
  • Müşterilere yardımcı olma tutkusu ve moda veya perakende ile ilgili olmak – geriye kalanları sana biz öğreteceğiz!

Ve…

  • İş birlikçi ve dinamik ortamlarda başarılı.
  • İletişimi güçlü, yaratıcı, mağazacılık teknolojisiyle çalışmaya meraklı, öğrenmeye ve gelişmeye istekli.
  • Esnek ve eylem odaklı.

BİZ KİMİZ

H&M Group, güçlü moda markaları ve girişimlerinden oluşan küresel bir şirkettir. Amacımız, olağanüstü tasarım, uygun fiyatlar ve sürdürülebilir çözümler arasında hiçbir taviz olmadığını kanıtlamaktır. Modayı birçok kişi için özgürleştirmek istiyoruz ve müşterilerimiz aldığımız her kararın merkezinde yer alıyor.

Paylaştığımız kültür ve değerlerle birleşmiş binlerce tutkulu ve yetenekli meslektaşımızdan oluşuyoruz. Birlikte, gücümüzü, ölçeğimizi ve bilgimizi kullanarak moda endüstrisini daha kapsayıcı ve sürdürülebilir bir geleceğe taşımak istiyoruz.​

BURADA ÇALIŞMAYI NEDEN SEVECEKSİN

H&M Group'ta, canlı ve misafirperver bir şirket olmaktan gurur duyuyoruz. Çalışanlarımıza dünya çapında kapsamlı gelişim fırsatlarıyla, cazip avantajlar sunuyoruz.

  • Tüm H&M Grubu markalarında hem mağazalarda hem de online olarak (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories ve ARKET) %25 personel indirimi.
  • H&M Teşvik Programı HIP. Program hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin. H&M Incentive Program.
  • Yemek Yardımı
  • Ulaşım Yardımı
  • Doğum Yardımı
  • Mazaret İzni (Ücretli)
  • Taşınma İzni
  • Doğum Günü İzni (1 yıl boyunca bizimle çalışma sonrası)
  • Özel durumlar için ilave ücretli izinler (Örnek: ek doğum, hamilelik izinleri)
  • Yıl Dönümü Kutlaması – 10 yıl ve üzeri bizimle çalışan ekip arkadaşlarımız

BİZE KATILIN

Bizim benzersizliğimiz, birçok şeyin birleşiminden gelir – kapsayıcı ve işbirlikçi kültürümüz, güçlü değerlerimiz ve büyüme fırsatlarımız. Ancak en önemlisi, bizi biz yapan insanlarımızdır.

Bu, Bursa Anatolium AVM'de bulunan yarı zamanlı bir pozisyondur. Başvurunuzu en kısa sürede, ancak en geç 04 Ekim 2026 tarihine kadar CV'nizi göndererek yapmanızı rica ederiz. Veri politikaları nedeniyle, yalnızca kariyer sayfası üzerinden yapılan başvuruları kabul ediyoruz.

​Birlikte kariyerinizde bir sonraki adımı atalım. Yolculuk burada başlıyor.​

*Mağaza Rollerinin Değerlendirilmesi

Satış Danışmanı pozisyonu için beklenen yüksek başvuru hacmini etkin bir şekilde yönetmek amacıyla, tüm mağazalarımızda yetkinlik bazlı işe alım için çevrimiçi değerlendirme yöntemini kullanıyoruz. Bu, başvuru ve eleme sürecinizin bir parçası olarak çevrimiçi bir değerlendirmeden geçeceğiniz anlamına gelir.Yanıtlarınız, H&M Group tarafından belirlenen önceden tanımlanmış kriterleri uygulayan bir değerlendirme aracı tarafından puanlanacaktır.

Değerlendirmeden sonra geri bildirimde bulunma ve soru sorma fırsatına sahipsiniz. Çevrimiçi değerlendirme yöntemiyle ilgili herhangi bir zorluk veya endişeniz varsa, recruitment_support@hm.com adresinden alternatif bir değerlendirme yöntemi talep edebilirsiniz. Alternatif bir yöntemi seçmek, pozisyon için değerlendirilme şansınızı etkilemeyecektir.

Kişisel verilerinizin tarafımızca nasıl işlendiği hakkında daha fazla bilgi için lütfen Gizlilik Politikamızı inceleyin.

** Adil ve eşit bir süreç yürütüyoruz ve bu nedenle bilinçsiz önyargılara neden olabilecek bir ön yazıyı başvurunuza eklememenizi rica ediyoruz.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
La risorsa entrerà a far parte del team di delivery Salesforce e si occuperà di:

  • Analizzare i requisiti funzionali e tradurli in soluzioni tecniche scalabili.
  • Sviluppare e manutenere applicazioni sulla piattaforma Salesforce.
  • Realizzare componenti custom utilizzando Apex, SOQL e Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Configurare e sviluppare automazioni tramite Salesforce Flow.
  • Implementare Trigger Apex seguendo le best practice Salesforce.
  • Integrare Salesforce con sistemi esterni tramite API REST e SOAP.
  • Gestire deployment e rilasci nei diversi ambienti.
  • Collaborare con Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, Architect e Project Manager.
  • Garantire qualità del codice attraverso attività di testing, code review e documentazione tecnica.
  • Contribuire al miglioramento continuo delle soluzioni e dei processi di sviluppo.
  • Esperienza tra 3-5 anni nello sviluppo Salesforce.
  • Ottima conoscenza di:
    • Apex
    • Trigger Apex
    • Salesforce Flow
    • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
    • SOQL e SOSL
    • Validation Rules
    • Approval Processes
    • Security Model Salesforce (Profili, Permission Set, Sharing Rules)
  • Esperienza nello sviluppo di integrazioni tramite API REST e SOAP.
  • Conoscenza degli strumenti di deployment e versionamento (Git, CI/CD).
  • Esperienza con Salesforce Data Loader e strumenti di migrazione dati.
  • Conoscenza delle best practice Salesforce e dei governor limits.
  • Laurea in ambito STEM e/o diploma tecnico o corso di formazione tecnica specialistico
  • Esperienza nel coordinamento di attività tecniche e/o di team di modesta dimensione
  • Esperienza nel trasferimento di know-how e on-boarding di colleghi junior
  • Buona padronanza della lingua inglese

Ti offriamo l’opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico, su progetti nazionali ed internazionali, che ti permetta di approfondire continuamente le tue conoscenze e di sviluppare le tue competenze.

Se vuoi dare una spinta alla tua carriera ed entrare a far parte di una società di servizi IT leader in Europa ed in continua crescita, inviaci il tuo curriculum!

Per questa posizione è prevista una RAL compresa tra € 33.000 e € 40.000.

Le sedi di lavoro disponibili sono: ASSAGO (MI), ROMA, POZZUOLI (NA) con possibilità, compatibilmente con l'attività svolta, di aderire all’accordo di smart working secondo quanto previsto dalla nostra policy aziendale. È comunque richiesta la disponibilità a compiere trasferte sul territorio nazionale e internazionale.

Scopri Sopra Steria! Visita il nostro sito e rimani aggiornato attraverso il blog e le pagine social

title: Prodejní poradce/poradkyně, zkrácený pracovní poměr 10h/20h týdně, Praha Palladium
description:
CO BUDETE DĚLAT

Jako Prodejní poradce/poradkyně v H&M budete klíčovou součástí týmu a pomůžete zákazníkům najít to, co hledají. Přivítáte je v prodejně, poradíte jim s výběrem a zajistíte, aby měli skvělý zákaznický zážitek. Svou energií a přístupem přispějete nejen k vlastnímu úspěchu, ale i k úspěchu celého týmu.

  • Pomáhat zákazníkům s výběrem a sdílet své znalosti o módě
  • Spolupracovat s kolegy a zajistit, aby byl obchod vždy přehledný a dobře zásobený
  • Podílet se na otevírání a zavírání prodejny
  • Reprezentovat značku H&M s pozitivním přístupem

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAT

Naše prodejny jsou srdcem společnosti – místem, kde zákazníci zažívají naši značku na vlastní kůži. Jako součást dynamického týmu, který tvoří Prodejní poradci, Store Manageři, Visual Merchandiseři a další kolegové, budete přispívat k příjemné atmosféře a skvělému zákaznickému servisu. Spolupracovat budete nejen se svým týmem, a společně se budete podílet na úspěchu. Pomůžete zákazníkům cítit se sebevědomě a vyjádřit svůj styl – a tím přispějete k tomu, aby byla móda dostupná a udržitelná pro všechny.

KOHO HLEDÁME

Hledáme nadšené lidi, kteří:

  • Mají zkušenosti se zákaznickým servisem v oblasti módy, retailu nebo podobném oboru (není podmínkou, ale výhodou).
  • Baví je móda a chtějí zákazníkům zajistit skvělý zákaznický zážitek.
  • Rádi pracují v dynamickém a týmovém prostředí.
  • Jsou komunikativní, kreativní a otevření novým technologiím.
  • Jsou flexibilní, proaktivní a ochotní učit se nové věci.
  • Mají češtinu na minimální úrovni B2
  • Otevření odpoledním směnám (do cca 22:00) a víkendové práci

PROČ SE K NÁM PŘIDAT
V H&M Group jsme hrdí na to, že jsme živou a přátelskou společností. Našim zaměstnancům nabízíme benefity a rozsáhlé rozvojové příležitosti po celém světě.

  • 25% sleva na všechny značky skupiny H&M – nakupujte výhodně v prodejnách i online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET).
  • Motivační program H&M HIP – Více informací najdete zde.​
  • Stravenkový paušál 90 CZK za každou odpracovanou směnu – při plném měsíčním úvazku až 1890 CZK navíc.
  • Multisport karta – udržujte se fit s přístupem do stovek sportovišť po celé ČR.
  • Odměna za doporučení nového kolegy až 7000 CZK – pomozte nám najít nové talenty a buďte za to odměněni.
  • 21 dní dovolené + až 4 Relaxing Days navíc – čas na odpočinek je u nás prioritou.
  • Jubilejní dny volna až 3 dny – oslavte pracovní výročí s volnem navíc.
  • Rozsáhlý školící program – investujeme do vašeho rozvoje od prvního dne.
  • Skvělé příležitosti pro kariérní růst – podpoříme vás na každém kroku vaší profesní cesty.

PŘIDEJTE SE K NÁM
Naše jedinečnost vychází z mnoha faktorů – inkluzivní a spolupracující kultury, silných hodnot i možností růstu. Především jsou to, ale naši zaměstnanci, kteří dělají H&M tím, čím je.

Jedná se o pozici na zkrácený úvazek (10 nebo 20 hodin týdně), se sídlem ve Praze. Přihlaste se zasláním životopisu co nejdříve, nejpozději však do 14.10.2026 .

Vzhledem k zásadám ochrany osobních údajů přijímáme žádosti pouze prostřednictvím kariérní stránky.

Udělejte další krok ve své kariéře společně s námi. Vaše cesta začíná právě tady.

*Hodnocení rolí v obchodě:
Abysme, zvládli vysoký objem žádostí na pozici Prodejního poradce, používáme v našich obchodech online hodnotící metodu pro nábor založený na dovednostech. Hodnocení je součást procesu žádosti a výběru. Vaše odpovědi budou hodnoceny nástrojem, který používá předem stanovená kritéria stanovená skupinou H&M.

Po dokončení hodnocení budete mít možnost sdílet zpětnou vazbu a klást otázky. Pokud narazíte na nějaké potíže nebo preferujete alternativní metodu hodnocení, kontaktujte prosím recruitment_support@hm.com. Výběr alternativy nebude mít vliv na vaši žádost.

Pro více informací o tom, jak zpracováváme vaše osobní údaje, prosím, podívejte se na naše Oznámení o ochraně soukromí.

** Zavazujeme se k náborovému procesu, který je spravedlivý, rovný a založený na kompetencích. Proto vás laskavě žádáme, abyste k vaší žádosti nepřikládali motivační dopis.

title: Operations Associate, Full-Time - Stanford Shopping Center
description:
Who we are:

Since 2009, we've been on a mission to bring sustainable fashion to everyone. Named one of Fast Company’s Brands That Matter and winning a Best Carbon Footprint award, we have big goals like being Climate Positive by 2025, Circular by 2030, and pushing the whole industry forward along the way. Our work has gotten love in Drapers and Sourcing Journal, and TIME wrote about how great our CEO, Hali Borenstein, is. Basically, we're saving the Earth and looking damn good doing it.

We're a global brand with 50+ stores (and counting) around the world, and our own sustainable factory in LA. We innovate across categories like accessories, swimwear, and sleepwear, and we reach millions of people with campaigns like this, this and this.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.

And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

Work Location/ Schedule:

  • Available to work a minimum of 30 hours per week, but up to 40 hours per week
  • Daily open availability across a full 7 day work week
  • Able to work flexible schedule (days, nights, weekends, & holidays if required to meet the needs of the business)

Sales Associate:

No position at Reformation is about the status quo, every team member is passionate about building a company rooted in excellence. Obsessed with customers and sustainability we use tech to create a unique interaction between our customers, employees, and the Reformation brand. The Associate will execute all efforts required to achieve individual sales goals.

Reporting to the Store Manager, essential responsibilities include but are not limited to:

What You’ll Do:

  • Consistently meet and exceed sales goals.
  • Assist in clientele generation through customer engagement.
  • Contribute to an in-store experience for customers that both surprises and delights them.
  • Deliver and foster a culture of an excellent client experience through a customer first mindset to build long term loyal client relationships.
  • Deliver an elevated client experience acting as a brand ambassador - embody brand values, engage customers on the brand and share the stories of Reformation with a focus on educating on sustainability.
  • Maintain extraordinary customer experience feedback and scoring on service evaluation through NPS.
  • Understand the need for consistent inventory accuracy and controls in store.
  • Contribute to Loss Prevention in all areas of the business.
  • Uphold time and attendance policy.
  • Ensure the selling floor reflects the brand and concept standards at all times.
  • Share your deep knowledge about our product with genuine enthusiasm.
  • Communicate product feedback based on customer feedback so we can continuously make our product and merchandising better.
  • Help ensure that the store environment is inspiring and our product is easily accessible.
  • Understand the core values and culture of Reformation and reflect these in all efforts.
  • Maintain and uphold a professional, healthy, and productive work environment.

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience working with a sales or retail organization and/or operationally intensive business
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced setting
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact effectively with diverse personalities
  • Driven approach to take on new challenges with the self-motivation for your work and career

FT Associate additions, include but are not limited to:

  • Be a leader among your peers - consistently deliver results at the highest level with sales, customer experience and clienteling
  • Serve as an expert resource - provide expertise on brand, key customer issues, and partner with peers to provide support

Compensation:

At Reformation, we believe in transparency and equity when it comes to compensation. For this role, the anticipated base hourly range is $16 - $25 per hour, depending on a variety of factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal compensation equity.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Eligible employees get employer-sponsored private medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as commuter benefits to help support your travel to and from work.
  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave, and company holidays for eligible employees.
  • We offer retirement planning support for eligible employees, including the option to invest in Environmental Social Governance-aligned (fancy way to say sustainable) funds.
  • We’re a mission-based company with offices in LA, NYC and London, as well as a global retail team, which means you’ll get to collaborate with people all around the world.
  • You’ll get access to fertility care support through Carrot, and up to a $5,000 USD reimbursement for related fertility expenses after 1 year of employment.
  • We care about the causes our employees care about so we donate to community efforts on a yearly basis.
  • We offer a clothing discount, culture events (like our annual Ref Values week and Volunteer Time Off), you know, all the meaningful and fun stuff!

Reformation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the world we want to live in. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, or veteran status—in accordance with applicable international, federal, state, and local laws.

If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to ensure you have what you need to show up as your best self.

Still don’t know if you should apply? We get it—studies show that many women and individuals from historically underrepresented communities hold back from applying unless they meet every single requirement. At Reformation, we’re all about growth, not gatekeeping. If you’re passionate about the role and excited about making fashion more sustainable, we’d love to hear from you. If this role doesn’t totally excite you, consider applying to our general application.

Want some more?! - Sustainability, Forbes, Fast Company
